````markdown
 24: 
 25: ## 1. Placeholder Syntax
 26: 
 27: All placeholders use **curly braces** `{PlaceholderName}` for consistency with common templating systems.
 28: 
 29: ### Conventions
 30: 
 31: | Format | Meaning | Example |
 32: |--------|---------|---------|
 33: | `{Entity}` | PascalCase singular | `Event`, `Order`, `Customer` |
 34: | `{Entities}` | PascalCase plural | `Events`, `Orders`, `Customers` |
 35: | `{entity}` | camelCase singular | `event`, `order`, `customer` |
 36: | `{entities}` | camelCase plural | `events`, `orders`, `customers` |
 37: | `{ENTITY}` | UPPERCASE | `EVENT`, `ORDER`, `CUSTOMER` |
 38: | `_{entity}` | Private field | `_event`, `_order`, `_customer` |
 39: 
 40: ---
 41: 
 42: ## 2. Project Placeholders
 43: 
 44: ### Solution & Project Names
 45: 
 46: | Placeholder | Description | Example Value |
 47: |-------------|-------------|---------------|
 48: | `{Project}` | Solution/project root name | `Explore`, `OrderSystem`, `MyApp` |
 49: | `{Project.Domain}` | Domain layer project | `Explore.Domain` |
 50: | `{Project.Application}` | Application layer project | `Explore.Application` |
 51: | `{Project.Persistence}` | Persistence layer project | `Explore.Persistence` |
 52: | `{Project.Infrastructure}` | Infrastructure layer project | `Explore.Infrastructure` |
 53: | `{Project.API}` | API project | `Explore.API` |
 54: | `{Project.Blazor}` | Blazor Server project | `Explore.Blazor` |
 55: | `{Project.Blazor.Client}` | Blazor WASM project | `Explore.Blazor.Client` |
 56: | `{Project.AppHost}` | Aspire AppHost project | `Explore.AppHost` |
 57: 
 58: ### Database & Context
 59: 
 60: | Placeholder | Description | Example Value |
 61: |-------------|-------------|---------------|
 62: | `{DbContext}` | EF Core DbContext class | `ExploreDbContext`, `AppDbContext` |
 63: | `{ConnectionString}` | Database connection string name | `DefaultConnection` |
 64: | `{DatabaseProvider}` | Database provider | `PostgreSQL`, `SQL Server` |
 65: 
 66: ---
 67: 
 68: ## 3. Entity Placeholders
 69: 
 70: ### Primary Entity
 71: 
 72: | Placeholder | Description | Example Value |
 73: |-------------|-------------|---------------|
 74: | `{Entity}` | Main entity being worked on (PascalCase) | `Event`, `Order`, `Product` |
 75: | `{Entities}` | Plural form | `Events`, `Orders`, `Products` |
 76: | `{entity}` | camelCase for variables | `event`, `order`, `product` |
 77: | `{entities}` | camelCase plural | `events`, `orders`, `products` |
 78: | `_{entity}` | Private field | `_event`, `_order`, `_product` |
 79: 
 80: ### Related Entities
 81: 
 82: | Placeholder | Description | Example Value |
 83: |-------------|-------------|---------------|
 84: | `{RelatedEntity}` | Foreign key target entity | `Organization`, `Category` |
 85: | `{RelatedEntities}` | Plural form | `Organizations`, `Categories` |
 86: | `{ParentEntity}` | Parent in hierarchy | `Category` (self-referencing) |
 87: | `{ChildEntity}` | Child in one-to-many | `OrderItem`, `EventSession` |
 88: | `{ChildEntities}` | Plural form | `OrderItems`, `EventSessions` |
 89: | `{LinkEntity}` | Many-to-many link table | `EventCategories`, `UserRoles` |
 90: 
 91: ### Lookup Tables
 92: 
 93: | Placeholder | Description | Example Value |
 94: |-------------|-------------|---------------|
 95: | `{LookupEntity}` | Lookup/reference table entity | `EventType`, `OrderStatus` |
 96: | `{LookupEntities}` | Plural form | `EventTypes`, `OrderStatuses` |
 97: 
 98: ---
 99: 
100: ## 4. Type Placeholders
101: 
102: ### ID Types
103: 
104: | Placeholder | Description | Typical Value |
105: |-------------|-------------|---------------|
106: | `{IdType}` | Primary key type for main entities | `Guid` |
107: | `{LookupIdType}` | Primary key type for lookup tables | `int` |
108: | `{TenantIdType}` | Tenant identifier type | `Guid` |
109: 
110: ### Common Types
111: 
112: | Placeholder | Description | Example Value |
113: |-------------|-------------|---------------|
114: | `{ResponseType}` | Command response type | `BaseCommandResponse<Guid>` |
115: | `{ListDtoType}` | List DTO type | `List<{Entity}ListDto>` |
116: | `{PaginatedType}` | Paginated response type | `PaginatedResult<{Entity}ListDto>` |
117: 
118: ---
119: 
120: ## 5. Layer Placeholders
121: 
122: ### Namespace Patterns
123: 
124: | Placeholder | Expands To |
125: |-------------|------------|
126: | `{Project.Domain.Namespace}` | `{Project}.Domain` |
127: | `{Project.Application.Namespace}` | `{Project}.Application` |
128: | `{Project.Application.Features.Namespace}` | `{Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}` |
129: | `{Project.Persistence.Namespace}` | `{Project}.Persistence` |
130: | `{Project.API.Namespace}` | `{Project}.API` |
131: 
132: ### File Path Patterns
133: 
134: | Placeholder | Example Path |
135: |-------------|--------------|
136: | `{Entity.Command.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Commands/` |
137: | `{Entity.Query.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Queries/` |
138: | `{Entity.Handler.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/` |
139: | `{Entity.Dto.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/` |
140: | `{Entity.Validator.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/` |
141: | `{Entity.Repository.Path}` | `{Project}.Persistence/Repositories/` |
142: | `{Entity.Controller.Path}` | `{Project}.API/Controllers/` |
143: 
144: ---
145: 
146: ## 6. CQRS Placeholders
147: 
148: ### Commands
149: 
150: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
151: |-------------|------------|---------|
152: | `Create{Entity}Command` | Create command class | `CreateEventCommand` |
153: | `Update{Entity}Command` | Update command class | `UpdateEventCommand` |
154: | `Delete{Entity}Command` | Delete command class | `DeleteEventCommand` |
155: | `Create{Entity}CommandHandler` | Create handler | `CreateEventCommandHandler` |
156: 
157: ### Queries
158: 
159: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
160: |-------------|------------|---------|
161: | `Get{Entity}ListRequest` | List query | `GetEventListRequest` |
162: | `Get{Entity}DetailsRequest` | Details query | `GetEventDetailsRequest` |
163: | `Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}Request` | Filter query | `GetEventsByOrganizationRequest` |
164: 
165: ### DTOs
166: 
167: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
168: |-------------|------------|---------|
169: | `{Entity}Dto` | Full details DTO | `EventDto` |
170: | `{Entity}ListDto` | List view DTO | `EventListDto` |
171: | `Create{Entity}Dto` | Create payload | `CreateEventDto` |
172: | `Update{Entity}Dto` | Update payload | `UpdateEventDto` |
173: 
174: ### Validators
175: 
176: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
177: |-------------|------------|---------|
178: | `Create{Entity}DtoValidator` | Create validator | `CreateEventDtoValidator` |
179: | `Update{Entity}DtoValidator` | Update validator | `UpdateEventDtoValidator` |
180: 
181: ### Repositories
182: 
183: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
184: |-------------|------------|---------|
185: | `I{Entity}Repository` | Repository interface | `IEventRepository` |
186: | `{Entity}Repository` | Repository implementation | `EventRepository` |
187: 
188: ---
189: 
190: ## 7. Substitution Examples
191: 
192: ### Example 1: Event Management System
193: 
194: **Substitutions:**
195: ```
196: {Project}        = Explore
197: {Entity}         = Event
198: {Entities}       = Events
199: {RelatedEntity}  = Organization
200: {LookupEntity}   = EventType
201: {IdType}         = Guid
202: {LookupIdType}   = int
203: ```
204: 
205: **Template Code:**
206: ```csharp
207: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
208: 
209: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
210: {
211:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
212:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity}Repository _{relatedEntity}Repository;
213: 
214:     // ...
215: }
216: ```
217: 
218: **Becomes:**
219: ```csharp
220: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Events.Handlers.Commands;
221: 
222: public class CreateEventCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEventCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
223: {
224:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
225:     private readonly IOrganizationRepository _organizationRepository;
226: 
227:     // ...
228: }
229: ```
230: 
231: ### Example 2: E-Commerce System
232: 
233: **Substitutions:**
234: ```
235: {Project}        = ECommerce
236: {Entity}         = Order
237: {Entities}       = Orders
238: {RelatedEntity}  = Customer
239: {ChildEntity}    = OrderItem
240: {LookupEntity}   = OrderStatus
241: {IdType}         = Guid
242: {LookupIdType}   = int
243: ```
244: 
245: **Template Code:**
246: ```csharp
247: public class {Entity}Repository : GenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>, I{Entity}Repository
248: {
249:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}({IdType} {relatedEntity}Id)
250:     {
251:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
252:             .Include(e => e.{ChildEntities})
253:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
254:             .Where(e => e.{RelatedEntity}Id == {relatedEntity}Id)
255:             .ToListAsync();
256:     }
257: }
258: ```
259: 
260: **Becomes:**
261: ```csharp
262: public class OrderRepository : GenericRepository<Order, Guid>, IOrderRepository
263: {
264:     public async Task<List<Order>> GetOrdersByCustomer(Guid customerId)
265:     {
266:         return await _dbContext.Orders
267:             .Include(e => e.OrderItems)
268:             .Include(e => e.OrderStatus)
269:             .Where(e => e.CustomerId == customerId)
270:             .ToListAsync();
271:     }
272: }
273: ```
274: 
275: ---
276: 
277: ## 8. Best Practices
278: 
279: ### When Creating New Documentation
280: 
281: 1. **Always use placeholders** for entity-specific names
282: 2. **Provide substitution tables** at the top of each document
283: 3. **Include concrete examples** in "Implementation Example" sections
284: 4. **Mark project-specific sections** clearly
285: 
286: ### Substitution Table Template
287: 
288: Add this to any document that uses placeholders:
289: 
290: ```markdown
291: ## Placeholder Substitutions
292: 
293: | Placeholder | Replace With |
294: |-------------|--------------|
295: | `{Project}` | Your solution name |
296: | `{Entity}` | Your main entity |
297: | `{Entities}` | Plural form |
298: | `{RelatedEntity}` | Related entity for FK |
299: | `{IdType}` | `Guid` (recommended) or `int` |
300: ```
301: 
302: ### Naming Conventions
303: 
304: | Type | Convention | Example |
305: |------|------------|---------|
306: | Entity | PascalCase, singular | `Event`, `Order` |
307: | DbSet | PascalCase, plural | `Events`, `Orders` |
308: | Repository | I{Entity}Repository | `IEventRepository` |
309: | Controller | {Entity}Controller | `EventController` |
310: | DTO | {Entity}Dto, {Entity}ListDto | `EventDto`, `EventListDto` |
311: | Command | {Verb}{Entity}Command | `CreateEventCommand` |
312: | Query | Get{Entity}*Request | `GetEventListRequest` |
313: | Handler | {Command/Query}Handler | `CreateEventCommandHandler` |
314: | Validator | {Dto}Validator | `CreateEventDtoValidator` |
315: 
316: ---
317: 
318: ## Design Principles Reference
319: 
320: These principles guide all documentation and should be followed when implementing:
321: 
322: ### SOLID Principles
323: 
324: | Principle | Application |
325: |-----------|-------------|
326: | **S**ingle Responsibility | Each handler handles one command/query |
327: | **O**pen/Closed | Use interfaces for extension |
328: | **L**iskov Substitution | Repositories implement interfaces correctly |
329: | **I**nterface Segregation | Small, focused repository interfaces |
330: | **D**ependency Inversion | Depend on abstractions (interfaces) |
331: 
332: ### Clean Architecture
333: 
334: | Rule | Enforcement |
335: |------|-------------|
336: | Dependencies flow inward | Domain has no dependencies |
337: | Entities are framework-agnostic | No EF Core in Domain |
338: | Use cases in Application | Business logic in handlers |
339: | Controllers are thin | Only HTTP ↔ MediatR |
340: 
341: ### Clean Code
342: 
343: | Principle | Example |
344: |-----------|---------|
345: | **DRY** | Use `GenericRepository<T, TId>` |
346: | **KISS** | Simple handlers, one responsibility |
347: | **YAGNI** | Don't add unused abstractions |
348: | Meaningful names | `GetEventsWithDetails()` not `GetData()` |
349: 
350: ---
351: 
352: ## Related Documentation
353: 
354: - **[GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md)** - Coding conventions (project-agnostic)
355: - **[QUICK_REFERENCE.md](QUICK_REFERENCE.md)** - Critical rules summary
356: - **[ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)** - System architecture patterns
357: 
358: ---
359: 
360: ## Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
361: 
362: This repository (`Explore`) uses the following substitutions:
363: 
364: | Placeholder | ISLAMU Event Value |
365: |-------------|-------------------|
366: | `{Project}` | `Explore` |
367: | `{Project.Domain}` | `Explore.Domain` |
368: | `{Project.Application}` | `Explore.Application` |
369: | `{Project.Persistence}` | `Explore.Persistence` |
370: | `{Project.API}` | `Explore.API` |
371: | `{Project.Blazor}` | `Explore.Blazor` |
372: | `{DbContext}` | `ExploreDbContext` |
373: | `{IdType}` | `Guid` |
374: | `{LookupIdType}` | `int` |
375: 
376: **Sample Entities:**
377: - `{Entity}` = `Event`, `Organization`, `User`, `EventSession`
378: - `{LookupEntity}` = `EventType`, `EventStatus`, `Madhab`, `AudienceAge`
379: - `{LinkEntity}` = `EventCategories`, `EventTags`, `OrganizationMembers`
````

````csharp
129:     public void SetAuthenticatedUser(Guid userId, string? name = null, string? email = null, Guid? tenantId = null)
130:     {
131:         var userIdString = userId.ToString();
132: 
133:         var claims = new List<Claim>
134:         {
135: 
136: 
137:             new("sub", userIdString),
138:             new(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, userIdString)
139:         };
140: 
141:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
142:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, name));
143:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(email))
144:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Email, email));
145:         if (tenantId.HasValue)
146:             claims.Add(new Claim("tenant_id", tenantId.Value.ToString()));
147: 
148:         _authContext.SetAuthorized(name ?? "TestUser");
149:         _authContext.SetClaims(claims.ToArray());
150:     }
````

````csharp
608:                ?? new HalResourceOfOrganizationDto();
````

````csharp
180:     private static HttpResponseMessage CreateJsonResponse<T>(T model, HttpStatusCode statusCode = HttpStatusCode.OK)
181:     {
182:         var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(model);
183:         return new HttpResponseMessage(statusCode)
184:         {
185:             Content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
186:         };
187:     }
188: 
189:     private void SetupBffClient(HttpResponseMessage response)
190:     {
191:         var handler = new MockHttpMessageHandler(response);
192:         var client = new HttpClient(handler) { BaseAddress = new Uri("https://test.local") };
193:         _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient").Returns(client);
194:     }
195: 
196:     private void SetupBffClient(Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> handler)
197:     {
198:         var httpHandler = new MockHttpMessageHandler(handler);
199:         var client = new HttpClient(httpHandler) { BaseAddress = new Uri("https://test.local") };
200:         _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient").Returns(client);
201:     }
202: 
203:     private class MockHttpMessageHandler : HttpMessageHandler
204:     {
205:         private readonly Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> _handler;
206: 
207:         public MockHttpMessageHandler(HttpResponseMessage response)
208:         {
209:             _handler = _ => Task.FromResult(response);
210:         }
211: 
212:         public MockHttpMessageHandler(Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> handler)
213:         {
214:             _handler = handler;
215:         }
216: 
217:         protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
218:             => _handler(request);
219:     }
220: }
````

````razor
 6: <MudDialog>

 9:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add" Class="mr-3 mb-n1" />
10:             Create New Category
11:         </MudText>
12:     </TitleContent>
13:     <DialogContent>
14:         <MudForm @ref="form" @bind-IsValid="success" Model="categoryDto">
15:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="categoryDto.FullName" Label="Name" For="@(() => categoryDto.FullName)" Required="true" RequiredError="Name is required." />
16:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="categoryDto.MasterCode" Label="Master Code" For="@(() => categoryDto.MasterCode)" Required="true" RequiredError="Master Code is required." />
17:         </MudForm>
18:     </DialogContent>
19:     <DialogActions>
20:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
21:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Create</MudButton>
22:     </DialogActions>
23: </MudDialog>
24: 
25: @code {
26:     [CascadingParameter]
27:     private IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
28: 
29:     private CreateCategoryDtoValidator validator = new();
30:     private MudForm form;
31:     private bool success;
32: 
33:     private CreateCategoryDto categoryDto = new();
34: 
35:     private async Task Submit()
36:     {
37:         await form.Validate();
38:         if (form.IsValid)
39:         {
40:             DialogReference?.Dismiss(DialogResult.Ok(categoryDto));
41:         }
42:     }
43: 
44:     void Cancel()
45:     {
46:         DialogReference?.Dismiss(DialogResult.Cancel());
47:     }
48: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/ErrorState.razor
````razor
 1: @* ABOUTME: Shared error state component for displaying API errors with retry capability. *@
 2: @* ABOUTME: Used across all pages for consistent error presentation. *@
 3: 
 4: @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ErrorMessage))
 5: {
 6:     <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" 
 7:               Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
 8:               Class="mb-4"
 9:               ShowCloseIcon="true"
10:               CloseIconClicked="OnDismiss">
11:         @ErrorMessage
12:     </MudAlert>
13:     
14:     @if (OnRetry.HasDelegate)
15:     {
16:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" 
17:                    Color="Color.Primary" 
18:                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh"
19:                    OnClick="OnRetry"
20:                    Class="mb-4">
21:             @RetryText
22:         </MudButton>
23:     }
24: }
25: 
26: @code {
27:     [Parameter] public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }
28:     [Parameter] public EventCallback OnRetry { get; set; }
29:     [Parameter] public string RetryText { get; set; } = "Try Again";
30:     
31:     private void OnDismiss()
32:     {
33:         ErrorMessage = null;
34:     }
35: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/CreateSessionDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Validators
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers
 4: @using FluentValidation
 5: @using MudBlazor
 6: 
 7: <MudDialog>
 8:     <TitleContent>
 9:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
10:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add" Class="mr-3 mb-n1" />
11:             Create New Session
12:         </MudText>
13:     </TitleContent>
14:     <DialogContent>
15:         <MudForm @ref="form" @bind-IsValid="success" Model="sessionDto">
16:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="sessionDto.Title" Label="Title" For="@(() => sessionDto.Title)" Required="true" RequiredError="Title is required." />
17:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="sessionDto.Description" Label="Description" For="@(() => sessionDto.Description)" Lines="3" />
18:             <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="startDate" Label="Start Date" Required="true" />
19:             <MudTimePicker @bind-Time="startTime" Label="Start Time" Required="true" />
20:             <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="endDate" Label="End Date" Required="true" />
21:             <MudTimePicker @bind-Time="endTime" Label="End Time" Required="true" />
22:             <MudNumericField @bind-Value="sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees" Label="Max Audience" For="@(() => sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees)" Min="0" />
23:         </MudForm>
24:     </DialogContent>
25:     <DialogActions>
26:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
27:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Create</MudButton>
28:     </DialogActions>
29: </MudDialog>
30: 
31: @code {
32:     [CascadingParameter]
33:     private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
34: 
35:     [Parameter] public Guid EventId { get; set; }
36: 
37:     private CreateEventSessionDtoValidator validator = new();
38:     private MudForm form;
39:     private bool success;
40: 
41:     private CreateEventSessionDto sessionDto = new();
42: 
43:     private DateTime? startDate = DateTime.Now;
44:     private TimeSpan? startTime = DateTime.Now.TimeOfDay;
45:     private DateTime? endDate = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1);
46:     private TimeSpan? endTime = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1).TimeOfDay;
47: 
48:     protected override void OnInitialized()
49:     {
50:         sessionDto.EventId = EventId;
51:     }
52: 
53:     private async Task Submit()
54:     {
55:         await form.Validate();
56:         if (form.IsValid)
57:         {
58:             // Use DateTimeHelper for consistent UTC conversion
59:             var startDateTime = startDate.Value.Date + startTime.Value;
60:             var endDateTime = endDate.Value.Date + endTime.Value;
61: 
62:             sessionDto.StartTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(startDateTime);
63:             sessionDto.EndTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(endDateTime);
64: 
65:             MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(sessionDto));
66:         }
67:     }
68: 
69:     void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
70: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/EventIslamicAspectCard.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Component displaying Islamic aspect information for an event. *@
  2: @* Shows Madhab, prayer timing, gender mode, Quran recitation, and language. *@
  3: 
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  5: @using MudBlazor
  6: 
  7: <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="islamic-aspect-card pa-4">
  8:     <div class="islamic-aspect-card__header">
  9:         <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2">
 10:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Mosque" Color="Color.Primary" />
 11:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Islamic Characteristics</MudText>
 12:         </div>
 13:         @if (ShowActions)
 14:         {
 15:             <div class="islamic-aspect-card__actions">
 16:                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
 17:                                Size="Size.Small"
 18:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 19:                                OnClick="@(() => OnEdit.InvokeAsync())"
 20:                                Title="Edit Islamic Aspect" />
 21:                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
 22:                                Size="Size.Small"
 23:                                Color="Color.Error"
 24:                                OnClick="@(() => OnDelete.InvokeAsync())"
 25:                                Title="Remove Islamic Aspect" />
 26:             </div>
 27:         }
 28:     </div>
 29: 
 30:     <MudDivider Class="my-3" />
 31: 
 32:     <MudGrid Spacing="2">
 33:         @if (Aspect?.MadhabId.HasValue == true)
 34:         {
 35:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 36:                 <div class="islamic-aspect-card__field">
 37:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Madhab (School of Jurisprudence)</MudText>
 38:                     <MudChip T="string" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 39:                         @(Aspect.MadhabName ?? "Not specified")
 40:                     </MudChip>
 41:                 </div>
 42:             </MudItem>
 43:         }
 44: 
 45:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 46:             <div class="islamic-aspect-card__field">
 47:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Gender Mode</MudText>
 48:                 <MudChip T="string" Color="@GetGenderModeColor()" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled">
 49:                     @GetGenderModeDisplay()
 50:                 </MudChip>
 51:             </div>
 52:         </MudItem>
 53: 
 54:         @if (Aspect?.ReferencePrayer.HasValue == true)
 55:         {
 56:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 57:                 <div class="islamic-aspect-card__field">
 58:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Prayer Time Reference</MudText>
 59:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 60:                         @GetPrayerTimeDisplay()
 61:                     </MudText>
 62:                 </div>
 63:             </MudItem>
 64:         }
 65: 
 66:         @if (Aspect?.IncludesQuranRecitation == true)
 67:         {
 68:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 69:                 <div class="islamic-aspect-card__field">
 70:                     <MudChip T="string" Color="Color.Success" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Text"
 71:                              Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MenuBook">
 72:                         Includes Quran Recitation
 73:                     </MudChip>
 74:                 </div>
 75:             </MudItem>
 76:         }
 77: 
 78:         @if (Aspect?.PrimaryLanguageId.HasValue == true)
 79:         {
 80:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 81:                 <div class="islamic-aspect-card__field">
 82:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Primary Language</MudText>
 83:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@(Aspect.PrimaryLanguageName ?? "Not specified")</MudText>
 84:                 </div>
 85:             </MudItem>
 86:         }
 87:     </MudGrid>
 88: </MudPaper>
 89: 
 90: @code {
 91:     [Parameter]
 92:     public EventIslamicAspectDto? Aspect { get; set; }
 93: 
 94:     [Parameter]
 95:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
 96: 
 97:     [Parameter]
 98:     public bool ShowActions { get; set; } = true;
 99: 
100:     [Parameter]
101:     public EventCallback OnEdit { get; set; }
102: 
103:     [Parameter]
104:     public EventCallback OnDelete { get; set; }
105: 
106:     private string GetGenderModeDisplay()
107:     {
108:         return Aspect?.GenderMode switch
109:         {
110:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Mixed => "Mixed",
111:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.MenOnly => "Men Only",
112:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.WomenOnly => "Women Only",
113:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Segregated => "Segregated",
114:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Family => "Family",
115:             _ => "Mixed"
116:         };
117:     }
118: 
119:     private Color GetGenderModeColor()
120:     {
121:         return Aspect?.GenderMode switch
122:         {
123:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.MenOnly => Color.Info,
124:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.WomenOnly => Color.Secondary,
125:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Segregated => Color.Warning,
126:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Family => Color.Success,
127:             _ => Color.Default
128:         };
129:     }
130: 
131:     private string GetPrayerTimeDisplay()
132:     {
133:         if (Aspect?.ReferencePrayer == null) return string.Empty;
134: 
135:         var prayerName = Aspect.ReferencePrayer switch
136:         {
137:             (int)PrayerTime.Fajr => "Fajr",
138:             (int)PrayerTime.Sunrise => "Sunrise",
139:             (int)PrayerTime.Dhuhr => "Dhuhr",
140:             (int)PrayerTime.Asr => "Asr",
141:             (int)PrayerTime.Maghrib => "Maghrib",
142:             (int)PrayerTime.Isha => "Isha",
143:             _ => "Unknown"
144:         };
145: 
146:         if (Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.HasValue && Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value != 0)
147:         {
148:             var offsetText = Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value > 0
149:                 ? $"+{Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value} min"
150:                 : $"{Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value} min";
151:             return $"{prayerName} ({offsetText})";
152:         }
153: 
154:         return prayerName;
155:     }
156: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/EventTechAspectCard.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Component displaying Tech aspect information for an event. *@
  2: @* Shows skill level, GitHub repo, hackathon details, tech stack, and competition info. *@
  3: 
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  5: @using MudBlazor
  6: 
  7: <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="tech-aspect-card pa-4">
  8:     <div class="tech-aspect-card__header">
  9:         <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2">
 10:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Code" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 11:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Tech Characteristics</MudText>
 12:         </div>
 13:         @if (ShowActions)
 14:         {
 15:             <div class="tech-aspect-card__actions">
 16:                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
 17:                                Size="Size.Small"
 18:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 19:                                OnClick="@(() => OnEdit.InvokeAsync())"
 20:                                Title="Edit Tech Aspect" />
 21:                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
 22:                                Size="Size.Small"
 23:                                Color="Color.Error"
 24:                                OnClick="@(() => OnDelete.InvokeAsync())"
 25:                                Title="Remove Tech Aspect" />
 26:             </div>
 27:         }
 28:     </div>
 29: 
 30:     <MudDivider Class="my-3" />
 31: 
 32:     <MudGrid Spacing="2">
 33:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 34:             <div class="tech-aspect-card__field">
 35:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Skill Level</MudText>
 36:                 <MudChip T="string" Color="@GetSkillLevelColor()" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled">
 37:                     @GetSkillLevelDisplay()
 38:                 </MudChip>
 39:             </div>
 40:         </MudItem>
 41: 
 42:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Aspect?.GithubRepoUrl))
 43:         {
 44:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 45:                 <div class="tech-aspect-card__field">
 46:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">GitHub Repository</MudText>
 47:                     <MudLink Href="@Aspect.GithubRepoUrl" Target="_blank" Typo="Typo.body2">
 48:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Custom.Brands.GitHub" Size="Size.Small" Class="mr-1" />
 49:                         @GetRepoName()
 50:                     </MudLink>
 51:                 </div>
 52:             </MudItem>
 53:         }
 54: 
 55:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Aspect?.HackathonTrack))
 56:         {
 57:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 58:                 <div class="tech-aspect-card__field">
 59:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Hackathon Track</MudText>
 60:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@Aspect.HackathonTrack</MudText>
 61:                 </div>
 62:             </MudItem>
 63:         }
 64: 
 65:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Aspect?.TechStackTags))
 66:         {
 67:             <MudItem xs="12">
 68:                 <div class="tech-aspect-card__field">
 69:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Tech Stack</MudText>
 70:                     <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
 71:                         @foreach (var tag in GetTechStackTags())
 72:                         {
 73:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Info">
 74:                                 @tag
 75:                             </MudChip>
 76:                         }
 77:                     </div>
 78:                 </div>
 79:             </MudItem>
 80:         }
 81: 
 82:         @if (Aspect?.RequiresLaptop == true)
 83:         {
 84:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 85:                 <MudChip T="string" Color="Color.Warning" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Text"
 86:                          Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Laptop">
 87:                     Laptop Required
 88:                 </MudChip>
 89:             </MudItem>
 90:         }
 91: 
 92:         @if (Aspect?.IsCodingCompetition == true)
 93:         {
 94:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 95:                 <MudChip T="string" Color="Color.Success" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Text"
 96:                          Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.EmojiEvents">
 97:                     Coding Competition
 98:                 </MudChip>
 99:             </MudItem>
100:         }
101: 
102:         @if (Aspect?.MaxTeamSize.HasValue == true)
103:         {
104:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
105:                 <div class="tech-aspect-card__field">
106:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Max Team Size</MudText>
107:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@Aspect.MaxTeamSize members</MudText>
108:                 </div>
109:             </MudItem>
110:         }
111: 
112:         @if (Aspect?.PrizePool.HasValue == true && Aspect.PrizePool > 0)
113:         {
114:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
115:                 <div class="tech-aspect-card__field">
116:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Prize Pool</MudText>
117:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Success" Style="font-weight: 600;">
118:                         @(Aspect.PrizeCurrencyCode ?? "USD") @Aspect.PrizePool.Value.ToString("N0")
119:                     </MudText>
120:                 </div>
121:             </MudItem>
122:         }
123:     </MudGrid>
124: </MudPaper>
125: 
126: @code {
127:     [Parameter]
128:     public EventTechAspectDto? Aspect { get; set; }
129: 
130:     [Parameter]
131:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
132: 
133:     [Parameter]
134:     public bool ShowActions { get; set; } = true;
135: 
136:     [Parameter]
137:     public EventCallback OnEdit { get; set; }
138: 
139:     [Parameter]
140:     public EventCallback OnDelete { get; set; }
141: 
142:     private string GetSkillLevelDisplay()
143:     {
144:         return Aspect?.SkillLevel switch
145:         {
146:             (int)SkillLevel.AllLevels => "All Levels",
147:             (int)SkillLevel.Beginner => "Beginner",
148:             (int)SkillLevel.Intermediate => "Intermediate",
149:             (int)SkillLevel.Advanced => "Advanced",
150:             _ => "All Levels"
151:         };
152:     }
153: 
154:     private Color GetSkillLevelColor()
155:     {
156:         return Aspect?.SkillLevel switch
157:         {
158:             (int)SkillLevel.Beginner => Color.Success,
159:             (int)SkillLevel.Intermediate => Color.Warning,
160:             (int)SkillLevel.Advanced => Color.Error,
161:             _ => Color.Default
162:         };
163:     }
164: 
165:     private string GetRepoName()
166:     {
167:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Aspect?.GithubRepoUrl)) return string.Empty;
168: 
169:         try
170:         {
171:             var uri = new Uri(Aspect.GithubRepoUrl);
172:             var path = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
173:             return path.Length > 30 ? path.Substring(0, 27) + "..." : path;
174:         }
175:         catch
176:         {
177:             return "View Repository";
178:         }
179:     }
180: 
181:     private IEnumerable<string> GetTechStackTags()
182:     {
183:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Aspect?.TechStackTags))
184:             return Enumerable.Empty<string>();
185: 
186:         return Aspect.TechStackTags
187:             .Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
188:             .Select(t => t.Trim())
189:             .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(t));
190:     }
191: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/IslamicAspectEditDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Dialog for creating or editing the Islamic aspect of an event. *@
  2: @* Allows setting Madhab, prayer timing, gender mode, Quran recitation, and language. *@
  3: 
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  7: @using MudBlazor
  8: 
  9: @inject IEventAspectService EventAspectService
 10: @inject IMadhabService MadhabService
 11: @inject ILanguageService LanguageService
 12: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 13: @inject ILogger<IslamicAspectEditDialog> Logger
 14: 
 15: <MudDialog>
 16:     <TitleContent>
 17:         <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2">
 18:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Mosque" Color="Color.Primary" />
 19:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@(IsNew ? "Add Islamic Characteristics" : "Edit Islamic Characteristics")</MudText>
 20:         </div>
 21:     </TitleContent>
 22:     <DialogContent>
 23:         @if (_isLoading)
 24:         {
 25:             <div class="d-flex justify-center pa-4">
 26:                 <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
 27:             </div>
 28:         }
 29:         else
 30:         {
 31:             <MudForm @ref="_form" @bind-IsValid="_isValid">
 32:                 <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 33:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 34:                         <MudSelect T="int?"
 35:                                    Label="Madhab (School of Jurisprudence)"
 36:                                    @bind-Value="_model.MadhabId"
 37:                                    Clearable="true"
 38:                                    Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 39:                             @foreach (var madhab in _madhabs)
 40:                             {
 41:                                 <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@madhab.Id">@madhab.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 42:                             }
 43:                         </MudSelect>
 44:                     </MudItem>
 45: 
 46:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 47:                         <MudSelect T="int?"
 48:                                    Label="Gender Mode"
 49:                                    @bind-Value="_model.GenderMode"
 50:                                    Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 51:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)GenderSegregationMode.Mixed">Mixed</MudSelectItem>
 52:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)GenderSegregationMode.MenOnly">Men Only</MudSelectItem>
 53:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)GenderSegregationMode.WomenOnly">Women Only</MudSelectItem>
 54:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)GenderSegregationMode.Segregated">Segregated</MudSelectItem>
 55:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)GenderSegregationMode.Family">Family</MudSelectItem>
 56:                         </MudSelect>
 57:                     </MudItem>
 58: 
 59:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 60:                         <MudSelect T="int?"
 61:                                    Label="Reference Prayer Time"
 62:                                    @bind-Value="_model.ReferencePrayer"
 63:                                    Clearable="true"
 64:                                    HelperText="Schedule event relative to a prayer time"
 65:                                    Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 66:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)PrayerTime.Fajr">Fajr</MudSelectItem>
 67:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)PrayerTime.Sunrise">Sunrise</MudSelectItem>
 68:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)PrayerTime.Dhuhr">Dhuhr</MudSelectItem>
 69:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)PrayerTime.Asr">Asr</MudSelectItem>
 70:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)PrayerTime.Maghrib">Maghrib</MudSelectItem>
 71:                             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="(int)PrayerTime.Isha">Isha</MudSelectItem>
 72:                         </MudSelect>
 73:                     </MudItem>
 74: 
 75:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 76:                         <MudNumericField T="int?"
 77:                                          Label="Prayer Time Offset (minutes)"
 78:                                          @bind-Value="_model.PrayerTimeOffset"
 79:                                          Disabled="@(_model.ReferencePrayer == null)"
 80:                                          HelperText="Minutes before (-) or after (+) prayer"
 81:                                          Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 82:                     </MudItem>
 83: 
 84:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 85:                         <MudSelect T="int?"
 86:                                    Label="Primary Language"
 87:                                    @bind-Value="_model.PrimaryLanguageId"
 88:                                    Clearable="true"
 89:                                    Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 90:                             @foreach (var language in _languages)
 91:                             {
 92:                                 <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@language.Id">@language.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 93:                             }
 94:                         </MudSelect>
 95:                     </MudItem>
 96: 
 97:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 98:                         <MudCheckBox T="bool?"
 99:                                      @bind-Value="_model.IncludesQuranRecitation"
100:                                      Label="Includes Quran Recitation"
101:                                      Color="Color.Primary" />
102:                     </MudItem>
103:                 </MudGrid>
104:             </MudForm>
105:         }
106:     </DialogContent>
107:     <DialogActions>
108:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel" Variant="Variant.Text">Cancel</MudButton>
109:         <MudButton OnClick="SaveAsync"
110:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
111:                    Color="Color.Primary"
112:                    Disabled="@(_isSaving || _isLoading)">
113:             @if (_isSaving)
114:             {
115:                 <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Class="mr-2" />
116:                 <span>Saving...</span>
117:             }
118:             else
119:             {
120:                 <span>Save</span>
121:             }
122:         </MudButton>
123:     </DialogActions>
124: </MudDialog>
125: 
126: @code {
127:     [CascadingParameter]
128:     private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
129: 
130:     [Parameter]
131:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
132: 
133:     [Parameter]
134:     public EventIslamicAspectDto? ExistingAspect { get; set; }
135: 
136:     private bool IsNew => ExistingAspect == null;
137: 
138:     private MudForm _form = null!;
139:     private bool _isValid;
140:     private bool _isLoading = true;
141:     private bool _isSaving;
142: 
143:     private CreateUpdateIslamicAspectDto _model = new();
144:     private ICollection<MadhabListDto> _madhabs = new List<MadhabListDto>();
145:     private ICollection<LanguageListDto> _languages = new List<LanguageListDto>();
146: 
147:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
148:     {
149:         await LoadLookupsAsync();
150: 
151:         if (ExistingAspect != null)
152:         {
153:             _model = new CreateUpdateIslamicAspectDto
154:             {
155:                 MadhabId = ExistingAspect.MadhabId,
156:                 ReferencePrayer = ExistingAspect.ReferencePrayer,
157:                 PrayerTimeOffset = ExistingAspect.PrayerTimeOffset,
158:                 GenderMode = ExistingAspect.GenderMode,
159:                 IncludesQuranRecitation = ExistingAspect.IncludesQuranRecitation,
160:                 PrimaryLanguageId = ExistingAspect.PrimaryLanguageId
161:             };
162:         }
163: 
164:         _isLoading = false;
165:     }
166: 
167:     private async Task LoadLookupsAsync()
168:     {
169:         try
170:         {
171:             var madhabsTask = MadhabService.GetMadhabsAsync();
172:             var languagesTask = LanguageService.GetLanguagesAsync();
173: 
174:             await Task.WhenAll(madhabsTask, languagesTask);
175: 
176:             _madhabs = await madhabsTask;
177:             _languages = await languagesTask;
178:         }
179:         catch (Exception ex)
180:         {
181:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load lookups for Islamic aspect dialog");
182:             Snackbar.Add("Failed to load form data", Severity.Error);
183:         }
184:     }
185: 
186:     private async Task SaveAsync()
187:     {
188:         if (_isSaving) return;
189: 
190:         _isSaving = true;
191: 
192:         try
193:         {
194:             var response = await EventAspectService.UpsertIslamicAspectAsync(EventId, _model);
195: 
196:             if (response?.Success == true)
197:             {
198:                 Snackbar.Add(IsNew ? "Islamic characteristics added" : "Islamic characteristics updated", Severity.Success);
199:                 MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
200:             }
201:             else
202:             {
203:                 var errorMessage = response?.Errors?.FirstOrDefault() ?? "Failed to save Islamic characteristics";
204:                 Snackbar.Add(errorMessage, Severity.Error);
205:             }
206:         }
207:         catch (Exception ex)
208:         {
209:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error saving Islamic aspect for event {EventId}", EventId);
210:             Snackbar.Add("An error occurred while saving", Severity.Error);
211:         }
212:         finally
213:         {
214:             _isSaving = false;
215:         }
216:     }
217: 
218:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
219: }
````

````razor
 44:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 45:                     <MudTextField T="string"
 46:                                   Label="Hackathon Track"
 47:                                   @bind-Value="_model.HackathonTrack"
 48:                                   Placeholder="e.g., AI/ML, Web3, Healthcare"
 49:                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 50:                 </MudItem>
 51: 
 52:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 53:                     <MudTextField T="string"
 54:                                   Label="Tech Stack Tags"
 55:                                   @bind-Value="_model.TechStackTags"
 56:                                   Placeholder="e.g., .NET, React, PostgreSQL"
 57:                                   HelperText="Comma-separated list of technologies"
 58:                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 59:                 </MudItem>
 60: 
 61:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 62:                     <MudCheckBox T="bool?"
 63:                                  @bind-Value="_model.RequiresLaptop"
 64:                                  Label="Requires Laptop"
 65:                                  Color="Color.Warning" />
 66:                 </MudItem>
 67: 
 68:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 69:                     <MudCheckBox T="bool?"
 70:                                  @bind-Value="_model.IsCodingCompetition"
 71:                                  Label="Is Coding Competition"
 72:                                  Color="Color.Success" />
 73:                 </MudItem>
 74: 
 75:                 @if (_model.IsCodingCompetition == true)
 76:                 {
 77:                     <MudItem xs="12">
 78:                         <MudDivider Class="my-2" />
 79:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Class="mb-2">Competition Details</MudText>
 80:                     </MudItem>
 81: 
 82:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
 83:                         <MudNumericField T="int?"
 84:                                          Label="Max Team Size"
 85:                                          @bind-Value="_model.MaxTeamSize"
 86:                                          Min="1"
 87:                                          Max="20"
 88:                                          HelperText="Leave empty for individual"
 89:                                          Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 90:                     </MudItem>
 91: 
 92:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
 93:                         <MudNumericField T="double?"
 94:                                          Label="Prize Pool"
 95:                                          @bind-Value="_model.PrizePool"
 96:                                          Min="0"
 97:                                          Format="N0"
 98:                                          Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 99:                     </MudItem>
100: 
101:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
102:                         <MudTextField T="string"
103:                                       Label="Currency"
104:                                       @bind-Value="_model.PrizeCurrencyCode"
105:                                       Placeholder="USD"
106:                                       MaxLength="3"
107:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
108:                     </MudItem>
109:                 }
110:             </MudGrid>
111:         </MudForm>
112:     </DialogContent>
113:     <DialogActions>
114:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel" Variant="Variant.Text">Cancel</MudButton>
115:         <MudButton OnClick="SaveAsync"
116:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
117:                    Color="Color.Primary"
118:                    Disabled="@_isSaving">
119:             @if (_isSaving)
120:             {
121:                 <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Class="mr-2" />
122:                 <span>Saving...</span>
123:             }
124:             else
125:             {
126:                 <span>Save</span>
127:             }
128:         </MudButton>
129:     </DialogActions>
130: </MudDialog>
131: 
132: @code {
133:     [CascadingParameter]
134:     private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
135: 
136:     [Parameter]
137:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
138: 
139:     [Parameter]
140:     public EventTechAspectDto? ExistingAspect { get; set; }
141: 
142:     private bool IsNew => ExistingAspect == null;
143: 
144:     private MudForm _form = null!;
145:     private bool _isValid;
146:     private bool _isSaving;
147: 
148:     private CreateUpdateTechAspectDto _model = new();
149: 
150:     protected override void OnInitialized()
151:     {
152:         if (ExistingAspect != null)
153:         {
154:             _model = new CreateUpdateTechAspectDto
155:             {
156:                 SkillLevel = ExistingAspect.SkillLevel,
157:                 GithubRepoUrl = ExistingAspect.GithubRepoUrl,
158:                 HackathonTrack = ExistingAspect.HackathonTrack,
159:                 TechStackTags = ExistingAspect.TechStackTags,
160:                 RequiresLaptop = ExistingAspect.RequiresLaptop,
161:                 IsCodingCompetition = ExistingAspect.IsCodingCompetition,
162:                 MaxTeamSize = ExistingAspect.MaxTeamSize,
163:                 PrizePool = ExistingAspect.PrizePool,
164:                 PrizeCurrencyCode = ExistingAspect.PrizeCurrencyCode
165:             };
166:         }
167:     }
168: 
169:     private async Task SaveAsync()
170:     {
171:         if (_isSaving) return;
172: 
173:         _isSaving = true;
174: 
175:         try
176:         {
177:             // Clear competition fields if not a competition
178:             if (_model.IsCodingCompetition != true)
179:             {
180:                 _model.MaxTeamSize = null;
181:                 _model.PrizePool = null;
182:                 _model.PrizeCurrencyCode = null;
183:             }
184: 
185:             var response = await EventAspectService.UpsertTechAspectAsync(EventId, _model);
186: 
187:             if (response?.Success == true)
188:             {
189:                 Snackbar.Add(IsNew ? "Tech characteristics added" : "Tech characteristics updated", Severity.Success);
190:                 MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
191:             }
192:             else
193:             {
194:                 var errorMessage = response?.Errors?.FirstOrDefault() ?? "Failed to save Tech characteristics";
195:                 Snackbar.Add(errorMessage, Severity.Error);
196:             }
197:         }
198:         catch (Exception ex)
199:         {
200:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error saving Tech aspect for event {EventId}", EventId);
201:             Snackbar.Add("An error occurred while saving", Severity.Error);
202:         }
203:         finally
204:         {
205:             _isSaving = false;
206:         }
207:     }
208: 
209:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
210: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/S3Image.razor
````razor
  1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  2: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  3: @inject IImageStorageService ImageStorageService
  4: @inject ILogger<S3Image> Logger
  5: <div class="s3-image-container" style="@ContainerStyle">
  6:     @if (isLoading && !hasError)
  7:     {
  8:         <div class="s3-image-placeholder">
  9:             <div class="loading-spinner">
 10:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" />
 11:             </div>
 12:         </div>
 13:     }
 14:     else if (hasError)
 15:     {
 16:         <div class="s3-image-error">
 17:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.BrokenImage" Color="Color.Secondary" Size="Size.Large" />
 18:             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption">@(ErrorText ?? "Failed to load image")</MudText>
 19:         </div>
 20:     }
 21:     else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(imageUrl))
 22:     {
 23:         <img src="@imageUrl"
 24:              alt="@Alt"
 25:              class="s3-image @(isLoading ? "loading" : "")"
 26:              @onload="OnImageLoaded"
 27:              @onerror="OnImageError" />
 28:     }
 29:     else
 30:     {
 31:         <div class="s3-image-placeholder">
 32:             <MudIcon Icon="@(PlaceholderIcon ?? Icons.Material.Filled.Image)"
 33:                     Color="Color.Secondary"
 34:                     Size="Size.Large" />
 35:         </div>
 36:     }
 37: </div>
 38: 
 39: @code {
 40:     /// <summary>
 41:     /// The S3 image key to load
 42:     /// </summary>
 43:     [Parameter] public string? ImageKey { get; set; }
 44: 
 45:     /// <summary>
 46:     /// Direct image URL (if already fetched)
 47:     /// </summary>
 48:     [Parameter] public string? ImageUrl { get; set; }
 49: 
 50:     /// <summary>
 51:     /// Alt text for the image
 52:     /// </summary>
 53:     [Parameter] public string Alt { get; set; } = "Image";
 54: 
 55:     /// <summary>
 56:     /// CSS object-fit property
 57:     /// </summary>
 58:     [Parameter] public string ObjectFit { get; set; } = "cover";
 59: 
 60:     /// <summary>
 61:     /// Border radius for the image
 62:     /// </summary>
 63:     [Parameter] public string? BorderRadius { get; set; }
 64: 
 65:     /// <summary>
 66:     /// Additional styles for the container
 67:     /// </summary>
 68:     [Parameter] public string? ContainerStyle { get; set; }
 69: 
 70:     /// <summary>
 71:     /// Icon to show when no image is available
 72:     /// </summary>
 73:     [Parameter] public string? PlaceholderIcon { get; set; }
 74: 
 75:     /// <summary>
 76:     /// Text to show on error
 77:     /// </summary>
 78:     [Parameter] public string? ErrorText { get; set; }
 79: 
 80:     /// <summary>
 81:     /// Whether to use a fallback image on error
 82:     /// </summary>
 83:     [Parameter] public string? FallbackUrl { get; set; }
 84: 
 85:     private string? imageUrl;
 86:     private bool isLoading = true;
 87:     private bool hasError = false;
 88: 
 89:     protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
 90:     {
 91:         await LoadImageAsync();
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     private async Task LoadImageAsync()
 95:     {
 96:         isLoading = true;
 97:         hasError = false;
 98:         imageUrl = null;
 99: 
100:         try
101:         {
102:             // If ImageUrl is provided directly, use it
103:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ImageUrl))
104:             {
105:                 imageUrl = ImageUrl;
106:                 isLoading = false;
107:                 return;
108:             }
109: 
110:             // If ImageKey is provided, fetch the pre-signed URL
111:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ImageKey))
112:             {
113:                 var url = await ImageStorageService.GetImageUrlAsync(ImageKey);
114: 
115:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(url))
116:                 {
117:                     imageUrl = url;
118:                 }
119:                 else
120:                 {
121:                     hasError = true;
122:                 }
123: 
124:                 isLoading = false;
125:             }
126:             else
127:             {
128:                 // No image key or URL provided
129:                 isLoading = false;
130:             }
131:         }
132:         catch (Exception ex)
133:         {
134:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading S3 image for key {ImageKey}", ImageKey);
135:             hasError = true;
136:             isLoading = false;
137:         }
138:     }
139: 
140:     private void OnImageLoaded()
141:     {
142:         isLoading = false;
143:         StateHasChanged();
144:     }
145: 
146:     private void OnImageError()
147:     {
148:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FallbackUrl))
149:         {
150:             imageUrl = FallbackUrl;
151:         }
152:         else
153:         {
154:             hasError = true;
155:         }
156: 
157:         isLoading = false;
158:         StateHasChanged();
159:     }
160: }
````

````razor
144:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Save" Class="rounded-pill px-6">
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Settings/SettingsPersonalInfo.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms
  6: @inject UserService UserService
  7: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  8: 
  9: <div class="settings-section">
 10:     <!-- Section Header -->
 11:     <div class="settings-section-header mb-6">
 12:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Personal Information</MudText>
 13:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Update your personal details and profile picture</MudText>
 14:     </div>
 15: 
 16:     @if (_loading)
 17:     {
 18:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-8">
 19:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 20:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mt-4" Color="Color.Secondary">Loading profile...</MudText>
 21:         </div>
 22:     }
 23:     else if (_user == null)
 24:     {
 25:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled">Failed to load user profile.</MudAlert>
 26:     }
 27:     else
 28:     {
 29:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 30:         {
 31:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _errorMessage = null)">
 32:                 @_errorMessage
 33:             </MudAlert>
 34:         }
 35: 
 36:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_successMessage))
 37:         {
 38:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Success" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _successMessage = null)">
 39:                 @_successMessage
 40:             </MudAlert>
 41:         }
 42: 
 43:         <MudForm @ref="_form" @bind-IsValid="_success">
 44:             <!-- Profile Picture Section -->
 45:             <div class="settings-profile-picture mb-8">
 46:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 600;" Class="mb-4">Profile Picture</MudText>
 47:                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-6">
 48:                     <div style="width: 120px;">
 49:                         <ImageUpload @bind-PreviewUrl="_profileImagePreview"
 50:                                    FileDataSelected="OnProfileImageFileDataSelected"
 51:                                    PlaceholderText="Select Profile Picture"
 52:                                    UploadButtonText="Change"
 53:                                    Width="120px"
 54:                                    Height="120px"
 55:                                    HintText="JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP (Max 5MB)" 
 56:                                    Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" />
 57:                     </div>
 58:                     <div>
 59:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
 60:                             Recommended: Square image, at least 400x400px
 61:                         </MudText>
 62:                     </div>
 63:                 </div>
 64:             </div>
 65: 
 66:             <!-- Divider -->
 67:             <MudDivider Class="my-6" />
 68: 
 69:             <!-- Name Section -->
 70:             <div class="settings-form-section mb-8">
 71:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 600;" Class="mb-4">Name</MudText>
 72:                 <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 73:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 74:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.FirstName" 
 75:                                       Label="First Name" 
 76:                                       Required="true" 
 77:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
 78:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
 79:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" />
 80:                     </MudItem>
 81:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 82:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.LastName" 
 83:                                       Label="Last Name" 
 84:                                       Required="true" 
 85:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 86:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
 87:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" />
 88:                     </MudItem>
 89:                 </MudGrid>
 90:             </div>
 91: 
 92:             <!-- Divider -->
 93:             <MudDivider Class="my-6" />
 94: 
 95:             <!-- Contact Section -->
 96:             <div class="settings-form-section mb-8">
 97:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 600;" Class="mb-4">Contact Information</MudText>
 98:                 <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 99:                     <MudItem xs="12">
100:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.Email" 
101:                                       Label="Email" 
102:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
103:                                       ReadOnly="true" 
104:                                       HelperText="Email cannot be changed"
105:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
106:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" />
107:                     </MudItem>
108:                     <MudItem xs="12">
109:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.Username" 
110:                                       Label="Username" 
111:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
112:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
113:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.AlternateEmail" />
114:                     </MudItem>
115:                 </MudGrid>
116:             </div>
117: 
118:             <!-- Divider -->
119:             <MudDivider Class="my-6" />
120: 
121:             <!-- Action Buttons -->
122:             <div class="d-flex justify-end gap-3 mt-8">
123:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
124:                            Color="Color.Default" 
125:                            OnClick="ResetForm"
126:                            Class="rounded-pill px-6">
127:                     Cancel
128:                 </MudButton>
129:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" 
130:                            Color="Color.Primary" 
131:                            OnClick="SaveSettings" 
132:                            Disabled="@(!_success || _isSaving)" 
133:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Save"
134:                            Class="rounded-pill px-6">
135:                     @if (_isSaving)
136:                     {
137:                         <MudProgressCircular Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" />
138:                         <span>Saving...</span>
139:                     }
140:                     else
141:                     {
142:                         <span>Save Changes</span>
143:                     }
144:                 </MudButton>
145:             </div>
146:         </MudForm>
147:     }
148: </div>
149: 
150: @code {
151:     [Inject]
152:     private IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
153: 
154:     private MudForm? _form;
155:     private bool _loading = true;
156:     private bool _isSaving = false;
157:     private bool _success = true;
158:     private string? _errorMessage;
159:     private string? _successMessage;
160:     private string? _profileImagePreview;
161:     private UserDto? _user;
162:     private UserDto? _originalUser;
163: 
164:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
165:     {
166:         await LoadUserDataAsync();
167:     }
168: 
169:     private async Task LoadUserDataAsync()
170:     {
171:         try
172:         {
173:             _loading = true;
174:             _user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
175:             _originalUser = new UserDto
176:             {
177:                 Id = _user?.Id,
178:                 FirstName = _user?.FirstName,
179:                 LastName = _user?.LastName,
180:                 Email = _user?.Email,
181:                 Username = _user?.Username,
182:                 ProfileImageUri = _user?.ProfileImageUri
183:             };
184:             _profileImagePreview = _user?.ProfileImageUri;
185:         }
186:         catch (Exception ex)
187:         {
188:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load user profile: {ex.Message}";
189:         }
190:         finally
191:         {
192:             _loading = false;
193:         }
194:     }
195: 
196:     private async Task SaveSettings()
197:     {
198:         if (_user == null)
199:             return;
200: 
201:         try
202:         {
203:             _isSaving = true;
204:             _errorMessage = null;
205:             _successMessage = null;
206: 
207:             var updateDto = new UpdateUserDto
208:             {
209:                 Id = _user.Id,
210:                 FirstName = _user.FirstName,
211:                 LastName = _user.LastName,
212:                 Email = _user.Email,
213:                 Username = _user.Username
214:             };
215: 
216:             var result = await UserService.UpdateUserAsync(updateDto);
217:             if (result?.Success == true)
218:             {
219:                 _successMessage = "Profile updated successfully!";
220:                 _originalUser = new UserDto
221:                 {
222:                     Id = _user.Id,
223:                     FirstName = _user.FirstName,
224:                     LastName = _user.LastName,
225:                     Email = _user.Email,
226:                     Username = _user.Username,
227:                     ProfileImageUri = _user.ProfileImageUri
228:                 };
229:             }
230:             else
231:             {
232:                 _errorMessage = result?.Message ?? "Failed to save profile";
233:             }
234:         }
235:         catch (Exception ex)
236:         {
237:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to save profile: {ex.Message}";
238:         }
239:         finally
240:         {
241:             _isSaving = false;
242:         }
243:     }
244: 
245:     private void ResetForm()
246:     {
247:         if (_originalUser != null && _user != null)
248:         {
249:             _user.FirstName = _originalUser.FirstName;
250:             _user.LastName = _originalUser.LastName;
251:             _user.Username = _originalUser.Username;
252:             _profileImagePreview = _originalUser.ProfileImageUri;
253:             _errorMessage = null;
254:             _successMessage = null;
255:         }
256:     }
257: 
258:     private Task OnProfileImageFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
259:     {
260:         try
261:         {
262:             if (_user != null && fileData != null)
263:             {
264:                 var base64 = Convert.ToBase64String(fileData.Content);
265:                 _profileImagePreview = $"data:{fileData.ContentType};base64,{base64}";
266:             }
267:         }
268:         catch (Exception ex)
269:         {
270:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to upload image: {ex.Message}";
271:         }
272: 
273:         return Task.CompletedTask;
274:     }
275: }
````

````csharp
 1: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers;
````

````csharp
 7: {

14: 
15:     public static string GetInitials(string? name, string fallback = "?")
16:     {
17:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return fallback;
18: 
19:         var words = name.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
20:         return words.Length switch
21:         {
22:             0 => fallback,
23:             1 => words[0][..Math.Min(2, words[0].Length)].ToUpperInvariant(),
24:             _ => $"{words[0][0]}{words[1][0]}".ToUpperInvariant()
25:         };
26:     }
27: 
28: 
29: 
30: 
31: 
32:     public static string GetInitials(string? firstName, string? lastName, string? username, string fallback = "?")
33:     {
34:         var firstInitial = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(firstName)
35:             ? firstName[0].ToString().ToUpperInvariant()
36:             : string.Empty;
37: 
38:         var lastInitial = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastName)
39:             ? lastName[0].ToString().ToUpperInvariant()
40:             : string.Empty;
41: 
42:         var initials = $"{firstInitial}{lastInitial}";
43: 
44:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(initials))
45:             return initials;
46: 
47:         return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(username)
48:             ? username[0].ToString().ToUpperInvariant()
49:             : fallback;
50:     }
51: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Helpers/EventAppearanceMetadataHelper.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Text.Json;
  2: using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
  3: 
  4: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers;
  5: 
  6: public sealed class EventAppearanceSettings
  7: {
  8:     public string BackgroundColor { get; set; } = string.Empty;
  9:     public string BackgroundMediaUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 10:     public string BackgroundEffect { get; set; } = "None";
 11: 
 12:     public bool IsEmpty =>
 13:         string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(BackgroundColor) &&
 14:         string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(BackgroundMediaUrl) &&
 15:         (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(BackgroundEffect) ||
 16:          BackgroundEffect.Equals("None", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 17: }
 18: 
 19: public static class EventAppearanceMetadataHelper
 20: {
 21:     private const string AppearanceNode = "appearance";
 22: 
 23:     public static EventAppearanceSettings Parse(string? metadataJson)
 24:     {
 25:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metadataJson))
 26:         {
 27:             return new EventAppearanceSettings();
 28:         }
 29: 
 30:         try
 31:         {
 32:             var root = JsonNode.Parse(metadataJson) as JsonObject;
 33:             var appearance = root?[AppearanceNode] as JsonObject;
 34:             if (appearance == null)
 35:             {
 36:                 return new EventAppearanceSettings();
 37:             }
 38: 
 39:             return new EventAppearanceSettings
 40:             {
 41:                 BackgroundColor = appearance["backgroundColor"]?.GetValue<string>() ?? string.Empty,
 42:                 BackgroundMediaUrl = appearance["backgroundMediaUrl"]?.GetValue<string>() ?? string.Empty,
 43:                 BackgroundEffect = appearance["backgroundEffect"]?.GetValue<string>() ?? "None"
 44:             };
 45:         }
 46:         catch
 47:         {
 48:             return new EventAppearanceSettings();
 49:         }
 50:     }
 51: 
 52:     public static string? Upsert(string? metadataJson, EventAppearanceSettings appearance)
 53:     {
 54:         JsonObject root;
 55:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metadataJson))
 56:         {
 57:             root = new JsonObject();
 58:         }
 59:         else
 60:         {
 61:             root = JsonNode.Parse(metadataJson) as JsonObject ?? new JsonObject();
 62:         }
 63: 
 64:         if (appearance.IsEmpty)
 65:         {
 66:             root.Remove(AppearanceNode);
 67:         }
 68:         else
 69:         {
 70:             root[AppearanceNode] = new JsonObject
 71:             {
 72:                 ["backgroundColor"] = NullIfWhiteSpace(appearance.BackgroundColor),
 73:                 ["backgroundMediaUrl"] = NullIfWhiteSpace(appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl),
 74:                 ["backgroundEffect"] = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.BackgroundEffect) ? "None" : appearance.BackgroundEffect.Trim()
 75:             };
 76:         }
 77: 
 78:         return root.Count == 0 ? null : root.ToJsonString(new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = false });
 79:     }
 80: 
 81:     public static string BuildHeroStyle(EventAppearanceSettings appearance, string fallbackColorHex)
 82:     {
 83:         var color = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.BackgroundColor)
 84:             ? fallbackColorHex
 85:             : appearance.BackgroundColor.Trim();
 86: 
 87:         var mediaUrl = appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl?.Trim();
 88:         var overlay = appearance.BackgroundEffect?.Trim() switch
 89:         {
 90:             "SoftOverlay" => "linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.24), rgba(0,0,0,0.24))",
 91:             "StrongOverlay" => "linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.40), rgba(0,0,0,0.40))",
 92:             "Blur" => "linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.18), rgba(0,0,0,0.18))",
 93:             _ => string.Empty
 94:         };
 95: 
 96:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(mediaUrl))
 97:         {
 98:             return $"aspect-ratio: 16/9; position: relative; background: {color};";
 99:         }
100: 
101:         var mediaBackground = $"url('{mediaUrl}') center / cover no-repeat";
102:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(overlay))
103:         {
104:             return $"aspect-ratio: 16/9; position: relative; background: {mediaBackground};";
105:         }
106: 
107:         return $"aspect-ratio: 16/9; position: relative; background: {overlay}, {mediaBackground};";
108:     }
109: 
110:     private static string? NullIfWhiteSpace(string? value)
111:     {
112:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? null : value.Trim();
````
