189:     public {Entity}Card()
190:     {
191:         _entityState = new(this);
192:     }
193: 
194:     private async Task DeleteClicked()
195:     {
196:         await OnDelete.InvokeAsync({Entity}.Id);
197:     }
198: }
199: ```
200: 
201: **Why ParameterState?** Prevents infinite re-render loops in MudBlazor components by managing parameter change tracking separately from Blazor's built-in mechanism.
202: 
203: *For more details, see [component-design.md](resources/component-design.md).*
204: 
205: ### 5. State Management
206: 
207: **Rule**: Choose the appropriate state management pattern based on the component relationship and data scope.
208: 
209: -   **Component State**: For isolated component data.
210: -   **Parameters/EventCallback**: For direct parent-child communication.
211: -   **CascadingValue**: For sharing state deep in the component hierarchy (e.g., `AuthenticationState`, theme).
212: -   **Scoped Services**: For sharing state across multiple, unrelated components within the same user session.
213: -   **Singleton Services**: For global, read-only application data.
214: 
215: *For more details, see [state-management.md](resources/state-management.md).*
216: 
217: ### 6. Render Modes
218: 
219: **Rule**: Use `InteractiveAuto` as the default render mode for interactive components. Use `InteractiveServer` for server-only features (e.g., `HttpContext` access) and `InteractiveWebAssembly` for offline-first or highly client-side interactive components.
220: 
221: ```razor
222: @page "/{entities}"
223: @rendermode InteractiveAuto // Default for interactive pages
224: ```
225: *For more details, see [render-modes.md](resources/render-modes.md).*
226: 
227: ### 7. Common Patterns
228: 
229: **Rule**: Implement common UI patterns like forms, dialogs, tables, and loading states consistently across the application.
230: 
231: ```razor
232: @* Confirmation Dialog *@
233: @inject IDialogService DialogService
234: 
235: <MudButton OnClick="Delete{Entity}">Delete</MudButton>
236: 
237: @code {
238:     private async Task Delete{Entity}()
239:     {
240:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<ConfirmDialog>("Confirm Delete");
241:         var result = await dialog.Result;
242:         if (!result.Canceled) { /* Perform delete */ }
243:     }
244: }
245: ```
246: *For more details, see [common-patterns.md](resources/common-patterns.md).*
247: 
248: ## Do's
249: 
250: -   **DO** use `@rendermode="InteractiveAuto"` as the default for interactive pages.
251: -   **DO** prefer MudBlazor components over custom HTML for consistency.
252: -   **DO** follow the BEM methodology for all custom CSS classes.
253: -   **DO** use `[Parameter]` for inputs and `EventCallback<T>` for child-to-parent events.
254: -   **DO** load data in `OnInitializedAsync` for initial setup.
255: -   **DO** use `IDialogService` for modals and `ISnackbar` for notifications.
256: -   **DO** implement `IDisposable` for event clean-up in services and components.
257: -   **DO** use scoped services for state management across components within a user session.
258: -   **DO** centralize theme customization in `wwwroot/css/site.css` and `wwwroot/css/variables.css`.
259: 
260: ## Don'ts
261: 
262: -   **DON'T** use raw HTML when a suitable MudBlazor component exists.
263: -   **DON'T** modify `[Parameter]` properties directly from within a child component.
264: -   **DON'T** access `HttpContext` in components rendered with `InteractiveAuto` or `InteractiveWebAssembly` (use `InteractiveServer` or BFF pattern).
265: -   **DON'T** use JavaScript interop for tasks that MudBlazor or Blazor itself can handle.
266: -   **DON'T** call `StateHasChanged()` unnecessarily (can lead to performance issues).
267: -   **DON'T** use static state in Blazor Server apps (can cause data leakage between users).
268: 
269: ---
270: 
271: **Related Documentation**:
272: - [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - Overall system architecture, especially Blazor Hybrid.
273: - [`blazor-bff-patterns`](../blazor-bff-patterns/SKILL.md) - Details on YARP, token forwarding, and cookie-based auth.
274: - [`auth-patterns`](../auth-patterns/SKILL.md) - Authentication and authorization patterns in Blazor.
````

## File: .claude/skills/clean-architecture-rules/resources/dependency-rules.md
````markdown
  1: # Dependency Rules - Complete Reference
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Dependency Rules**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Dependency Matrix
  8: 
  9: | Layer | Can Reference | Cannot Reference | Framework Dependencies Allowed |
 10: |-------|---------------|------------------|-------------------------------|
 11: | **{Project}.Domain** | Nothing | Everything | None (pure C#) |
 12: | **{Project}.Application** | Domain | Infrastructure, Persistence, API, Blazor | MediatR, FluentValidation, AutoMapper |
 13: | **{Project}.Persistence** | Application, Domain | API, Blazor | EF Core, Database Provider, PostGIS |
 14: | **{Project}.Infrastructure** | Application, Domain | API, Blazor | Any (email, file storage, external APIs) |
 15: | **{Project}.API** | All | None (top layer) | ASP.NET Core, Swashbuckle, Serilog |
 16: | **{Project}.Blazor** | All | None (top layer) | Blazor, MudBlazor, SignalR |
 17: | **{Project}.Blazor.Client** | Shared DTOs | Server components | Blazor WebAssembly, MudBlazor |
 18: 
 19: ## Visual Dependency Flow
 20: 
 21: ```mermaid
 22: graph TD
 23:     subgraph Presentation Layer
 24:         A[{Project}.API]
 25:         B[{Project}.Blazor]
 26:     end
 27: 
 28:     subgraph Infrastructure Layer

 30:         D[{Project}.Infrastructure]
 31:     end
 32: 
 33:     subgraph Application Layer
 34:         E[{Project}.Application]
 35:     end
 36: 
 37:     subgraph Domain Layer
 38:         F[{Project}.Domain]
 39:     end
 40: 
 41:     A --> E
 42:     A --> C
 43:     A --> D
 44: 
 45:     B --> E
 46:     B --> C
 47:     B --> D
 48: 
 49:     C --> E
 50:     C --> F
 51: 
 52:     D --> E
 53:     D --> F
 54: 
 55:     E --> F
 56: 
 57:     style A fill:#fbe5c5,stroke:#333
 58:     style B fill:#fbe5c5,stroke:#333
 59:     style C fill:#c5fbe5,stroke:#333

 61:     style E fill:#e5c5fb,stroke:#333
 62:     style F fill:#c5fbc5,stroke:#333

 64: 
 65: ## The Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP)
 66: 
 67: **Core Idea**: High-level modules should not depend on low-level modules. Both should depend on abstractions.
 68: 
 69: ### Example: Application needs Database Access
 70: 
 71: **❌ WITHOUT Dependency Inversion** (Violation):
 72: ```
 73: Application ──────> Infrastructure
 74: (high-level)        (low-level, concrete)
 75: 
 76: Create{Entity}CommandHandler → {DbContext}
 77: ```
 78: *Problem*: Application layer depends on concrete Infrastructure implementation.
 79: 
 80: **✅ WITH Dependency Inversion** (Correct):
 81: ```
 82: Application ──────> I{Entity}Repository (Interface)
 83:                            ▲
 84:                            │ implements
 85: Infrastructure ────────────┘
 86: {Entity}Repository (implements I{Entity}Repository)
 87: ```
 88: *Solution*: Both depend on abstraction (interface) defined in Application.
 89: 
 90: ## Allowed `using` Statements by Layer
 91: 
 92: ### {Project}.Domain
 93: 
 94: ```csharp
 95: // File: {Project}.Domain/{Entity}.cs
 96: namespace {Project}.Domain;
 97: 
 98: // ✅ ALLOWED - Pure C# only
 99: using System;
100: using System.Collections.Generic;
101: using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
102: 
103: public class {Entity}
104: {
105:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
106: 
107:     [ForeignKey("{LookupEntity}")]
108:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
109:     public {LookupEntity} {LookupEntity} { get; set; }
110: 
111:     [ForeignKey("{RelatedEntity}")]
112:     public {IdType} {RelatedEntity}Id { get; set; }
113:     public {RelatedEntity} {RelatedEntity} { get; set; }
114: 
115:     // ... more navigation properties
116: }
117: 
118: // ❌ NOT ALLOWED in Domain
119: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;           // Infrastructure concern
120: using {Project}.Application;                   // Layer above
121: using {Project}.Infrastructure;                // Layer above
122: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;                // Presentation concern
123: using MediatR;                                 // Application concern
124: ```
125: 
126: ### {Project}.Application
127: 
128: ```csharp
129: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
130: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
131: 
132: // ✅ ALLOWED
133: using System;
134: using System.Collections.Generic;
135: using System.Linq;
136: using System.Threading;
137: using System.Threading.Tasks;
138: using AutoMapper;                                       // Application framework
139: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;     // Same layer
140: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};             // Same layer
141: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;  // Same layer
142: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;  // Same layer
143: using {Project}.Application.Responses;                 // Same layer
144: using {Project}.Domain;                                // Domain entities
145: using MediatR;                                         // CQRS framework
146: 
147: // ❌ NOT ALLOWED
148: using {Project}.Persistence;                   // Infrastructure layer
149: using {Project}.Infrastructure;                // Infrastructure layer
150: using {Project}.API;                           // Presentation layer
151: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;           // Infrastructure concern
152: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;                // Presentation concern
153: ```
154: 
155: ### {Project}.Persistence
156: 
157: ```csharp
158: // File: {Project}.Persistence/Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs
159: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
160: 
161: // ✅ ALLOWED
162: using System;
163: using System.Collections.Generic;
164: using System.Linq;
165: using System.Threading.Tasks;
166: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;     // Application interfaces
167: using {Project}.Domain;                                // Domain entities
168: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;                   // ORM framework
169: 
170: // ❌ NOT ALLOWED
171: using {Project}.API;                           // Presentation layer
172: using {Project}.Blazor;                        // Presentation layer
173: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;                // Presentation concern
174: ```
175: 
176: ### {Project}.Infrastructure
177: 
178: ```csharp
179: // File: {Project}.Infrastructure/Email/EmailService.cs
180: namespace {Project}.Infrastructure.Email;
181: 
182: // ✅ ALLOWED
183: using {Project}.Domain;                                   // Domain entities
184: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;     // Application interfaces
185: using SendGrid;                                           // External service
186: using Azure.Storage.Blobs;                                // External service
187: 
188: // ❌ NOT ALLOWED
189: using {Project}.API;                           // Presentation layer
190: using {Project}.Blazor;                        // Presentation layer
191: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;                // Presentation concern
192: ```
193: 
194: ### {Project}.API
195: 
196: ```csharp
197: // File: {Project}.API/Controllers/{Entity}Controller.cs
198: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
199: 
200: // ✅ ALLOWED (Everything)
201: using System;
202: using System.Collections.Generic;
203: using System.Linq;
204: using System.Security.Claims;
205: using System.Threading.Tasks;
206: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};                          // DTOs
207: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
208: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
209: using {Project}.Application.Responses;                              // Response wrappers
210: using MediatR;                                                      // CQRS
211: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;                           // Auth
212: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;                                    // HTTP context
213: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;                                     // Controllers
214: // ... any other dependencies
215: ```
216: 
217: ## Project Reference Rules (.csproj)
218: 
219: ### {Project}.Domain.csproj
220: ```xml
221: <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
222:   <PropertyGroup>
223:     <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
224:   </PropertyGroup>
225: 
226:   <!-- ✅ NO PROJECT REFERENCES -->
227:   <ItemGroup>
228:     <!-- Only System.ComponentModel.Annotations for [ForeignKey] -->
229:     <PackageReference Include="System.ComponentModel.Annotations" Version="10.0.0" />
230:   </ItemGroup>
231: </Project>
232: ```
233: 
234: ### {Project}.Application.csproj
235: ```xml
236: <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
237:   <ItemGroup>
238:     <!-- ✅ ALLOWED: Reference to Domain -->
239:     <ProjectReference Include="..\{Project}.Domain\{Project}.Domain.csproj" />
240:   </ItemGroup>
241: 
242:   <ItemGroup>
243:     <!-- ✅ ALLOWED: Framework packages -->
244:     <PackageReference Include="MediatR" Version="12.4.0" />
245:     <PackageReference Include="FluentValidation" Version="11.9.0" />
246:     <PackageReference Include="AutoMapper" Version="13.0.1" />
247:   </ItemGroup>
248: 
249:   <!-- ❌ NOT ALLOWED: References to Infrastructure, Persistence, API, Blazor -->
250: </Project>
251: ```
252: 
253: ### {Project}.Persistence.csproj
254: ```xml
255: <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
256:   <ItemGroup>
257:     <!-- ✅ ALLOWED: References to Domain and Application -->
258:     <ProjectReference Include="..\{Project}.Domain\{Project}.Domain.csproj" />
259:     <ProjectReference Include="..\{Project}.Application\{Project}.Application.csproj" />
260:   </ItemGroup>
261: 
262:   <ItemGroup>
263:     <!-- ✅ ALLOWED: EF Core and database packages -->
264:     <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore" Version="10.0.0" />
265:     <PackageReference Include="Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL" Version="10.0.0" />
266:   </ItemGroup>
267: </Project>
268: ```
269: 
270: ### {Project}.API.csproj
271: ```xml
272: <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">
273:   <ItemGroup>
274:     <!-- ✅ ALLOWED: References to ALL -->
275:     <ProjectReference Include="..\{Project}.Application\{Project}.Application.csproj" />
276:     <ProjectReference Include="..\{Project}.Infrastructure\{Project}.Infrastructure.csproj" />
277:     <ProjectReference Include="..\{Project}.Persistence\{Project}.Persistence.csproj" />
278:   </ItemGroup>
279: </Project>
280: ```
281: 
282: ## Verification Commands
283: 
284: ### Check Project References
285: ```bash
286: # Domain should have NO project references
287: dotnet list {Project}.Domain/{Project}.Domain.csproj reference
288: 
289: # Application should ONLY reference Domain
290: dotnet list {Project}.Application/{Project}.Application.csproj reference
291: 
292: # Persistence should reference Domain + Application
293: dotnet list {Project}.Persistence/{Project}.Persistence.csproj reference
294: ```
295: 
296: ### Search for Violations
297: ```bash
298: # Find prohibited using statements in Domain
299: rg "using (Microsoft\.(EntityFrameworkCore|AspNetCore)|{Project}\.(Application|Infrastructure|API|Blazor))" {Project}.Domain/
300: 
301: # Find validation annotations in Domain (except [ForeignKey])
302: rg "\[Required\]|\[MaxLength\]|\[Range\]|\[StringLength\]" {Project}.Domain/
303: ```
304: 
305: ## Common Questions
306: 
307: ### Q: Can Domain use System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations?
308: **A**: LIMITED USE. Only `[ForeignKey]` is acceptable for EF Core relationships. Avoid `[Required]`, `[MaxLength]`, `[Range]` etc.
309: 
310: ```csharp
311: // File: {Project}.Domain/{Entity}.cs
312: public class {Entity}
313: {
314:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
315: 
316:     // ✅ OK - Specifies foreign key relationship
317:     [ForeignKey("{LookupEntity}")]
318:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
319:     public {LookupEntity} {LookupEntity} { get; set; }
320: 
321:     // ❌ NOT OK - Validation annotations
322:     // [Required]
323:     // [MaxLength(200)]
324:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
325: }
326: ```
327: 
328: **Why**: `[ForeignKey]` is metadata for EF Core navigation, not validation. Use FluentValidation in Application layer for validation rules.
329: 
330: ### Q: Can Application use AutoMapper?
331: **A**: ✅ YES. AutoMapper is an Application-layer concern for mapping Domain entities to DTOs.
332: 
333: ```csharp
334: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
335: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
336: {
337:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
338:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
339: 
340:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
341:     {
342:         var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // Returns List<{Entity}>
343:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});  // ✅ Maps to DTOs
344:     }
345: }
346: ```
347: 
348: ### Q: Can Application reference EF Core for IQueryable?
349: **A**: ❌ NO. Define repository interfaces that return `Task<List<T>>` instead. Let Infrastructure handle IQueryable.
350: 
351: **Correct Pattern**:
352: ```csharp
353: // File: {Project}.Application/Contracts/Persistence/I{Entity}Repository.cs
354: namespace {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
355: 
356: public interface I{Entity}Repository : IGenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>
357: {
358:     Task<{Entity}?> Get{Entity}WithDetails({IdType} id);
359:     Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // ✅ Returns List<{Entity}>, not IQueryable
360: }
361: 
362: // File: {Project}.Persistence/Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs
363: public class {Entity}Repository : GenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>, I{Entity}Repository
364: {
365:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails()
366:     {
367:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}  // ✅ EF Core IQueryable handled here
368:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
369:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity})
370:             .ToListAsync();  // ✅ Materializes to List
371:     }
372: }
373: ```
374: 
375: ### Q: Where do I put Email sending logic?
376: **A**:
377: - **Interface**: `{Project}.Application/Contracts/Infrastructure/IEmailService.cs`
378: - **Implementation**: `{Project}.Infrastructure/Services/EmailService.cs`
379: - **Usage**: Application layer uses `IEmailService`, Infrastructure provides concrete implementation
380: 
381: ### Q: Can Blazor.Client reference Persistence?
382: **A**: ❌ NO. Blazor.Client runs in the browser (WebAssembly) and cannot access databases directly. Use shared DTOs and API calls.
383: 
384: **Correct Pattern**:
385: ```csharp
386: // Shared DTO in {Project}.Application
387: public record {Entity}ListDto
388: {
389:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
390:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
391:     public string {LookupEntity}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
392: }
393: 
394: // API endpoint in {Project}.API
395: [HttpGet]
396: [AllowAnonymous]
397: public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll()
398: {
399:     var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
400:     return Ok({entities});
401: }
402: 
403: // Blazor.Client calls API
404: @inject HttpClient Http
405: 
406: var {entities} = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<{Entity}ListDto>>("/api/v1/{entity}");
407: ```
408: 
409: ---
410:

## File: .claude/skills/clean-architecture-rules/resources/fix-patterns.md
````markdown
  1: # Fix Patterns - How to Resolve Violations
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Fix Patterns Reference**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Pattern #1: Move Logic to Correct Layer
  8: 
  9: ### Scenario: Business Logic in Controller
 10: 
 11: **❌ Before** (Logic in wrong layer):
 12: ```csharp
 13: // File: {Project}.API/Controllers/{Entity}Controller.cs
 14: [HttpPost]
 15: public async Task<ActionResult> Create(Create{Entity}Dto dto)
 16: {
 17:     // ❌ Business logic in controller
 18:     if (dto.Title == null || dto.Title.Length > 500)
 19:         return BadRequest("Title must be between 1 and 500 characters");
 20: 
 21:     if (dto.{LookupEntity}Id <= 0)
 22:         return BadRequest("{LookupEntity} is required");
 23: 
 24:     var {entity} = new {Entity}
 25:     {
 26:         Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
 27:         Title = dto.Title,
 28:         {LookupEntity}Id = dto.{LookupEntity}Id,
 29:         ViewCount = 0
 30:     };
 31: 
 32:     _dbContext.{Entities}.Add({entity});
 33:     await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 34: 
 35:     return Ok({entity}.Id);
 36: }
 37: ```
 38: 
 39: **✅ After** (Logic in correct layers):
 40: ```csharp
 41: // Step 1: Create Command in Application layer
 42: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Commands/Create{Entity}Command.cs
 43: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
 44: 
 45: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 46: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
 47: using MediatR;
 48: 
 49: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
 50: {
 51:     public Create{Entity}Dto {Entity}Dto { get; set; } = null!;
 52: }
 53: 
 54: // Step 2: Create Validator in Application layer
 55: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
 56: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
 57: 
 58: using FluentValidation;
 59: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 60: 
 61: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
 62: {
 63:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
 64:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
 65:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
 66:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity3}Repository _{relatedEntity3}Repository;
 67:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity4}Repository _{relatedEntity4}Repository;
 68: 
 69:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
 70:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
 71:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
 72:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
 73:         I{RelatedEntity3}Repository {relatedEntity3}Repository,
 74:         I{RelatedEntity4}Repository {relatedEntity4}Repository)
 75:     {
 76:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
 77:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
 78:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
 79:         _{relatedEntity3}Repository = {relatedEntity3}Repository;
 80:         _{relatedEntity4}Repository = {relatedEntity4}Repository;
 81: 
 82:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
 83:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required")
 84:             .MaximumLength(200);
 85: 
 86:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
 87:             .MaximumLength(5000)
 88:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description));
 89: 
 90:         RuleFor(x => x.{LookupEntity}Id)
 91:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{LookupEntity} is required")
 92:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 93:             {
 94:                 var exists = await _{lookupEntity}Repository.Exists(id);
 95:                 return exists;
 96:             })
 97:             .WithMessage("{LookupEntity} not found");
 98: 
 99:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id)
100:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} is required")
101:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
102:             {
103:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity2}Repository.Exists(id);
104:                 return exists;
105:             })
106:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} not found");
107: 
108:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity1}Id)
109:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} is required")
110:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
111:             {
112:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity1}Repository.Exists(id);
113:                 return exists;
114:             })
115:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} not found");
116: 
117:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity3}Id)
118:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
119:             {
120:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
121:                 return await _{relatedEntity3}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
122:             })
123:             .When(x => x.{RelatedEntity3}Id.HasValue)
124:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity3} does not exist.");
125: 
126:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity4}Id)
127:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
128:             {
129:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
130:                 return await _{relatedEntity4}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
131:             })
132:             .When(x => x.{RelatedEntity4}Id.HasValue)
133:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity4} does not exist.");
134:     }
135: }
136: 
137: // Step 3: Create Handler in Application layer
138: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
139: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
140: 
141: using System;
142: using System.Linq;
143: using System.Threading;
144: using System.Threading.Tasks;
145: using AutoMapper;
146: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
147: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
148: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
149: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
150: using {Project}.Domain;
151: using MediatR;
152: 
153: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
154: {
155:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
156:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
157:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
158:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
159:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity3}Repository _{relatedEntity3}Repository;
160:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity4}Repository _{relatedEntity4}Repository;
161:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
162: 
163:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
164:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
165:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
166:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
167:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
168:         I{RelatedEntity3}Repository {relatedEntity3}Repository,
169:         I{RelatedEntity4}Repository {relatedEntity4}Repository,
170:         IMapper mapper)
171:     {
172:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
173:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
174:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
175:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
176:         _{relatedEntity3}Repository = {relatedEntity3}Repository;
177:         _{relatedEntity4}Repository = {relatedEntity4}Repository;
178:         _mapper = mapper;
179:     }
180: 
181:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
182:     {
183:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
184: 
185:         // ✅ Validate using FluentValidation - instantiated manually with dependencies
186:         var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
187:             _{relatedEntity1}Repository,
188:             _{relatedEntity2}Repository,
189:             _{lookupEntity}Repository,
190:             _{relatedEntity3}Repository,
191:             _{relatedEntity4}Repository);
192: 
193:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
194: 
195:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
196:         {
197:             response.Success = false;
198:             response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
199:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
200:             return response;
201:         }
202: 
203:         // ✅ Map DTO to Entity
204:         var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
205:         {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
206: 
207:         // ✅ Save through repository
208:         {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
209: 
210:         response.Success = true;
211:         response.Id = {entity}.Id;
212:         response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
213: 
214:         return response;
215:     }
216: }
217: 
218: // Step 4: Thin Controller in API layer
219: // File: {Project}.API/Controllers/{Entity}Controller.cs
220: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
221: 
222: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
223: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
224: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
225: using MediatR;
226: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
227: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
228: 
229: [Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
230: [ApiController]
231: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
232: {
233:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
234: 
235:     public {Entity}Controller(IMediator mediator) => _mediator = mediator;
236: 
237:     [HttpPost]
238:     [Authorize]
239:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Create([FromBody] Create{Entity}Dto dto)
240:     {
241:         var command = new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto };
242:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command);
243:         return Ok(response);
244:     }
245: }
246: ```
247: 
248: **Benefits**:
249: - ✅ Business logic is testable without HTTP
250: - ✅ Validation runs automatically via FluentValidation
251: - ✅ Controller is thin (5 lines)
252: - ✅ Logic can be reused from Blazor, CLI, etc.
253: 
254: ---
255: 
256: ## Pattern #2: Use Interfaces for Infrastructure Dependencies
257: 
258: ### Scenario: Application Needs Email Sending
259: 
260: **❌ Before** (Direct dependency):
261: ```csharp
262: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
263: using {Project}.Infrastructure.Email;  // ❌ VIOLATION!
264: using SendGrid;  // ❌ Infrastructure concern
265: 
266: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
267: {
268:     private readonly SendGridEmailService _emailService;  // ❌ Concrete class
269: 
270:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
271:     {
272:         // ... create {entity}
273: 
274:         await _emailService.SendAsync(email);  // ❌ Tightly coupled
275: 
276:         return response;
277:     }
278: }
279: ```
280: 
281: **✅ After** (Dependency Inversion):
282: ```csharp
283: // Step 1: Define interface in Application layer
284: // File: {Project}.Application/Contracts/Infrastructure/IEmailService.cs
285: namespace {Project}.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
286: 
287: using System;
288: using System.Threading;
289: using System.Threading.Tasks;
290: 
291: public interface IEmailService
292: {
293:     Task Send{Entity}CreatedNotificationAsync(
294:         {IdType} {entity}Id,
295:         string {entity}Title,
296:         string ownerEmail,
297:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
298: }
299: 
300: // Step 2: Use interface in Application layer
301: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
302: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
303: 
304: using System;
305: using System.Linq;
306: using System.Threading;
307: using System.Threading.Tasks;
308: using AutoMapper;
309: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;  // ✅ Same layer interface
310: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
311: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
312: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
313: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
314: using {Project}.Domain;
315: using MediatR;
316: 
317: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
318: {
319:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
320:     private readonly IEmailService _emailService;  // ✅ Interface
321:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
322:     // ... other dependencies
323: 
324:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
325:     {
326:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
327: 
328:         // Validation...
329:         var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
330:         {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
331:         {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
332: 
333:         // ✅ Calls interface, doesn't know about SendGrid
334:         await _emailService.Send{Entity}CreatedNotificationAsync(
335:             {entity}.Id,
336:             {entity}.Title,
337:             request.{Entity}Dto.OwnerEmail,
338:             cancellationToken);
339: 
340:         return response;
341:     }
342: }
343: 
344: // Step 3: Implement in Infrastructure layer
345: // File: {Project}.Infrastructure/Email/SendGridEmailService.cs
346: namespace {Project}.Infrastructure.Email;
347: 
348: using System;
349: using System.Threading;
350: using System.Threading.Tasks;
351: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;  // ✅ Implements interface
352: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
353: using SendGrid;
354: using SendGrid.Helpers.Mail;
355: 
356: public class SendGridEmailService : IEmailService
357: {
358:     private readonly ISendGridClient _client;
359:     private readonly ILogger<SendGridEmailService> _logger;
360: 
361:     public SendGridEmailService(ISendGridClient client, ILogger<SendGridEmailService> logger)
362:     {
363:         _client = client;
364:         _logger = logger;
365:     }
366: 
367:     public async Task Send{Entity}CreatedNotificationAsync(
368:         {IdType} {entity}Id,
369:         string {entity}Title,
370:         string ownerEmail,
371:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
372:     {
373:         var from = new EmailAddress("noreply@example.com", "Application Name");
374:         var to = new EmailAddress(ownerEmail);
375:         var subject = $"{Entity} Created: {{entity}Title}";
376:         var htmlContent = $"<p>Your {entity} <strong>{{entity}Title}</strong> has been created successfully.</p>";
377: 
378:         var msg = MailHelper.CreateSingleEmail(from, to, subject, null, htmlContent);
379: 
380:         try
381:         {
382:             var response = await _client.SendEmailAsync(msg, cancellationToken);
383:             _logger.LogInformation("Email sent to {Email} for {Entity} {{EntityId}}", ownerEmail, {entity}Id);
384:         }
385:         catch (Exception ex)
386:         {
387:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to send email for {Entity} {{EntityId}}", {entity}Id);
388:             throw;
389:         }
390:     }
391: }
392: 
393: // Step 4: Register in API (Composition Root)
394: // File: {Project}.API/Program.cs
395: builder.Services.AddScoped<IEmailService, SendGridEmailService>();
396: ```
397: 
398: **Benefits**:
399: - ✅ Application doesn't know about SendGrid
400: - ✅ Can easily swap SendGrid for Mailgun, SMTP, or mock for testing
401: - ✅ No breaking changes to Application when Infrastructure changes
402:

405: ## Pattern #3: Repository Pattern for Data Access
406: 
407: ### Scenario: Application Needs Database Queries
408: 
409: **❌ Before** (Direct DbContext access):
410: ```csharp
411: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
412: using {Project}.Persistence;  // ❌ VIOLATION!
413: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;  // ❌ VIOLATION!
414: 
415: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
416: {
417:     private readonly {DbContext} _context;  // ❌ Concrete class
418: 
419:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
420:     {
421:         return await _context.{Entities}  // ❌ Direct DbSet access
422:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
423:             .Where(e => e.StatusId == 2)
424:             .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
425:     }
426: }
427: ```
428: 
429: **✅ After** (Repository pattern):
430: ```csharp
431: // Step 1: Define repository interface in Application layer
432: // File: {Project}.Application/Contracts/Persistence/I{Entity}Repository.cs
433: namespace {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
434: 
435: using System;
436: using System.Collections.Generic;
437: using System.Threading.Tasks;
438: using {Project}.Domain;
439: 
440: public interface I{Entity}Repository : IGenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>
441: {
442:     Task<{Entity}?> Get{Entity}WithDetails({IdType} id);
443:     Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails();
444:     Task<List<{Entity}>> GetMy{Entities}WithDetails(string userId);
445: }
446: 
447: // Step 2: Use interface in Application layer
448: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
449: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
450: 
451: using System.Collections.Generic;
452: using System.Threading;
453: using System.Threading.Tasks;
454: using AutoMapper;
455: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;  // ✅ Same layer
456: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
457: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
458: using MediatR;
459: 
460: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
461: {
462:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;  // ✅ Abstraction
463:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
464: 
465:     public Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository, IMapper mapper)
466:     {
467:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
468:         _mapper = mapper;
469:     }
470: 
471:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
472:     {
473:         var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // ✅ Returns List<{Entity}>
474:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});  // ✅ Maps to DTOs
475:     }
476: }
477: 
478: // Step 3: Implement repository in Persistence layer
479: // File: {Project}.Persistence/Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs
480: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
481: 
482: using System;
483: using System.Collections.Generic;
484: using System.Linq;
485: using System.Threading.Tasks;
486: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;  // ✅ Implements interface
487: using {Project}.Domain;
488: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
489: 
490: public class {Entity}Repository : GenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>, I{Entity}Repository
491: {
492:     private readonly {DbContext} _dbContext;
493: 
494:     public {Entity}Repository({DbContext} dbContext) : base(dbContext)
495:     {
496:         _dbContext = dbContext;
497:     }
498: 
499:     public async Task<{Entity}?> Get{Entity}WithDetails({IdType} id)
500:     {
501:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
502:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
503:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
504:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
505:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity3})
506:                 .ThenInclude(r => r.{NestedEntity})
507:             .Include(e => e.Status)
508:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity4})
509:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity5})
510:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity6})
511:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity7})
512:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity8})
513:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.Id == id);
514:     }
515: 
516:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails()
517:     {
518:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
519:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
520:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
521:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
522:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity3})
523:                 .ThenInclude(r => r.{NestedEntity})
524:             .Include(e => e.Status)
525:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity4})
526:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity5})
527:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity6})
528:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity7})
529:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity8})
530:             .ToListAsync();
531:     }
532: 
533:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> GetMy{Entities}WithDetails(string userId)
534:     {
535:         {IdType} userGuid;
536:         var isGuid = {IdType}.TryParse(userId, out userGuid);
537: 
538:         var query = _dbContext.{Entities}
539:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
540:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
541:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
542:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity3})
543:                 .ThenInclude(r => r.{NestedEntity})
544:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity7})
545:             .Include(e => e.Status)
546:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity4})
547:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity5})
548:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity6})
549:             .AsQueryable();
550: 
551:         if (isGuid)
552:         {
553:             query = query.Where(e =>
554:                 _dbContext.Users.Any(u => u.Id == userGuid && u.{RelatedEntity3}Id == e.{RelatedEntity3}Id) ||
555:                 _dbContext.{ParentEntity}Members.Any(pm =>
556:                     pm.UserId == userGuid &&
557:                     _dbContext.{ParentEntities}.Any(p => p.Id == pm.{ParentEntity}Id && p.{RelatedEntity3}Id == e.{RelatedEntity3}Id)));
558:         }
559: 
560:         return await query.ToListAsync();
561:     }
562: }
563: 
564: // Step 4: Register in API (Composition Root)
565: // File: {Project}.API/Program.cs
566: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{Entity}Repository, {Entity}Repository>();
567: ```
568: 
569: **Benefits**:
570: - ✅ Application doesn't know about EF Core
571: - ✅ Can mock repository for unit tests
572: - ✅ Complex queries are encapsulated in Persistence
573: - ✅ Can optimize queries without changing Application
574: 
575: ---
576: 
577: ## Pattern #4: Domain Invariants vs Application Validation
578: 
579: ### Scenario: Ensuring Data Integrity
580: 
581: **Concept**:
582: - **Domain Invariants**: Rules that must ALWAYS be true (enforced in Domain)
583: - **Application Validation**: Input validation that can vary by use case (enforced in Application)
584: 
585: **❌ Before** (Validation in wrong place):
586: ```csharp
587: // File: {Project}.Domain/{Entity}.cs
588: using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;  // ❌ VIOLATION!
589: 
590: public class {Entity}
591: {
592:     [Required]  // ❌ Presentation concern
593:     [MaxLength(500)]  // ❌ Database concern
594:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
595: 
596:     [Range(1, 10000)]  // ❌ Arbitrary validation rule
597:     public int? MaxAttendees { get; set; }
598: }
599: ```
600: 
601: **✅ After** (Proper separation):
602: ```csharp
603: // File: {Project}.Domain/{Entity}.cs
604: namespace {Project}.Domain;
605: 
606: using System;
607: using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
608: 
609: public class {Entity}
610: {
611:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
612:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
613:     public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
614:     public decimal? Price { get; set; }
615:     public string CurrencyCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
616:     public int ViewCount { get; set; }
617: 
618:     [ForeignKey("{LookupEntity}")]
619:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
620:     public {LookupEntity} {LookupEntity} { get; set; } = null!;
621: 
622:     [ForeignKey("{RelatedEntity1}")]
623:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity1}Id { get; set; }
624:     public {RelatedEntity1} {RelatedEntity1} { get; set; } = null!;
625: 
626:     // ✅ No validation annotations - domain is pure
627: }
628: 
629: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
630: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
631: 
632: using FluentValidation;
633: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
634: 
635: // ✅ INPUT VALIDATION: Can vary by use case
636: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
637: {
638:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
639:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
640:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
641: 
642:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
643:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
644:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
645:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository)
646:     {
647:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
648:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
649:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
650: 
651:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
652:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required")
653:             .MaximumLength(200).WithMessage("Title must not exceed 200 characters");
654: 
655:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
656:             .MaximumLength(5000).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description))
657:             .WithMessage("Description must not exceed 5000 characters");
658: 
659:         RuleFor(x => x.{LookupEntity}Id)
660:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{LookupEntity} is required")
661:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
662:             {
663:                 var exists = await _{lookupEntity}Repository.Exists(id);
664:                 return exists;
665:             })
666:             .WithMessage("{LookupEntity} not found");
667:     }
668: }
669: 
670: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Update{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
671: // ✅ UPDATE validation can be different (e.g., allow partial updates)
672: public class Update{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Update{Entity}Dto>
673: {
674:     public Update{Entity}DtoValidator()
675:     {
676:         RuleFor(x => x.Id)
677:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Id is required");
678: 
679:         // Maybe title is optional when updating
680:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
681:             .MaximumLength(200).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Title))
682:             .WithMessage("Title must not exceed 200 characters");
683: 
684:         // Description optional
685:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
686:             .MaximumLength(5000).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description))
687:             .WithMessage("Description must not exceed 5000 characters");
688:     }
689: }
690: ```
691: 
692: **Decision Matrix**:
693: 
694: | Question | Domain Invariant | Application Validation |
695: |----------|------------------|----------------------|
696: | Can it vary by use case? | ❌ No | ✅ Yes |
697: | Can entity exist without it? | ❌ No | ✅ Yes |
698: | Is it a business rule? | ✅ Yes | ⚠️ Maybe |
699: | Example | "{Entity} must have {RelatedEntity}" | "Title required for CREATE, optional for UPDATE" |
700: 
701: ---
702: 
703: ## Pattern #5: Sharing Code Between Layers (DTOs)
704: 
705: ### Scenario: Sharing DTOs Between API and Blazor
706: 
707: **❌ Before** (DTOs in wrong layer):
708: ```csharp
709: // File: {Project}.API/Models/{Entity}Dto.cs
710: namespace {Project}.API.Models;  // ❌ API-specific
711: 
712: public class {Entity}Dto
713: {
714:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
715:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
716: }
717: 
718: // File: {Project}.Blazor.Client/Models/{Entity}Dto.cs
719: namespace {Project}.Blazor.Client.Models;  // ❌ Duplicated!
720: 
721: public class {Entity}Dto  // ❌ Same DTO copied
722: {
723:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
724:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
725: }
726: ```
727: 
728: **✅ After** (DTOs in Application layer):
729: ```csharp
730: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/{Entity}ListDto.cs
731: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
732: 
733: using System;
734: 
735: // ✅ Shared DTO in Application layer
736: public class {Entity}ListDto
737: {
738:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
739:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
740:     public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
741:     public string {LookupEntity}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
742:     public string {RelatedEntity1}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
743:     public string {RelatedEntity2}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
744: }
745: 
746: // File: {Project}.API/Controllers/{Entity}Controller.cs
747: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
748: 
749: using System.Collections.Generic;
750: using System.Threading.Tasks;
751: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};  // ✅ References Application DTOs
752: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
753: using MediatR;
754: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
755: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
756: 
757: [Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
758: [ApiController]
759: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
760: {
761:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
762: 
763:     public {Entity}Controller(IMediator mediator) => _mediator = mediator;
764: 
765:     [HttpGet]
766:     [AllowAnonymous]
767:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll()
768:     {
769:         var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
770:         return Ok({entities});
771:     }
772: }
773: 
774: // File: {Project}.Blazor.Client/Pages/{Entities}List.razor
775: @using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}  @* ✅ References same DTOs *@
776: @inject HttpClient Http
777: 
778: @code {
779:     private List<{Entity}ListDto>? _{entities};
780: 
781:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
782:     {
783:         _{entities} = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<{Entity}ListDto>>("/api/v1/{entity}");
784:     }
785: }
786: ```
787: 
788: **Benefits**:
789: - ✅ Single source of truth for DTOs
790: - ✅ No duplication between API and Blazor
791: - ✅ Changes to DTOs are reflected everywhere
792: - ✅ Can be shared across multiple UIs (Blazor, CLI, etc.)
793: 
794: ---
795: 
796: ## Pattern #6: Composition Root (DI Registration)
797: 
798: ### Scenario: Wiring Up All Dependencies
799: 
800: **Location**: Always in **API or Blazor Program.cs** (Presentation layer)
801: 
802: **Example from {Project}.API/Program.cs**:
803: ```csharp
804: // File: {Project}.API/Program.cs
805: using {Project}.Application;
806: using {Project}.Infrastructure;
807: using {Project}.Persistence;
808: 
809: var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
810: 
811: // ✅ Register Application layer services
812: builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(MappingProfile).Assembly));
813: builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(typeof(MappingProfile));
814: 
815: // ✅ Register Persistence layer services (DbContext, Repositories)
816: builder.Services.AddDbContext<{DbContext}>(options =>
817:     options.UseNpgsql(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")));
818: 
819: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{Entity}Repository, {Entity}Repository>();
820: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{RelatedEntity3}Repository, {RelatedEntity3}Repository>();
821: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{ParentEntity}Repository, {ParentEntity}Repository>();
822: 
823: // ✅ Register Infrastructure layer services
824: builder.Services.AddScoped<IEmailService, SendGridEmailService>();
825: builder.Services.AddScoped<IFileStorageService, AzureBlobStorageService>();
826: 
827: var app = builder.Build();
828: app.Run();
829: ```
830: 
831: **Benefits**:
832: - ✅ All dependencies registered in one place
833: - ✅ Clear composition root
834: - ✅ Each layer provides services
835: - ✅ Testable with mock implementations
836: 
837: ---
838: 
839: ## Quick Reference: Fix Decision Tree
840: 
841: ```
842: Violation detected. What should I do?
843: 
844: 1. Is it a business rule or domain concept?
845:    YES → Move to Domain entity method
846:    NO → Continue
847: 
848: 2. Is it a use case/workflow?
849:    YES → Create Command/Query in Application
850:    NO → Continue
851: 
852: 3. Is it database access?
853:    YES → Create interface in Application, implement in Persistence
854:    NO → Continue
855: 
856: 4. Is it external service (email, file storage)?
857:    YES → Create interface in Application, implement in Infrastructure
858:    NO → Continue
859: 
860: 5. Is it HTTP-specific (status codes, headers)?
861:    YES → Keep in API Controller
862:    NO → Continue
863: 
864: 6. Is it UI-specific (rendering, user interaction)?
865:    YES → Keep in Blazor component
866:    NO → Re-evaluate (might be in wrong layer)
867: ```
868: 
869: ---
870: 
871: **Summary**: When in doubt, dependencies flow INWARD. High-level policy (Domain, Application) does not depend on low-level details (Infrastructure, Persistence, API).
````

## File: .claude/skills/clean-architecture-rules/resources/layer-responsibilities.md
````markdown
  1: # Layer Responsibilities - What Goes Where
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Layer Guidelines**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Decision Tree: Where Does This Code Belong?
  8: 
  9: ```
 10: Is it a business rule or domain concept?
 11: ├─ YES → DOMAIN layer
 12: │  └─ Example: {Entity}, {LookupEntity}, {EntityStatus} enum
 13: │
 14: └─ NO → Is it a use case or application workflow?
 15:    ├─ YES → APPLICATION layer
 16:    │  └─ Example: Create{Entity}Command, Get{Entity}ListRequest, {Entity}Dto
 17:    │
 18:    └─ NO → Is it a technical implementation detail?
 19:       ├─ YES → Does it involve data persistence?
 20:       │  ├─ YES → PERSISTENCE layer
 21:       │  │  └─ Example: {DbContext}, {Entity}Repository
 22:       │  │
 23:       │  └─ NO → INFRASTRUCTURE layer
 24:       │     └─ Example: EmailService, FileStorageService
 25:       │
 26:       └─ NO → Is it a user interface or HTTP endpoint?
 27:          └─ YES → PRESENTATION layer (API or Blazor)
 28:             └─ Example: {Entity}Controller, {Entities}List.razor
 29: ```
 30: 
 31: ## 1. Domain Layer ({Project}.Domain)
 32: 
 33: **Purpose**: Pure business logic and domain concepts. The heart of the application.
 34: 
 35: **Contains**:
 36: - **Entities**: Core business objects with identity ({Entity}, {RelatedEntity}, User)
 37: - **Value Objects**: Immutable objects defined by their attributes (Address, DateRange)
 38: - **Enums**: Domain concepts ({EntityStatus}, Gender, {LookupEntity})
 39: - **Domain Events**: Things that happened in the domain ({Entity}CreatedEvent)
 40: - **Exceptions**: Domain-specific errors ({Entity}CapacityExceededException)
 41: 
 42: **Does NOT contain**:
 43: - DTOs (those are in Application)
 44: - Database configurations (those are in Persistence)
 45: - API models (those are in API)
 46: - Any framework dependencies
 47: 
 48: **File Structure**:
 49: ```
 50: {Project}.Domain/
 51: ├── Entities/
 52: │   ├── {Entity}.cs
 53: │   ├── {RelatedEntity}.cs
 54: │   ├── {LinkEntity}.cs
 55: │   └── User.cs
 56: ├── Enums/
 57: │   ├── {EntityStatus}.cs
 58: │   ├── Gender.cs
 59: │   └── {LookupEntity}Type.cs
 60: ├── ValueObjects/
 61: │   ├── Address.cs
 62: │   ├── DateRange.cs
 63: │   └── Geolocation.cs
 64: ├── Events/
 65: │   ├── {Entity}CreatedEvent.cs
 66: │   └── {Entity}CancelledEvent.cs
 67: └── Exceptions/
 68:     ├── {Entity}CapacityExceededException.cs
 69:     └── DomainException.cs
 70: ```
 71: 
 72: **Example - Entity**:
 73: ```csharp
 74: namespace {Project}.Domain.Entities;
 75: 
 76: public class {Entity}
 77: {
 78:     public {IdType} Id { get; private set; }
 79:     public string Title { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
 80:     public string Description { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
 81:     public DateTime StartsAt { get; private set; }
 82:     public DateTime? EndsAt { get; private set; }
 83:     public {EntityStatus} Status { get; private set; }
 84:     public int? MaxParticipants { get; private set; }
 85:     public {IdType} {RelatedEntity}Id { get; private set; }
 86: 
 87:     // Navigation properties
 88:     public {RelatedEntity} {RelatedEntity} { get; private set; } = null!;
 89:     public ICollection<{LinkEntity}> {LinkEntities} { get; private set; } = new List<{LinkEntity}>();
 90: 
 91:     // Business logic methods
 92:     public void Cancel()
 93:     {
 94:         if (Status == {EntityStatus}.Cancelled)
 95:             throw new InvalidOperationException("{Entity} is already cancelled");
 96: 
 97:         if (StartsAt < DateTime.UtcNow)
 98:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot cancel a {entity} that has already started");
 99: 
100:         Status = {EntityStatus}.Cancelled;
101:     }
102: }
103: ```
104: 
105: **Key Principle**: Domain entities contain business rules. They enforce invariants and maintain consistency.
106: 
107: ---
108: 
109: ## 2. Application Layer ({Project}.Application)
110: 
111: **Purpose**: Application business logic, use cases, and orchestration. Defines WHAT the system does.
112: 
113: **Contains**:
114: - **Commands** (CQRS): Write operations (Create{Entity}Command, Update{Entity}Command)
115: - **Queries** (CQRS): Read operations (Get{Entity}DetailsRequest, Get{Entity}ListRequest)
116: - **Handlers**: Process commands and queries using MediatR
117: - **DTOs**: Data Transfer Objects for API/UI communication
118: - **Validators**: FluentValidation rules for requests
119: - **Interfaces**: Contracts that Infrastructure implements (I{Entity}Repository, IEmailService)
120: - **Mapping**: AutoMapper profiles for Entity ↔ DTO conversion
121: 
122: **Does NOT contain**:
123: - Database access logic (use interfaces, implement in Persistence)
124: - HTTP concerns (status codes, headers - those are in API)
125: - UI logic (those are in Blazor)
126: 
127: **File Structure**:
128: ```
129: {Project}.Application/
130: ├── Features/
131: │   └── {Entities}/
132: │       ├── Requests/
133: │       │   ├── Commands/
134: │       │   │   ├── Create{Entity}Command.cs
135: │       │   │   ├── Update{Entity}Command.cs
136: │       │   │   └── Delete{Entity}Command.cs
137: │       │   └── Queries/
138: │       │       ├── Get{Entity}ListRequest.cs
139: │       │       ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequest.cs
140: │       │       └── Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}Request.cs
141: │       └── Handlers/
142: │           ├── Commands/
143: │           │   ├── Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
144: │           │   ├── Update{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
145: │           │   └── Delete{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
146: │           └── Queries/
147: │               ├── Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
148: │               ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler.cs
149: │               └── Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}RequestHandler.cs
150: ├── DTOs/
151: │   └── {Entity}/
152: │       ├── {Entity}Dto.cs
153: │       ├── {Entity}ListDto.cs
154: │       ├── Create{Entity}Dto.cs
155: │       ├── Update{Entity}Dto.cs
156: │       └── Validators/
157: │           ├── Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
158: │           └── Update{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
159: ├── Contracts/
160: │   ├── Persistence/
161: │   │   ├── I{Entity}Repository.cs
162: │   │   ├── IGenericRepository.cs
163: │   │   └── I{RelatedEntity}Repository.cs
164: │   └── Infrastructure/
165: │       ├── IEmailService.cs
166: │       └── IFileStorageService.cs
167: ├── Profiles/
168: │   └── MappingProfile.cs
169: └── Responses/
170:     └── BaseCommandResponse.cs
171: ```
172: 
173: **Example - Create Command Handler**:
174: ```csharp
175: // Command (Request)
176: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
177: 
178: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
179: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
180: using MediatR;
181: 
182: public record Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
183: {
184:     public Create{Entity}Dto {Entity}Dto { get; set; } = null!;
185: }
186: 
187: // Handler
188: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
189: 
190: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
191: {
192:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
193:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity}Repository _{relatedEntity}Repository;
194:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
195: 
196:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
197:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
198:         I{RelatedEntity}Repository {relatedEntity}Repository,
199:         IMapper mapper)
200:     {
201:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
202:         _{relatedEntity}Repository = {relatedEntity}Repository;
203:         _mapper = mapper;
204:     }
205: 
206:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
207:     {
208:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
209: 
210:         // Validator instantiated manually with dependencies
211:         var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(_{relatedEntity}Repository);
212:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
213: 
214:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
215:         {
216:             response.Success = false;
217:             response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
218:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
219:             return response;
220:         }
221: 
222:         // Create entity using domain logic
223:         var entity = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
224:         entity = await _{entity}Repository.Create(entity);
225: 
226:         response.Success = true;
227:         response.Id = entity.Id;
228:         response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
229: 
230:         return response;
231:     }
232: }
233: ```
234: 
235: **Key Principle**: Application orchestrates domain logic and coordinates infrastructure services through interfaces.
236: 
237: ---
238: 
239: ## 3. Persistence Layer ({Project}.Persistence)
240: 
241: **Purpose**: Data access implementation using Entity Framework Core. Defines HOW data is stored.
242: 
243: **Contains**:
244: - **DbContext**: EF Core database context
245: - **Entity Configurations**: Fluent API configuration (IEntityTypeConfiguration)
246: - **Repositories**: Concrete implementations of repository interfaces
247: - **Migrations**: Database schema changes
248: - **Seed Data**: Initial data for development/testing
249: 
250: **Does NOT contain**:
251: - Business logic (that belongs in Domain/Application)
252: - API endpoints (those are in API)
253: 
254: **File Structure**:
255: ```
256: {Project}.Persistence/
257: ├── Configurations/
258: │   ├── {Entity}Configuration.cs
259: │   ├── {RelatedEntity}Configuration.cs
260: │   └── {LinkEntity}Configuration.cs
261: ├── Repositories/
262: │   ├── GenericRepository.cs
263: │   ├── {Entity}Repository.cs
264: │   └── {RelatedEntity}Repository.cs
265: ├── Migrations/
266: │   ├── 20250103_InitialCreate.cs
267: │   └── 20250104_Add{Entity}Tags.cs
268: ├── Seeders/
269: │   └── {LookupEntity}Seeder.cs
270: └── {DbContext}.cs
271: ```
272: 
273: **Example - DbContext**:
274: ```csharp
275: namespace {Project}.Persistence;
276: 
277: using {Project}.Domain;
278: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
279: 
280: public class {DbContext} : DbContext
281: {
282:     public {DbContext}(DbContextOptions<{DbContext}> options)
283:         : base(options)
284:     {
285:     }
286: 
287:     public DbSet<{Entity}> {Entities} => Set<{Entity}>();
288:     public DbSet<{RelatedEntity}> {RelatedEntities} => Set<{RelatedEntity}>();
289:     public DbSet<{LinkEntity}> {LinkEntities} => Set<{LinkEntity}>();
290: 
291:     protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
292:     {
293:         base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
294: 
295:         // Apply all configurations from assembly
296:         modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof({DbContext}).Assembly);
297:     }
298: }
299: ```
300: 
301: **Example - Entity Configuration**:
302: ```csharp
303: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Configurations;
304: 
305: using {Project}.Domain;
306: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
307: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
308: 
309: public class {Entity}Configuration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<{Entity}>
310: {
311:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<{Entity}> builder)
312:     {
313:         builder.ToTable("{entities}");
314: 
315:         builder.HasKey(e => e.Id);
316: 
317:         builder.Property(e => e.Title)
318:             .IsRequired()
319:             .HasMaxLength(200);
320: 
321:         builder.Property(e => e.Description)
322:             .HasMaxLength(5000);
323: 
324:         // Relationships
325:         builder.HasOne(e => e.{RelatedEntity})
326:             .WithMany()
327:             .HasForeignKey(e => e.{RelatedEntity}Id)
328:             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
329: 
330:         builder.HasMany(e => e.{LinkEntities})
331:             .WithOne(l => l.{Entity})
332:             .HasForeignKey(l => l.{Entity}Id);
333:     }
334: }
335: ```
336: 
337: **Example - Repository Implementation**:
338: ```csharp
339: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
340: 
341: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
342: using {Project}.Domain;
343: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
344: 
345: public class {Entity}Repository : GenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>, I{Entity}Repository
346: {
347:     private readonly {DbContext} _dbContext;
348: 
349:     public {Entity}Repository({DbContext} dbContext) : base(dbContext)
350:     {
351:         _dbContext = dbContext;
352:     }
353: 
354:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails()
355:     {
356:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
357:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
358:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity})
359:             .ToListAsync();
360:     }
361: 
362:     public async Task<{Entity}?> Get{Entity}WithDetails({IdType} id)
363:     {
364:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
365:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
366:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity})
367:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.Id == id);
368:     }
369: }
370: ```
371: 
372: **Key Principle**: Persistence knows about databases, SQL, EF Core. Application doesn't.
373: 
374: ---
375: 
376: ## 4. Infrastructure Layer ({Project}.Infrastructure)
377: 
378: **Purpose**: External services and integrations (email, file storage, external APIs).
379: 
380: **Contains**:
381: - **Email Services**: SendGrid, SMTP implementations
382: - **File Storage**: Azure Blob Storage, AWS S3, local file system
383: - **External APIs**: Federation (planned), third-party integrations
384: - **Time Services**: System clock abstraction
385: - **Caching**: Redis, in-memory cache
386: 
387: **File Structure**:
388: ```
389: {Project}.Infrastructure/
390: ├── Email/
391: │   └── SendGridEmailService.cs
392: ├── Storage/
393: │   └── AzureBlobStorageService.cs
394: ├── External/
395: │   └── (third-party integrations)
396: ├── Time/
397: │   └── SystemTimeProvider.cs
398: └── DependencyInjection.cs
399: ```
400: 
401: **Example - Email Service**:
402: ```csharp
403: namespace {Project}.Infrastructure.Email;
404: 
405: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
406: using SendGrid;
407: using SendGrid.Helpers.Mail;
408: 
409: public class SendGridEmailService : IEmailService
410: {
411:     private readonly ISendGridClient _client;
412: 
413:     public SendGridEmailService(ISendGridClient client)
414:     {
415:         _client = client;
416:     }
417: 
418:     public async Task Send{Entity}CreatedNotificationAsync({IdType} {entity}Id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
419:     {
420:         var from = new EmailAddress("noreply@example.org", "{Project}");
421:         var to = new EmailAddress("admin@example.org");
422:         var subject = $"New {Entity} Created: {{entity}Id}";
423:         var plainTextContent = $"A new {entity} has been created with ID: {{entity}Id}";
424:         var htmlContent = $"<strong>A new {entity} has been created with ID: {{entity}Id}</strong>";
425: 
426:         var msg = MailHelper.CreateSingleEmail(from, to, subject, plainTextContent, htmlContent);
427:         await _client.SendEmailAsync(msg, cancellationToken);
428:     }
429: }
430: ```
431: 
432: ---
433: 
434: ## 5. Presentation Layer ({Project}.API)
435: 
436: **Purpose**: HTTP API endpoints using ASP.NET Core controllers.
437: 
438: **Contains**:
439: - **Controllers**: REST API endpoints
440: - **Middleware**: Error handling, authentication, logging
441: - **DTOs/Models**: Request/Response models (if not shared with Application)
442: - **Filters**: Authorization, validation filters
443: - **Program.cs**: DI registration (Composition Root)
444: 
445: **File Structure**:
446: ```
447: {Project}.API/
448: ├── Controllers/
449: │   ├── {Entity}Controller.cs
450: │   ├── {RelatedEntity}Controller.cs
451: │   └── {LookupEntity}Controller.cs
452: ├── Middleware/
453: │   └── ExceptionHandlingMiddleware.cs
454: ├── Filters/
455: │   └── ApiKeyAuthorizationFilter.cs
456: └── Program.cs
457: ```
458: 
459: **Example - Controller**:
460: ```csharp
461: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
462: 
463: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
464: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
465: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
466: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
467: using MediatR;
468: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
469: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
470: 
471: [ApiController]
472: [Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
473: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
474: {
475:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
476: 
477:     public {Entity}Controller(IMediator mediator)
478:     {
479:         _mediator = mediator;
480:     }
481: 
482:     [HttpGet("{id}")]
483:     [AllowAnonymous]
484:     [EndpointSummary("Get {Entity} Details")]
485:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof({Entity}Dto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
486:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
487:     public async Task<ActionResult<{Entity}Dto>> GetById({IdType} id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
488:     {
489:         var request = new Get{Entity}DetailsRequest { Id = id };
490:         var result = await _mediator.Send(request, cancellationToken);
491: 
492:         return result is not null ? Ok(result) : NotFound();
493:     }
494: 
495:     [HttpPost]
496:     [Authorize]
497:     [EndpointSummary("Create {Entity}")]
498:     [Consumes("application/json")]
499:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
500:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
501:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Create(
502:         [FromBody] Create{Entity}Dto dto,
503:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
504:     {
505:         var command = new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto };
506:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command, cancellationToken);
507: 
508:         return response.Success ? Ok(response) : BadRequest(response);
509:     }
510: }
511: ```
512: 
513: **Key Principle**: Controllers are thin. They receive requests, delegate to MediatR handlers, and return responses.
514: 
515: ---
516: 
517: ## 6. Presentation Layer ({Project}.Blazor)
518: 
519: **Purpose**: Interactive web UI using Blazor Server + WebAssembly.
520: 
521: **Contains**:
522: - **Pages**: Routable Blazor components (@page directive)
523: - **Components**: Reusable UI components
524: - **Services**: UI-specific services (state management, navigation)
525: - **Program.cs**: DI registration
526: 
527: **File Structure**:
528: ```
529: {Project}.Blazor/
530: ├── Pages/
531: │   ├── {Entities}/
532: │   │   ├── {Entities}List.razor
533: │   │   ├── {Entity}Details.razor
534: │   │   └── Create{Entity}.razor
535: │   └── Index.razor
536: ├── Components/
537: │   ├── Layout/
538: │   │   ├── MainLayout.razor
539: │   │   └── NavMenu.razor
540: │   └── Shared/
541: │       ├── {Entity}Card.razor
542: │       └── LoadingSpinner.razor
543: └── Program.cs
544: ```
545: 
546: **Example - Blazor Page**:
547: ```razor
548: @page "/{entities}"
549: @using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}
550: @using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries
551: @using MediatR
552: @inject IMediator Mediator
553: 
554: <PageTitle>{Entities}</PageTitle>
555: 
556: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large">
557:     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="mb-4">All {Entities}</MudText>
558: 
559:     @if (_{entities} is null)
560:     {
561:         <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" />
562:     }
563:     else
564:     {
565:         <MudGrid>
566:             @foreach (var item in _{entities})
567:             {
568:                 <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
569:                     <{Entity}Card {Entity}="@item" />
570:                 </MudItem>
571:             }
572:         </MudGrid>
573:     }
574: </MudContainer>
575: 
576: @code {
577:     private List<{Entity}ListDto>? _{entities};
578: 
579:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
580:     {
581:         var request = new Get{Entity}ListRequest();
582:         _{entities} = await Mediator.Send(request);
583:     }
584: }
585: ```
586: 
587: ---
588: 
589: ## Common Scenarios: Where Does This Go?
590: 
591: | Scenario | Layer | Why |
592: |----------|-------|-----|
593: | {Entity} capacity validation | **Domain** | Business rule invariant |
594: | Creating a {entity} via API | **Application** (Command/Handler) | Use case orchestration |
595: | Saving {entity} to database | **Persistence** (DbContext) | Data persistence implementation |
596: | Sending {entity} notification email | **Infrastructure** (EmailService) | External service integration |
597: | {Entity} list API endpoint | **API** (Controller) | HTTP entry point |
598: | {Entity} list UI page | **Blazor** (Razor page) | User interface |
599: | {Entity}Dto for API response | **Application** (DTOs folder) | Application-level data transfer |
600: | I{Entity}Repository interface | **Application** (Contracts) | Abstraction for persistence |
601: | {Entity}Repository implementation | **Persistence** | Concrete implementation |
602: 
603: ---
604: 
605: **Next**: See [violation-examples.md](violation-examples.md) for common mistakes and [fix-patterns.md](fix-patterns.md) for comprehensive fix strategies.
````

## File: .claude/skills/clean-architecture-rules/resources/violation-examples.md
````markdown
  1: # Common Violations and Error Messages
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Violation Examples**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Violation #1: Domain Referencing Infrastructure
  8: 
  9: ### The Problem
 10: 
 11: ```csharp
 12: // File: {Project}.Domain/{Entity}.cs
 13: namespace {Project}.Domain;
 14: 
 15: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;  // ❌ VIOLATION!
 16: 
 17: public class {Entity}
 18: {
 19:     [Key]  // ❌ Data annotation from EF Core
 20:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
 21: 
 22:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 23: }
 24: ```
 25: 
 26: **Error Message**:
 27: ```
 28: ⚠️ CLEAN ARCHITECTURE VIOLATION DETECTED
 29: 
 30: Layer: Domain
 31: File: {Project}.Domain/{Entity}.cs
 32: Violation: Domain layer cannot reference Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore
 33: 
 34: REASON:
 35: Domain must be framework-agnostic. EF Core is an infrastructure concern.
 36: 
 37: FIX:
 38: 1. Remove [Key] attribute
 39: 2. Use [ForeignKey] for navigation properties only
 40: 3. Configure constraints in Persistence layer using Fluent API
 41: ```
 42: 
 43: ### The Fix
 44: 
 45: ```csharp
 46: // File: {Project}.Domain/{Entity}.cs
 47: namespace {Project}.Domain;
 48: 
 49: using System;
 50: using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;  // ✅ Only for [ForeignKey]
 51: 
 52: public class {Entity}
 53: {
 54:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }  // ✅ Plain C# property
 55:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 56: 
 57:     // ✅ OK - Specifies relationship metadata
 58:     [ForeignKey("{LookupEntity}")]
 59:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
 60:     public {LookupEntity} {LookupEntity} { get; set; }
 61: 
 62:     [ForeignKey("{RelatedEntity}")]
 63:     public {IdType} {RelatedEntity}Id { get; set; }
 64:     public {RelatedEntity} {RelatedEntity} { get; set; }
 65: }
 66: ```
