## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/DeleteEventDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  4: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  5: 
  6: <MudDialog>
  7:     <TitleContent>
  8:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
  9:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Warning" Color="Color.Error" Class="mr-2" />
 10:             Delete Event
 11:         </MudText>
 12:     </TitleContent>
 13:     <DialogContent>
 14:         @if (_isLoading)
 15:         {
 16:             <div class="d-flex align-center justify-center pa-4">
 17:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Small" />
 18:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="ml-3">Loading event details...</MudText>
 19:             </div>
 20:         }
 21:         else
 22:         {
 23:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">
 24:                 Are you sure you want to delete the event "<strong>@EventTitle</strong>"?
 25:             </MudText>
 26: 
 27:             @if (_sessionCount > 0)
 28:             {
 29:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Dense="true" Class="mb-3">
 30:                     This event has <strong>@_sessionCount</strong> @(_sessionCount == 1 ? "session" : "sessions") that will also be deleted.
 31:                 </MudAlert>
 32:             }
 33: 
 34:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Dense="true">
 35:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 36:                     <strong>This action cannot be undone.</strong>
 37:                 </MudText>
 38:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mt-2">
 39:                     The following will be permanently deleted:
 40:                 </MudText>
 41:                 <ul class="mt-1 mb-0">
 42:                     <li>Event details and metadata</li>
 43:                     @if (_sessionCount > 0)
 44:                     {
 45:                         <li>@_sessionCount event @(_sessionCount == 1 ? "session" : "sessions")</li>
 46:                         <li>All registrations for @(_sessionCount == 1 ? "this session" : "these sessions")</li>
 47:                     }
 48:                 </ul>
 49:             </MudAlert>
 50:         }
 51:     </DialogContent>
 52:     <DialogActions>
 53:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel" Variant="Variant.Text" Disabled="@_isDeleting">Cancel</MudButton>
 54:         <MudButton Color="Color.Error"
 55:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
 56:                    OnClick="ConfirmDelete"
 57:                    Disabled="@(_isDeleting || _isLoading)"
 58:                    StartIcon="@(_isDeleting ? Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassBottom : Icons.Material.Filled.Delete)">
 59:             @(_isDeleting ? "Deleting..." : "Delete Event")
 60:         </MudButton>
 61:     </DialogActions>
 62: </MudDialog>
 63: 
 64: @code {
 65:     [CascadingParameter]
 66:     private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
 67: 
 68:     [Parameter]
 69:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
 70: 
 71:     [Parameter]
 72:     public string EventTitle { get; set; } = "";
 73: 
 74:     [Inject]
 75:     private IEventService EventService { get; set; } = default!;
 76: 
 77:     [Inject]
 78:     private ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = default!;
 79: 
 80:     [Inject]
 81:     private ILogger<DeleteEventDialog> Logger { get; set; } = default!;
 82: 
 83:     private bool _isDeleting = false;
 84:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 85:     private int _sessionCount = 0;
 86: 
 87:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 88:     {
 89:         await LoadSessionCount();
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     private async Task LoadSessionCount()
 93:     {
 94:         _isLoading = true;
 95:         StateHasChanged();
 96: 
 97:         try
 98:         {
 99:             var sessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
100:             _sessionCount = sessions?.Count ?? 0;
101:             Logger.LogDebug("Loaded {SessionCount} sessions for event {EventId}", _sessionCount, EventId);
102:         }
103:         catch (Exception ex)
104:         {
105:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading session count for event {EventId}", EventId);
106:             // Continue anyway - deletion should still work even if we can't load session count
107:             _sessionCount = 0;
108:         }
109:         finally
110:         {
111:             _isLoading = false;
112:             StateHasChanged();
113:         }
114:     }
115: 
116:     private void Cancel()
117:     {
118:         Logger.LogDebug("Delete cancelled for event {EventId}", EventId);
119:         MudDialog.Cancel();
120:     }
121: 
122:     private async Task ConfirmDelete()
123:     {
124:         if (_isDeleting || _isLoading) return;
125: 
126:         _isDeleting = true;
127:         StateHasChanged();
128: 
129:         try
130:         {
131:             Logger.LogInformation("Attempting to delete event {EventId} with {SessionCount} sessions", EventId, _sessionCount);
132: 
133:             var success = await EventService.DeleteEventAsync(EventId);
134: 
135:             if (success)
136:             {
137:                 var message = _sessionCount > 0
138:                     ? $"Event and {_sessionCount} {(_sessionCount == 1 ? "session" : "sessions")} deleted successfully"
139:                     : "Event deleted successfully";
140: 
141:                 Logger.LogInformation("Successfully deleted event {EventId}", EventId);
142:                 Snackbar.Add(message, Severity.Success);
143:                 MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
144:             }
145:             else
146:             {
147:                 Logger.LogWarning("Failed to delete event {EventId} - API returned false", EventId);
148:                 Snackbar.Add("Failed to delete event. You may not have permission or the event may not exist.", Severity.Error);
149:                 _isDeleting = false;
150:                 StateHasChanged();
151:             }
152:         }
153:         catch (Exception ex)
154:         {
155:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting event {EventId}", EventId);
156:             Snackbar.Add($"Error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
157:             _isDeleting = false;
158:             StateHasChanged();
159:         }
160:     }
161: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/EditSessionDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Validators
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers
 4: @using FluentValidation
 5: @using MudBlazor
 6: 
 7: <MudDialog>
 8:     <TitleContent>
 9:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
10:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" Class="mr-3 mb-n1" />
11:             Edit Session
12:         </MudText>
13:     </TitleContent>
14:     <DialogContent>
15:         <MudForm @ref="form" @bind-IsValid="success" Model="sessionDto">
16:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="sessionDto.Title" Label="Title" For="@(() => sessionDto.Title)" Required="true" RequiredError="Title is required." />
17:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="sessionDto.Description" Label="Description" For="@(() => sessionDto.Description)" Lines="3" />
18:             <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="startDate" Label="Start Date" Required="true" />
19:             <MudTimePicker @bind-Time="startTime" Label="Start Time" Required="true" />
20:             <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="endDate" Label="End Date" Required="true" />
21:             <MudTimePicker @bind-Time="endTime" Label="End Time" Required="true" />
22:             <MudNumericField @bind-Value="sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees" Label="Max Audience" For="@(() => sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees)" Min="0" />
23:         </MudForm>
24:     </DialogContent>
25:     <DialogActions>
26:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
27:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Update</MudButton>
28:     </DialogActions>
29: </MudDialog>
30: 
31: @code {
32:     [CascadingParameter]
33:     private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
34: 
35:     [Parameter] public EventSessionDto ExistingSession { get; set; }
36: 
37:     private UpdateEventSessionDtoValidator validator = new();
38:     private MudForm form;
39:     private bool success;
40: 
41:     private UpdateEventSessionDto sessionDto = new();
42: 
43:     private DateTime? startDate = DateTime.Now;
44:     private TimeSpan? startTime = DateTime.Now.TimeOfDay;
45:     private DateTime? endDate = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1);
46:     private TimeSpan? endTime = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1).TimeOfDay;
47: 
48:     protected override void OnInitialized()
49:     {
50:         sessionDto.EventId = ExistingSession.EventId;
51:         sessionDto.Id = ExistingSession.Id;
52:         sessionDto.Title = ExistingSession.Title;
53:         sessionDto.Description = ExistingSession.Description;
54:         sessionDto.StartTime = ExistingSession.StartTime;
55:         sessionDto.EndTime = ExistingSession.EndTime;
56:         sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees = ExistingSession.MaxAudienceAttendees;
57: 
58:         // Set date/time pickers from existing session
59:         if (ExistingSession.StartTime.HasValue)
60:         {
61:             startDate = ExistingSession.StartTime.Value.Date.ToLocalTime();
62:             startTime = ExistingSession.StartTime.Value.TimeOfDay;
63:         }
64:         if (ExistingSession.EndTime.HasValue)
65:         {
66:             endDate = ExistingSession.EndTime.Value.Date.ToLocalTime();
67:             endTime = ExistingSession.EndTime.Value.TimeOfDay;
68:         }
69:     }
70: 
71:     private async Task Submit()
72:     {
73:         await form.Validate();
74:         if (form.IsValid)
75:         {
76:             // Use DateTimeHelper for consistent UTC conversion
77:             var startDateTime = startDate.Value.Date + startTime.Value;
78:             var endDateTime = endDate.Value.Date + endTime.Value;
79: 
80:             sessionDto.StartTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(startDateTime);
81:             sessionDto.EndTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(endDateTime);
82: 
83:             MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(sessionDto));
84:         }
85:     }
86: 
87:     void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
88: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/ManageSpeakersDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  3: @using MudBlazor
  4: @using MudBlazor.Services
  5: @inject IEventSessionSpeakerService EventSessionSpeakerService
  6: @inject IActorService ActorService
  7: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  8: 
  9: <MudDialog>
 10:     <TitleContent>
 11:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Manage Speakers</MudText>
 12:     </TitleContent>
 13:     <DialogContent>
 14:         <MudStack Spacing="4">
 15:             <MudAutocomplete T="ActorListDto" Label="Add Speaker" @bind-Value="selectedActor"
 16:                              SearchFunc="@SearchActors" ToStringFunc="@(e => e?.DisplayName)"
 17:                              Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true" />
 18: 
 19:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="AddSpeaker" Disabled="@(selectedActor == null)">Add Speaker</MudButton>
 20: 
 21:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Current Speakers</MudText>
 22:             <MudList T="EventSessionSpeakerListDto" Clickable="true">
 23:                 @foreach (var speaker in speakers)
 24:                 {
 25:                     <MudListItem T="EventSessionSpeakerListDto">
 26:                         @speaker.ActorDisplayName
 27:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" Size="Size.Small" OnClick="@(() => RemoveSpeaker(speaker.Id))" />
 28:                     </MudListItem>
 29:                 }
 30:             </MudList>
 31:         </MudStack>
 32:     </DialogContent>
 33:     <DialogActions>
 34:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
 35:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Ok</MudButton>
 36:     </DialogActions>
 37: </MudDialog>
 38: 
 39: @code {
 40:     [CascadingParameter] IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
 41:     [Parameter] public Guid SessionId { get; set; }
 42: 
 43:     private List<EventSessionSpeakerListDto> speakers = new();
 44:     private ActorListDto? selectedActor;
 45:     private List<ActorListDto> allActors = new();
 46: 
 47:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 48:     {
 49:         await LoadSpeakers();
 50:         var actorsCollection = await ActorService.GetActorsAsync();
 51:         allActors = actorsCollection.ToList();
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     private async Task LoadSpeakers()
 55:     {
 56:         // Note: Service returns ICollection<object> due to neutralized methods
 57:         var rawSpeakers = await EventSessionSpeakerService.GetSpeakersBySessionAsync(SessionId);
 58:         speakers = new List<EventSessionSpeakerListDto>(); // Will be empty until API is updated
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     private async Task<IEnumerable<ActorListDto>> SearchActors(string value, CancellationToken token)
 62:     {
 63:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
 64:         {
 65:             return allActors;
 66:         }
 67:         return allActors.Where(x => x.DisplayName.Contains(value, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     private async Task AddSpeaker()
 71:     {
 72:         if (selectedActor != null && selectedActor.Id.HasValue)
 73:         {
 74:             // Note: Using anonymous object since CreateEventSessionSpeakerDto is not available
 75:             var newSpeaker = new { ActorId = selectedActor.Id.Value, EventSessionId = SessionId };
 76:             var response = await EventSessionSpeakerService.AddSpeakerToSessionAsync(newSpeaker);
 77:             if (response?.Success == true)
 78:             {
 79:                 Snackbar.Add("Speaker added.", Severity.Success);
 80:                 await LoadSpeakers();
 81:                 selectedActor = null;
 82:                 StateHasChanged();
 83:             }
 84:             else
 85:             {
 86:                 Snackbar.Add(response?.Message ?? "Failed to add speaker", Severity.Error);
 87:             }
 88:         }
 89:     }
 90: 
 91:     private async Task RemoveSpeaker(Guid? speakerId)
 92:     {
 93:         if (!speakerId.HasValue) return;
 94:         await EventSessionSpeakerService.RemoveSpeakerFromSessionAsync(speakerId.Value);
 95:         Snackbar.Add("Speaker removed.", Severity.Success);
 96:         await LoadSpeakers();
 97:         StateHasChanged();
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     void Submit() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
101:     void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
102: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/RegistrationManagerDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using MudBlazor
 3: @inject IEventService EventService
 4: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 5: 
 6: <MudDialog>
 7:     <TitleContent>
 8:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
 9:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.People" Class="mr-3 mb-n1" />
10:             Registration Manager
11:         </MudText>
12:     </TitleContent>
13:     <DialogContent>
14:     <MudDataGrid T="EventRegistrationListDto" Items="@registrations" ReadOnly="true"
15:                  Bordered="true" Dense="true" Hover="true">
16:         <Columns>
17:             <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.UserFullName" Title="Name" />
18:             <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.UserId" Title="User Id" />
19:             <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.ApprovalStatusFullName" Title="Status" />
20:             <TemplateColumn StickyRight="true">
21:                 <CellTemplate Context="context">
22:                     @if (context.Item.ApprovalStatusMasterCode == "PENDING")
23:                     {
24:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Check" Size="Size.Small" OnClick="@(() => UpdateStatus(context.Item, 2))" />
25:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Close" Size="Size.Small" OnClick="@(() => UpdateStatus(context.Item, 3))" />
26:                     }
27:                 </CellTemplate>
28:             </TemplateColumn>
29:         </Columns>
30:     </MudDataGrid>
31:     </DialogContent>
32:     <DialogActions>
33:         <MudButton OnClick="Close">Close</MudButton>
34:     </DialogActions>
35: </MudDialog>
36: 
37: @code {
38:     [CascadingParameter]
39:     private IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
40: 
41:     [Parameter] public Guid EventSessionId { get; set; }
42: 
43:     private List<EventRegistrationListDto> registrations = new();
44: 
45:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
46:     {
47:         await LoadRegistrations();
48:     }
49: 
50:     private async Task LoadRegistrations()
51:     {
52:         try
53:         {
54:             var result = await EventService.GetRegistrationsForSessionAsync(EventSessionId);
55:             registrations = result.ToList();
56:             StateHasChanged();
57:         }
58:         catch (Exception ex)
59:         {
60:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading registrations: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
61:         }
62:     }
63: 
64:     private async Task UpdateStatus(EventRegistrationListDto registration, int newStatusId)
65:     {
66:         var dto = new UpdateEventRegistrationDto
67:         {
68:             Id = registration.Id,
69:             UserId = registration.UserId,
70:             EventSessionId = registration.EventSessionId,
71:             ApprovalStatusId = newStatusId,
72:             TenantId = registration.TenantId,
73:             AtprotoRecordId = null
74:         };
75: 
76:         try
77:         {
78:             var response = await EventService.UpdateRegistrationAsync(dto);
79:             if (response?.Success == true)
80:             {
81:                 Snackbar.Add("Registration status updated.", Severity.Success);
82:                 await LoadRegistrations();
83:             }
84:             else
85:             {
86:                 Snackbar.Add(response?.Message ?? "Failed to update registration.", Severity.Error);
87:             }
88:         }
89:         catch (Exception ex)
90:         {
91:             Snackbar.Add($"Error updating status: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
92:         }
93:     }
94: 
95:     private void Close()
96:     {
97:         DialogReference?.Dismiss(DialogResult.Cancel());
98:     }
99: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/EventReviewDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
  3: 
  4: <MudDialog>
  5:     <DialogContent>
  6: <div class="review-dialog-content">
  7:             <div class="rating-section">
  8:                 <div class="rating-label">How would you rate this event?</div>
  9:                 <div class="star-rating">
 10:                     @for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
 11:                     {
 12:                         var starIndex = i;
 13:                         <span class="star @(starIndex <= rating ? "filled" : "")"
 14:                               @onclick="@(() => SetRating(starIndex))">
 15:                             @if (starIndex <= rating)
 16:                             {
 17:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Star" />
 18:                             }
 19:                             else
 20:                             {
 21:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.StarBorder" />
 22:                             }
 23:                         </span>
 24:                     }
 25:                 </div>
 26:                 @if (rating > 0)
 27:                 {
 28:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Primary" Class="mt-2">
 29:                         @GetRatingText()
 30:                     </MudText>
 31:                 }
 32:             </div>
 33: 
 34:             <div class="comment-section">
 35:                 <div class="comment-label">Share your experience (optional)</div>
 36:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="comment"
 37:                               Label="Your review"
 38:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 39:                               Lines="5"
 40:                               Placeholder="Tell us about your experience at this event..."
 41:                               MaxLength="500"
 42:                               Counter="500" />
 43:             </div>
 44: 
 45:             @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorMessage))
 46:             {
 47:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mb-3">@errorMessage</MudAlert>
 48:             }
 49:         </div>
 50:     </DialogContent>
 51:     <DialogActions>
 52:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel"
 53:                    Variant="Variant.Text"
 54:                    Color="Color.Default">
 55:             Cancel
 56:         </MudButton>
 57:         <MudButton OnClick="Submit"
 58:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
 59:                    Color="Color.Primary"
 60:                    Disabled="@(rating == 0)"
 61:                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Send">
 62:             Submit Review
 63:         </MudButton>
 64:     </DialogActions>
 65: </MudDialog>
 66: 
 67: @code {
 68:     [CascadingParameter]
 69:     private IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
 70: 
 71:     [Parameter]
 72:     public string EventTitle { get; set; } = "";
 73: 
 74:     [Parameter]
 75:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
 76: 
 77:     private int rating = 0;
 78:     private string comment = "";
 79:     private string errorMessage = "";
 80: 
 81:     private void SetRating(int value)
 82:     {
 83:         rating = value;
 84:         errorMessage = "";
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     private string GetRatingText()
 88:     {
 89:         return rating switch
 90:         {
 91:             1 => "Poor",
 92:             2 => "Fair",
 93:             3 => "Good",
 94:             4 => "Very Good",
 95:             5 => "Excellent",
 96:             _ => ""
 97:         };
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     private void Submit()
101:     {
102:         if (rating == 0)
103:         {
104:             errorMessage = "Please select a rating";
105:             return;
106:         }
107: 
108:         // Here you would call the API to submit the review
109:         // For now, just close the dialog with success
110:         DialogReference?.Close(DialogResult.Ok(new { Rating = rating, Comment = comment }));
111:     }
112: 
113:     private void Cancel()
114:     {
115:         DialogReference?.Close(DialogResult.Cancel());
116:     }
117: }
````

315:     private static ICollection<T> DeserializeItems<T>(ICollection<object> items) where T : class
316:     {
317:         var result = new List<T>(items.Count);
318:         foreach (var item in items)
319:         {
320:             if (item is T typedItem)
321:             {
322: 
323:                 result.Add(typedItem);
324:             }
325:             else if (item is Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject jObject)
326:             {
327: 
328:                 var deserialized = jObject.ToObject<T>();
329:                 if (deserialized != null)
330:                     result.Add(deserialized);
331:             }
332:             else if (item is System.Text.Json.JsonElement jsonElement)
333:             {
334: 
335:                 var deserialized = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(
336:                     jsonElement.GetRawText(),
337:                     SystemTextJsonOptions);
338:                 if (deserialized != null)
339:                     result.Add(deserialized);
340:             }
341:             else
342:             {
343: 
344:                 var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(item, JsonSettings);
345:                 var deserialized = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<T>(json, JsonSettings);
346:                 if (deserialized != null)
347:                     result.Add(deserialized);
348:             }
349:         }
350:         return result;
351:     }
352: }

  1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  2: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  5: using Microsoft.JSInterop;
  6: using MudBlazor;
  7: 
  8: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Layout;
  9: 
 10: public partial class MainLayout : LayoutComponentBase
 11: {
 12:     private bool _isDarkMode = false;
 13:     private bool _isInitialized = false;
 14:     private MudTheme? _theme;
 15: 
 16:     [Inject]
 17:     protected IUserService UserService { get; set; } = null!;
 18: 
 19:     [Inject]
 20:     protected AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider { get; set; } = null!;
 21: 
 22:     [Inject]
 23:     protected IJSRuntime JSRuntime { get; set; } = null!;
 24: 
 25:     [Inject]
 26:     protected ILogger<MainLayout> Logger { get; set; } = null!;
 27: 
 28:     [CascadingParameter(Name = "InitialTheme")]
 29:     public bool? InitialTheme { get; set; }
 30: 
 31:     public string DarkLightModeButtonIcon => _isDarkMode switch
 32:     {
 33:         true => Icons.Material.Rounded.AutoMode,
 34:         false => Icons.Material.Outlined.DarkMode,
 35:     };
 36: 
 37:     protected override void OnInitialized()
 38:     {
 39:         base.OnInitialized();
 40: 
 41: 
 42:         if (InitialTheme.HasValue)
 43:         {
 44:             _isDarkMode = InitialTheme.Value;
 45:         }
 46: 
 47:         _theme = new()
 48:         {
 49:             PaletteLight = _lightPalette,
 50:             PaletteDark = _darkPalette,
 51:             LayoutProperties = new LayoutProperties()
 52:         };
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
 56:     {
 57:         if (firstRender)
 58:         {
 59: 
 60:             try
 61:             {
 62:                 var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 63:                 if (authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
 64:                 {
 65:                     await UserService.SyncUserAsync();
 66:                 }
 67:             }
 68:             catch (Exception ex)
 69:             {
 70:                 Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error syncing user");
 71:             }
 72: 
 73: 
 74:             try
 75:             {
 76:                 var storedTheme = await JSRuntime.InvokeAsync<string>("ExploreTheme.getStoredTheme");
 77:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(storedTheme))
 78:                 {
 79:                     var isDarkStorage = storedTheme == "dark";
 80:                     if (_isDarkMode != isDarkStorage)
 81:                     {
 82:                         _isDarkMode = isDarkStorage;
 83:                         StateHasChanged();
 84:                     }
 85:                 }
 86:             }
 87:             catch (Exception ex)
 88:             {
 89:                 Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error reading theme from localStorage");
 90:             }
 91: 
 92:             _isInitialized = true;
 93:         }
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     private async Task DarkModeToggle()
 97:     {
 98:         _isDarkMode = !_isDarkMode;
 99:         var themeValue = _isDarkMode ? "dark" : "light";
100: 
101:         try
102:         {
103:             await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("ExploreTheme.setStoredTheme", themeValue);
104:             await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("ExploreTheme.setThemeCookie", themeValue);
105:         }
106:         catch (Exception ex)
107:         {
108:             Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error saving theme");
109:         }
110:     }
111:

116:         Black = "#0A0A0A",
117:         AppbarText = "#1A1A1A",
118:         AppbarBackground = "rgba(245,245,247,0.8)",
119:         Background = "#F5F5F7",

288: }

290: 
291: 
292: 
293: 
294: .navbar__dropdown-overlay {

302: }
303: 
304: 
305:

309:         padding: 6px 12px;

318:         font-size: 0.95rem;

320:

324:     }
325:

329:

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/Tags.razor.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Admin;
  3: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  5: using MudBlazor;
  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Admin;
  8: 
  9: public partial class Tags
 10: {
 11:     [Inject] protected ITagService TagService { get; set; } = null!;
 12:     [Inject] protected IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
 13:     [Inject] protected ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = null!;
 14:     [Inject] protected NavigationManager Nav { get; set; } = null!;
 15: 
 16:     private ICollection<TagListDto> _tags = new List<TagListDto>();
 17:     private string _searchString = string.Empty;
 18:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 19: 
 20:     private IEnumerable<TagListDto> FilteredTags
 21:     {
 22:         get
 23:         {
 24:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
 25:             {
 26:                 return _tags;
 27:             }
 28: 
 29:             return _tags.Where(t =>
 30:                 (t.FullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
 31:                 (t.MasterCode?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
 32:         }
 33:     }
 34: 
 35:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 36:     {
 37:         await LoadTags();
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     private async Task LoadTags()
 41:     {
 42:         _isLoading = true;
 43:         try
 44:         {
 45:             _tags = await TagService.GetTagsAsync() ?? new List<TagListDto>();
 46:         }
 47:         catch (Exception ex)
 48:         {
 49:             Snackbar.Add($"Failed to load tags: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
 50:         }
 51:         finally
 52:         {
 53:             _isLoading = false;
 54:         }
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
 58:     {
 59:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 60:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateTagDialog>("Create Tag", options);
 61:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 62: 
 63:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: CreateTagDto createDto })
 64:         {
 65:             var response = await TagService.CreateTagAsync(createDto);
 66:             if (response?.Success == true)
 67:             {
 68:                 Snackbar.Add($"Tag '{createDto.FullName}' created successfully", Severity.Success);
 69:                 await LoadTags();
 70:             }
 71:             else
 72:             {
 73:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
 74:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to create tag: {errors}", Severity.Error);
 75:             }
 76:         }
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     private async Task OpenEditDialog(TagListDto tag)
 80:     {
 81:         if (!tag.Id.HasValue) return;
 82: 
 83:         var tagDetails = await TagService.GetTagByIdAsync(tag.Id.Value);
 84:         if (tagDetails == null)
 85:         {
 86:             Snackbar.Add("Failed to load tag details", Severity.Error);
 87:             return;
 88:         }
 89: 
 90:         var parameters = new DialogParameters<EditTagDialog>
 91:         {
 92:             { x => x.ExistingTag, tagDetails }
 93:         };
 94: 
 95:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 96:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditTagDialog>("Edit Tag", parameters, options);
 97:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 98: 
 99:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: UpdateTagDto updateDto } && updateDto.Id.HasValue)
100:         {
101:             var response = await TagService.UpdateTagAsync(updateDto.Id.Value, updateDto);
102:             if (response?.Success == true)
103:             {
104:                 Snackbar.Add($"Tag '{updateDto.FullName}' updated successfully", Severity.Success);
105:                 await LoadTags();
106:             }
107:             else
108:             {
109:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
110:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to update tag: {errors}", Severity.Error);
111:             }
112:         }
113:     }
114: 
115:     private async Task DeleteTag(TagListDto tag)
116:     {
117:         if (!tag.Id.HasValue) return;
118: 
119:         bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
120:             "Confirm Delete",
121:             $"Are you sure you want to delete the tag '{tag.FullName}'? This action cannot be undone.",
122:             yesText: "Delete",
123:             cancelText: "Cancel");
124: 
125:         if (confirm == true)
126:         {
127:             var success = await TagService.DeleteTagAsync(tag.Id.Value);
128:             if (success)
129:             {
130:                 Snackbar.Add($"Tag '{tag.FullName}' deleted successfully", Severity.Success);
131:                 await LoadTags();
132:             }
133:             else
134:             {
135:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to delete tag '{tag.FullName}'", Severity.Error);
136:             }
137:         }
138:     }
139: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Auth/LoginRedirect.razor
````razor
 1: @page "/login"
 2: @using MudBlazor
 3: @inject NavigationManager Navigation
 4: 
 5: <PageTitle>Redirecting...</PageTitle>
 6: 
 7: <MudContainer Class="d-flex justify-center align-center" Style="min-height: 60vh;">
 8:     <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="3">
 9:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
10:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Redirecting to sign-in...</MudText>
11:     </MudStack>
12: </MudContainer>
13: 
14: @code {
15:     protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
16:     {
17:         if (!firstRender)
18:         {
19:             return;
20:         }
21: 
22:         // Navigate to the server authentication endpoint (not /login which is this Blazor component)
23:         var query = new Uri(Navigation.Uri).Query;
24:         var challengeUrl = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) ? "/auth/challenge" : $"/auth/challenge{query}";
25:         Navigation.NavigateTo(challengeUrl, forceLoad: true);
26:     }
27: }
````

 33:                         x.FullName.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

 35:         ?? Enumerable.Empty<OrganizationListDto>();

 40:         await LoadOrganizationsAsync();

 47:     private async Task LoadOrganizationsAsync()
 48:     {
 49:         _isLoading = true;
 50:         _errorMessage = null;
 51: 
 52:         try
 53:         {
 54:             Logger.LogInformation("[MyOrganizations] Loading organizations...");
 55: 
 56: 
 57:             var orgs = await OrganizationService.GetMyOrganizationsAsync();
 58: 
 59:             if (orgs == null || orgs.Count == 0)
 60:             {
 61:                 Logger.LogInformation("[MyOrganizations] No organizations found, attempting user sync...");
 62:                 var syncResult = await UserService.SyncUserAsync();
 63: 
 64:                 if (syncResult?.Success == true)
 65:                 {
 66:                     await Task.Delay(200);
 67:                     orgs = await OrganizationService.GetMyOrganizationsAsync();
 68:                 }
 69:             }
 70: 
 71:             _organizations = orgs ?? new List<OrganizationListDto>();
 72:             Logger.LogInformation("[MyOrganizations] Loaded {Count} organizations", _organizations.Count);
 73:         }
 74:         catch (Exception ex)
 75:         {
 76:             Logger.LogError(ex, "[MyOrganizations] Error loading organizations");
 77:             _errorMessage = "Unable to load your organizations. Please try again.";
 78:         }
 79:         finally
 80:         {
 81:             _isLoading = false;
 82:         }
 83:     }

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/AuthStateService.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Security.Claims;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Configuration;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
  5: 
  6: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: public interface IAuthStateService
 13: {
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17: 
 18:     Task<string> GetCurrentUserIdAsync();
 19: 
 20: 
 21: 
 22: 
 23: 
 24:     Task<Guid> GetCurrentTenantIdAsync();
 25: 
 26: 
 27: 
 28: 
 29:     Task<bool> IsAuthenticatedAsync();
 30: }
 31: 
 32: public class AuthStateService : IAuthStateService
 33: {
 34:     private readonly AuthenticationStateProvider _authenticationStateProvider;
 35:     private readonly ILogger<AuthStateService> _logger;
 36:     private readonly TenantConfiguration _tenantConfig;
 37: 
 38:     public AuthStateService(
 39:         AuthenticationStateProvider authenticationStateProvider,
 40:         ILogger<AuthStateService> logger,
 41:         IOptions<TenantConfiguration> tenantConfig)
 42:     {
 43:         _authenticationStateProvider = authenticationStateProvider;
 44:         _logger = logger;
 45:         _tenantConfig = tenantConfig?.Value ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tenantConfig));
 46: 
 47: 
 48:         if (!_tenantConfig.IsValid())
 49:         {
 50:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
 51:                 "Invalid tenant configuration. DefaultTenantId and DefaultTenant must be set.");
 52:         }
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public async Task<string> GetCurrentUserIdAsync()
 56:     {
 57:         var authState = await _authenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 58:         var user = authState.User;
 59: 
 60:         if (!user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
 61:         {
 62:             _logger.LogWarning("Attempted to get user ID for unauthenticated user");
 63:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User is not authenticated");
 64:         }
 65: 
 66: 
 67:         var userId = user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
 68:                      ?? user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
 69:                      ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
 70:                      ?? user.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
 71: 
 72:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
 73:         {
 74:             _logger.LogError("User ID not found in JWT claims for authenticated user. Available claims: {Claims}",
 75:                 string.Join(", ", user.Claims.Select(c => c.Type)));
 76:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User ID not found in token claims");
 77:         }
 78: 
 79:         return userId;
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     public async Task<Guid> GetCurrentTenantIdAsync()
 83:     {
 84:         var authState = await _authenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 85:         var user = authState.User;
 86: 
 87:         if (!user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
 88:         {
 89:             _logger.LogWarning("Attempted to get tenant ID for unauthenticated user");
 90:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User is not authenticated");
 91:         }
 92: 
 93: 
 94: 
 95:         if (!_tenantConfig.Enabled)
 96:         {
 97:             _logger.LogDebug("Single-tenant mode: Using default tenant {TenantId}", _tenantConfig.DefaultTenantId);
 98:             return _tenantConfig.DefaultTenantId;
 99:         }
100: 
101: 
102:         _logger.LogDebug("Multi-tenant mode: Extracting tenant from user claims");
103: 
104: 
105:         var tenantIdString = user.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value
106:                             ?? user.FindFirst("tenantId")?.Value
107:                             ?? user.FindFirst("tid")?.Value
108:                             ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/tenantid")?.Value;
109: 
110:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantIdString))
111:         {
112: 
113:             _logger.LogError("Multi-tenant mode enabled but tenant ID not found in claims. Available claims: {Claims}",
114:                 string.Join(", ", user.Claims.Select(c => c.Type)));
115:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
116:                 "Multi-tenant mode is enabled but no tenant ID found in user claims. " +
117:                 "Ensure your identity provider includes tenant_id claim.");
118:         }
119: 
120:         if (!Guid.TryParse(tenantIdString, out var tenantId))
121:         {
122:             _logger.LogError("Invalid tenant ID format in claims: {TenantId}", tenantIdString);
123:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid tenant ID format: {tenantIdString}");
124:         }
125: 
126:         _logger.LogDebug("Multi-tenant mode: Using tenant {TenantId} from claims", tenantId);
127:         return tenantId;
128:     }
129: 
130:     public async Task<bool> IsAuthenticatedAsync()
131:     {
132:         var authState = await _authenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
133:         return authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;
134:     }
135: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/BffUnauthorizedHandler.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Linq;
  2: using System.Net;
  3: using System.Net.Http;
  4: using System.Threading;
  5: using System.Threading.Tasks;
  6: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  7: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  8: 
  9: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 10: 
 11: public sealed class BffUnauthorizedHandler : DelegatingHandler
 12: {
 13:     private static readonly string[] AnonymousApiPathPrefixes =
 14:     [
 15:         "/api/v1/publicexperience/settings",
 16:         "/api/v1/instanceonboarding/status"
 17:     ];
 18: 
 19:     private readonly NavigationManager _nav;
 20:     private readonly ILogger<BffUnauthorizedHandler> _logger;
 21: 
 22:     public BffUnauthorizedHandler(NavigationManager nav, ILogger<BffUnauthorizedHandler> logger)
 23:     {
 24:         _nav = nav;
 25:         _logger = logger;
 26:     }
 27: 
 28:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 29:     {
 30:         HttpResponseMessage response;
 31:         try
 32:         {
 33:             response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
 34:         }
 35:         catch (Exception ex)
 36:         {
 37:             _logger.LogError(ex, "BFF handler: request failed for {Method} {Uri}", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
 38:             throw;
 39:         }
 40: 
 41:         if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
 42:         {
 43:             var path = request.RequestUri?.AbsolutePath ?? string.Empty;
 44:             var currentRelativePath = _nav.ToBaseRelativePath(_nav.Uri);
 45:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentRelativePath))
 46:             {
 47:                 currentRelativePath = "/";
 48:             }
 49:             else if (!currentRelativePath.StartsWith('/'))
 50:             {
 51:                 currentRelativePath = "/" + currentRelativePath;
 52:             }
 53:             else
 54:             {
 55:                 var queryIndex = currentRelativePath.IndexOf('?', System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
 56:                 if (queryIndex >= 0)
 57:                 {
 58:                     currentRelativePath = currentRelativePath[..queryIndex];
 59:                 }
 60:             }
 61: 
 62: 
 63:             if (path.StartsWith("/login", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
 64:                 path.StartsWith("/logout", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
 65:                 path.StartsWith("/auth", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 66:             {
 67:                 _logger.LogDebug("BFF handler: received 401 from auth endpoint {Method} {Uri}", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
 68:                 return response;
 69:             }
 70: 
 71: 
 72:             if (currentRelativePath.StartsWith("/login", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
 73:                 currentRelativePath.StartsWith("/logout", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 74:             {
 75:                 _logger.LogDebug("BFF handler: suppressing 401 redirect while on auth page {CurrentPath}", currentRelativePath);
 76:                 return response;
 77:             }
 78: 
 79: 
 80:             if (AnonymousApiPathPrefixes.Any(prefix => path.StartsWith(prefix, System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
 81:             {
 82:                 _logger.LogDebug("BFF handler: received 401 from anonymous endpoint {Method} {Uri}", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
 83:                 return response;
 84:             }
 85: 
 86:             _logger.LogWarning("BFF handler: received 401 for {Method} {Uri} - redirecting to /login", request.Method, request.RequestUri);
 87: 
 88:             var relativeCurrentPath = _nav.ToBaseRelativePath(_nav.Uri);
 89:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(relativeCurrentPath))
 90:             {
 91:                 relativeCurrentPath = "/";
 92:             }
 93:             else if (!relativeCurrentPath.StartsWith('/'))
 94:             {
 95:                 relativeCurrentPath = "/" + relativeCurrentPath;
 96:             }
 97: 
 98:             var returnUrl = Uri.EscapeDataString(relativeCurrentPath);
 99:             _nav.NavigateTo($"/login?returnUrl={returnUrl}", forceLoad: true);
100:         }
101: 
102:         return response;
103:     }
104: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Http;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 5: 
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: 
10: public class BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler : DelegatingHandler
11: {
12:     private readonly ILogger<BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler>? _logger;
13: 
14:     public BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler()
15:     {
16: 
17:     }
18: 
19:     public BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler(ILogger<BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler> logger)
20:     {
21:         _logger = logger;
22:     }
23: 
24:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
25:         HttpRequestMessage request,
26:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
27:     {
28: 
29:         request.SetBrowserRequestCredentials(BrowserRequestCredentials.Include);
30: 
31: 
32:         request.SetBrowserRequestMode(BrowserRequestMode.SameOrigin);
33: 
34:         _logger?.LogDebug("[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Credentials: Include, Mode: SameOrigin",
35:             request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
36: 
37:         try
38:         {
39:             var response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
40: 
41:             _logger?.LogDebug("[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Response: {StatusCode}",
42:                 request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery, (int)response.StatusCode);
43: 
44: 
45:             if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
46:             {
47:                 _logger?.LogWarning("[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Unauthorized (401). User may need to re-authenticate.",
48:                     request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
49:             }
50: 
51:             return response;
52:         }
53:         catch (Exception ex)
54:         {
55:             _logger?.LogError(ex, "[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Request failed",
56:                 request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
57:             throw;
58:         }
59:     }
60: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/MapsService.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Net.Http.Json;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 5: 
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: public interface IMapsService
10: {
11:     Task<string> GetEmbedUrlAsync(string query);
12: }
13: 
14: 
15: 
16: 
17: public class MapsService : IMapsService
18: {
19:     private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
20:     private readonly ILogger<MapsService> _logger;
21: 
22:     public MapsService(HttpClient httpClient, ILogger<MapsService> logger)
23:     {
24:         _httpClient = httpClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClient));
25:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
26:     }
27: 
28:     public async Task<string> GetEmbedUrlAsync(string query)
29:     {
30:         try
31:         {
32:             if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(query))
33:             {
34:                 return string.Empty;
35:             }
36: 
37:             var encodedQuery = Uri.EscapeDataString(query);
38:             var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync($"/bff/api/Maps/embed-url?query={encodedQuery}");
39: 
40:             if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
41:             {
42:                 var embedUrl = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
43: 
44:                 return embedUrl?.Trim('"') ?? string.Empty;
45:             }
46: 
47:             _logger.LogWarning("Error getting map embed URL: {StatusCode}", response.StatusCode);
48:             return string.Empty;
49:         }
50:         catch (Exception ex)
51:         {
52:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error in GetEmbedUrlAsync");
53:             return string.Empty;
54:         }
55:     }
56: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/S3UploadMessageHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Http;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 5: 
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: 
10: public class S3UploadMessageHandler : DelegatingHandler
11: {
12:     private readonly ILogger<S3UploadMessageHandler>? _logger;
13: 
14:     public S3UploadMessageHandler()
15:     {
16:     }
17: 
18:     public S3UploadMessageHandler(ILogger<S3UploadMessageHandler> logger)
19:     {
20:         _logger = logger;
21:     }
22: 
23:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
24:         HttpRequestMessage request,
25:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
26:     {
27: 
28: 
29:         request.SetBrowserRequestMode(BrowserRequestMode.Cors);
30: 
31: 
32: 
33:         request.SetBrowserRequestCredentials(BrowserRequestCredentials.Omit);
34: 
35:         _logger?.LogDebug("[S3 Upload] {Method} {Host} - Mode: CORS, Credentials: Omit",
36:             request.Method, request.RequestUri?.Host);
37: 
38:         try
39:         {
40:             var response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
41: 
42:             if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
43:             {
44:                 _logger?.LogWarning("[S3 Upload] {Method} {Uri} - Failed with status {StatusCode}",
45:                     request.Method, request.RequestUri, (int)response.StatusCode);
46:             }
47:             else
48:             {
49:                 _logger?.LogInformation("[S3 Upload] {Method} {Host} - Success ({StatusCode})",
50:                     request.Method, request.RequestUri?.Host, (int)response.StatusCode);
51:             }
52: 
53:             return response;
54:         }
55:         catch (Exception ex)
56:         {
57:             _logger?.LogError(ex, "[S3 Upload] {Method} {Uri} - Request failed with exception",
58:                 request.Method, request.RequestUri);
59:             throw;
60:         }
61:     }
62: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/Dockerfile
````
 1: # Explore.Blazor/Dockerfile
 2: # Multi-stage build for production deployment
 3: # Secrets are loaded at runtime via AddSecretManagement() - no CLI needed
 4: # Supports zero-downtime deployments with Coolify
 5: 
 6: FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0 AS base
 7: USER $APP_UID
 8: WORKDIR /app
 9: EXPOSE 8080
10: EXPOSE 8081
11: 
12: FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 AS build
13: ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
14: WORKDIR /src
15: 
16: # Copy all project files for restore
17: COPY ["Explore.Blazor/Explore.Blazor.csproj", "Explore.Blazor/"]
18: COPY ["Explore.Blazor.Client/Explore.Blazor.Client.csproj", "Explore.Blazor.Client/"]
19: COPY ["Explore.Secrets/Explore.Secrets.csproj", "Explore.Secrets/"]
20: COPY ["Explore.ServiceDefaults/Explore.ServiceDefaults.csproj", "Explore.ServiceDefaults/"]
21: 
22: RUN dotnet restore "./Explore.Blazor/Explore.Blazor.csproj"
23: COPY . .
24: WORKDIR "/src/Explore.Blazor"
25: RUN dotnet build "./Explore.Blazor.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/build
26: 
27: FROM build AS publish
28: ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
29: RUN dotnet publish "./Explore.Blazor.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/publish /p:UseAppHost=false
30: 
31: FROM base AS final
32: WORKDIR /app
33: 
34: # Copy published application
35: COPY --from=publish /app/publish .
36: 
37: # Secret management is handled by the application via AddSecretManagement()
38: # Configure via environment variables:
39: #   SECRET_PROVIDER=infisical (or "none" for env vars only)
40: #   Infisical__ProjectId, Infisical__ClientId, Infisical__ClientSecret, etc.
41: # See docs/CONFIGURATION.md for full list of options
42: 
43: ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Explore.Blazor.dll"]
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/wwwroot/js/layout.js
````javascript
 1: window.ExploreLayout = {
 2:     setAnnouncementBarHeight: function (element) {
 3:         var height = element && element.offsetHeight ? element.offsetHeight : 0;
 4:         document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--announcement-bar-height", height + "px");
 5:     },
 6:     clearAnnouncementBarHeight: function () {
 7:         document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--announcement-bar-height", "0px");
 8:     }
 9: };
10: 
11: (function () {
12:     var path = (window.location.pathname || "").toLowerCase();
13: 
14:     // Normalize optional trailing slash while keeping root intact.
15:     if (path.length > 1 && path.endsWith("/")) {
16:         path = path.slice(0, -1);
17:     }
18: 
19:     if (path === "/login") {
20:         window.location.replace("/auth/challenge" + (window.location.search || ""));
21:         return;
22:     }
23: 
24:     if (path === "/logout") {
25:         window.location.replace("/auth/signout" + (window.location.search || ""));
26:     }
27: })();

````csharp
  1: using System.Text.Json;
  2: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;
  4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
  5: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
  6: using Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;
  7: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  8: using Microsoft.Extensions.ServiceDiscovery;
  9: using OpenTelemetry;
 10: using OpenTelemetry.Metrics;
 11: using OpenTelemetry.Trace;
 12: 
 13: namespace Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17: 
 18: public static class Extensions
 19: {
 20:     private const string HealthEndpointPath = "/health";
 21:     private const string AlivenessEndpointPath = "/alive";
 22: 
 23:     public static TBuilder AddServiceDefaults<TBuilder>(this TBuilder builder) where TBuilder : IHostApplicationBuilder
 24:     {
 25:         builder.ConfigureOpenTelemetry();
 26: 
 27:         builder.AddDefaultHealthChecks();
 28: 
 29:         builder.Services.AddServiceDiscovery();
 30: 
 31:         builder.Services.ConfigureHttpClientDefaults(http =>
 32:         {
 33: 
 34:             http.AddStandardResilienceHandler();
 35: 
 36: 
 37:             http.AddServiceDiscovery();
 38:         });
 39: 
 40: 
 41: 
 42: 
 43: 
 44: 
 45: 
 46:         return builder;
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     public static TBuilder ConfigureOpenTelemetry<TBuilder>(this TBuilder builder) where TBuilder : IHostApplicationBuilder
 50:     {
 51:         builder.Logging.AddOpenTelemetry(logging =>
 52:         {
 53:             logging.IncludeFormattedMessage = true;
 54:             logging.IncludeScopes = true;
 55:         });
 56: 
 57:         builder.Services.AddOpenTelemetry()
 58:             .WithMetrics(metrics =>
 59:             {
 60:                 metrics.AddAspNetCoreInstrumentation()
 61:                     .AddHttpClientInstrumentation()
 62:                     .AddRuntimeInstrumentation();
 63:             })
 64:             .WithTracing(tracing =>
 65:             {
 66:                 tracing.AddSource(builder.Environment.ApplicationName)
 67:                     .AddAspNetCoreInstrumentation(tracing =>
 68: 
 69:                         tracing.Filter = context =>
 70:                             !context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments(HealthEndpointPath)
 71:                             && !context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments(AlivenessEndpointPath)
 72:                     )
 73: 
 74: 
 75:                     .AddHttpClientInstrumentation();
 76:             });
 77: 
 78:         builder.AddOpenTelemetryExporters();
 79: 
 80:         return builder;
 81:     }
 82: 
 83:     private static TBuilder AddOpenTelemetryExporters<TBuilder>(this TBuilder builder) where TBuilder : IHostApplicationBuilder
 84:     {
 85:         var useOtlpExporter = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(builder.Configuration["OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT"]);
 86: 
 87:         if (useOtlpExporter)
 88:         {
 89:             builder.Services.AddOpenTelemetry().UseOtlpExporter();
 90:         }
 91: 
 92: 
 93: 
 94: 
 95: 
 96: 
 97: 
 98: 
 99:         return builder;
100:     }
101: 
102:     public static TBuilder AddDefaultHealthChecks<TBuilder>(this TBuilder builder) where TBuilder : IHostApplicationBuilder
103:     {
104:         builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()
105: 
106:             .AddCheck("self", () => HealthCheckResult.Healthy(), ["live"]);
107: 
108:         return builder;
109:     }
110: 
111:     public static WebApplication MapDefaultEndpoints(this WebApplication app)
112:     {
113: 
114: 
115: 
116: 
117:         var healthCheckOptions = new HealthCheckOptions
118:         {
119:             ResponseWriter = WriteHealthCheckResponse,
120:             ResultStatusCodes =
121:             {
122:                 [HealthStatus.Healthy] = StatusCodes.Status200OK,
123:                 [HealthStatus.Degraded] = StatusCodes.Status200OK,
124:                 [HealthStatus.Unhealthy] = StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable
125:             }
126:         };
127: 
128: 
129:         app.MapHealthChecks(HealthEndpointPath, healthCheckOptions);
130: 
131: 
132:         app.MapHealthChecks(AlivenessEndpointPath, new HealthCheckOptions
133:         {
134:             Predicate = r => r.Tags.Contains("live"),
135:             ResponseWriter = WriteHealthCheckResponse,
136:             ResultStatusCodes =
137:             {
138:                 [HealthStatus.Healthy] = StatusCodes.Status200OK,
139:                 [HealthStatus.Degraded] = StatusCodes.Status200OK,
140:                 [HealthStatus.Unhealthy] = StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable
141:             }
142:         });
143: 
144:         return app;
145:     }
146: 
147:     private static async Task WriteHealthCheckResponse(HttpContext context, HealthReport report)
148:     {
149: 
150:         context.Response.ContentType = "application/json; charset=utf-8";
151:         context.Response.Headers["Connection"] = "close";
152:         context.Response.Headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*";
153:         context.Response.Headers["X-Health-Status"] = report.Status.ToString();
154:         context.Response.Headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
155:         context.Response.Headers["Pragma"] = "no-cache";
156: 
157:         var response = new
158:         {
159:             status = report.Status.ToString(),
160:             message = report.Status switch
161:             {
162:                 HealthStatus.Healthy => "Ok",
163:                 HealthStatus.Degraded => "Degraded",
164:                 HealthStatus.Unhealthy => "Service Unavailable",
165:                 _ => "Unknown"
166:             },
167:             totalDuration = report.TotalDuration.TotalMilliseconds,
168:             checks = report.Entries.Select(e => new
169:             {
170:                 name = e.Key,
171:                 status = e.Value.Status.ToString(),
172:                 description = e.Value.Description,
173:                 duration = e.Value.Duration.TotalMilliseconds,
174:                 error = e.Value.Exception?.Message,
175:                 data = e.Value.Data.Count > 0 ? e.Value.Data : null
176:             })
177:         };
178: 
179:         var jsonOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions
180:         {
181:             WriteIndented = true,
182:             PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
183:             DefaultIgnoreCondition = System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
184:         };
185: 
186:         await context.Response.WriteAsync(JsonSerializer.Serialize(response, jsonOptions));
187:     }
188: }
````

 58: ## Key Architectural Decisions
 59: 
 60: ### Decision 1: Render Mode (REQUIRES PROJECT LEAD INPUT)
 61: - **Current**: `InteractiveServer` (App.razor line 71)
 62: - **Documented**: `InteractiveAuto` (BLAZOR.md, ARCHITECTURE.md)
 63: - **Options**:
 64:   - (A) Switch to `InteractiveAuto` -- requires scoped token service, WASM testing
 65:   - (B) Stay with `InteractiveServer` -- remove WASM infrastructure, update docs
 66: - **Impact**: Affects Phase 3 entirely; blocks token service redesign approach
 67: 
 68: ### Decision 2: Token Service Architecture
 69: - **Current**: Static `ConcurrentDictionary` with cross-user `GetAnyValidToken()` fallback
 70: - **Documented Pattern**: Scoped service with per-circuit `_accessToken` property
 71: - **Decision**: Simplify to documented pattern; no cross-user fallback ever
 72: 
 73: ### Decision 3: Error Handling Pattern
 74: - **Current**: Services return `null`/empty on error; no distinction between "not found" and "error"
 75: - **Proposed**: Introduce `Result<T>` pattern or standard error notification to callers
 76: - **Impact**: Touches every service and every page that consumes services
 77: 
 78: ### Decision 4: Validation Strategy
 79: - **Current**: Mix of `DataAnnotationsValidator`, manual validation, and unused FluentValidation validators
 80: - **Proposed**: FluentValidation throughout; `MudForm` with FluentValidation integration
 81: - **Impact**: All form pages need updating

246: 
247: ## Technology Research Key Findings
248: 
249: ### MudBlazor
250: - Current stable: v8.15.0; v9 in preview with breaking changes
251: - Use `IMudDialogInstance` (not concrete class) -- future-proof for v9
252: - `DialogOptions` is an immutable record -- use `with` syntax
253: - `MudPopoverProvider` required in bUnit tests for overlays
254: - `ServerData` + virtualization for DataGrid >100 rows
255: - FluentValidation integration via `Validation` parameter on form fields
256: - `style-src 'unsafe-inline'` required in CSP for MudBlazor popover positioning
257: 
258: ### .NET 10 / C# 14 Relevant Features
259: - `[PersistentState]` attribute -- eliminates prerender state boilerplate
260: - `NotFoundPage` on Router -- proper 404 handling
261: - Named query filters (EF Core 10) -- already in project rules
262: - `field` keyword -- cleaner property accessors
263: - Null-conditional assignment (`customer?.Order = value;`)
264: - Extension members (`extension` blocks for properties, static extensions)
265: 
266: ### bUnit 2.5.x
267: - Latest for .NET 10; `FindByTestId`, generic typed `Find<TComponent, TElement>`
268: - `WaitForAssertion` preferred over `Task.Delay`
269: - `AuthenticationState` in services container for auth testing
270: 
271: ---
272:

276: Phase 1 (Security) -- no dependencies, start immediately

278: Phase 2 (Dead Code) -- no dependencies, can parallel with Phase 1

281:   |                     -- requires render mode decision from project lead
282:   |
283: Phase 4 (Code Quality) -- depends on Phase 2 (dead code removed first)
284:   |

286:   |
287: Phase 6 (Validation) -- depends on Phase 4 (Bootstrap removal)
288:   |
289: Phase 7 (Performance) -- depends on Phase 5 (error handling in place)
290:   |
291: Phase 8 (Tests) -- Task 8.1 can start in parallel with Phase 2
292:                -- Tasks 8.2-8.5 should follow Phase 4-7 to avoid churn
293: ```
294:

 28: 
 29: ## 1. Technology Stack
 30: 
 31: | Layer | Technology | Purpose |
 32: |-------|------------|---------|
 33: | **Runtime** | .NET 10.0 | Primary framework |
 34: | **Orchestration** | .NET Aspire | Service orchestration, observability |
 35: | **Web UI** | Blazor (Server + WebAssembly) | Hybrid rendering model |
 36: | **UI Components** | MudBlazor | Material Design components |
 37: | **Database** | PostgreSQL + PostGIS | Primary datastore with spatial queries |
 38: | **ORM** | Entity Framework Core | Data access layer |
 39: | **Authentication** | Keycloak | OIDC/JWT identity provider |
 40: | **Authorization** | ASP.NET Core Authorization | `[Authorize]` attributes and resource-based logic |
 41: | **Secrets** | Infisical | Secrets management |
 42: | **Logging** | Serilog | Structured logging |
 43: | **Telemetry** | OpenTelemetry | Distributed tracing and metrics |
 44: | **API Docs** | Scalar + Swagger | OpenAPI documentation |
 45: | **Federation** | ATProto / ActivityPub (Planned) | Domain model exists; federation endpoints are not yet implemented. |
 46: 
 47: ## 2. Architectural Paradigm: Clean Architecture + CQRS
 48: 
 49: The project is built upon **Clean Architecture** principles to ensure a separation of concerns, testability, and maintainability. It uses **Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS)** to separate read and write operations within the application layer.
 50: 
 51: ### Layer Dependencies
 52: 
 53: Dependencies must only flow inwards. The domain layer has no dependencies on any other layer.
 54: 
 55: **Generic Structure:**
 56: - **Presentation Layer**: `{Project}.API`, `{Project}.Blazor`
 57: - **Application Layer**: `{Project}.Application`
 58: - **Domain Layer**: `{Project}.Domain`
 59: - **Infrastructure Layer**: `{Project}.Persistence`, `{Project}.Infrastructure`
 60: 
 61: **Diagram (Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event):**
 62: 
 63: ```mermaid
 64: graph TD
 65:     subgraph Presentation Layer
 66:         A[Explore.API]
 67:         B[Explore.Blazor]
 68:     end
 69: 
 70:     subgraph Application Layer
 71:         C[Explore.Application]
 72:     end
 73: 
 74:     subgraph Domain Layer
 75:         D[Explore.Domain]
 76:     end
 77: 
 78:     subgraph Infrastructure Layer
 79:         E[Explore.Persistence]
 80:         F[Explore.Infrastructure]
 81:     end
 82: 
 83:     A --> C
 84:     B --> C
 85:     C --> D
 86:     E --> C
 87:     F --> C
 88: ```
 89: 
 90: *Substitute "Explore" with your `{Project}` name.*
 91: 
 92: **Layer Responsibilities:**
 93: 
 94: -   **Domain**: Contains pure business logic, entities, and value objects. It is the core of the application and has no external dependencies.
 95: -   **Application**: Orchestrates the domain logic. It contains use cases (commands/queries), DTOs, and interfaces for infrastructure services. It depends only on the Domain layer.
 96: -   **Infrastructure**: Provides concrete implementations for data access with repository pattern (Persistence via `{Project}.Persistence`) and external services (email, file storage via `{Project}.Infrastructure`). It depends on the Application layer to implement its interfaces.
 97: -   **Presentation**: The entry points to the application, including the REST API (`{Project}.API`) and the Blazor UI (`{Project}.Blazor`). This layer composes the other layers and handles user interaction and HTTP requests.
 98: 
 99: ### Data Flow (CQRS Pattern)
100: 
101: The CQRS pattern is implemented using the **MediatR** library.
102: 
103: **Generic Flow:**
104: 1. Client sends HTTP request to `{Entity}Controller`
105: 2. Controller sends command/query to MediatR
106: 3. MediatR routes to appropriate handler
107: 4. Handler interacts with repository
108: 5. Response flows back through the chain
109: 
110: **Sequence Diagram:**
111: 
112: ```mermaid
113: sequenceDiagram
114:     participant Client
115:     participant Controller
116:     participant MediatR
117:     participant Handler
118:     participant Repository
119: 
120:     Client->>Controller: HTTP Request (e.g., POST /api/v1/{entity})
121:     Controller->>MediatR: `_mediator.Send(command)`
122:     MediatR->>Handler: `Handle(command)`
123:     Handler->>Repository: `_repository.Create(entity)`
124:     Repository-->>Handler: Returns updated entity
125:     Handler-->>MediatR: Returns `BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>`
126:     MediatR-->>Controller: Returns response
127:     Controller-->>Client: HTTP Response (e.g., 200 OK)
128: ```
129: 
130: *Replace `{entity}` with your resource name (e.g., `event`, `order`, `product`) and `{IdType}` with your ID type (`Guid`, `int`).*
131: 
132: *For detailed implementation guidance, see the `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` skill.*
133: 
134: ## 3. Frontend Architecture: Blazor Hybrid with BFF
135: 
136: The frontend is a **Blazor Hybrid** application that uses the **Backend-for-Frontend (BFF)** pattern for security and performance.
137: 
138: ### Rendering Mode: InteractiveAuto
139: 
140: The application uses the `InteractiveAuto` render mode by default.
141: 
142: 1.  **Fast Initial Load**: The first visit renders pages on the **server** via a SignalR connection, providing immediate content to the user.
143: 2.  **Background Download**: The Blazor **WebAssembly** runtime and application DLLs are downloaded in the background.
144: 3.  **Seamless Transition**: Once the WASM assets are cached, the application transitions to client-side rendering, offloading work from the server and enabling potential offline capabilities.
145: 
146: ### BFF Security Model
147: 
148: The `{Project}.Blazor` project acts as a security gateway for the `{Project}.Blazor.Client` frontend.
149: 
150: **Architecture Flow:**
151: 
152: ```mermaid
153: graph LR
154:     A[Browser / WASM] -- Cookie --> B[BFF / Blazor Server]
155:     B -- OIDC Redirect --> C[OIDC Provider]
156:     B -- YARP Proxy --> D[Backend API]
157:     D -- JWT Auth --> D
158: ```
159: 
160: **Security Layers:**
161: 
162: -   The **BFF** (`{Project}.Blazor`) handles the OIDC authentication flow with your identity provider (e.g., Keycloak) and maintains the user session in a secure, `HttpOnly` cookie.
163: -   The **WASM Client** (`{Project}.Blazor.Client`) is "dumb" regarding authentication; it simply sends the cookie with each request to the BFF.
164: -   The **BFF** uses **YARP** as a reverse proxy. When a request for `/api/v1/...` arrives, it reads the access token from the session cookie and forwards the request to the `{Project}.API` backend with a `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
165: -   This architecture ensures **no tokens are ever exposed to the browser**.
166: 
167: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
168: 
169: - **BFF**: `Explore.Blazor` (Blazor Server)
170: - **WASM Client**: `Explore.Blazor.Client`
171: - **Backend API**: `Explore.API`
172: - **OIDC Provider**: Keycloak
173: 
174: *For detailed implementation guidance, see the `blazor-bff-patterns` and `auth-patterns` skills.*
175: 
176: ## 4. API Architecture
177: 
178: The `{Project}.API` project is a standard ASP.NET Core REST API following Clean Architecture principles.
179: 
180: ### Key Conventions
181: 
182: -   **Stateless**: The API is stateless and relies solely on the provided JWT for authentication and authorization.
183: -   **Thin Controllers**: Controllers are minimal. Their only job is to receive an HTTP request, send a command or query to MediatR, and return an appropriate HTTP response.
184: -   **Authorization**: Write endpoints (`POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`) are protected with `[Authorize]`. Read endpoints (`GET`) are public with `[AllowAnonymous]`.
185: -   **Documentation**: Endpoints are documented using `[EndpointSummary]`, `[EndpointDescription]`, and `[ProducesResponseType]` attributes for OpenAPI generation.
186: 
187: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
188: 
189: - **API Project**: `Explore.API`
190: - **Base URL**: `https://localhost:7001/api/v1`
191: 
192: *For detailed implementation guidance, see `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` skill.*
193: 
194: ## 5. Project Structure
195: 
196: The solution is organized into projects that directly map to the layers of Clean Architecture.
197: 
198: ### Generic Template
199: 
200: ```
201: {Project}.sln
202: ├── {Project}.Domain/              # Domain layer: Entities, Enums, Value Objects
203: ├── {Project}.Application/         # Application layer: CQRS handlers, DTOs, Interfaces
204: ├── {Project}.Persistence/         # Infrastructure: EF Core DbContext, Repositories
205: ├── {Project}.Infrastructure/      # Infrastructure: External services (email, storage, etc.)
206: ├── {Project}.API/                 # Presentation: REST API
207: ├── {Project}.Blazor/              # Presentation: Blazor Server (BFF)
208: ├── {Project}.Blazor.Client/       # Presentation: Blazor WebAssembly (UI)
209: ├── {Project}.AppHost/             # .NET Aspire Orchestrator
210: └── {Project}.ServiceDefaults/     # Shared Aspire configuration (observability, resilience)
211: ├── tests/
212: │   ├── {Project}.Application.UnitTests/
213: │   ├── {Project}.Domain.UnitTests/
214: │   └── {Project}.API.IntegrationTests/
215: └── docs/
216:     └── ... (Architecture documentation, guides)
217: ```
218: 
219: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
220: 
221: ```
222: Explore.sln
223: ├── Explore.Domain/              # Domain layer: Event, Organization, User entities
224: ├── Explore.Application/         # Application layer: Event handlers, DTOs
225: ├── Explore.Persistence/         # Infrastructure: ExploreDbContext, Repositories
226: ├── Explore.Infrastructure/      # Infrastructure: Email, file storage services
227: ├── Explore.API/                 # Presentation: REST API
228: ├── Explore.Blazor/              # Presentation: Blazor Server (BFF)
229: ├── Explore.Blazor.Client/       # Presentation: Blazor WebAssembly (UI)
230: ├── Explore.AppHost/             # .NET Aspire Orchestrator
231: └── Explore.ServiceDefaults/     # Shared Aspire configuration
232: ├── tests/
233: │   ├── Event.Application.UnitTests/
234: │   └── ... (other test projects)
235: └── docs/
236:     └── ... (High-level documentation)
237: ```
238: 
239: *Substitute `{Project}` with your solution name (e.g., `OrderSystem`, `InventoryApp`, `HRPortal`).*
````

````markdown
  1: # Configuration
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Configuration Guide**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Placeholder Substitutions
  8: 
  9: | Placeholder | Replace With | Example (ISLAMU Event) |
 10: |-------------|--------------|------------------------|
 11: | `{Project}` | Your solution name | `Explore` |
 12: | `{project}` | Lowercase project name | `explore` |
 13: | `{Project}.API` | API project name | `Explore.API` |
 14: | `{Instance Name}` | Your instance display name | `ISLAMU Event` |
 15: | `{Instance Domain}` | Your instance domain | `events.islamu.org` |
 16: 
 17: ---
 18: 
 19: ## Application Settings
 20: 
 21: **Generic Template:**
 22: ```json
 23: {
 24:   "Keycloak": {
 25:     "Authority": "https://your-keycloak-instance.com/realms/{realm}",
 26:     "Realm": "your-realm",

 50:       { "Name": "Seq", "Args": { "serverUrl": "http://localhost:5341" } }
 51:     ]
 52:   }
 53: }
 54: ```
