 56: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
 57: ```json
 58: {
 59:   "Keycloak": {
 60:     "Authority": "https://keycloak.openislamu.org/realms/islamu-dev",
 61:     "Realm": "islamu-dev",
 62:     "ClientId": "explore-api",
 63:     "ClientSecret": ""
 64:   },
 65:   "Federation": {
 66:     "InstanceDomain": "events.islamu.org",
 67:     "InstanceName": "ISLAMU Event",
 68:     "EnableFederation": true,
 69:     "SharedInboxEnabled": true
 70:   }
 71: }
 72: ```
 73: 
 74: ## Environment Variables
 75: 
 76: | Variable | Description | Example |
 77: |----------|-------------|---------|
 78: | `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT` | Runtime environment | `Development`, `Staging`, `Production` |
 79: | `ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection` | PostgreSQL connection | `Host=...;Database=...` |
 80: | `Keycloak__ClientSecret` | Keycloak client secret | `...` |
 81: | `Infisical__ClientId` | Secrets manager client | `...` |
 82: | `Infisical__ClientSecret` | Secrets manager secret | `...` |
 83: 
 84: ## Secret Management
 85: 
 86: The application uses a unified secret management system (`Explore.Secrets`) that supports multiple providers:
 87: 
 88: ### Secret Providers
 89: 
 90: | Provider | Use Case | Configuration |
 91: |----------|----------|---------------|
 92: | `none` | Self-hosters, local dev | Use environment variables directly |
 93: | `infisical` | Production with Infisical | Connects to Infisical service |
 94: 
 95: ### Configuration Options
 96: 
 97: ```json
 98: {
 99:   "SecretProvider": {
100:     "Provider": "infisical",
101:     "FailFast": true
102:   },
103:   "Infisical": {
104:     "Url": "https://app.infisical.com",
105:     "ProjectId": "your-project-id",
106:     "ClientId": "your-client-id",
107:     "ClientSecret": "your-client-secret",
108:     "Environment": "dev"
109:   },
110:   "SecretRefresh": {
111:     "RefreshInterval": "00:05:00",
112:     "BaseBackoffDelay": "00:00:30",
113:     "MaxBackoffDelay": "00:05:00"
114:   }
115: }
116: ```
117: 
118: ### Environment Variables
119: 
120: | Variable | Description | Required |
121: |----------|-------------|----------|
122: | `SECRET_PROVIDER` | Provider type: `none` or `infisical` | No (default: `none`) |
123: | `Infisical__Url` | Infisical server URL | Only if using Infisical |
124: | `Infisical__ProjectId` | Infisical project ID | Only if using Infisical |
125: | `Infisical__ClientId` | Universal Auth client ID | Only if using Infisical |
126: | `Infisical__ClientSecret` | Universal Auth client secret | Only if using Infisical |
127: | `Infisical__Environment` | Environment slug (dev, staging, prod) | No (default: `dev`) |
128: 
129: ### Self-Hosted Deployment (No Secret Manager)
130: 
131: For self-hosters who don't want to use Infisical, set `SECRET_PROVIDER=none` and provide all secrets via environment variables:
132: 
133: ```bash
134: # Required environment variables for self-hosted deployment
135: SECRET_PROVIDER=none
136: ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection=Host=...;Database=...;Username=...;Password=...
137: Keycloak__Authority=https://your-keycloak/realms/your-realm
138: Keycloak__ClientId=explore-api
139: Keycloak__ClientSecret=your-secret
140: S3Settings__AccessKeyId=your-access-key
141: S3Settings__SecretAccessKey=your-secret-key
142: ```
143: 
144: ### Infisical Deployment
145: 
146: For production with Infisical:
147: 
148: ```bash
149: SECRET_PROVIDER=infisical
150: Infisical__Url=https://app.infisical.com
151: Infisical__ProjectId=your-project-id
152: Infisical__ClientId=your-client-id
153: Infisical__ClientSecret=your-client-secret
154: Infisical__Environment=prod
155: ```
156: 
157: Secrets are automatically loaded from Infisical paths:
158: - `/keycloak` - Keycloak configuration
159: - `/postgresql` - Database credentials
160: - `/api` - API-specific secrets (S3, etc.)
161: - `/blazor` - Blazor-specific configuration
162: 
163: ### Features
164: 
165: - **Automatic Refresh**: Secrets are refreshed periodically (configurable interval)
166: - **Health Checks**: Secret provider health is exposed at `/health`
167: - **Metrics**: Prometheus-compatible metrics for monitoring
168: - **Audit Logging**: All secret access is logged with redaction
169: - **Graceful Fallback**: Falls back to environment variables if Infisical unavailable
170: 
171: ## Cerbos (Planned - Not Currently Integrated)
172: 
173: Some older docs/templates mention a `Cerbos` configuration section.
174: 
175: Cerbos is **not currently integrated** into `{Project}.API`. All authorization logic is currently implemented within the application code. There is no active Cerbos configuration required for the running system.
176: 
177: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
178: Cerbos is not currently integrated into `Explore.API`. Authorization is handled by MediatR handlers and endpoint-level `[Authorize]` attributes.
179: 
180: ---
181: 
182: ## Instance-Level Settings
183: 
184: The system supports **instance-level configuration** that controls deployment modes, feature toggles, and system-wide settings through the `SystemSetting` table.
185: 
186: ### SystemSetting Table
187: 
188: Instance administrators can configure system behavior through database-stored settings:
189: 
190: **Generic Pattern:**
191: ```csharp
192: public class SystemSetting
193: {
194:     public Guid Id { get; set; }
195:     public string Key { get; set; } = string.Empty;
196:     public string Value { get; set; } = string.Empty;
197:     public string? Description { get; set; }
198: 
199:     // Auditing
200:     public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
201:     public Guid? CreatedBy { get; set; }
202:     public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
203:     public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; set; }
204: }
205: ```
206: 
207: ### Governance Setting Keys
208: 
209: System settings are defined as constants in `GovernanceSettingKeys`:
210: 
211: ```csharp
212: public static class GovernanceSettingKeys
213: {
214:     // Deployment Mode
215:     public const string DeploymentMode = "System.DeploymentMode";  // "SingleTenant" or "MultiTenant"
216: 
217:     // Feature Flags
218:     public const string FederationEnabled = "System.Federation.Enabled";
219:     public const string RegistrationOpen = "System.Registration.Open";
220:     public const string MaintenanceMode = "System.MaintenanceMode";
221: 
222:     // Module Governance (see Module-Specific Configuration section)
223:     public const string IslamicModuleEnabled = "System.Modules.Islamic.Enabled";
224:     public const string TechModuleEnabled = "System.Modules.Tech.Enabled";
225: 
226:     // Instance Metadata
227:     public const string InstanceName = "System.Instance.Name";
228:     public const string InstanceDomain = "System.Instance.Domain";
229: }
230: ```
231: 
232: ### Deployment Mode Switching
233: 
234: The `DeploymentMode` setting controls multi-tenant vs single-tenant behavior:
235: 
236: **Generic Pattern:**
237: ```csharp
238: // Retrieve deployment mode
239: var deploymentMode = await _systemSettingService.GetAsync(
240:     GovernanceSettingKeys.DeploymentMode);
241: 
242: if (deploymentMode == "SingleTenant")
243: {
244:     // Single tenant: All users belong to default tenant
245:     // No tenant selection UI shown
246: }
247: else if (deploymentMode == "MultiTenant")
248: {
249:     // Multi-tenant: Users can belong to multiple tenants
250:     // Tenant selection UI shown
251:     // Tenant context required for all operations
252: }
253: ```
254: 
255: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
256: 
257: ```csharp
258: // Explore.Domain/Constants/GovernanceSettingKeys.cs
259: public static class GovernanceSettingKeys
260: {
261:     public const string DeploymentMode = "System.DeploymentMode";
262:     public const string FederationEnabled = "System.Federation.Enabled";
263:     public const string IslamicModuleEnabled = "System.Modules.Islamic.Enabled";
264:     // ... more keys
265: }
266: 
267: // Usage in services
268: var federationEnabled = await _systemSettingService.GetBoolAsync(
269:     GovernanceSettingKeys.FederationEnabled);
270: 
271: if (federationEnabled)
272: {
273:     // Enable federation endpoints
274: }
275: ```
276: 
277: **See Also**: [OPERATIONS.md](OPERATIONS.md) for deployment mode details.
278: 
279: ---
280: 
281: ## Module-Specific Configuration
282: 
283: The system supports **modular event types** through per-tenant capability configuration. Different tenants can enable different event modules (e.g., Islamic events, Tech events).
284: 
285: ### TenantCapability Table
286: 
287: Modules are enabled per-tenant through the `TenantCapability` table:
288: 
289: **Generic Pattern:**
290: ```csharp
291: public class TenantCapability
292: {
293:     public Guid Id { get; set; }
294:     public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
295:     public string ModuleName { get; set; } = string.Empty;  // "Islamic", "Tech", etc.
296:     public bool Enabled { get; set; }
297:     public Dictionary<string, string>? Configuration { get; set; }  // Module-specific settings
298: 
299:     // Relationships
300:     public Tenant? Tenant { get; set; }
301: }
302: ```
303: 
304: ### Module Governance Settings
305: 
306: Modules can be enabled/disabled at two levels:
307: 
308: 1. **System Level** (via `SystemSetting` table):
309:    - Controls if a module is available at all
310:    - Instance admin configures
311: 
312: 2. **Tenant Level** (via `TenantCapability` table):
313:    - Controls if a specific tenant can use a module
314:    - Tenant admin configures
315: 
316: **Hierarchy**:
317: ```
318: System.Modules.Islamic.Enabled = true   (System-wide toggle)
319:   └── TenantCapability: TenantId=abc, ModuleName="Islamic", Enabled=true   (Tenant-specific)
320: ```
321: 
322: If system-level setting is `false`, the module is unavailable to ALL tenants, regardless of `TenantCapability` settings.
323: 
324: ### Module Resolution Example
325: 
326: **Generic Pattern:**
327: ```csharp
328: // Check if module is available for tenant
329: public async Task<bool> IsModuleAvailableAsync(Guid tenantId, string moduleName)
330: {
331:     // 1. Check system-level setting
332:     var systemKey = $"System.Modules.{moduleName}.Enabled";
333:     var systemEnabled = await _systemSettingService.GetBoolAsync(systemKey);
334:     if (!systemEnabled) return false;
335: 
336:     // 2. Check tenant-level capability
337:     var capability = await _tenantCapabilityRepository.GetByTenantAndModule(
338:         tenantId, moduleName);
339: 
340:     return capability?.Enabled ?? false;
341: }
342: 
343: // Usage in handlers
344: if (await _moduleService.IsModuleAvailableAsync(tenantId, "Islamic"))
345: {
346:     // Load EventIslamicAspect
347:     var aspect = await _islamicAspectRepository.GetByEventId(eventId);
348: }
349: ```
350: 
351: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
352: 
353: ```csharp
354: // Module availability check in Create Event handler
355: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(...)
356: {
357:     // ... create base event ...
358: 
359:     // If Islamic module enabled for this tenant, create Islamic aspect
360:     if (await _moduleService.IsModuleAvailableAsync(tenantId, "Islamic"))
361:     {
362:         if (request.EventDto.IslamicAspect != null)
363:         {
364:             var islamicAspect = new EventIslamicAspect
365:             {
366:                 EventId = newEvent.Id,
367:                 PrayerTimesAvailable = request.EventDto.IslamicAspect.PrayerTimesAvailable,
368:                 // ... map other fields
369:             };
370:             await _islamicAspectRepository.Create(islamicAspect);
371:         }
372:     }
373: 
374:     return response;
375: }
376: ```
377: 
378: **See Also**: [CODEBASE_INSIGHTS.md](CODEBASE_INSIGHTS.md) Section 7 for module governance implementation.
379: 
380: ---
381: 
382: ## Monitoring & Observability
383: 
384: The system uses **Prometheus** for metrics and **Loki** for centralized logging.
385: 
386: ### Prometheus (Metrics)
387: 
388: Application metrics are exposed at `/metrics` endpoint using Prometheus format:
389: 
390: **Generic Configuration:**
391: ```json
392: {
393:   "Prometheus": {
394:     "Enabled": true,
395:     "MetricsPath": "/metrics",
396:     "Port": 9090
397:   }
398: }
399: ```
400: 
401: **Metrics Exposed**:
402: - HTTP request duration histograms
403: - Database query performance
404: - Command/Query execution times (MediatR pipeline)
405: - Repository operation counters
406: - Exception counts by type
407: 
408: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
409: ```csharp
410: // Explore.API/Program.cs
411: builder.Services.AddOpenTelemetry()
412:     .WithMetrics(metrics =>
413:     {
414:         metrics.AddPrometheusExporter();
415:         metrics.AddMeter("Explore.API");
416:         metrics.AddAspNetCoreInstrumentation();
417:         metrics.AddHttpClientInstrumentation();
418:     });
419: 
420: app.MapPrometheusScrapingEndpoint();  // Exposes /metrics
421: ```
422: 
423: ### Loki (Centralized Logging)
424: 
425: Logs are shipped to Loki via Serilog:
426: 
427: **Generic Configuration:**
428: ```json
429: {
430:   "Serilog": {
431:     "WriteTo": [
432:       {
433:         "Name": "GrafanaLoki",
434:         "Args": {
435:           "uri": "http://loki:3100",
436:           "labels": [
437:             { "key": "app", "value": "{project}-api" },
438:             { "key": "environment", "value": "production" }
439:           ]
440:         }
441:       }
442:     ]
443:   }
444: }
445: ```
446: 
447: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
448: ```csharp
449: // Explore.API/Program.cs
450: builder.Host.UseSerilog((context, configuration) =>
451: {
452:     configuration
453:         .ReadFrom.Configuration(context.Configuration)
454:         .Enrich.FromLogContext()
455:         .Enrich.WithProperty("Application", "Explore.API")
456:         .WriteTo.Console()
457:         .WriteTo.GrafanaLoki(
458:             context.Configuration["Loki:Uri"]!,
459:             labels: new List<LokiLabel>
460:             {
461:                 new() { Key = "app", Value = "explore-api" },
462:                 new() { Key = "env", Value = context.HostingEnvironment.EnvironmentName }
463:             });
464: });
465: ```
466: 
467: ### Observability Stack
468: 
469: **Recommended Stack**:
470: - **Prometheus**: Metrics collection and storage
471: - **Loki**: Log aggregation and querying
472: - **Grafana**: Unified dashboards for metrics + logs
473: - **Aspire Dashboard** (Development): Local observability during development
474: 
475: **Key Benefits**:
476: - Unified observability (metrics + logs in Grafana)
477: - Label-based log filtering (tenant, user, request ID)
478: - Performance monitoring (P50, P95, P99 latencies)
479: - Error tracking with stack traces
480: - Correlation between logs and metrics
481: 
482: **See Also**: [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](TROUBLESHOOTING.md) for debugging with Prometheus/Loki.
````

## File: docs/CONTRIBUTING.md
````markdown
  1: # Contribution Workflow
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Contribution Guidelines**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Placeholder Substitutions
  8: 
  9: | Placeholder | Replace With | Example (ISLAMU Event) |
 10: |-------------|--------------|------------------------|
 11: | `{Project}` | Your solution name | `Explore` |
 12: | `{Project}.API` | API project | `{Project}.API` |
 13: | `{Project}.AppHost` | Aspire AppHost | `{Project}.AppHost` |
 14: | `{Project}ApiClient` | Generated API client | `{Project}ApiClient` |
 15: 
 16: ---
 17: 
 18: ## Branch Strategy
 19: 
 20: ```
 21: main                    # Default branch
 22: ├── feature/xxx         # New features
 23: ├── bugfix/xxx          # Bug fixes
 24: └── refactor/xxx        # Code improvements
 25: ```
 26: 
 27: ## Commit Convention
 28: 
 29: ```
 30: type(scope): subject
 31: 
 32: body (optional)
 33: 
 34: footer (optional)
 35: ```
 36: 
 37: **Types**: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`
 38: 
 39: **Examples**:
 40: ```
 41: feat(events): add prayer-relative scheduling
 42: fix(federation): correct HTTP signature validation
 43: docs(api): update endpoint documentation
 44: ```
 45: 
 46: ## Pull Request Process
 47: 
 48: 1. Create a branch from `main`
 49: 2. Implement changes with tests
 50: 3. Ensure all tests pass: `dotnet test`
 51: 4. Ensure code formatting: `dotnet format`
 52: 5. Create PR with description and linked issue
 53: 6. Request review from maintainers
 54: 7. Address feedback
 55: 8. Squash and merge when approved
 56: 
 57: ## Issue Templates
 58: 
 59: - **Bug Report**: Describe bug, steps to reproduce, expected behavior
 60: - **Feature Request**: Describe need, proposed solution, alternatives
 61: - **Task**: Technical work without user-facing change
 62: 
 63: ---
 64: 
 65: ## DTO Change Workflow (API → Blazor Client)
 66: 
 67: When making changes to DTOs in the API project, follow this specific workflow to ensure the Blazor client is properly updated.
 68: 
 69: ### Why This Workflow Matters
 70: 
 71: The project uses **.NET Aspire** for orchestration, which:
 72: 1. Fetches secrets from Infisical and injects them as environment variables
 73: 2. Starts all projects in the correct order
 74: 3. **Triggers OpenAPI schema regeneration** in the API project on startup
 75: 4. **NSwag watches for schema changes** and automatically regenerates the Blazor API client
 76: 
 77: **Key Point**: You must run Aspire to regenerate the client. Building alone won't update the generated client code.
 78: 
 79: ### The Vicious Cycle Problem
 80: 
 81: Understanding **why** this workflow exists prevents frustrating debugging sessions.
 82: 
 83: #### The Problem: Build Errors Block Client Regeneration
 84: 
 85: When you change DTOs in the API and then try to build the **full solution**, you enter a vicious cycle:
 86: 
 87: ```
 88: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 89: │                    ❌ THE VICIOUS CYCLE                              │
 90: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 91: │                                                                     │
 92: │  1. You change a DTO in the API (add new property)                  │
 93: │     ↓                                                               │
 94: │  2. You try to build the FULL SOLUTION                              │
 95: │     ↓                                                               │
 96: │  3. ❌ BUILD FAILS - Blazor references the OLD generated client     │
 97: │     │   (The generated client doesn't have the new property yet)    │
 98: │     ↓                                                               │
 99: │  4. ❌ ASP.NET API won't run (solution didn't build)                │
100: │     ↓                                                               │
101: │  5. ❌ swagger.json can't regenerate (API isn't running)            │
102: │     ↓                                                               │
103: │  6. ❌ NSwag can't update the client (no new schema)                │
104: │     ↓                                                               │
105: │  7. ❌ Generated client stays outdated                              │
106: │     ↓                                                               │
107: │  8. ❌ Build errors persist → BACK TO STEP 3                        │
108: │                                                                     │
109: │  💀 YOU ARE STUCK IN AN INFINITE LOOP                               │
110: │                                                                     │
111: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
112: ```
113: 
114: #### The Solution: Build API Separately First
115: 
116: By building **only the API project** first, you break the cycle:
117: 
118: ```
119: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
120: │                    ✅ THE CORRECT WORKFLOW                           │
121: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
122: │                                                                     │
123: │  1. You change a DTO in the API (add new property)                  │
124: │     ↓                                                               │
125: │  2. Build ONLY the API project: `dotnet build {Project}.API`          │
126: │     ↓                                                               │
127: │  3. ✅ API builds successfully (no Blazor dependency issues)        │
128: │     ↓                                                               │
129: │  4. Run Aspire: `dotnet run --project {Project}.AppHost`              │
130: │     ↓                                                               │
131: │  5. ✅ API starts and generates new swagger.json                    │
132: │     ↓                                                               │
133: │  6. ✅ NSwag detects changes, regenerates client                    │
134: │     ↓                                                               │
135: │  7. ✅ Generated client now has the new property                    │
136: │     ↓                                                               │
137: │  8. NOW update Blazor services/components                           │
138: │     ↓                                                               │
139: │  9. ✅ Build full solution: `dotnet build {Project}.sln`              │
140: │                                                                     │
141: │  🎉 SUCCESS - No build errors!                                      │
142: │                                                                     │
143: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
144: ```
145: 
146: #### Common Trap: Updating Blazor Services Too Early
147: 
148: A particularly frustrating mistake is updating **Blazor services that interact with the generated API client** before the client is regenerated:
149: 
150: ```
151: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
152: │              ❌ THE SERVICE UPDATE TRAP                              │
153: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
154: │                                                                     │
155: │  Scenario: You add `Description` property to `EventDto`             │
156: │                                                                     │
157: │  1. You update EventDto in API (✅ correct)                         │
158: │     ↓                                                               │
159: │  2. You update EventService in Blazor to use `.Description`         │
160: │     ↓                                                               │
161: │  3. ❌ ERROR: 'EventDto' does not contain 'Description'             │
162: │     │                                                               │
163: │     │   WHY? The generated client ({Project}ApiClient.cs) still       │
164: │     │   has the OLD EventDto without Description!                   │
165: │     │                                                               │
166: │     │   Your service references: Generated.EventDto (OLD)           │
167: │     │   You expect:              Generated.EventDto.Description     │
168: │     │   Reality:                 Property doesn't exist yet         │
169: │     ↓                                                               │
170: │  4. Build fails on BOTH sides:                                      │
171: │     • API side: Works fine (your DTO has the property)              │
172: │     • Blazor side: Fails (generated client is outdated)             │
173: │                                                                     │
174: │  💡 The generated client is OUT OF SYNC with the API!               │
175: │                                                                     │
176: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
177: ```
178: 
179: **Rule of Thumb**:
180: - **API-only changes** → Build API only, run Aspire, then update Blazor
181: - **UI-only changes** (no DTO changes) → Can work directly in Blazor
182: - **Both API + Blazor changes** → Follow the full checklist, API first
183: 
184: ### Standard Workflow
185: 
186: ```
187: API Changes → Build API → Run Aspire → Client Regenerates → Update Blazor UI
188: ```
189: 
190: ### Process Checklist for DTO Changes
191: 
192: Follow this checklist whenever you add/modify DTO properties:
193: 
194: ```markdown
195: ## DTO Change Checklist
196: 
197: ### 1. Application Layer Changes
198: - [ ] Add/update properties in `{Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/` files
199: - [ ] Update `{Entity}Dto.cs` (full details)
200: - [ ] Update `{Entity}ListDto.cs` (list view) if applicable
201: - [ ] Update `Create{Entity}Dto.cs` / `Update{Entity}Dto.cs` if applicable
202: 
203: ### 2. Mapping & Data Access
204: - [ ] Update `MappingProfile.cs` if new navigation properties
205: - [ ] Update Repository `.Include()` statements if loading related data
206: - [ ] Update Handler if new processing logic needed
207: 
208: ### 3. Build & Regenerate
209: - [ ] Build API project only: `dotnet build {Project}.API`
210: - [ ] Start Aspire: `dotnet run --project {Project}.AppHost`
211: - [ ] Wait for swagger.json to regenerate (automatic on API startup)
212: - [ ] NSwag regenerates client automatically (watches schema file)
213: 
214: ### 4. Blazor UI Updates
215: - [ ] NOW update Blazor components to use new properties
216: - [ ] Build full solution: `dotnet build {Project}.sln`
217: - [ ] Test the changes in browser
218: ```
219: 
220: ### Quick Fix: If You Forgot the Workflow
221: 
222: If you already updated Blazor UI before running Aspire and the generated client is missing properties:
223: 
224: **Option 1: Proper Fix (Recommended)**
225: ```powershell
226: # Stop any running instances
227: # Run Aspire to regenerate everything
228: dotnet run --project {Project}.AppHost
229: ```
230: 
231: **Option 2: Manual Fix (Quick Workaround)**
232: Manually add the missing properties to the generated client file as a temporary fix, then run Aspire later to properly regenerate.
233: 
234: ### Architecture Diagram
235: 
236: ```
237: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
238: │                         .NET Aspire Orchestration                    │
239: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
240: │                                                                     │
241: │  1. Aspire Starts                                                   │
242: │     └── Fetches secrets from Infisical                              │
243: │     └── Injects environment variables to all projects               │
244: │                                                                     │
245: │  2. API Project Starts                                              │
246: │     └── Generates swagger.json (OpenAPI schema)                     │
247: │     └── Schema reflects current DTO structure                       │
248: │                                                                     │
249: │  3. Blazor Project Watches                                          │
250: │     └── NSwag detects swagger.json changes                          │
251: │     └── Regenerates API client ({Project}ApiClient.cs)                │
252: │                                                                     │
253: │  4. Blazor Components                                               │
254: │     └── Use the regenerated client with new properties              │
255: │                                                                     │
256: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
257: ```
258: 
259: ### Common Mistakes
260: 
261: | Mistake | Why It Fails | Fix |
262: |---------|--------------|-----|
263: | Build solution without running Aspire | swagger.json not regenerated | Run Aspire first |
264: | Update Blazor before API | Generated client missing new properties | Follow the checklist order |
265: | Manually edit generated files | Changes overwritten on next regeneration | Add to source DTOs, regenerate |
266: | Skip the MappingProfile update | AutoMapper doesn't map new properties | Always update profile |
267: 
268: ### Related Documentation
269: 
270: - [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) - Overall system architecture
271: - [API.md](API.md) - API endpoint patterns
272: - [BLAZOR.md](BLAZOR.md) - Blazor client architecture
273: - [GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md) - DTO patterns and conventions
````

## File: docs/GOVERNANCE.md
````markdown
  1: # Code Conventions & Governance
  2: 
  3: > **Standards and Conventions for .NET Clean Architecture Projects**
  4: >
  5: > This document defines naming conventions, organizational patterns, and architectural decisions.
  6: > For code examples and implementation patterns, see the relevant skills in `.claude/skills/`.
  7: 
  8: **Last Updated**: January 2026
  9: 
 10: ---
 11: 
 12: ## Table of Contents
 13: 
 14: 1. [Critical Rules Summary](#critical-rules-summary)
 15: 2. [Naming Conventions](#naming-conventions)
 16: 3. [File Organization](#file-organization)
 17: 4. [Layer Responsibilities](#layer-responsibilities)
 18: 5. [Design Principles](#design-principles)
 19: 6. [Pattern Selection Guide](#pattern-selection-guide)
 20: 7. [Decision Framework](#decision-framework)
 21: 
 22: ---
 23: 
 24: ## Critical Rules Summary
 25: 
 26: These rules are **non-negotiable**. Violations break architectural integrity.
 27: 
 28: | # | Rule | Rationale |
 29: |---|------|-----------|
 30: | 1 | Repositories return **entities**, never DTOs | Single responsibility; mapping belongs in handlers |
 31: | 2 | Validators use **manual instantiation**, not DI | Fine-grained control; consistent pattern |
 32: | 3 | Navigation properties are **readonly for writes** | Tenant isolation; explicit repository operations |
 33: | 4 | Use `int` for IDs (except where `Guid`/`long` needed) | Consistency; sufficient for most scenarios |
 34: | 5 | No default values in entity properties | Explicit initialization; clear value origins |
 35: | 6 | Keep all using statements | Build system dependencies; prevents issues |
 36: | 7 | Commands return `BaseCommandResponse<T>` | Consistent error handling; structured responses |
 37: | 8 | GET = AllowAnonymous, Write = Authorize | Public discovery; protected writes |
 38: | 9 | UserId extraction uses fallback pattern | Provider compatibility; claim name variations |
 39: | 10 | Use file-scoped namespaces | C# 10+ convention; cleaner code |
 40: 
 41: **For detailed examples**: See `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` and relevant skills.
 42: 
 43: ---
 44: 
 45: ## Naming Conventions
 46: 
 47: ### General Rules
 48: 
 49: | Element | Convention | Example |
 50: |---------|------------|---------|
 51: | Public members | PascalCase | `Title`, `CreatedAt` |
 52: | Private fields | _camelCase with underscore | `_eventRepository` |
 53: | Parameters | camelCase | `eventId`, `createDto` |
 54: | Constants | PascalCase | `DefaultPageSize` |
 55: | Interfaces | IPascalCase | `IEventRepository` |
 56: | Async methods | Suffix with Async | `GetEventsAsync()` |
 57: 
 58: ### Entity Naming
 59: 
 60: | Type | Pattern | Example |
 61: |------|---------|---------|
 62: | Core entity | Singular noun | `Event`, `Organization` |
 63: | Lookup/enum entity | Singular noun | `EventType`, `ApprovalStatus` |
 64: | Join table | Combined names | `EventCategories`, `EventTags` |
 65: | Aspect table | Parent + Details | `EventIslamicDetails` |
 66: 
 67: ### DTO Naming
 68: 
 69: | Type | Pattern | Purpose |
 70: |------|---------|---------|
 71: | Full details | `{Entity}Dto` | Read operations with all fields |
 72: | List view | `{Entity}ListDto` | Minimal fields for lists |
 73: | Create payload | `Create{Entity}Dto` | Write operations (no ID) |
 74: | Update payload | `Update{Entity}Dto` | Write operations (ID required) |
 75: 
 76: ### Handler Naming
 77: 
 78: | Type | Pattern | Example |
 79: |------|---------|---------|
 80: | Command | `Create{Entity}Command` | `CreateEventCommand` |
 81: | Command Handler | `Create{Entity}CommandHandler` | `CreateEventCommandHandler` |
 82: | Query | `Get{Entity}ListRequest` | `GetEventListRequest` |
 83: | Query Handler | `Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler` | `GetEventListRequestHandler` |
 84: 
 85: ### Repository Naming
 86: 
 87: | Type | Pattern | Example |
 88: |------|---------|---------|
 89: | Interface | `I{Entity}Repository` | `IEventRepository` |
 90: | Implementation | `{Entity}Repository` | `EventRepository` |
 91: | Generic base | `IGenericRepository<T, TId>` | Base interface |
 92: 
 93: ---
 94: 
 95: ## File Organization
 96: 
 97: ### Solution Structure
 98: 
 99: ```
100: {Project}.sln
101: ├── src/
102: │   ├── {Project}.Domain/           # Entities, Enums, Interfaces
103: │   ├── {Project}.Application/      # CQRS, DTOs, Validators
104: │   ├── {Project}.Persistence/      # DbContext, Repositories
105: │   ├── {Project}.Infrastructure/   # External services
106: │   ├── {Project}.API/              # REST endpoints
107: │   ├── {Project}.Blazor/           # BFF (Blazor Server)
108: │   └── {Project}.Blazor.Client/    # UI (Blazor WASM)
109: ├── tests/
110: │   ├── {Project}.Domain.UnitTests/
111: │   ├── {Project}.Application.UnitTests/
112: │   ├── {Project}.API.IntegrationTests/
113: │   └── {Project}.Persistence.IntegrationTests/
114: └── docs/
115: ```
116: 
117: ### Application Layer Organization
118: 
119: ```
120: {Project}.Application/
121: ├── Features/{Entity}/
122: │   ├── Requests/
123: │   │   ├── Commands/           # Create, Update, Delete
124: │   │   └── Queries/            # Get, List, Search
125: │   └── Handlers/
126: │       ├── Commands/           # Command handlers
127: │       └── Queries/            # Query handlers
128: ├── DTOs/{Entity}/
129: │   ├── {Entity}Dto.cs
130: │   ├── {Entity}ListDto.cs
131: │   ├── Create{Entity}Dto.cs
132: │   ├── Update{Entity}Dto.cs
133: │   └── Validators/
134: ├── Contracts/
135: │   ├── Persistence/            # Repository interfaces
136: │   ├── Infrastructure/         # Service interfaces
137: │   └── Identity/               # User context interfaces
138: ├── Responses/                  # BaseCommandResponse, etc.
139: ├── Exceptions/                 # Custom exceptions
140: └── Profiles/                   # AutoMapper profiles
141: ```
142: 
143: ### Domain Layer Organization
144: 
145: ```
146: {Project}.Domain/
147: ├── Entities/                   # Core business entities
148: ├── Enums/                      # Enum definitions
149: ├── Interfaces/                 # Domain interfaces
150: │   ├── ITenantEntity.cs
151: │   ├── IAuditableEntity.cs
152: │   └── ISoftDeletable.cs
153: └── ValueObjects/               # Value objects (if any)
154: ```
155: 
156: ### Persistence Layer Organization
157: 
158: ```
159: {Project}.Persistence/
160: ├── Configurations/
161: │   └── Entities/               # EF Core configurations
162: ├── Repositories/               # Repository implementations
163: ├── Migrations/                 # Database migrations
164: └── {DbContext}.cs              # Main DbContext
165: ```
166: 
167: ---
168: 
169: ## Layer Responsibilities
170: 
171: ### What Goes Where
172: 
173: | Concern | Layer | Location |
174: |---------|-------|----------|
175: | Entity definition | Domain | `{Project}.Domain/` |
176: | Business rules | Domain | Entity methods, value objects |
177: | Repository interface | Application | `Contracts/Persistence/` |
178: | Command/Query | Application | `Features/{Entity}/Requests/` |
179: | Handler logic | Application | `Features/{Entity}/Handlers/` |
180: | DTO definition | Application | `DTOs/{Entity}/` |
181: | Validation rules | Application | `DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/` |
182: | Repository implementation | Persistence | `Repositories/` |
183: | EF configuration | Persistence | `Configurations/Entities/` |
184: | External service impl | Infrastructure | Service classes |
185: | API endpoint | Presentation | `Controllers/` |
186: | UI component | Presentation | `Components/` |
187: 
188: ### Dependency Rules
189: 
190: | Layer | Can Reference | Cannot Reference |
191: |-------|--------------|------------------|
192: | Domain | Nothing | Application, Infrastructure, Presentation |
193: | Application | Domain | Infrastructure, Presentation |
194: | Infrastructure | Domain, Application | Presentation |
195: | Presentation | All | (Entry point) |
196: 
197: ---
198: 
199: ## Design Principles
200: 
201: ### SOLID Application
202: 
203: | Principle | How We Apply It |
204: |-----------|-----------------|
205: | **S**ingle Responsibility | One handler per command/query; one repository per entity |
206: | **O**pen/Closed | Extend via new handlers, not modifying existing |
207: | **L**iskov Substitution | All repository implementations honor interface contracts |
208: | **I**nterface Segregation | Small, focused interfaces per entity type |
209: | **D**ependency Inversion | Application defines interfaces; Infrastructure implements |
210: 
211: ### Additional Principles
212: 
213: | Principle | Application |
214: |-----------|-------------|
215: | **DRY** | Generic repository base; shared validation patterns |
216: | **KISS** | Simple handlers; one responsibility per class |
217: | **YAGNI** | Don't add abstractions until needed |
218: | **Explicit > Implicit** | Clear initialization; obvious dependencies |
219: | **Fail Fast** | Validate early; return errors immediately |
220: 
221: ---
222: 
223: ## Pattern Selection Guide
224: 
225: ### When to Use Each Pattern
226: 
227: | Scenario | Pattern | Reasoning |
228: |----------|---------|-----------|
229: | Simple CRUD | CQRS + Generic Repository | Standard approach |
230: | Complex query | Custom repository method | Optimize for specific needs |
231: | Cross-entity operation | Domain service | Coordinate multiple entities |
232: | External integration | Infrastructure service | Isolate external dependencies |
233: | Validation | FluentValidation | Consistent, testable rules |
234: | Mapping | AutoMapper | Convention-based, less boilerplate |
235: 
236: ### When NOT to Use Patterns
237: 
238: | Anti-Pattern | Why to Avoid |
239: |--------------|--------------|
240: | Repository for simple lookups | Over-engineering |
241: | Domain service for single-entity ops | Should be in handler |
242: | Generic repository for complex queries | Loses optimization |
243: | MediatR behaviors for one-off logic | Use handler directly |
244: 
245: ---
246: 
247: ## Decision Framework
248: 
249: ### Choosing ID Types
250: 
251: | Type | Use When | Examples |
252: |------|----------|----------|
253: | `Guid` | Main entities, distributed systems | Event, Organization, User |
254: | `int` | Lookup tables, enums, sequential IDs | EventType, ApprovalStatus |
255: | `long` | Large sequences, file sizes, cursors | Pagination, storage metrics |
256: 
257: ### Choosing Validation Location
258: 
259: | Location | Use When |
260: |----------|----------|
261: | DTO Validator | Input validation, format checks |
262: | Handler | Business rules requiring data access |
263: | Entity | Invariants that must always hold |
264: | Controller | Quick format/auth checks |
265: 
266: ### Choosing Query Strategy
267: 
268: | Strategy | Use When |
269: |----------|----------|
270: | Repository method | Standard queries, reusable |
271: | Handler-specific query | One-off, optimized for use case |
272: | Specification pattern | Complex, composable filters |
273: 
274: ---
275: 
276: ## Code Quality Standards
277: 
278: ### Required in Every File
279: 
280: - File-scoped namespace
281: - All necessary using statements preserved
282: - Async suffix on async methods
283: - CancellationToken passed through
284: 
285: ### Required in Every Entity
286: 
287: - Primary key property
288: - TenantId (for tenant-scoped entities)
289: - Audit fields (CreatedAt, UpdatedAt)
290: - Soft delete support (IsDeleted)
291: 
292: ### Required in Every Controller
293: 
294: - Route attribute with version
295: - OpenAPI attributes on actions
296: - Authorization attributes
297: - Proper HTTP status codes
298: 
299: ---
300: 
301: ## Related Documentation
302: 
303: - **[QUICK_REFERENCE.md](QUICK_REFERENCE.md)** - Critical rules with examples
304: - **[ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)** - System architecture overview
305: - **[TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md)** - Placeholder definitions
306: 
307: ## Implementation Reference
308: 
309: For detailed code patterns and examples, see:
310: 
311: | Skill | Content |
312: |-------|---------|
313: | `clean-architecture-rules` | Layer boundaries, dependency rules |
314: | `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` | Commands, queries, handlers |
315: | `dotnet-efcore-guidelines` | DbContext, repositories, queries |
316: | `blazor-ui-conventions` | Component patterns, state management |
317: | `auth-patterns` | User ID extraction, authorization |
````

## File: docs/QUICK_REFERENCE.md
````markdown
  1: # Quick Reference - Critical Rules
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic .NET Clean Architecture Quick Reference**
  4: >
  5: > Fast lookup for critical rules and patterns. For full details, see [GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md).
  6: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  7: 
  8: **Last Updated**: January 2026
  9: 
 10: ---
 11: 
 12: ## 12 Critical Rules (Never Violate)
 13: 
 14: ### 1. Repositories Return ENTITIES, Never DTOs
 15: 
 16: ```csharp
 17: // ❌ WRONG
 18: public interface I{Entity}Repository
 19: {
 20:     Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // WRONG
 21: }
 22: 
 23: // ✅ CORRECT
 24: public interface I{Entity}Repository
 25: {
 26:     Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // CORRECT
 27: }
 28: 
 29: // Handler maps entities to DTOs
 30: public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(...)
 31: {
 32:     var entities = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // Entities
 33:     return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>(entities);  // DTOs
 34: }
 35: ```
 36: 
 37: **Why (SOLID - Single Responsibility)**: Repositories handle data access; handlers handle mapping.
 38: 
 39: ---
 40: 
 41: ### 2. Validators Use Manual Instantiation (NOT DI)
 42: 
 43: ```csharp
 44: // ❌ WRONG - DI injection
 45: public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
 46:     I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
 47:     IValidator<Create{Entity}Dto> validator)  // WRONG
 48: {
 49:     _validator = validator;
 50: }
 51: 
 52: // ✅ CORRECT - Manual instantiation
 53: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(...)
 54: {
 55:     var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
 56:         _{relatedEntity}Repository,
 57:         _{lookupEntity}Repository);
 58: 
 59:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
 60: }
 61: ```
 62: 
 63: **Why**: Fine-grained control; avoids DI complexity; consistent pattern.
 64: 
 65: ---
 66: 
 67: ### 3. Navigation Properties on Link Tables Are Readonly
 68: 
 69: ```csharp
 70: // ❌ WRONG - Write through navigation
 71: var {parentEntity} = await _{parentEntity}Repository.GetById(id);
 72: {parentEntity}.{ChildEntities}.Add({childEntity});  // WRONG
 73: await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 74: 
 75: // ✅ CORRECT - Write through repository
 76: var {linkEntity} = new {LinkEntity}
 77: {
 78:     {ParentEntity}Id = id,
 79:     {ChildEntity}Id = childId
 80: };
 81: await _{linkEntity}Repository.Create({linkEntity});  // CORRECT
 82: ```
 83: 
 84: **Why**: Tenant isolation; explicit writes; prevents accidental cross-tenant data mixing.
 85: 
 86: ---
 87: 
 88: ### 4. Use int Instead of long (Except Size/Cursor)
 89: 
 90: ```csharp
 91: // ❌ WRONG
 92: public long Id { get; set; }
 93: 
 94: // ✅ CORRECT
 95: public int Id { get; set; }      // For lookup tables
 96: public Guid Id { get; set; }     // For main entities
 97: public long Size { get; set; }   // OK for file size
 98: public long Cursor { get; set; } // OK for pagination cursor
 99: ```
100: 
101: **Why**: Consistent conventions; `int` sufficient for most scenarios.
102: 
103: ---
104: 
105: ### 5. No Default Values in Entities
106: 
107: ```csharp
108: // ❌ WRONG
109: public class {Entity}
110: {
111:     public int ViewCount { get; set; } = 0;  // WRONG
112: }
113: 
114: // ✅ CORRECT
115: public class {Entity}
116: {
117:     public int ViewCount { get; set; }  // Set in handler or DB
118: }
119: 
120: // In handler:
121: var entity = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
122: entity.ViewCount = 0;  // Set here
123: ```
124: 
125: **Why**: Clear initialization; avoids confusion between default and database values.
126: 
127: ---
128: 
129: ### 6. Do Not Remove Using Statements
130: 
131: ```csharp
132: // ✅ KEEP all using statements even if they appear unused
133: using System;
134: using System.Collections.Generic;
135: using System.Linq;
136: using System.Threading;
137: using System.Threading.Tasks;
138: using AutoMapper;
139: using MediatR;
140: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
141: using {Project}.Domain;
142: // ... keep all
143: ```
144: 
145: **Why**: Build system may need them; prevents hard-to-debug issues.
146: 
147: ---
148: 
149: ### 7. Commands Return BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>
150: 
151: ```csharp
152: // ❌ WRONG
153: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<{IdType}>
154: 
155: // ✅ CORRECT
156: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
157: ```
158: 
159: **Response Structure**:
160: ```csharp
161: public class BaseCommandResponse<T>
162: {
163:     public bool Success { get; set; }
164:     public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
165:     public T? Id { get; set; }
166:     public List<string> Errors { get; set; } = new();
167: }
168: ```
169: 
170: **Why**: Consistent error handling; validation messages; success/failure distinction.
171: 
172: ---
173: 
174: ### 8. GET = AllowAnonymous, Write = Authorize, Admin = Roles
175: 
176: ```csharp
177: [HttpGet]
178: [AllowAnonymous]  // ✅ Public read access
179: public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll() { }
180: 
181: [HttpPost]
182: [Authorize]  // ✅ Authenticated write access
183: public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Create(...) { }
184: 
185: [HttpPut("{id}")]
186: [Authorize]  // ✅ Authenticated write access
187: public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Update(...) { }
188: 
189: [HttpDelete("{id}")]
190: [Authorize]  // ✅ Authenticated write access (or use Roles="Admin" for admin-only)
191: public async Task<ActionResult> Delete({IdType} id) { }
192: 
193: // Admin-only endpoints
194: [HttpDelete("{id}")]
195: [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]  // ✅ Admin-only access
196: public async Task<ActionResult> DeletePermanent({IdType} id) { }
197: ```
198: 
199: **Why (Security)**: Public discovery; protected writes; role-based access control for sensitive operations.
200: 
201: ---
202: 
203: ### 9. Extract UserId with Fallback Pattern
204: 
205: ```csharp
206: var userId = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
207:     ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst(
208:         "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
209:     ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
210: 
211: if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
212: {
213:     return Unauthorized(new { error = "User ID not found in token" });
214: }
215: ```
216: 
217: **Claim Priority**: `sub` → `nameidentifier` → `sid`
218: 
219: **Why**: Different auth providers use different claim names.
220: 
221: ---
222: 
223: ### 10. File-Scoped Namespaces
224: 
225: ```csharp
226: // ❌ WRONG - Nested namespace
227: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands
228: {
229:     public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler { }
230: }
231: 
232: // ✅ CORRECT - File-scoped namespace
233: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
234: 
235: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler { }
236: ```
237: 
238: **Why (Clean Code)**: C# 10+ convention; reduces nesting; cleaner code.
239: 
240: ---
241: 
242: ### 11. Entities Include Auditing Fields (ENHANCED with Soft Delete Audit)
243: 
244: ```csharp
245: // ✅ CORRECT - Include auditing fields
246: public class {Entity}
247: {
248:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
249:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
250: 
251:     // Standard auditing fields
252:     public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
253:     public Guid? CreatedBy { get; set; }
254:     public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
255:     public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; set; }
256: 
257:     // Enhanced soft delete with audit trail
258:     public bool IsDeleted { get; set; }
259:     public DateTime? DeletedAt { get; set; }
260:     public Guid? DeletedBy { get; set; }
261: 
262:     // Tenant isolation
263:     public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
264: }
265: 
266: // Set in handler
267: var entity = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
268: entity.CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
269: entity.CreatedBy = currentUserId;  // From HttpContext
270: entity.IsDeleted = false;
271: 
272: // Soft delete is automatically handled by SaveChangesAsync override in DbContext
273: // which sets IsDeleted, DeletedAt, and DeletedBy when an entity is deleted
274: ```
275: 
276: **Why (Audit Trail)**: Track who created/modified entities and when; enables soft delete with complete audit trail (who deleted and when); maintains full data history.
277: 
278: ---
279: 
280: ### 12. Use Named Query Filters for Soft Delete
281: 
282: ```csharp
283: // ❌ WRONG - Single combined filter
284: modelBuilder.Entity<{Entity}>()
285:     .HasQueryFilter(e => !e.IsDeleted && (TenantContext == null || e.TenantId == TenantContext.TenantId));
286: 
287: // ✅ CORRECT - Named filters (EF Core 10+)
288: modelBuilder.Entity<{Entity}>()
289:     .HasQueryFilter(e => TenantContext == null || e.TenantId == TenantContext.TenantId);
290: 
291: modelBuilder.Entity<{Entity}>()
292:     .HasQueryFilter(name: "SoftDelete", predicate: e => !e.IsDeleted);
293: 
294: // Temporarily disable soft delete filter when needed
295: var allEntities = await _dbContext.{Entities}
296:     .IgnoreQueryFilter("SoftDelete")
297:     .ToListAsync();
298: ```
299: 
300: **Why (EF Core 10)**: Named filters allow selective disabling; tenant filter always active; soft delete filter can be bypassed for admin operations.
301: 
302: ---
303: 
304: ## CQRS Pattern Quick Reference
305: 
306: ### Command Pattern (Write)
307: 
308: ```csharp
309: // 1. Command Request
310: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
311: {
312:     public Create{Entity}Dto {Entity}Dto { get; set; } = null!;
313: }
314: 
315: // 2. Command Handler
316: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
317: {
318:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
319:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity}Repository _{relatedEntity}Repository;
320:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
321: 
322:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(...)
323:     {
324:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
325: 
326:         // Instantiate validator manually
327:         var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(_{relatedEntity}Repository);
328:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
329: 
330:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
331:         {
332:             response.Success = false;
333:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
334:             return response;
335:         }
336: 
337:         var entity = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
338:         entity = await _{entity}Repository.Create(entity);
339: 
340:         response.Success = true;
341:         response.Id = entity.Id;
342:         return response;
343:     }
344: }
345: ```
346: 
347: ### Query Pattern (Read)
348: 
349: ```csharp
350: // 1. Query Request
351: public class Get{Entity}ListRequest : IRequest<List<{Entity}ListDto>> { }
352: 
353: // 2. Query Handler
354: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
355: {
356:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
357:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
358: 
359:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(...)
360:     {
361:         var entities = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();  // Entities
362:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>(entities);  // DTOs
363:     }
364: }
365: ```
366: 
367: ---
368: 
369: ## Folder Structure
370: 
371: ```
372: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/
373: ├── Requests/
374: │   ├── Commands/
375: │   │   ├── Create{Entity}Command.cs
376: │   │   ├── Update{Entity}Command.cs
377: │   │   └── Delete{Entity}Command.cs
378: │   └── Queries/
379: │       ├── Get{Entity}ListRequest.cs
380: │       ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequest.cs
381: │       └── Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}Request.cs
382: └── Handlers/
383:     ├── Commands/
384:     │   ├── Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
385:     │   ├── Update{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
386:     │   └── Delete{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
387:     └── Queries/
388:         ├── Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
389:         ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler.cs
390:         └── Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}RequestHandler.cs
391: 
392: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/
393: ├── {Entity}Dto.cs              // Full details
394: ├── {Entity}ListDto.cs          // List view
395: ├── Create{Entity}Dto.cs        // Create payload
396: ├── Update{Entity}Dto.cs        // Update payload
397: └── Validators/
398:     ├── Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
399:     └── Update{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
400: ```
401: 
402: ---
403: 
404: ## Controller Pattern
405: 
406: ```csharp
407: [Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
408: [ApiController]
409: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
410: {
411:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
412: 
413:     public {Entity}Controller(IMediator mediator) => _mediator = mediator;
414: 
415:     [HttpGet]
416:     [AllowAnonymous]
417:     [EndpointSummary("Get all {Entities}")]
418:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(List<{Entity}ListDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
419:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll()
420:         => Ok(await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest()));
421: 
422:     [HttpGet("{id}")]
423:     [AllowAnonymous]
424:     [EndpointSummary("Get {Entity} by ID")]
425:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof({Entity}Dto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
426:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
427:     public async Task<ActionResult<{Entity}Dto>> GetById({IdType} id)
428:         => Ok(await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}DetailsRequest { Id = id }));
429: 
430:     [HttpPost]
431:     [Authorize]
432:     [EndpointSummary("Create {Entity}")]
433:     [Consumes("application/json")]
434:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
435:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
436:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Create([FromBody] Create{Entity}Dto dto)
437:     {
438:         var response = await _mediator.Send(new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto });
439:         return response.Success ? Ok(response) : BadRequest(response);
440:     }
441: 
442:     [HttpPut("{id}")]
443:     [Authorize]
444:     [EndpointSummary("Update {Entity}")]
445:     [Consumes("application/json")]
446:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Update({IdType} id, [FromBody] Update{Entity}Dto dto)
447:     {
448:         if (id != dto.Id) return BadRequest(new { error = "ID mismatch" });
449:         var response = await _mediator.Send(new Update{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto });
450:         return response.Success ? Ok(response) : BadRequest(response);
451:     }
452: 
453:     [HttpDelete("{id}")]
454:     [Authorize]
455:     [EndpointSummary("Delete {Entity}")]
456:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
457:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
458:     public async Task<ActionResult> Delete({IdType} id)
459:     {
460:         var result = await _mediator.Send(new Delete{Entity}Command { Id = id });
461:         return result ? NoContent() : NotFound();
462:     }
463: }
464: ```
465: 
466: ---
467: 
468: ## API Endpoint Metadata (Required)
469: 
470: All controller actions must include OpenAPI attributes:
471: 
472: ```csharp
473: [HttpGet("{id}")]
474: [EndpointSummary("Get {Entity} Details")]
475: [EndpointDescription("Returns full {entity} details including related entities.")]
476: [AllowAnonymous]
477: [ProducesResponseType(typeof({Entity}Dto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
478: [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
479: public async Task<ActionResult<{Entity}Dto>> GetById({IdType} id)
480: ```
481: 
482: **Required Attributes**:
483: - `[EndpointSummary]` - Short title
484: - `[EndpointDescription]` - Detailed description
485: - `[ProducesResponseType]` - Success + failure codes
486: - `[Consumes]` - For POST/PUT with JSON body
487: 
488: ---
489: 
490: ## Common Mistakes & Fixes
491: 
492: | Mistake | Fix |
493: |---------|-----|
494: | Repository returns DTOs | Return entities; map in handler |
495: | Validator injected via DI | Instantiate manually in handler |
496: | `{parentEntity}.{ChildEntities}.Add()` | Use `_{linkEntity}Repository.Create()` |
497: | `public long Id` | Use `public int Id` or `public Guid Id` |
498: | `= 0` default in entity | Remove; set in handler |
499: | Removed using statements | Keep all using statements |
500: | `IRequest<{IdType}>` | Use `IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>` |
501: | Nested namespaces | Use file-scoped namespaces |
502: | Missing userId fallback | Use sub → nameidentifier → sid |
503: | Missing [AllowAnonymous] on GET | Add for public read access |
504: | Missing auditing fields | Add CreatedAt, CreatedBy, UpdatedAt, UpdatedBy, DeletedAt, DeletedBy |
505: | Missing soft delete | Add IsDeleted, DeletedAt, DeletedBy; use named query filter |
506: | **Delete command returns `bool`** | **Use `IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>` for ALL commands (including deletes)** |
507: | Admin endpoint without Roles | Add `[Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]` |
508: | Combined query filters | Use named filters: `HasQueryFilter(name: "SoftDelete", ...)` |
509: 
510: ---
511: 
512: ## Design Principles Summary
513: 
514: | Principle | Application |
515: |-----------|-------------|
516: | **S**ingle Responsibility | Each handler handles ONE command/query |
517: | **O**pen/Closed | Use interfaces for extension |
518: | **L**iskov Substitution | Repositories implement interfaces correctly |
519: | **I**nterface Segregation | Small, focused interfaces |
520: | **D**ependency Inversion | Depend on abstractions |
521: | **DRY** | Use `GenericRepository<T, TId>` |
522: | **KISS** | Simple handlers, one responsibility |
523: | **YAGNI** | Don't add unused abstractions |
524: 
525: ---

````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: 
  5: <MudTable Items="Items" Hover="true" Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm" Elevation="0" Dense="true" Class="border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
  6:     <HeaderContent>
  7:         <MudTh>Submitted</MudTh>
  8:         <MudTh>ID</MudTh>
  9:         <MudTh>Organization</MudTh>
 10:         <MudTh>Status</MudTh>
 11:         <MudTh Style="text-align:center">Actions</MudTh>
 12:         <MudTh Style="text-align:center">Details</MudTh>
 13:     </HeaderContent>
 14: 
 15:     <RowTemplate>
 16:         <MudTd DataLabel="Submitted">
 17:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">
 18:                 @(context.CreatedAt?.ToLocalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm") ?? "N/A")
 19:             </MudText>
 20:             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@GetRelative(context.CreatedAt ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow)</MudText>
 21:         </MudTd>
 22: 
 23:         <MudTd DataLabel="ID">
 24:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="font-monospace">@context.Id.ToString()[..8]…</MudText>
 25:         </MudTd>
 26: 
 27:         <MudTd DataLabel="Organization">
 28:             <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
 29:                 <MudAvatar Size="Size.Medium" Variant="Variant.Filled" Rounded="true" Color="Color.Surface">
 30:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business" Color="Color.Primary" />
 31:                 </MudAvatar>
 32: 
 33:                 <div>
 34:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 700;">
 35:                         @context.FullName
 36:                     </MudText>
 37:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">
 38:                         @(context.City ?? "Unknown"), @(context.Country ?? "Unknown") • @context.Email
 39:                     </MudText>
 40:                 </div>
 41:             </div>
 42:         </MudTd>
 43: 
 44:         <MudTd DataLabel="Status">
 45:             <MudChip T="string"
 46:                      Color="@StatusColor((RequestStatus)context.ApprovalStatusId)"
 47:                      Variant="Variant.Filled"
 48:                      Size="Size.Small"
 49:                      Class="rounded-pill px-3">
 50:                 @context.StatusTypeFullName
 51:             </MudChip>
 52:         </MudTd>
 53: 
 54:         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Style="text-align:center">
 55:             <div class="d-flex justify-center gap-2">
 56:                 @if (context.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Pending)
 57:                 {
 58:                     <MudTooltip Text="Approve">
 59:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle"
 60:                                        Color="Color.Success"
 61:                                        Variant="Variant.Filled"
 62:                                        Size="Size.Small"
 63:                                        OnClick="@(() => OnApprove.InvokeAsync(context))" />
 64:                     </MudTooltip>
 65:                     <MudTooltip Text="Reject">
 66:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Cancel"
 67:                                        Color="Color.Error"
 68:                                        Variant="Variant.Filled"
 69:                                        Size="Size.Small"
 70:                                        OnClick="@(() => OnReject.InvokeAsync(context))" />
 71:                     </MudTooltip>
 72:                 }
 73:                 else if (context.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Approved)
 74:                 {
 75:                     <MudTooltip Text="Revoke approval">
 76:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Restore"
 77:                                        Color="Color.Warning"
 78:                                        Variant="Variant.Filled"
 79:                                        Size="Size.Small"
 80:                                        OnClick="@(() => OnRevert.InvokeAsync(context))" />
 81:                     </MudTooltip>
 82:                 }
 83:                 else if (context.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Rejected)
 84:                 {
 85:                     <MudTooltip Text="Move back to pending">
 86:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Restore"
 87:                                        Color="Color.Info"
 88:                                        Variant="Variant.Filled"
 89:                                        Size="Size.Small"
 90:                                        OnClick="@(() => OnRevert.InvokeAsync(context))" />
 91:                     </MudTooltip>
 92:                 }
 93:             </div>
 94:         </MudTd>
 95: 
 96:         <MudTd DataLabel="Details" Style="text-align:center">
 97:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 98:                        Color="Color.Primary"
 99:                        Size="Size.Small"
100:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Visibility"
101:                        OnClick="@(() => OnViewDetails.InvokeAsync(context))"
102:                        Class="rounded-pill">
103:                 Details
104:             </MudButton>
105:         </MudTd>
106:     </RowTemplate>
107: 
108:     <NoRecordsContent>
109:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center pa-8">
110:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Inbox" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Default" />
111:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-2" Style="font-weight: 700;">No matching requests</MudText>
112:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Try clearing filters or changing your search.</MudText>
113:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
114:                        Color="Color.Primary"
115:                        OnClick="OnClearFilters"
116:                        Class="mt-4 rounded-pill">
117:                 Clear filters
118:             </MudButton>
119:         </div>
120:     </NoRecordsContent>
121: </MudTable>
122: 
123: @code {
124:     [Parameter] public IEnumerable<OrganizationListDto> Items { get; set; } = Enumerable.Empty<OrganizationListDto>();
125:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<OrganizationListDto> OnApprove { get; set; }
126:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<OrganizationListDto> OnReject { get; set; }
127:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<OrganizationListDto> OnRevert { get; set; }
128:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<OrganizationListDto> OnViewDetails { get; set; }
129:     [Parameter] public EventCallback OnClearFilters { get; set; }
130: 
131:     // Helpers duplicated here for display logic
132:     private enum RequestStatus { Pending = 1, Approved = 2, Rejected = 3 }
133: 
134:     private Color StatusColor(RequestStatus s) => s switch
135:     {
136:         RequestStatus.Pending => Color.Info,
137:         RequestStatus.Approved => Color.Success,
138:         RequestStatus.Rejected => Color.Error,
139:         _ => Color.Default
140:     };
141: 
142:     private string GetRelative(DateTimeOffset utc)
143:     {
144:         var ts = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - utc;
145:         if (ts.TotalDays >= 1) return $"{(int)ts.TotalDays}d ago";
146:         if (ts.TotalHours >= 1) return $"{(int)ts.TotalHours}h ago";
147:         if (ts.TotalMinutes >= 1) return $"{(int)ts.TotalMinutes}m ago";
148:         return "just now";
149:     }
150: }

 65: @code {

 67:     [Parameter] public bool ShowRegisterButton { get; set; } = false;
 68:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<EventSessionListDto> OnRegisterClick { get; set; }
 69: 
 70:     public List<EventSessionListDto> Sessions { get; private set; } = new();
 71:     
 72:     private Guid _previousEventId;
 73:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 74: 
 75:     protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
 76:     {
 77:         if (EventId != Guid.Empty && EventId != _previousEventId)
 78:         {
 79:             _previousEventId = EventId;
 80:             await LoadSessions();
 81:         }
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     public async Task LoadSessions()
 85:     {
 86:         _isLoading = true;
 87:         try
 88:         {
 89:             var result = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
 90:             Sessions = result.OrderBy(s => s.StartTime).ToList();
 91:         }
 92:         catch (Exception ex)
 93:         {
 94:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading sessions: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
 95:             Sessions = new List<EventSessionListDto>();
 96:         }
 97:         finally
 98:         {
 99:             _isLoading = false;
100:             StateHasChanged();
101:         }
102:     }
103: }

  1: @using MudBlazor

 61:     private bool IsAllSelected => Sessions.Any(s => s.Id.HasValue) && _selectedSessionIds.Count == Sessions.Count(s => s.Id.HasValue);
 62: 
 63:     private void ToggleSelectAll()

 65:         if (IsAllSelected)

 67:             _selectedSessionIds.Clear();

 72:         }

 75:     private string GetAllSelectionStyle()
 76:     {
 77:         return IsAllSelected 
 78:             ? "border: 2px solid var(--mud-palette-primary); background-color: var(--mud-palette-primary-hover);" 
 79:             : "border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-lines-default);";
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     private void ToggleSelection(Guid sessionId)
 83:     {
 84:         if (_selectedSessionIds.Contains(sessionId))
 85:             _selectedSessionIds.Remove(sessionId);
 86:         else
 87:             _selectedSessionIds.Add(sessionId);
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     private string GetSessionStyle(Guid sessionId)
 91:     {
 92:         return _selectedSessionIds.Contains(sessionId) 
 93:             ? "border: 2px solid var(--mud-palette-primary); background-color: var(--mud-palette-primary-hover);" 
 94:             : "border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-lines-default);";
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
 98: 
 99:     private void Submit() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(_selectedSessionIds.ToList()));
100: }

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/ImageUpload.razor
````razor
  1: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  4: @inject IImageStorageService ImageStorageService
  5: @inject ILogger<ImageUpload> Logger
  6: 
  7: <div class="d-flex flex-column gap-2" style="@($"width: {Width};")">
  8:     <div class="relative d-flex justify-center align-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed mud-border-primary" 
  9:          style="@($"height: {Height}; background-color: var(--mud-palette-background-grey);")">
 10:         
 11:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PreviewUrl))
 12:         {
 13:             <img src="@PreviewUrl" alt="@(Alt ?? "Image preview")" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;" />
 14:         }
 15:         else
 16:         {
 17:             <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center gap-2 pa-4 text-center">
 18:                 <MudIcon Icon="@(Icon ?? Icons.Material.Filled.Image)" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 19:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">@(PlaceholderText ?? "No image selected")</MudText>
 20:             </div>
