````razor
 22:     </div>
 23: 
 24:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 25:     {
 26:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Dense="true" Class="my-1" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _errorMessage = null)">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     <div class="d-flex justify-center gap-2">
 30:         <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile"
 31:                        @ref="_fileUpload"
 32:                        FilesChanged="OnFileSelected"
 33:                        Accept="@AcceptedFormats"
 34:                        MaximumFileCount="1">
 35:             <ActivatorContent>
 36:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 37:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CloudUpload"
 38:                            Color="Color.Primary"
 39:                            Size="Size.Small">
 40:                     @(UploadButtonText ?? "Select Image")
 41:                 </MudButton>
 42:             </ActivatorContent>
 43:         </MudFileUpload>
 44: 
 45:         @if (HasImage)
 46:         {
 47:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
 48:                        Color="Color.Error"
 49:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
 50:                        Size="Size.Small"
 51:                        OnClick="RemoveImage">
 52:                 Remove
 53:             </MudButton>
 54:         }
 55:     </div>
 56: 
 57:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(HintText))
 58:     {
 59:         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary" Align="Align.Center">@HintText</MudText>
 60:     }
 61: </div>
 62: 
 63: @code {
 64:     [Parameter] public string? PreviewUrl { get; set; }
 65:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<string?> PreviewUrlChanged { get; set; }
 66: 
 67:     /// <summary>
 68:     /// Legacy callback that passes IBrowserFile. Prefer using FileDataSelected for reliable WASM uploads.
 69:     /// </summary>
 70:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<IBrowserFile?> FileSelected { get; set; }
 71: 
 72:     /// <summary>
 73:     /// Preferred callback that passes FileUploadData (bytes read into memory).
 74:     /// This prevents stream exhaustion issues in Blazor WASM.
 75:     /// </summary>
 76:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<FileUploadData?> FileDataSelected { get; set; }
 77: 
 78:     // Customization parameters
 79:     [Parameter] public string Width { get; set; } = "100%";
 80:     [Parameter] public string Height { get; set; } = "250px";
 81:     [Parameter] public string? PlaceholderText { get; set; }
 82:     [Parameter] public string? UploadButtonText { get; set; }
 83:     [Parameter] public string? HintText { get; set; } = "Supported formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP (Max 5MB)";
 84:     [Parameter] public string? Icon { get; set; }
 85:     [Parameter] public string? Alt { get; set; }
 86:     [Parameter] public string AcceptedFormats { get; set; } = ".jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif,.webp";
 87:     [Parameter] public long MaxFileSize { get; set; } = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5MB default
 88: 
 89:     /// <summary>
 90:     /// Set to true to show a loading indicator while processing the file.
 91:     /// </summary>
 92:     [Parameter] public bool IsProcessing { get; set; }
 93: 
 94:     private MudFileUpload<IBrowserFile>? _fileUpload;
 95:     private bool _isReadingFile;
 96:     private bool HasImage => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PreviewUrl);
 97:     private string? _errorMessage;
 98: 
 99:     private async Task OnFileSelected(IBrowserFile? file)
100:     {
101:         _errorMessage = null;
102:         if (file == null) return;
103: 
104:         // Validate file type
105:         var allowedTypes = new[] { "image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/gif", "image/webp" };
106:         if (!allowedTypes.Contains(file.ContentType.ToLower()))
107:         {
108:             _errorMessage = "Please select a valid image file (JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP)";
109:             return;
110:         }
111: 
112:         // Validate file size
113:         if (file.Size > MaxFileSize)
114:         {
115:             var maxSizeMB = MaxFileSize / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
116:             _errorMessage = $"File size must be less than {maxSizeMB:F1}MB";
117:             return;
118:         }
119: 
120:         _isReadingFile = true;
121:         StateHasChanged();
122: 
123:         try
124:         {
125:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Starting file processing for {FileName} ({Size} bytes)", file.Name, file.Size);
126: 
127:             // STEP 1: Read the file bytes FIRST - this is reliable
128:             // We'll generate the preview from these bytes (skip browser-side resizing which can hang)
129:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 1: Reading file {FileName} ({Size} bytes) into memory...", file.Name, file.Size);
130:             var fileData = await ImageStorageService.ReadFileAsync(file, MaxFileSize);
131: 
132:             if (fileData == null)
133:             {
134:                 Logger.LogError("[ImageUpload] ReadFileAsync returned null for {FileName}", file.Name);
135:                 _errorMessage = "Failed to read the selected file. Please try again.";
136:                 await RemoveImage();
137:                 return;
138:             }
139: 
140:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 1a: Successfully read {ByteCount} bytes from {FileName}", fileData.Size, fileData.FileName);
141: 
142:             // STEP 2: Generate preview from the bytes we just read
143:             // Use full-size bytes directly - browser-side resizing (RequestImageFileAsync) can hang in WASM
144:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 2: Generating preview from bytes...");
145:             string localPreview = ImageStorageService.GenerateLocalPreviewFromBytes(fileData);
146: 
147:             if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(localPreview))
148:             {
149:                 Logger.LogWarning("[ImageUpload] Failed to generate preview for {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
150:                 _errorMessage = "Failed to generate image preview";
151:                 // Continue anyway - the upload might still work
152:             }
153:             else
154:             {
155:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 2a: Preview generated successfully");
156:             }
157: 
158:             // STEP 3: Update preview URL and notify parent
159:             // Yield to allow UI thread to process before heavy operations
160:             await Task.Yield();
161:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3: Setting preview URL (length={Length} chars)...", localPreview?.Length ?? 0);
162:             try
163:             {
164:                 PreviewUrl = localPreview;
165:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3a: PreviewUrl property set");
166: 
167:                 // Use InvokeAsync to ensure we're on the correct sync context
168:                 await InvokeAsync(() =>
169:                 {
170:                     Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3b: Inside InvokeAsync, calling StateHasChanged...");
171:                     StateHasChanged();
172:                 });
173:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3c: StateHasChanged completed");
174: 
175:                 // Yield again after render to let browser process
176:                 await Task.Yield();
177: 
178:                 if (PreviewUrlChanged.HasDelegate)
179:                 {
180:                     Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3d: Invoking PreviewUrlChanged callback...");
181:                     await PreviewUrlChanged.InvokeAsync(localPreview);
182:                     Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3e: PreviewUrlChanged callback completed");
183:                 }
184:                 else
185:                 {
186:                     Logger.LogWarning("[ImageUpload] Step 3d: PreviewUrlChanged has no delegate");
187:                 }
188:             }
189:             catch (Exception previewEx)
190:             {
191:                 Logger.LogError(previewEx, "[ImageUpload] Error during preview URL update: {Message}", previewEx.Message);
192:                 // Continue - don't fail the entire upload just because preview failed
193:             }
194: 
195:             // STEP 4: Pass the file data to the parent component for upload
196:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 4: Checking FileDataSelected delegate (HasDelegate={HasDelegate})...", FileDataSelected.HasDelegate);
197:             if (FileDataSelected.HasDelegate)
198:             {
199:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 4a: Invoking FileDataSelected callback with {Size} bytes...", fileData.Size);
200:                 await FileDataSelected.InvokeAsync(fileData);
201:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 4b: FileDataSelected callback completed successfully");
202:             }
203:             else
204:             {
205:                 Logger.LogWarning("[ImageUpload] FileDataSelected has no delegate - parent callback not configured!");
206:             }
207: 
208:             // STEP 5: Also invoke legacy callback for backward compatibility
209:             if (FileSelected.HasDelegate)
210:             {
211:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 5: Invoking legacy FileSelected callback...");
212:                 await FileSelected.InvokeAsync(file);
213:             }
214: 
215:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] ✓ File processing completed successfully for {FileName}", file.Name);
216:         }
217:         catch (Exception ex)
218:         {
219:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing selected file {FileName}", file.Name);
220:             _errorMessage = $"An error occurred while processing the image: {ex.Message}";
221:             await RemoveImage();
222:         }
223:         finally
224:         {
225:             _isReadingFile = false;
226:             StateHasChanged();
227:         }
228:     }
229: 
230:     public async Task RemoveImage()
231:     {
232:         PreviewUrl = null;
233:         _errorMessage = null;
234:         await PreviewUrlChanged.InvokeAsync(null);
235: 
236:         // Notify parent that file was removed
237:         if (FileDataSelected.HasDelegate)
238:         {
239:             await FileDataSelected.InvokeAsync(null);
240:         }
241:         if (FileSelected.HasDelegate)
242:         {
243:             await FileSelected.InvokeAsync(null);
244:         }
245: 
246:         // Clear the file upload component
247:         if (_fileUpload != null)
248:         {
249:             await _fileUpload.ClearAsync();
250:         }
251: 
252:         StateHasChanged();
253:     }
254: }
````

````csharp
 23:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 24:     private string? _errorMessage;
 25:     private HashSet<RequestStatus> _selectedStatuses = new();
 26:     private enum SortOption { OldestFirst, NewestFirst, Name, Status }
 27:     private SortOption _sort = SortOption.OldestFirst;
 28: 
 29:     private int PendingCount => _organizationRequests.Count(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Pending);
 30:     private int ApprovedCount => _organizationRequests.Count(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Approved);
 31:     private int RejectedCount => _organizationRequests.Count(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Rejected);
 32: 
 33:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 34:     {
 35:         await LoadOrganizationRequests();
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     private async Task LoadOrganizationRequests()
 39:     {
 40:         _isLoading = true;
 41:         _errorMessage = null;
 42: 
 43:         try
 44:         {
 45:             Logger.LogDebug("Loading organizations from API");
 46:             var tempOrgs = await AdminService.GetOrganizationRequestsAsync();
 47: 
 48:             if (tempOrgs != null)
 49:             {
 50:                 _organizationRequests = tempOrgs;
 51:                 Logger.LogDebug("Loaded {OrganizationCount} organizations", _organizationRequests.Count);
 52:             }
 53:             else
 54:             {
 55:                 _organizationRequests = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
 56:             }
 57:         }
 58:         catch (Exception ex)
 59:         {
 60:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load organizations: {ex.Message}";
 61:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load organizations");
 62:             _organizationRequests = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
 63:         }
 64:         finally
 65:         {
 66:             _isLoading = false;
 67:         }
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     private bool IsStatusSelected(RequestStatus s) => _selectedStatuses.Contains(s);
 71: 
 72:     private void ToggleStatus(RequestStatus s)
 73:     {
 74:         if (_selectedStatuses.Contains(s)) _selectedStatuses.Remove(s); else _selectedStatuses.Add(s);
 75:         StateHasChanged();
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     private void ClearFilters()
 79:     {
 80:         _selectedStatuses.Clear();
 81:         _search = string.Empty;
 82:         _sort = SortOption.OldestFirst;
 83:         StateHasChanged();
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     private IEnumerable<OrganizationListDto> GetFilteredAndSorted(RequestStatus? status)
 87:     {
 88:         IEnumerable<OrganizationListDto> q = _organizationRequests;
 89: 
 90:         if (status.HasValue)
 91:             q = q.Where(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)status.Value);
 92: 
 93: 
 94:         if (_selectedStatuses.Count > 0)
 95:         {
 96:             var allowed = _selectedStatuses.Select(s => (int)s).ToHashSet();
 97:             q = q.Where(r => r.ApprovalStatusId.HasValue && allowed.Contains(r.ApprovalStatusId.Value));
 98:         }
 99: 
100:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search))
101:         {
102:             var s = _search.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
103:             q = q.Where(r =>
104:                 (r.FullName?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false) ||
105:                 (r.Id.ToString().ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s)) ||
106:                 (r.Email?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false) ||
107:                 (r.City?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false) ||
108:                 (r.Country?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false));
109:         }
110: 
111: 
112:         q = _sort switch
113:         {
114:             SortOption.NewestFirst => q.OrderByDescending(r => r.CreatedAt),
115:             SortOption.Name => q.OrderBy(r => r.FullName),
116:             SortOption.Status => q.OrderBy(r => r.ApprovalStatusId),
117:             _ => q.OrderBy(r => r.CreatedAt)
118:         };
119: 
120:         return q;
121:     }
122: 
123:     private async Task Approve(OrganizationListDto req)
124:     {
125:         if (!req.Id.HasValue) return;
126: 
127:         bool? ok = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
128:             "Confirm approval",
129:             $"Approve {req.FullName}?",
130:             yesText: "Approve", cancelText: "Cancel");
131: 
132:         if (ok == true)
133:         {
134:             var success = await AdminService.ApproveOrganizationAsync(req.Id.Value);
135:             if (success)
136:             {
137:                 await LoadOrganizationRequests();
138:             }
139:             else
140:             {
141:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to approve {req.FullName}";
142:             }
143:         }
144:     }
145: 
146:     private async Task Reject(OrganizationListDto req)
147:     {
148:         if (!req.Id.HasValue) return;
149: 
150:         bool? ok = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
151:             "Confirm rejection",
152:             $"Reject {req.FullName}?",
153:             yesText: "Reject", cancelText: "Cancel");
154: 
155:         if (ok == true)
156:         {
157:             var success = await AdminService.RejectOrganizationAsync(req.Id.Value);
158:             if (success)
159:             {
160:                 await LoadOrganizationRequests();
161:             }
162:             else
163:             {
164:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to reject {req.FullName}";
165:             }
166:         }
167:     }
168: 
169:     private async Task RevertToPending(OrganizationListDto req)
170:     {
171:         if (!req.Id.HasValue) return;
172:         var success = await AdminService.RevertToPendingAsync(req.Id.Value);
173:         if (success)
174:         {
175:             await LoadOrganizationRequests();
176:         }
177:         else
178:         {
179:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to revert {req.FullName} to pending";
180:         }
181:     }
182: 
183:     private void ViewDetails(OrganizationListDto req)
184:     {
185:         if (req.Id.HasValue)
186:         {
187:             Nav.NavigateTo($"/admin/organization/{req.Id.Value}");
188:         }
189:     }
190: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/Categories.razor.cs
````csharp

  4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  5: using MudBlazor;
  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Admin;
  8: 
  9: public partial class Categories
 10: {
 11:     [Inject] protected ICategoryService CategoryService { get; set; } = null!;
 12:     [Inject] protected IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
 13:     [Inject] protected NavigationManager Nav { get; set; } = null!;
 14: 
 15:     private ICollection<CategoryListDto> _categories = new List<CategoryListDto>();
 16:     private string _searchString = string.Empty;
 17:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 18:     private string? _errorMessage;
 19: 
 20:     private IEnumerable<CategoryListDto> FilteredCategories
 21:     {
 22:         get
 23:         {
 24:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
 25:             {
 26:                 return _categories;
 27:             }
 28: 
 29:             return _categories.Where(c =>
 30:                 (c.FullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
 31:                 (c.MasterCode?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
 32:                 (c.ParentFullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
 33:         }
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 37:     {
 38:         await LoadCategories();
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     private async Task LoadCategories()
 42:     {
 43:         _isLoading = true;
 44:         _errorMessage = null;
 45:         try
 46:         {
 47:             _categories = await CategoryService.GetCategoriesAsync() ?? new List<CategoryListDto>();
 48:         }
 49:         catch (Exception ex)
 50:         {
 51:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load categories: {ex.Message}";
 52:         }
 53:         finally
 54:         {
 55:             _isLoading = false;
 56:         }
 57:     }
 58: 
 59:     private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
 60:     {
 61:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 62:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateCategoryDialog>("Create Category", options);
 63:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 64: 
 65:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: CreateCategoryDto createDto })
 66:         {
 67:             var response = await CategoryService.CreateCategoryAsync(createDto);
 68:             if (response?.Success == true)
 69:             {
 70:                 await LoadCategories();
 71:             }
 72:             else
 73:             {
 74:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to create category: {response?.Message ?? "Unknown error"}";
 75:             }
 76:         }
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     private async Task OpenEditDialog(CategoryListDto category)
 80:     {
 81:         var parameters = new DialogParameters<EditCategoryDialog>
 82:         {
 83:             { x => x.ExistingCategory, category }
 84:         };
 85: 
 86:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 87:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditCategoryDialog>("Edit Category", parameters, options);
 88:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 89: 
 90:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: UpdateCategoryDto updateDto } && updateDto.Id.HasValue)
 91:         {
 92:             var response = await CategoryService.UpdateCategoryAsync(updateDto.Id.Value, updateDto);
 93:             if (response?.Success == true)
 94:             {
 95:                 await LoadCategories();
 96:             }
 97:             else
 98:             {
 99:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to update category: {response?.Message ?? "Unknown error"}";
100:             }
101:         }
102:     }
103: 
104:     private async Task DeleteCategory(CategoryListDto category)
105:     {
106:         if (!category.Id.HasValue) return;
107: 
108:         bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
109:             "Confirm Delete",
110:             $"Are you sure you want to delete the category '{category.FullName}'? This action cannot be undone.",
111:             yesText: "Delete",
112:             cancelText: "Cancel");
113: 
114:         if (confirm == true)
115:         {
116:             var success = await CategoryService.DeleteCategoryAsync(category.Id.Value);
117:             if (success)
118:             {
119:                 await LoadCategories();
120:             }
121:             else
122:             {
123:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to delete category '{category.FullName}'";
124:             }
125:         }
126:     }
127: }
````

````css
  7:
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/Madhabs.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/admin/madhabs"
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  5: @attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
  6: 
  7: <div class="admin-madhabs">
  8:     <!-- Hero Section -->
  9:     <MudPaper Class="admin-madhabs__hero" Elevation="0">
 10:         <div class="admin-madhabs__hero-top">
 11:             <div class="admin-madhabs__hero-title">
 12:                 <div class="admin-madhabs__hero-badge">
 13:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MenuBook" Color="Color.Tertiary" />
 14:                 </div>
 15:                 <div>
 16:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="admin-madhabs__title-text">
 17:                         Madhabs
 18:                     </MudText>
 19:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-madhabs__hero-subtitle">
 20:                         Islamic jurisprudence schools (read-only lookup table)
 21:                     </MudText>
 22:                 </div>
 23:             </div>
 24: 
 25:             <MudStack Row Spacing="1" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center">
 26:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 27:                            Color="Color.Default"
 28:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack"
 29:                            OnClick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/admin"))"
 30:                            Class="admin-madhabs__action-btn">
 31:                     Back to Admin
 32:                 </MudButton>
 33:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 34:                            Color="Color.Tertiary"
 35:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh"
 36:                            OnClick="LoadData"
 37:                            Class="admin-madhabs__action-btn">
 38:                     Refresh
 39:                 </MudButton>
 40:             </MudStack>
 41:         </div>
 42: 
 43:         <!-- Stats -->
 44:         <div class="admin-madhabs__stats">
 45:             <div class="admin-madhabs__stat">
 46:                 <div class="admin-madhabs__stat-row">
 47:                     <div class="admin-madhabs__stat-icon">
 48:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MenuBook" Color="Color.Tertiary" />
 49:                     </div>
 50:                     <div>
 51:                         <div class="admin-madhabs__stat-label">Total Madhabs</div>
 52:                         <div class="admin-madhabs__stat-value">@_items.Count</div>
 53:                     </div>
 54:                 </div>
 55:             </div>
 56:         </div>
 57:     </MudPaper>
 58: 
 59:     @if (_isLoading)
 60:     {
 61:         <MudPaper Class="admin-madhabs__panel" Elevation="0">
 62:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2" Class="py-4">
 63:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Tertiary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 64:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">Loading madhabs…</MudText>
 65:             </MudStack>
 66:         </MudPaper>
 67:     }
 68:     else
 69:     {
 70:         <div class="admin-madhabs__section">
 71:             <!-- Info Banner -->
 72:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="admin-madhabs__alert mb-3">
 73:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 74:                     <strong>Read-only lookup table.</strong> Madhabs are system-defined values used throughout the application.
 75:                     Contact system administrator if changes are needed.
 76:                 </MudText>
 77:             </MudAlert>
 78: 
 79:             <!-- Table -->
 80:             <MudPaper Class="admin-madhabs__table-panel" Elevation="0">
 81:                 <MudTable Items="@_items"
 82:                           Dense="true"
 83:                           Hover="true"
 84:                           Striped="true"
 85:                           Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm"
 86:                           Loading="@_isLoading"
 87:                           LoadingProgressColor="Color.Tertiary">
 88:                     <HeaderContent>
 89:                         <MudTh Class="admin-madhabs__col-id">ID</MudTh>
 90:                         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
 91:                         <MudTh>Master Code</MudTh>
 92:                         <MudTh>Description</MudTh>
 93:                     </HeaderContent>
 94:                     <RowTemplate>
 95:                         <MudTd DataLabel="ID">
 96:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Default">
 97:                                 @context.Id
 98:                             </MudChip>
 99:                         </MudTd>
100:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">
101:                             <div class="admin-madhabs__name-cell">
102:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MenuBook" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Tertiary" />
103:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-madhabs__name-text">@context.FullName</MudText>
104:                             </div>
105:                         </MudTd>
106:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Code">
107:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Default">
108:                                 @context.MasterCode
109:                             </MudChip>
110:                         </MudTd>
111:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Description">
112:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-madhabs__muted">
113:                                 @(context.Description ?? "—")
114:                             </MudText>
115:                         </MudTd>
116:                     </RowTemplate>
117:                     <NoRecordsContent>
118:                         <div class="admin-madhabs__empty">
119:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MenuBook" Size="Size.Large" />
120:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="admin-madhabs__empty-title">No madhabs found</MudText>
121:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-madhabs__muted">
122:                                 The lookup table is empty.
123:                             </MudText>
124:                         </div>
125:                     </NoRecordsContent>
126:                 </MudTable>
127:             </MudPaper>
128:         </div>
129:     }
130: </div>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/Tags.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/admin/tags"
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Admin
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  6: @attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
  7: 
  8: <div class="admin-tags">
  9:     <!-- Hero Section -->
 10:     <MudPaper Class="admin-tags__hero" Elevation="0">
 11:         <div class="admin-tags__hero-top">
 12:             <div class="admin-tags__hero-title">
 13:                 <div class="admin-tags__hero-badge">
 14:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocalOffer" Color="Color.Primary" />
 15:                 </div>
 16:                 <div>
 17:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="admin-tags__title-text">
 18:                         Tags Management
 19:                     </MudText>
 20:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-tags__hero-subtitle">
 21:                         Create, edit, and manage event tags
 22:                     </MudText>
 23:                 </div>
 24:             </div>
 25: 
 26:             <MudStack Row Spacing="1" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center">
 27:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 28:                            Color="Color.Default"
 29:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack"
 30:                            OnClick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/admin"))"
 31:                            Class="admin-tags__action-btn">
 32:                     Back to Admin
 33:                 </MudButton>
 34:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 35:                            Color="Color.Primary"
 36:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh"
 37:                            OnClick="LoadTags"
 38:                            Class="admin-tags__action-btn">
 39:                     Refresh
 40:                 </MudButton>
 41:             </MudStack>
 42:         </div>
 43: 
 44:         <!-- Stats -->
 45:         <div class="admin-tags__stats">
 46:             <div class="admin-tags__stat">
 47:                 <div class="admin-tags__stat-row">
 48:                     <div class="admin-tags__stat-icon">
 49:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocalOffer" Color="Color.Primary" />
 50:                     </div>
 51:                     <div>
 52:                         <div class="admin-tags__stat-label">Total Tags</div>
 53:                         <div class="admin-tags__stat-value">@_tags.Count</div>
 54:                     </div>
 55:                 </div>
 56:             </div>
 57:         </div>
 58:     </MudPaper>
 59: 
 60:     @if (_isLoading)
 61:     {
 62:         <MudPaper Class="admin-tags__panel" Elevation="0">
 63:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2" Class="py-4">
 64:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 65:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">Loading tags…</MudText>
 66:             </MudStack>
 67:         </MudPaper>
 68:     }
 69:     else
 70:     {
 71:         <div class="admin-tags__section">
 72:             <!-- Toolbar -->
 73:             <MudPaper Class="admin-tags__panel" Elevation="0">
 74:                 <div class="admin-tags__toolbar">
 75:                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
 76:                                   Placeholder="Search tags..."
 77:                                   Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 78:                                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 79:                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 80:                                   Immediate="true"
 81:                                   Clearable="true"
 82:                                   Margin="Margin.Dense"
 83:                                   Class="admin-tags__search-field" />
 84: 
 85:                     <MudSpacer />
 86: 
 87:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 88:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 89:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
 90:                                OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
 91:                                Class="admin-tags__create-btn">
 92:                         Create Tag
 93:                     </MudButton>
 94:                 </div>
 95:             </MudPaper>
 96: 
 97:             <!-- Table -->
 98:             <MudPaper Class="admin-tags__table-panel" Elevation="0">
 99:                 <MudTable Items="@FilteredTags"
100:                           Dense="true"
101:                           Hover="true"
102:                           Striped="true"
103:                           Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm"
104:                           Loading="@_isLoading"
105:                           LoadingProgressColor="Color.Primary">
106:                     <HeaderContent>
107:                         <MudTh Class="admin-tags__col-id">#</MudTh>
108:                         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
109:                         <MudTh>Master Code</MudTh>
110:                         <MudTh Class="admin-tags__col-actions">Actions</MudTh>
111:                     </HeaderContent>
112:                     <RowTemplate>
113:                         <MudTd DataLabel="#">
114:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-tags__id">@context.Id.ToString()[..8]…</MudText>
115:                         </MudTd>
116:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">
117:                             <div class="admin-tags__name-cell">
118:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocalOffer" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Primary" />
119:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-tags__name-text">@context.FullName</MudText>
120:                             </div>
121:                         </MudTd>
122:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Code">
123:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Default">
124:                                 @context.MasterCode
125:                             </MudChip>
126:                         </MudTd>
127:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Class="admin-tags__cell-actions">
128:                             <div class="admin-tags__actions">
129:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Edit">
130:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
131:                                                    Color="Color.Primary"
132:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
133:                                                    OnClick="@(() => OpenEditDialog(context))" />
134:                                 </MudTooltip>
135:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Delete">
136:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
137:                                                    Color="Color.Error"
138:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
139:                                                    OnClick="@(() => DeleteTag(context))" />
140:                                 </MudTooltip>
141:                             </div>
142:                         </MudTd>
143:                     </RowTemplate>
144:                     <NoRecordsContent>
145:                         <div class="admin-tags__empty">
146:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocalOffer" Size="Size.Large" />
147:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="admin-tags__empty-title">No tags found</MudText>
148:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-tags__muted">
149:                                 @if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
150:                                 {
151:                                     <span>Create your first tag to get started.</span>
152:                                 }
153:                                 else
154:                                 {
155:                                     <span>No tags match your search criteria.</span>
156:                                 }
157:                             </MudText>
158:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
159:                                        Color="Color.Primary"
160:                                        OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
161:                                        Class="admin-tags__empty-btn">
162:                                 Create Tag
163:                             </MudButton>
164:                         </div>
165:                     </NoRecordsContent>
166:                     <PagerContent>
167:                         <MudTablePager PageSizeOptions="new int[] { 10, 25, 50, 100 }" />
168:                     </PagerContent>
169:                 </MudTable>
170:             </MudPaper>
171:         </div>
172:     }
173: </div>
````

````razor
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Landing
 3: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
 4: @inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
 5: @inject ILogger<Home> Logger
 6: 
 7: <PageTitle>ISLAMU Explore</PageTitle>
 8: 
 9: @if (isLoading)
10: {
11:     <div class="home-page__loading">
12:         <div class="home-page__loading-content">
13:             <div class="home-page__loading-title">Loading...</div>
14:             <div class="home-page__loading-text">Please wait while we check your authentication status</div>
````

````csharp
 8: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Landing;
 9: 
10: public partial class LandingPageForNonUsers
11: {
12:     [Inject] protected IJSRuntime JS { get; set; } = null!;
13:     [Inject] protected ILandingPageService LandingPageService { get; set; } = null!;
14:     [Inject] protected ILogger<LandingPageForNonUsers> Logger { get; set; } = null!;
15: 
16:     private ICollection<EventListDto> _events = new List<EventListDto>();
17:     private int _membersCount = 1200;
18:     private int _eventsCount = 0;
19:     private bool _isLoading = true;
20:     private string? _errorMessage;
21: 
22:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
23:     {
24:         await LoadDataAsync();
25:     }
26: 
27:     private async Task LoadDataAsync()
28:     {
29:         _isLoading = true;
30:         _errorMessage = null;
31: 
32:         try
33:         {
34:             Logger.LogDebug("Loading landing page data from API");
35: 
36: 
37:             var eventsTask = LandingPageService.GetFeaturedEventsAsync(12);
38:             var membersTask = LandingPageService.GetTotalMembersCountAsync();
39:             var eventsCountTask = LandingPageService.GetUpcomingEventsCountAsync();
40: 
41:             await Task.WhenAll(eventsTask, membersTask, eventsCountTask);
42: 
43:             _events = await eventsTask;
44:             _membersCount = await membersTask;
45:             _eventsCount = await eventsCountTask;
46: 
47:             Logger.LogDebug("Loaded {EventCount} events, {MembersCount} members, {UpcomingCount} upcoming events", _events.Count, _membersCount, _eventsCount);
48:         }
49:         catch (Exception ex)
50:         {
51:             _errorMessage = $"Error loading landing page data: {ex.Message}";
52:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading landing page data");
53: 
54:         }
55:         finally
56:         {
57:             _isLoading = false;
58:         }
59:     }
60: 
61:     private static string TruncateText(string text, int maxLength)
62:     {
63:         return StringHelper.TruncateText(text, maxLength);
64:     }
65: 
66:     private IEnumerable<List<T>> Chunk<T>(IEnumerable<T> source, int size)
67:     {
68:         var bucket = new List<T>(size);
69:         foreach (var item in source)
70:         {
71:             bucket.Add(item);
72:             if (bucket.Count == size)
73:             {
74:                 yield return bucket;
75:                 bucket = new List<T>(size);
76:             }
77:         }
78:         if (bucket.Count > 0) yield return bucket;
79:     }
80: 
81:     private async Task ScrollToRegister()
82:         => await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("eval", "document.getElementById('register').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});");
83: }
````

````csharp
  4: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;

 10: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Organization;
 11: 
 12: public partial class CreateOrganization
 13: {
 14:     [Inject] protected NavigationManager NavigationManager { get; set; } = null!;
 15:     [Inject] protected IOrganizationService OrganizationService { get; set; } = null!;
 16:     [Inject] protected IImageStorageService ImageStorageService { get; set; } = null!;
 17:     [Inject] protected ILogger<CreateOrganization> Logger { get; set; } = null!;
 18: 
 19:     private CreateOrganizationDto organization = new();
 20:     private bool acceptTerms = false;
 21:     private bool confirmInformation = false;
 22:     private bool isSubmitting = false;
 23:     private string logoPreview = string.Empty;
 24: 
 25:     private ImageUpload? _imageUpload;
 26:     private FileUploadData? _selectedLogoData;
 27:     private bool _isUploadingLogo = false;
 28:     private Guid? _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = null;
 29:     private string? _logoUploadError;
 30:     private OrganizationAppearanceSettings _appearance = new();
 31: 
 32:     private bool submitSuccess = false;
 33:     private string errorMessage = string.Empty;
 34: 
 35:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 36:     {
 37:         organization = new CreateOrganizationDto();
 38:         await base.OnInitializedAsync();
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     private async Task HandleSubmit()
 42:     {
 43:         if (!CanSubmit()) return;
 44: 
 45:         isSubmitting = true;
 46:         errorMessage = string.Empty;
 47: 
 48:         try
 49:         {
 50:             organization.MetadataJson = OrganizationAppearanceMetadataHelper.Upsert(organization.MetadataJson, _appearance);
 51:             var createdOrganization = await OrganizationService.CreateOrganizationAsync(organization);
 52: 
 53:             if (createdOrganization != null)
 54:             {
 55:                 submitSuccess = true;
 56:                 Logger.LogInformation("Organization successfully created with ID: {OrganizationId}", createdOrganization.Id);
 57:                 await Task.Delay(1000);
 58:                 NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/organization/success");
 59:             }
 60:             else
 61:             {
 62:                 errorMessage = "An error occurred while creating the organization. Please try again.";
 63:             }
 64:         }
 65:         catch (Exception ex)
 66:         {
 67:             errorMessage = $"Error creating organization: {ex.Message}";
 68:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Exception during organization creation");
 69:         }
 70:         finally
 71:         {
 72:             isSubmitting = false;
 73:             StateHasChanged();
 74:         }
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     private async Task OnLogoFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
 78:     {
 79:         _selectedLogoData = fileData;
 80:         _logoUploadError = null;
 81: 
 82:         if (fileData == null)
 83:         {
 84:             _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = null;
 85:             organization.ProfilePictureId = null;
 86:             return;
 87:         }
 88: 
 89:         _isUploadingLogo = true;
 90:         await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
 91: 
 92:         try
 93:         {
 94:             var uploadResult = await ImageStorageService.UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync(fileData);
 95: 
 96:             if (uploadResult?.Success == true)
 97:             {
 98:                 _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
 99:                 organization.ProfilePictureId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
100:                 _logoUploadError = null;
101:             }
102:             else
103:             {
104:                 _logoUploadError = uploadResult?.ErrorMessage ?? "Failed to upload logo.";
105:                 await ClearLogoUploadState();
106:             }
107:         }
108:         catch (Exception ex)
109:         {
110:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Exception during logo upload");
111:             _logoUploadError = $"Upload error: {ex.Message}";
112:             await ClearLogoUploadState();
113:         }
114:         finally
115:         {
116:             _isUploadingLogo = false;
117:             await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
118:         }
119:     }
120: 
121:     private async Task ClearLogoUploadState()
122:     {
123:         try
124:         {
125:             if (_imageUpload != null)
126:             {
127:                 await _imageUpload.RemoveImage();
128:             }
129:         }
130:         catch { }
131: 
132:         _selectedLogoData = null;
133:         _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = null;
134:         organization.ProfilePictureId = null;
135:     }
136: 
137:     private void OnLogoPreviewUrlChanged(string? value)
138:     {
139:         logoPreview = value ?? string.Empty;
140:     }
141: 
142:     private bool CanSubmit()
143:     {
144:         return acceptTerms &&
145:                confirmInformation &&
146:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.FullName) &&
147:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.Email) &&
148:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.Address) &&
149:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.City) &&
150:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.Country) &&
151:                organization.Postcode > 0 &&
152:                !_isUploadingLogo;
153:     }
154: }
````

````razor
  5: @using Blazouter.Services
  6: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  7: @inject IOrganizationService OrganizationService
  8: @inject IOrganizationReviewService OrganizationReviewService
  9: @inject NavigationManager Navigation
 10: @inject RouterStateService RouterState
 11: @inject ILogger<OrganizationReviews> Logger
 12: 
 13: <PageTitle>Organization Reviews</PageTitle>
 14: <MudContainer Class="organization-reviews">
 15:     <MudButton StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack" OnClick="GoBack" Class="mb-4">Back to Profile</MudButton>
 16: 
 17:     @if (_isLoading)
 18:     {
 19:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" />
 20:     }
 21:     else if (_organization == null)
 22:     {
 23:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">Organization not found.</MudAlert>
 24:     }
 25:     else
 26:     {
 27:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="mb-2">Reviews for @_organization.FullName</MudText>
 28:         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Class="mb-6" Color="Color.Secondary">
 29:             @_reviews.Count reviews • @(_reviews.Any() && _reviews.Any(r => r.Rating.HasValue) ? _reviews.Where(r => r.Rating.HasValue).Average(r => r.Rating!.Value).ToString("0.0") : "0.0")★ average rating
 30:         </MudText>
 31: 
 32:         <MudGrid>
 33:             @if (_reviews.Any())
 34:             {
 35:                 @foreach (var review in _reviews)
 36:                 {
 37:                     <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
 38:                         <MudPaper Class="pa-4 organization-reviews__card" Elevation="0">
 39:                             <MudStack Spacing="2">
 40:                                 <MudStack Row AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2">
 41:                                     <MudAvatar Size="Size.Medium" Color="Color.Primary">
 42:                                         <MudText>@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(review.UserFullName) ? "?" : review.UserFullName.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper())</MudText>
 43:                                     </MudAvatar>
 44:                                     <MudStack Spacing="0">
 45:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2">@review.UserFullName</MudText>
 46:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@(review.CreatedAt?.DateTime.ToShortDateString() ?? "Unknown")</MudText>
 47:                                     </MudStack>
 48:                                 </MudStack>
 49: 
 50:                                 <MudStack Row AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2">
 51:                                     <div class="organization-reviews__rating">
 52:                                         @for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
 53:                                         {
 54:                                             if (i <= review.Rating)
 55:                                             {
 56:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Star" />
 57:                                             }
 58:                                             else
 59:                                             {
 60:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.StarBorder" />
 61:                                             }
 62:                                         }
 63:                                     </div>
 64:                                 </MudStack>
 65: 
 66:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 67:                                     @review.Comment
 68:                                 </MudText>
 69:                             </MudStack>
 70:                         </MudPaper>
 71:                     </MudItem>
 72:                 }
 73:             }
 74:             else
 75:             {
 76:                 <MudItem xs="12">
 77:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary">No reviews yet.</MudText>
 78:                 </MudItem>
 79:             }
 80:         </MudGrid>
 81:     }
 82: </MudContainer>
 83: 
 84: @code {
 85:     private Guid Id { get; set; }
 86: 
 87:     private OrganizationDto? _organization;
 88:     private List<OrganizationReviewDto> _reviews = new();
 89:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 90: 
 91:     // Client-only load state (no prerender persistence)
 92:     private string? _errorMessage;
 93: 
 94:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 95:     {
 96:         // Get route parameter from Blazouter
 97:         var idStr = RouterState.GetParam("id");
 98:         if (Guid.TryParse(idStr, out var id))
 99:         {
100:             Id = id;
101:         }
102: 
103:         _isLoading = true;
104:         _errorMessage = null;
105: 
106:         try
107:         {
108:             // Load organization and its reviews from API (client-side)
109:             _organization = await OrganizationService.GetOrganizationByIdAsync(Id);
110:             _reviews = (await OrganizationReviewService.GetReviewsByOrganizationId(Id)).ToList();
111:             Logger.LogDebug("Loaded organization {OrganizationId} with {ReviewCount} reviews", Id, _reviews.Count);
112:         }
113:         catch (Exception ex)
114:         {
115:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load reviews: {ex.Message}";
116:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load organization reviews for {OrganizationId}", Id);
117:         }
118:         finally
119:         {
120:             _isLoading = false;
121:         }
122:     }
123: 
124:     // PersistData removed: no PersistentComponentState usage in client-only rendering mode.
125: 
126:     // Dispose removed: no persistence subscription to dispose.
127: 
128:     private void GoBack()
129:     {
130:         Navigation.NavigateTo($"/organization/profile/{Id}");
131:     }
132: }
````

````csharp
  1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;

  4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;

  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.User;
  8: 
  9: public partial class MyRegistrations
 10: {
 11:     [Inject] protected IEventService EventService { get; set; } = null!;
 12:     [Inject] protected IUserService UserService { get; set; } = null!;
 13:     [Inject] protected ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = null!;
 14:     [Inject] protected IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
 15:     [Inject] protected NavigationManager Navigation { get; set; } = null!;
 16: 
 17:     private List<MyRegistrationViewModel> _registrations = new();
 18:     private bool _loading = true;
 19:     private string _searchString = "";
 20: 
 21:     private IEnumerable<MyRegistrationViewModel> FilteredRegistrations =>
 22:         string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString)
 23:             ? _registrations
 24:             : _registrations.Where(r => r.EventTitle?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true);
 25: 
 26:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 27:     {
 28:         await LoadRegistrations();
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     private async Task LoadRegistrations()
 32:     {
 33:         _loading = true;
 34:         try
 35:         {
 36:             var user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
 37:             if (user != null && user.Id.HasValue)
 38:             {
 39:                 var registrations = await EventService.GetRegistrationsByUserAsync(user.Id.Value);
 40: 
 41:                 var tasks = registrations.Select(async r =>
 42:                 {
 43:                     var vm = new MyRegistrationViewModel
 44:                     {
 45:                         RegistrationId = r.Id ?? Guid.Empty,
 46:                         EventSessionId = r.EventSessionId ?? Guid.Empty,
 47:                         Status = r.ApprovalStatusFullName,
 48:                         StatusId = r.ApprovalStatusId
 49:                     };
 50: 
 51:                     if (r.EventSessionId.HasValue)
 52:                     {
 53:                         var session = await EventService.GetSessionByIdAsync(r.EventSessionId.Value);
 54:                         if (session != null)
 55:                         {
 56:                             vm.EventId = session.EventId ?? Guid.Empty;
 57:                             vm.EventTitle = session.EventTitle;
 58:                             vm.StartTime = session.StartTime;
 59: 
 60:                             if (session.EventId.HasValue)
 61:                             {
 62:                                 var evt = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(session.EventId.Value);
 63:                                 if (evt != null)
 64:                                 {
 65:                                     vm.FeaturedImageUri = evt.FeaturedImageUri;
 66:                                     vm.EventTitle = evt.Title;
 67:                                 }
 68:                             }
 69:                         }
 70:                     }
 71: 
 72:                     return vm;
 73:                 });
 74: 
 75:                 _registrations = (await Task.WhenAll(tasks)).ToList();
 76:             }
 77:         }
 78:         catch (Exception ex)
 79:         {
 80:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading registrations: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
 81:         }
 82:         finally
 83:         {
 84:             _loading = false;
 85:         }
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     private async Task CancelRegistration(Guid registrationId)
 89:     {
 90:         var result = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
 91:             "Cancel Registration",
 92:             "Are you sure you want to cancel your registration for this event?",
 93:             yesText: "Yes, Cancel", cancelText: "No");
 94: 
 95:         if (result == true)
 96:         {
 97:             try
 98:             {
 99:                 var success = await EventService.CancelEventRegistrationAsync(registrationId);
100:                 if (success)
101:                 {
102:                     Snackbar.Add("Registration cancelled successfully.", Severity.Success);
103:                     await LoadRegistrations();
104:                 }
105:                 else
106:                 {
107:                     Snackbar.Add("Failed to cancel registration.", Severity.Error);
108:                 }
109:             }
110:             catch (Exception ex)
111:             {
112:                 Snackbar.Add($"Error cancelling registration: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
113:             }
114:         }
115:     }
116: 
117:     public class MyRegistrationViewModel
118:     {
119:         public Guid RegistrationId { get; set; }
120:         public Guid EventId { get; set; }
121:         public Guid EventSessionId { get; set; }
122:         public string? EventTitle { get; set; }
123:         public string? FeaturedImageUri { get; set; }
124:         public DateTimeOffset? StartTime { get; set; }
125:         public string? Status { get; set; }
126:         public int? StatusId { get; set; }
127:     }
128: }
````

````csharp
  1: using Explore.Secrets.Extensions;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
  3: 
  4: namespace Explore.Blazor.Extensions;
  5: 
  6: public static class ConfigurationExtensions
  7: {
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11:

 22: 
 23: 
 24:     public static void AddInfisicalBlazorCompatibility(this IConfigurationBuilder configBuilder)
 25:     {
 26: 
 27:         var bootstrapConfig = configBuilder.Build();
 28: 
 29: 
 30: 
 31:         Console.WriteLine("[Blazor Infisical] Checking bootstrap credentials...");
 32:         Console.WriteLine($"[Blazor Infisical] ProjectId: {(string.IsNullOrEmpty(bootstrapConfig["Infisical:ProjectId"]) ? "(not set)" : "(set)")}");
 33:         Console.WriteLine($"[Blazor Infisical] ClientId: {(string.IsNullOrEmpty(bootstrapConfig["Infisical:ClientId"]) ? "(not set)" : "(set)")}");
 34:         Console.WriteLine($"[Blazor Infisical] HasClientSecret: {!string.IsNullOrEmpty(bootstrapConfig["Infisical:ClientSecret"])}");
 35: 
 36:         // Add Infisical as configuration source (loads secrets from Infisical service)
 37:         configBuilder.AddInfisical(bootstrapConfig, source =>
 38:         {
 39:             // Configure paths to load from Infisical
 40:             source.Paths.Clear();
 41:             source.Paths.AddRange(["/keycloak", "/blazor", "/api"]);
 42: 
 43: 
 44:             source.ThrowOnFirstLoadFailure = false;
 45:         });
 46: 
 47: 
 48:         var configWithSecrets = configBuilder.Build();
 49: 
 50: 
 51:         ApplyBlazorCompatibilityMapping(configBuilder, configWithSecrets);
 52:     }
 53: 
 54: 
 55: 
 56: 
 57:     private static void ApplyBlazorCompatibilityMapping(IConfigurationBuilder configBuilder, IConfiguration config)
 58:     {
 59: 
 60:         var rawRealm = config["Keycloak:Realm"] ?? config["KEYCLOAK_REALM"] ?? "islamu-dev";
 61:         var rawClientSecret = config["EXPLORE_BLAZOR_SERVER_CLIENT_SECRET_COOLIFY"]
 62:             ?? config["EXPLORE_BLAZOR_SERVER_CLIENT_SECRET"]
 63:             ?? config["KEYCLOAK_BLAZOR_CLIENT_SECRET"]
 64:             ?? config["Keycloak:ClientSecret"];
 65:         var rawApiUrl = config["EXPLORE_API_BASE_URL"] ?? config["ExploreApi:BaseUrl"];
 66:         var baseUrl = config["KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL"]
 67:             ?? config["KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL"]
 68:             ?? config["Keycloak:BaseUrl"]
 69:             ?? "https://keycloak.openislamu.org";
 70:         var explicitAuthority = config["Keycloak:Authority"];
 71: 
 72: 
 73:         var keycloakAuthority = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(explicitAuthority)
 74:             ? explicitAuthority
 75:             : $"{baseUrl.TrimEnd('/')}/realms/{rawRealm}";
 76:         var metadataAddress = $"{keycloakAuthority}/.well-known/openid-configuration";
 77: 
 78: 
 79: 
 80:         Console.WriteLine("[Blazor Infisical] Keycloak configuration mapped:");
 81:         Console.WriteLine($"  Authority: {keycloakAuthority}");
 82:         Console.WriteLine($"  HasClientSecret: {!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rawClientSecret)}");
 83:         Console.WriteLine($"  API BaseUrl: {rawApiUrl ?? "(not set, will use default)"}");
 84: 
 85:         var mappedConfig = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
 86: 
 87:         static void TrySet(IDictionary<string, string?> dict, IConfiguration root, string key, string? value)
 88:         {
 89:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(root[key]))
 90:             {
 91:                 return;
 92:             }
 93: 
 94:             dict[key] = value;
 95:         }
 96: 
 97: 
 98:         TrySet(mappedConfig, config, "Keycloak:Realm", rawRealm);
 99:         TrySet(mappedConfig, config, "Keycloak:Authority", keycloakAuthority);
100:         TrySet(mappedConfig, config, "Keycloak:MetadataAddress", metadataAddress);
101:         TrySet(mappedConfig, config, "Keycloak:ClientId", config["Keycloak:ClientId"] ?? "explore-blazor-server");
102:         TrySet(mappedConfig, config, "Keycloak:RequireHttpsMetadata", "true");
103: 
104: 
105: 
106:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawClientSecret))
107:         {
108:             mappedConfig["Keycloak:ClientSecret"] = rawClientSecret;
109:             Console.WriteLine("[Blazor Infisical] Setting Keycloak:ClientSecret from Infisical (overriding existing)");
110:         }
111: 
112: 
113:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rawApiUrl))
114:         {
115:             TrySet(mappedConfig, config, "ExploreApi:BaseUrl", rawApiUrl);
116:         }
117: 
118: 
119:         configBuilder.AddInMemoryCollection(
120:             mappedConfig.Where(kv => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(kv.Value))
121:                         .ToDictionary(kv => kv.Key, kv => kv.Value)!
122:         );
123:     }
124: }
````

````razor
 11:                     Checking registration status...

 17:             <div class="registration-shell">
 18:                 <div class="success-content">
 19:                     <div class="success-icon">
 20:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.EventAvailable" Style="color: var(--mud-palette-success);" />
 21:                     </div>
 22:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="success-title">
 23:                         You're Already Registered! ✅
 24:                     </MudText>

 26:                         You have already registered for this event.<br />
 27:                         We look forward to seeing you there!
 28:                     </MudText>
 29:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 30:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 31:                                Size="Size.Large"
 32:                                OnClick="Close"
 33:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Close">
 34:                         Close
 35:                     </MudButton>
 36:                 </div>
 37:             </div>
 38:         }
 39:         else if (!isRegistered)
 40:         {
 41:             <div class="registration-shell">
 42:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mb-2">@Title</MudText>
 43:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mb-6 mud-text-secondary">
 44:                     Click confirm to register for this event
 45:                 </MudText>
 46: 
 47:                 @if (currentUser != null)
 48:                 {
 49:                     <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Class="mb-4">
 50:                         You will be registered as: <strong>@currentUser.FirstName @currentUser.LastName</strong> (@currentUser.Email)
 51:                     </MudAlert>
 52:                 }
 53: 
 54:                 <div class="action-buttons">
 55:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
 56:                                Color="Color.Default"
 57:                                OnClick="Cancel"
 58:                                Disabled="isSubmitting">
 59:                         Cancel
 60:                     </MudButton>
 61:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 62:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 63:                                OnClick="HandleSubmit"
 64:                                Disabled="isSubmitting || currentUser == null"
 65:                                StartIcon="@(isSubmitting ? null : Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle)">
 66:                         @if (isSubmitting)
 67:                         {
 68:                             <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Class="mr-2" />
 69:                             <span>Registering...</span>
 70:                         }
 71:                         else
 72:                         {
 73:                             <span>Confirm Registration</span>
 74:                         }
 75:                     </MudButton>
 76:                 </div>
 77:             </div>
 78:         }
 79:         else
 80:         {
 81:             <div class="registration-shell">
 82:                 <div class="success-content">
 83:                     <div class="success-icon">
 84:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle" />
 85:                     </div>
 86:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="success-title">
 87:                         Registration Successful! 🎉
 88:                     </MudText>
 89:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="success-message">
 90:                         Thank you for registering@(currentUser != null ? $", {currentUser.FirstName}" : "")! <br />
 91:                         You will receive a confirmation email shortly.
 92:                     </MudText>
 93:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 94:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 95:                                Size="Size.Large"
 96:                                OnClick="Close"
 97:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Close">
 98:                         Close
 99:                     </MudButton>
100:                 </div>
101:             </div>
102:         }
103:     </DialogContent>
104: </MudDialog>
105: 
106: @code {
107:     [CascadingParameter]
108:     private MudBlazor.IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
109: 
110:     [Parameter]
111:     public Guid EventSessionId { get; set; }
112: 
113:     [Parameter]
114:     public string Title { get; set; } = "Register for Event";
115: 
116:     private CreateEventRegistrationDto registrationModel = new();
117:     private UserDto? currentUser;
118:     private bool isSubmitting = false;
119:     private bool isRegistered = false;
120:     private bool isAlreadyRegistered = false;
121:     private bool isLoading = true;
122: 
123:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
124:     {
125:         try
126:         {
127:             // Get current user
128:             currentUser = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
129: 
130:             if (currentUser != null)
131:             {
132:                 registrationModel.EventSessionId = EventSessionId;
133:                 registrationModel.UserId = currentUser.Id;
134:             }
135:         }
136:         catch (Exception ex)
137:         {
138:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading user data: {ex.Message}", Severity.Warning);
139:         }
140:         finally
141:         {
142:             isLoading = false;
143:         }
144:     }
145: 
146:     private async Task HandleSubmit()
147:     {
148:         if (currentUser == null)
149:         {
150:             Snackbar.Add("You must be logged in to register.", Severity.Error);
151:             return;
152:         }
153: 
154:         if (EventSessionId == Guid.Empty)
155:         {
156:             Snackbar.Add("Registration is unavailable for this session.", Severity.Error);
157:             return;
158:         }
159: 
160:         isSubmitting = true;
161: 
162:         try
163:         {
164:             var response = await EventService.RegisterForEventSessionAsync(registrationModel);
165: 
166:             if (response?.Success == true)
167:             {
168:                 isRegistered = true;
169:                 Snackbar.Add("You have been successfully registered!", Severity.Success);
170:             }
171:             else
172:             {
173:                 Snackbar.Add(response?.Message ?? "Something went wrong. Please try again later.", Severity.Error);
174:             }
175:         }
176:         catch (Exception ex)
177:         {
178:             Snackbar.Add($"Registration error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
179:         }
180:         finally
181:         {
182:             isSubmitting = false;
183:         }
184:     }
185: 
186:     private void Cancel()
187:     {
188:         DialogReference?.Close();
189:     }
190: 
191:     private void Close()
192:     {
193:         DialogReference?.Close();
194:     }
195: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Explore.Blazor.Client.csproj
````
  1: <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.BlazorWebAssembly">
  2: 
  3:   <PropertyGroup>
  4:     <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
  5:     <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  6:     <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
  7:     <NoDefaultLaunchSettingsFile>true</NoDefaultLaunchSettingsFile>
  8:     <StaticWebAssetProjectMode>Default</StaticWebAssetProjectMode>
  9:     <!-- Strip .NET IL after AOT compilation for smaller WASM bundles (20-50% reduction) -->
 10:     <WasmStripILAfterAOT>true</WasmStripILAfterAOT>
 11:   </PropertyGroup>
 12: 
 13:   <ItemGroup>
 14:     <PackageReference Include="Blazored.FluentValidation" />
 15:     <PackageReference Include="Blazouter" />
 16:     <PackageReference Include="Blazouter.WebAssembly" />
 17:     <PackageReference Include="FluentValidation" />
 18:     <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly" />
 19:     <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Authentication" />
 20:     <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Client">
 21:       <PrivateAssets>all</PrivateAssets>
 22:       <IncludeAssets>runtime; build; native; contentfiles; analyzers; buildtransitive</IncludeAssets>
 23:     </PackageReference>
 24:     <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Http" />
 25:     <PackageReference Include="MudBlazor" />
 26:     <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" />
 27:     <PackageReference Include="NSwag.ApiDescription.Client">
 28:       <PrivateAssets>all</PrivateAssets>
 29:       <IncludeAssets>runtime; build; native; contentfiles; analyzers; buildtransitive</IncludeAssets>
 30:     </PackageReference>
 31:   </ItemGroup>
 32: 
 33:   <!--
 34:     OpenAPI Client Generation (NSwag)
 35:     ==================================
 36:     WORKFLOW:
 37:     1. Start Aspire → API starts and exports swagger.json (via OpenApiExportService)
 38:     2. Build Blazor.Client → NSwag regenerates EventApiClient.g.cs BEFORE compilation
 39: 
 40:     KEY DESIGN: Generation happens BEFORE CoreCompile, so:
 41:     - If swagger.json changed, client regenerates first
 42:     - Then compiler sees the fresh generated code
 43:     - You can regenerate even if your other code has build errors
 44: 
 45:     The swagger.json is checked into source control for CI/CD builds.
 46: 
 47:     To manually regenerate (bypasses build):
 48:       dotnet nswag run nswag.json
 49: 
 50:     INPUTS/OUTPUTS: MSBuild skips generation if swagger.json hasn't changed
 51:   -->
 52: 
 53:   <!-- Custom inline task for regex text replacement (avoids PowerShell escaping issues) -->
 54:   <UsingTask TaskName="ReplaceFileText" TaskFactory="RoslynCodeTaskFactory" AssemblyFile="$(MSBuildToolsPath)\Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Core.dll">
 55:     <ParameterGroup>
 56:       <InputFilename ParameterType="System.String" Required="true" />
 57:       <MatchExpression ParameterType="System.String" Required="true" />
 58:       <ReplacementText ParameterType="System.String" Required="true" />
 59:     </ParameterGroup>
 60:     <Task>
 61:       <Using Namespace="System" />
 62:       <Using Namespace="System.IO" />
 63:       <Using Namespace="System.Text.RegularExpressions" />
 64:       <Code Type="Fragment" Language="cs"><![CDATA[
 65:         if (File.Exists(InputFilename))
 66:         {
 67:             var content = File.ReadAllText(InputFilename);
 68:             var newContent = Regex.Replace(content, MatchExpression, ReplacementText);
 69:             if (content != newContent)
 70:             {
 71:                 File.WriteAllText(InputFilename, newContent);
 72:                 Log.LogMessage(MessageImportance.High, "Fixed NSwag void returns in {0}", Path.GetFileName(InputFilename));
 73:             }
 74:         }
 75:       ]]></Code>
 76:     </Task>
 77:   </UsingTask>
 78: 
 79:   <!-- NSwag Client Generation - Runs BEFORE compilation -->
 80:   <Target Name="GenerateApiClient" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile" Inputs="..\Explore.API\swagger.json" Outputs="Clients\EventApiClient.g.cs" Condition="Exists('..\Explore.API\swagger.json')">
 81:     <Message Importance="high" Text="NSwag: Regenerating API client from swagger.json..." />
 82:     <Exec Command="dotnet nswag run nswag.json" WorkingDirectory="$(ProjectDir)" ConsoleToMSBuild="true" />
 83:     <!-- Fix NSwag bug: 'return default(void)!;' is invalid C# for void methods (204 No Content responses) -->
 84:     <ReplaceFileText InputFilename="$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)\Clients\EventApiClient.g.cs" MatchExpression="return default\(void\)!;" ReplacementText="return;" />
 85:     <Message Importance="high" Text="NSwag: API client regenerated and patched successfully." />
 86:   </Target>
 87: 
 88:   <!-- Fix NSwag void return bug - ALWAYS runs before compilation (no Inputs/Outputs skip) -->
 89:   <Target Name="FixNSwagVoidReturns" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile">
 90:     <ReplaceFileText InputFilename="$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)\Clients\EventApiClient.g.cs" MatchExpression="return default\(void\)!;" ReplacementText="return;" />
 91:   </Target>
 92: 
 93:   <!-- Exclude generated file from source analysis (it's auto-generated) -->
 94:   <ItemGroup>
 95:     <Compile Update="Clients\EventApiClient.g.cs">
 96:       <AutoGen>true</AutoGen>
 97:       <DependentUpon>nswag.json</DependentUpon>
 98:     </Compile>
 99:   </ItemGroup>
100: 
101: 
102: </Project>
````

````razor
144:                                            Color="Color.Error"

153:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-2" Style="font-weight: 700;">No categories found</MudText>
154:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
155:                             @if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
````

````razor
 96:     {

 98:             <!-- Toolbar -->
 99:             <MudPaper Class="admin-locations__panel" Elevation="0">
100:                 <div class="admin-locations__toolbar">
101:                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
102:                                   Placeholder="Search locations..."
103:                                   Adornment="Adornment.Start"
104:                                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
105:                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
106:                                   Immediate="true"
107:                                   Clearable="true"
108:                                   Margin="Margin.Dense"
109:                                   Class="admin-locations__search-field" />
110: 
111:                     <MudSpacer />
112: 
113:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
114:                                Color="Color.Success"
````
