116:                                OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
117:                                Class="admin-locations__create-btn">
118:                         Create Location
119:                     </MudButton>
120:                 </div>
121:             </MudPaper>
122: 
123:             <!-- Table -->
124:             <MudPaper Class="admin-locations__table-panel" Elevation="0">
125:                 <MudTable Items="@FilteredLocations"
126:                           Dense="true"
127:                           Hover="true"
128:                           Striped="true"
129:                           Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm"
130:                           Loading="@_isLoading"
131:                           LoadingProgressColor="Color.Success">
132:                     <HeaderContent>
133:                         <MudTh Class="admin-locations__col-id">#</MudTh>
134:                         <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
135:                         <MudTh>Address</MudTh>
136:                         <MudTh>City</MudTh>
137:                         <MudTh>Country</MudTh>
138:                         <MudTh Class="admin-locations__col-actions">Actions</MudTh>
139:                     </HeaderContent>
140:                     <RowTemplate>
141:                         <MudTd DataLabel="#">
142:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-locations__id">@context.Id.ToString()[..8]…</MudText>
143:                         </MudTd>
144:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Name">
145:                             <div class="admin-locations__name-cell">
146:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Success" />
147:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-locations__name-text">@context.FullName</MudText>
148:                             </div>
149:                         </MudTd>
150:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Address">
151:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@(context.Address ?? "—")</MudText>
152:                         </MudTd>
153:                         <MudTd DataLabel="City">
154:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Info">
155:                                 @(context.City ?? "—")
156:                             </MudChip>
157:                         </MudTd>
158:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Country">
159:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Default">
160:                                 @(context.Country ?? "—")
161:                             </MudChip>
162:                         </MudTd>
163:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Class="admin-locations__cell-actions">
164:                             <div class="admin-locations__actions">
165:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Edit">
166:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
167:                                                    Color="Color.Primary"
168:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
169:                                                    OnClick="@(() => OpenEditDialog(context))" />
170:                                 </MudTooltip>
171:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Delete">
172:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
173:                                                    Color="Color.Error"
174:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
175:                                                    OnClick="@(() => DeleteLocation(context))" />
176:                                 </MudTooltip>
177:                             </div>
178:                         </MudTd>
179:                     </RowTemplate>
180:                     <NoRecordsContent>
181:                         <div class="admin-locations__empty">
182:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Large" />
183:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="admin-locations__empty-title">No locations found</MudText>
184:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-locations__muted">
185:                                 @if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
186:                                 {
187:                                     <span>Create your first location to get started.</span>
188:                                 }
189:                                 else
190:                                 {
191:                                     <span>No locations match your search criteria.</span>
192:                                 }
193:                             </MudText>
194:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
195:                                        Color="Color.Success"
196:                                        OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
197:                                        Class="admin-locations__empty-btn">
198:                                 Create Location
199:                             </MudButton>
200:                         </div>
201:                     </NoRecordsContent>
202:                     <PagerContent>
203:                         <MudTablePager PageSizeOptions="new int[] { 10, 25, 50, 100 }" />
204:                     </PagerContent>
205:                 </MudTable>
206:             </MudPaper>
207:         </div>
208:     }
209: </div>
210: 
211: @code {
212:     private ICollection<LocationListDto> _locations = new List<LocationListDto>();
213:     private string _searchString = string.Empty;
214:     private bool _isLoading = true;
215: 
216:     private IEnumerable<LocationListDto> FilteredLocations => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString)
217:         ? _locations
218:         : _locations.Where(l =>
219:             (l.FullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
220:             (l.Address?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
221:             (l.City?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
222:             (l.Country?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
223: 
224:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
225:     {
226:         await LoadLocations();
227:     }
228: 
229:     private async Task LoadLocations()
230:     {
231:         _isLoading = true;
232:         try
233:         {
234:             _locations = await LocationService.GetLocations();
235:         }
236:         catch (Exception ex)
237:         {
238:             Snackbar.Add($"Failed to load locations: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
239:             _locations = new List<LocationListDto>();
240:         }
241:         finally
242:         {
243:             _isLoading = false;
244:         }
245:     }
246: 
247:     private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
248:     {
249:         var options = new DialogOptions
250:         {
251:             CloseButton = true,
252:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
253:             FullWidth = true
254:         };
255: 
256:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateLocationDialog>("Create Location", options);
257:         var result = await dialog.Result;
258: 
259:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: CreateLocationDto createDto })
260:         {
261:             var response = await LocationService.CreateLocationAsync(createDto);
262:             if (response?.Success == true)
263:             {
264:                 Snackbar.Add($"Location '{createDto.FullName}' created successfully", Severity.Success);
265:                 await LoadLocations();
266:             }
267:             else
268:             {
269:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
270:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to create location: {errors}", Severity.Error);
271:             }
272:         }
273:     }
274: 
275:     private async Task OpenEditDialog(LocationListDto location)
276:     {
277:         if (location.Id == null)
278:         {
279:             Snackbar.Add("Location ID is missing.", Severity.Error);
280:             return;
281:         }
282: 
283:         // First, get the full location details
284:         var locationDetails = await LocationService.GetLocationByIdAsync(location.Id.Value);
285:         if (locationDetails == null)
286:         {
287:             Snackbar.Add("Failed to load location details", Severity.Error);
288:             return;
289:         }
290: 
291:         var parameters = new DialogParameters<EditLocationDialog>
292:         {
293:             { x => x.ExistingLocation, locationDetails }
294:         };
295: 
296:         var options = new DialogOptions
297:         {
298:             CloseButton = true,
299:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
300:             FullWidth = true
301:         };
302: 
303:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditLocationDialog>("Edit Location", parameters, options);
304:         var result = await dialog.Result;
305: 
306:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: UpdateLocationDto updateDto })
307:         {
308:             if (updateDto.Id == null)
309:             {
310:                 Snackbar.Add("Location ID is missing for update.", Severity.Error);
311:                 return;
312:             }
313:             var response = await LocationService.UpdateLocationAsync(updateDto.Id.Value, updateDto);
314:             if (response?.Success == true)
315:             {
316:                 Snackbar.Add($"Location '{updateDto.FullName}' updated successfully", Severity.Success);
317:                 await LoadLocations();
318:             }
319:             else
320:             {
321:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
322:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to update location: {errors}", Severity.Error);
323:             }
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     private async Task DeleteLocation(LocationListDto location)
328:     {
329:         bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
330:             "Confirm Delete",
331:             $"Are you sure you want to delete the location '{location.FullName}'? This action cannot be undone.",
332:             yesText: "Delete",
333:             cancelText: "Cancel");
334: 
335:         if (confirm == true)
336:         {
337:             if (location.Id == null)
338:             {
339:                 Snackbar.Add("Location ID is missing for delete.", Severity.Error);
340:                 return;
341:             }
342:             var success = await LocationService.DeleteLocationAsync(location.Id.Value);
343:             if (success)
344:             {
345:                 Snackbar.Add($"Location '{location.FullName}' deleted successfully", Severity.Success);
346:                 await LoadLocations();
347:             }
348:             else
349:             {
350:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to delete location '{location.FullName}'", Severity.Error);
351:             }
352:         }
353:     }
354: }

 87: public class ImageUploadResponse
 88: {
 89:     public string UploadUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 90:     public string ObjectKey { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 91:     public string ViewUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;

 93: }
 94:

100:     public bool Success { get; set; }
101:     public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }
102: }

104: public class PresignedDownloadUrlResponse
105: {
106:     public string PresignedUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;
107:     public string ObjectKey { get; set; } = string.Empty;
108:     public int ExpiresInMinutes { get; set; }
109: }
110:

113: 
114: public class ImageStorageService : IImageStorageService
115: {
116:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient;
117:     private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
118:     private readonly ILogger<ImageStorageService> _logger;
119:     private const long DefaultMaxFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
120: 
121:     public ImageStorageService(IEventApiClient apiClient, IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory, ILogger<ImageStorageService> logger)
122:     {
123:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
124:         _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClientFactory));
125:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
126:     }
127: 
128: 
129:     public async Task<FileUploadData?> ReadFileAsync(IBrowserFile file, long maxFileSize = DefaultMaxFileSize)
130:     {
131:         if (file == null)
132:         {
133:             _logger.LogWarning("ReadFileAsync called with null file");
134:             return null;
135:         }
136: 
137:         try
138:         {
139:             _logger.LogInformation("Reading file into memory: {FileName}, Size: {Size} bytes, ContentType: {ContentType}",
140:                 file.Name, file.Size, file.ContentType);
141: 
142:             if (file.Size > maxFileSize)
143:             {
144:                 _logger.LogWarning("File {FileName} exceeds max size ({Size} > {MaxSize})",
145:                     file.Name, file.Size, maxFileSize);
146:                 return null;
147:             }
148: 
149: 
150:             await using var stream = file.OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize: maxFileSize);
151:             using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
152:             await stream.CopyToAsync(memoryStream);
153:             var bytes = memoryStream.ToArray();
154: 
155:             _logger.LogDebug("Successfully read {ByteCount} bytes from {FileName}", bytes.Length, file.Name);
156: 
157:             return new FileUploadData
158:             {
159:                 Content = bytes,
160:                 FileName = file.Name,
161:                 ContentType = file.ContentType
162:             };
163:         }
164:         catch (Exception ex)
165:         {
166:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error reading file {FileName} into memory", file.Name);
167:             return null;
168:         }
169:     }
170: 
171: 
172:     public async Task<ImageUploadResponse?> GetUploadUrlAsync(string fileName, string contentType)
173:     {
174:         try
175:         {
176:             _logger.LogInformation("Getting upload URL for: {FileName}, type: {ContentType}", fileName, contentType);
177: 
178:             var request = new UploadRequestDto
179:             {
180:                 FileName = fileName,
181:                 ContentType = contentType
182:             };
183: 
184:             var response = await _apiClient.GenerateUploadUrlAsync(request);
185: 
186: 
187:             if (response == null)
188:             {
189:                 _logger.LogWarning("GenerateUploadUrlAsync returned null response");
190:                 return null;
191:             }
192: 
193:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response.UploadUrl))
194:             {
195:                 _logger.LogWarning("UploadUrl is null or empty. Check server S3 configuration (bucket/endpoint/credentials)");
196:                 return null;
197:             }
198: 
199:             _logger.LogDebug("Got upload URL: {UploadUrlPreview}...", response.UploadUrl?.Substring(0, Math.Min(50, response.UploadUrl?.Length ?? 0)));
200:             return new ImageUploadResponse
201:             {
202:                 UploadUrl = response.UploadUrl ?? string.Empty,
203:                 ObjectKey = response.ObjectKey ?? string.Empty,
204:                 ViewUrl = response.ViewUrl ?? string.Empty,
205:                 ExpiresInMinutes = response.ExpiresInMinutes ?? 60
206:             };
207:         }
208:         catch (ApiException ex)
209:         {
210:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error getting upload URL: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
211:             return null;
212:         }
213:         catch (Exception ex)
214:         {
215:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting upload URL");
216:             return null;
217:         }
218:     }
219: 
220: 
221:     public async Task<bool> UploadImageAsync(string uploadUrl, IBrowserFile file)
222:     {
223:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uploadUrl))
224:         {
225:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL (empty/null) - aborting upload");
226:             return false;
227:         }
228: 
229:         if (!Uri.TryCreate(uploadUrl, UriKind.Absolute, out var validatedUri))
230:         {
231:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL format: {UploadUrl} - aborting upload", uploadUrl);
232:             return false;
233:         }
234: 
235:         try
236:         {
237:             _logger.LogInformation("Uploading to S3: {FileName}, Size: {Size} bytes, ContentType: {ContentType}, Host: {Host}",
238:                 file.Name, file.Size, file.ContentType, validatedUri.Host);
239: 
240: 
241:             using var s3Client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("S3Upload");
242: 
243: 
244:             const long maxFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
245:             await using var stream = file.OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize: maxFileSize);
246:             using var content = new StreamContent(stream);
247: 
248: 
249:             content.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue(file.ContentType);
250: 
251:             _logger.LogDebug("Sending PUT request to S3...");
252: 
253: 
254:             var response = await s3Client.PutAsync(validatedUri, content);
255: 
256:             if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
257:             {
258:                 var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
259:                 _logger.LogError("S3 upload failed: {StatusCode} - {ReasonPhrase} - {ErrorContent}",
260:                     (int)response.StatusCode, response.ReasonPhrase, errorContent);
261: 
262: 
263:                 if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
264:                 {
265:                     _logger.LogError("S3 403 Forbidden - Check: 1) CORS config on bucket 2) Pre-signed URL expired 3) Content-Type mismatch");
266:                 }
267:                 else if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.BadRequest)
268:                 {
269:                     _logger.LogError("S3 400 Bad Request - Check: 1) Content-Type header matches pre-signed URL 2) Request headers are correct");
270:                 }
271:             }
272:             else
273:             {
274:                 var etag = response.Headers.ETag?.Tag ?? "no-etag";
275:                 _logger.LogInformation("S3 upload successful! ETag: {ETag}", etag);
276:             }
277: 
278:             return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
279:         }
280:         catch (HttpRequestException ex)
281:         {
282:             _logger.LogError(ex, "HTTP request error uploading to S3. This may be a CORS issue - check bucket CORS configuration.");
283:             return false;
284:         }
285:         catch (Exception ex)
286:         {
287:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error uploading image to S3");
288:             return false;
289:         }
290:     }

292: 
293:     public async Task<bool> UploadImageFromBytesAsync(string uploadUrl, FileUploadData fileData)
294:     {
295:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uploadUrl))
296:         {
297:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL (empty/null) - aborting upload");
298:             return false;
299:         }
300: 
301:         if (fileData == null || fileData.Content.Length == 0)
302:         {
303:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid file data (null or empty) - aborting upload");
304:             return false;
305:         }
306: 
307:         if (!Uri.TryCreate(uploadUrl, UriKind.Absolute, out var validatedUri))
308:         {
309:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL format: {UploadUrl} - aborting upload", uploadUrl);
310:             return false;
311:         }
312: 
313:         try
314:         {
315:             _logger.LogInformation("Uploading to S3: {FileName}, Size: {Size} bytes, ContentType: {ContentType}, Host: {Host}",
316:                 fileData.FileName, fileData.Size, fileData.ContentType, validatedUri.Host);
317: 
318: 
319:             using var s3Client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("S3Upload");
320: 
321: 
322: 
323:             using var content = new ByteArrayContent(fileData.Content);
324: 
325: 
326:             content.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue(fileData.ContentType);
327: 
328:             _logger.LogDebug("Sending PUT request to S3 with ByteArrayContent ({Size} bytes)...", fileData.Size);
329: 
330: 
331:             using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(3));
332:             var response = await s3Client.PutAsync(validatedUri, content, cts.Token);
333: 
334:             if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
335:             {
336:                 var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
337:                 _logger.LogError("S3 upload failed: {StatusCode} - {ReasonPhrase} - {ErrorContent}",
338:                     (int)response.StatusCode, response.ReasonPhrase, errorContent);
339: 
340: 
341:                 if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
342:                 {
343:                     _logger.LogError("S3 403 Forbidden - Check: 1) CORS config on bucket 2) Pre-signed URL expired 3) Content-Type mismatch");
344:                 }
345:                 else if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.BadRequest)
346:                 {
347:                     _logger.LogError("S3 400 Bad Request - Check: 1) Content-Type header matches pre-signed URL 2) Request headers are correct");
348:                 }
349: 
350:                 return false;
351:             }
352: 
353:             var etag = response.Headers.ETag?.Tag ?? "no-etag";
354:             _logger.LogInformation("S3 upload successful! ETag: {ETag}, Size: {Size} bytes", etag, fileData.Size);
355:             return true;
356:         }
357:         catch (OperationCanceledException)
358:         {
359:             _logger.LogError("S3 upload timed out after 3 minutes for file {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
360:             return false;
361:         }
362:         catch (HttpRequestException ex)
363:         {
364:             _logger.LogError(ex, "HTTP request error uploading to S3. This may be a CORS issue - check bucket CORS configuration. File: {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
365:             return false;
366:         }
367:         catch (Exception ex)
368:         {
369:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error uploading image to S3. File: {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
370:             return false;
371:         }
372:     }

459:                 _logger.LogInformation("Returning successful ImageUploadResult for {FileName}", fileData.FileName);

668:     public async Task<string> GenerateLocalPreviewAsync(IBrowserFile file, long maxFileSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024)
669:     {
670:         try
671:         {
672:             var resizedImage = await file.RequestImageFileAsync(file.ContentType, 400, 400);
673:             using var stream = resizedImage.OpenReadStream(maxFileSize);
674:             using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
675:             await stream.CopyToAsync(memoryStream);
676:             var bytes = memoryStream.ToArray();
677:             return $"data:{file.ContentType};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(bytes)}";
678:         }
679:         catch (Exception ex)
680:         {
681:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating preview");
682:             return string.Empty;
683:         }
684:     }

690:         {

692:             return string.Empty;
693:         }
694: 
695:         try
696:         {
697:             return $"data:{fileData.ContentType};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(fileData.Content)}";
698:         }
699:         catch (Exception ex)
700:         {
701:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating preview from bytes");
702:             return string.Empty;
703:         }
704:     }
705: 
706:     private int GetFileTypeId(string contentType)
707:     {
708:         return contentType.ToLower() switch
709:         {
710:             "image/jpeg" or "image/jpg" => 1,
711:             "image/png" => 2,
712:             "image/gif" => 3,
713:             "image/webp" => 4,
714:             "image/svg+xml" => 5,
715:             _ => 1
716:         };
717:     }
718: }

  1: using System.Collections.Concurrent;
  2: using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
  3: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Constants;
  4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
  5: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Blazor.Services;
  8: 
  9: public interface ICircuitAccessTokenService
 10: {
 11:     string? AccessToken { get; }
 12:     void SetToken(string? token);
 13: }
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17: 
 18: 
 19: 
 20: public class CircuitAccessTokenService : ICircuitAccessTokenService
 21: {
 22: 
 23: 
 24:     private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, TokenEntry> _tokenStore = new();
 25: 
 26: 
 27:     private static TokenEntry? _latestToken;
 28:     private static readonly object _latestTokenLock = new();
 29: 
 30:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
 31:     private readonly ILogger<CircuitAccessTokenService> _logger;
 32:     private string? _localToken;
 33:     private string? _userId;
 34: 
 35:     public CircuitAccessTokenService(IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor, ILogger<CircuitAccessTokenService> logger)
 36:     {
 37:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
 38:         _logger = logger;
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     public string? AccessToken => _localToken ?? GetStoredToken();
 42: 
 43:     public void SetToken(string? token)
 44:     {
 45:         _localToken = token;
 46: 
 47:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
 48:         {
 49:             _logger.LogWarning("[CircuitAccessTokenService] SetToken called with null/empty token");
 50:             return;
 51:         }
 52: 
 53: 
 54:         var userId = ExtractUserIdFromToken(token, _logger) ?? GetUserIdFromHttpContext();
 55: 
 56:         _logger.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService] SetToken called. Token length: {TokenLen}, UserId: {UserId}",
 57:             token.Length, userId ?? "(null)");
 58: 
 59: 
 60:         lock (_latestTokenLock)
 61:         {
 62:             _latestToken = new TokenEntry(token, DateTime.UtcNow);
 63:         }
 64:         _logger.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService] Stored as latest token (length: {TokenLen})", token.Length);
 65: 
 66:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
 67:         {
 68:             _userId = userId;
 69:             _tokenStore[userId] = new TokenEntry(token, DateTime.UtcNow);
 70:             _logger.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService] Token stored for userId: {UserId}. Store has {Count} entries",
 71:                 userId, _tokenStore.Count);
 72:             CleanupOldTokens();
 73:         }
 74:         else
 75:         {
 76:             _logger.LogWarning("[CircuitAccessTokenService] Could not extract userId from token - stored as latest only");
 77:         }
 78:     }
 79: 
 80: 
 81: 
 82: 
 83: 
 84:     private static string? ExtractUserIdFromToken(string token, ILogger logger)
 85:     {
 86:         try
 87:         {
 88:             var handler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
 89:             if (handler.CanReadToken(token))
 90:             {
 91:                 var jwtToken = handler.ReadJwtToken(token);
 92:                 var sub = jwtToken.Claims.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == "sub")?.Value;
 93:                 logger.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService] Extracted userId from JWT: {UserId}", sub ?? "(null)");
 94:                 return sub;
 95:             }
 96:         }
 97:         catch (Exception ex)
 98:         {
 99:             logger.LogDebug(ex, "[CircuitAccessTokenService] Failed to parse JWT");
100:         }
101:         return null;
102:     }
103: 
104:     private string? GetUserIdFromHttpContext()
105:     {
106:         var user = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User;
107:         var userId = user?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
108:             ?? user?.FindFirst(System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
109:         _logger.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService] GetUserIdFromHttpContext: {UserId}", userId ?? "(null)");
110:         return userId;
111:     }
112: 
113:     private string? GetStoredToken()
114:     {
115:         var userId = _userId ?? GetUserIdFromHttpContext();
116:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId) && _tokenStore.TryGetValue(userId, out var entry))
117:         {
118: 
119:             if (entry.CreatedAt > DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-1))
120:             {
121:                 return entry.Token;
122:             }
123:         }
124:         return null;
125:     }
126: 
127: 
128: 
129: 
130: 
131:     public static string? GetAnyValidToken(ILogger? logger = null)
132:     {
133:         var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-1);
134:         var validEntries = _tokenStore.Values.Where(e => e.CreatedAt > cutoff).ToList();
135:         logger?.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService.GetAnyValidToken] Total store entries: {Total}, Valid entries: {Valid}",
136:             _tokenStore.Count, validEntries.Count);
137: 
138:         var entry = validEntries.FirstOrDefault();
139:         if (entry != null)
140:         {
141:             logger?.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService.GetAnyValidToken] Found valid token from store (length: {Len})", entry.Token.Length);
142:             return entry.Token;
143:         }
144: 
145: 
146:         lock (_latestTokenLock)
147:         {
148:             if (_latestToken != null && _latestToken.CreatedAt > cutoff)
149:             {
150:                 logger?.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService.GetAnyValidToken] Found valid latest token (length: {Len})", _latestToken.Token.Length);
151:                 return _latestToken.Token;
152:             }
153:         }
154: 
155:         logger?.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService.GetAnyValidToken] No valid tokens found anywhere");
156:         return null;
157:     }
158: 
159: 
160: 
161: 
162:     public static string? GetTokenForUser(string userId, ILogger? logger = null)
163:     {
164:         logger?.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService.GetTokenForUser] Looking for userId: {UserId}, Store has {Count} entries",
165:             userId, _tokenStore.Count);
166: 
167:         if (_tokenStore.TryGetValue(userId, out var entry))
168:         {
169:             if (entry.CreatedAt > DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-1))
170:             {
171:                 logger?.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService.GetTokenForUser] Found valid token for {UserId} (length: {Len})",
172:                     userId, entry.Token.Length);
173:                 return entry.Token;
174:             }
175:             logger?.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService.GetTokenForUser] Token for {UserId} is expired", userId);
176:         }
177:         else
178:         {
179:             logger?.LogDebug("[CircuitAccessTokenService.GetTokenForUser] No entry found for userId: {UserId}", userId);
180:         }
181:         return null;
182:     }
183: 
184:     private static void CleanupOldTokens()
185:     {
186:         var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-2);
187:         var oldKeys = _tokenStore.Where(kvp => kvp.Value.CreatedAt < cutoff).Select(kvp => kvp.Key).ToList();
188:         foreach (var key in oldKeys)
189:         {
190:             _tokenStore.TryRemove(key, out _);
191:         }
192:     }
193: 
194:     private record TokenEntry(string Token, DateTime CreatedAt);
195: }
196:

199: 
200: 
201: public class AccessTokenForwardingHandler : DelegatingHandler
202: {
203:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
204:     private readonly ILogger<AccessTokenForwardingHandler> _logger;
205: 
206:     public AccessTokenForwardingHandler(
207:         IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
208:         ILogger<AccessTokenForwardingHandler> logger)
209:     {
210:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
211:         _logger = logger;
212:     }
213: 
214:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
215:         HttpRequestMessage request,
216:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
217:     {
218:         _logger.LogDebug("[AccessTokenForwardingHandler] Processing request to {Path}", request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
219: 
220:         string? token = null;
221:         string source = "none";
222: 
223: 
224:         var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext;
225:         var isAuthenticated = httpContext?.User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true;
226: 
227:         if (isAuthenticated)
228:         {
229:             try
230:             {
231:                 token = await httpContext!.GetTokenAsync("access_token");
232:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
233:                 {
234:                     source = "HttpContext";
235:                     _logger.LogDebug("[AccessTokenForwardingHandler] Got token from HttpContext (length: {Len})", token.Length);
236:                 }
237:                 else
238:                 {
239:                     _logger.LogDebug("[AccessTokenForwardingHandler] HttpContext.GetTokenAsync returned null/empty");
240:                 }
241:             }
242:             catch (Exception ex)
243:             {
244:                 _logger.LogWarning(ex, "[AccessTokenForwardingHandler] Could not get token from HttpContext");
245:             }
246:         }
247: 
248: 
249:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
250:         {
251:             var userId = httpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
252:                 ?? httpContext?.User?.FindFirst(System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
253: 
254:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
255:             {
256:                 token = CircuitAccessTokenService.GetTokenForUser(userId, _logger);
257:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
258:                 {
259:                     source = "StaticStore(userId)";
260:                 }
261:             }
262:         }
263: 
264: 
265:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
266:         {
267:             token = CircuitAccessTokenService.GetAnyValidToken(_logger);
268:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
269:             {
270:                 source = "StaticStore(any)";
271:             }
272:         }
273: 
274: 
275:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token) && !request.Headers.Contains("Authorization"))
276:         {
277:             request.Headers.Authorization = new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
278:             _logger.LogDebug("[AccessTokenForwardingHandler] Added Bearer token from {Source} to {Path}", source, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
279:         }
280:         else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
281:         {
282:             var path = request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery ?? string.Empty;
283:             if (IsAnonymousAllowedPath(path))
284:             {
285:                 _logger.LogDebug("[AccessTokenForwardingHandler] No token needed for anonymous endpoint {Path}", path);
286:             }
287:             else
288:             {
289:                 _logger.LogWarning("[AccessTokenForwardingHandler] No token available for {Path} - request will likely fail with 401", path);
290:             }
291:         }
292: 
293:         var incomingTenantHeader = httpContext?.Request.Headers[TenantConstants.TenantIdHeaderName].FirstOrDefault();
294:         if (!request.Headers.Contains(TenantConstants.TenantIdHeaderName) &&
295:             !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(incomingTenantHeader))
296:         {
297:             request.Headers.Add(TenantConstants.TenantIdHeaderName, incomingTenantHeader);
298:             _logger.LogDebug("[AccessTokenForwardingHandler] Forwarded tenant header {Header}: {TenantId} to {Path}",
299:                 TenantConstants.TenantIdHeaderName, incomingTenantHeader, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
300:         }
301: 
302:         var forwardedHost = httpContext?.Request.Headers["X-Forwarded-Host"].FirstOrDefault();
303:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(forwardedHost))
304:         {
305:             forwardedHost = httpContext?.Request.Host.Value;
306:         }
307: 
308:         if (!request.Headers.Contains("X-Forwarded-Host") && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(forwardedHost))
309:         {
310:             request.Headers.Add("X-Forwarded-Host", forwardedHost);
311:             _logger.LogDebug("[AccessTokenForwardingHandler] Forwarded host header X-Forwarded-Host: {Host} to {Path}",
312:                 forwardedHost, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
313:         }
314: 
315:         return await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
316:     }
317: 
318:     private static bool IsAnonymousAllowedPath(string pathAndQuery)
319:     {
320:         return pathAndQuery.Contains("/api/v1/PublicExperience/settings", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
321:             || pathAndQuery.Contains("/api/v1/InstanceOnboarding/status", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
322:     }
323: }

  1: # Troubleshooting
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic .NET Backend Troubleshooting Guide**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).

 11: ## Placeholder Substitutions
 12: 
 13: | Placeholder | Replace With | Example (ISLAMU Event) |
 14: |-------------|--------------|------------------------|
 15: | `{Project}` | Your solution name | `Explore` |
 16: | `{Project}.API` | API project | `Explore.API` |
 17: | `{Project}.Application` | Application project | `Explore.Application` |
 18: | `{Project}.Domain` | Domain project | `Explore.Domain` |

 23: 
 24: This guide focuses on common issues when working on the **backend** projects:
 25: 
 26: - `{Project}.API`
 27: - `{Project}.Application`
 28: - `{Project}.Domain`
 29: - `{Project}.Persistence`
 30: - `{Project}.Infrastructure`
 31: - Migration/worker services (if applicable)
 32: 
 33: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
 34: 
 35: ```
 36: - Explore.API
 37: - Explore.Application
 38: - Explore.Domain
 39: - Explore.Persistence
 40: - Explore.Infrastructure
 41: - Event.MigrationService
 42: ```
 43: 
 44: ## Build & Restore
 45: 
 46: ### Effective Commands for Error Visibility
 47: 
 48: Basic `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` hide important error details. Use these commands instead:
 49: 
 50: #### Building
 51: 
 52: ```bash
 53: # Clean summary with error/warning counts
 54: dotnet build --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 55: 
 56: # Full error details when you need them
 57: dotnet build --configuration Release --verbosity normal
 58: ```
 59: 
 60: #### Running Tests
 61: 
 62: **Always run test projects individually** — solution-level `dotnet test` fails if any project has MSBuild issues (e.g., placeholder projects without a test framework).
 63: 
 64: ```bash
 65: # Clean pass/fail summary per project
 66: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 67: 
 68: # Inline error details
 69: dotnet test --project Event.API.IntegrationTests/Event.API.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity normal
 70: ```
 71: 
 72: **Important:** Always use `--project` flag. Positional project path (e.g., `dotnet test path.csproj`) does not work reliably — use `dotnet test --project path.csproj`.
 73: 
 74: #### Debugging Test Failures with TRX Reports
 75: 
 76: When you need detailed failure analysis (failed test names, error messages, stack traces), generate a TRX report:
 77: 
 78: ```bash
 79: # Generate TRX report
 80: dotnet test --project Event.API.IntegrationTests/Event.API.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release -- --report-trx --report-trx-filename results.trx
 81: ```
 82: 
 83: **TRX file location:** `<ProjectDir>/bin/Release/net10.0/TestResults/results.trx`
 84: 
 85: **Analyzing the TRX file** (use Grep tool, not bash grep):
 86: 
 87: ```
 88: # Find all failed tests
 89: Grep pattern: outcome="Failed"
 90: 
 91: # Get full class.method names for failed tests
 92: Grep pattern: className=
 93: # Correlate testId from failed entries to className entries
 94: 
 95: # Read error messages and stack traces
 96: Grep pattern: <Message>
 97: Grep pattern: <StackTrace>
 98: ```
 99: 
100: **TRX workflow summary:**
101: 1. Generate TRX with `-- --report-trx --report-trx-filename results.trx`
102: 2. Grep for `outcome="Failed"` to find failed test entries and their `testId`
103: 3. Grep for `className=` with the `testId` to get the full `Namespace.Class.Method`
104: 4. Read the `<Message>` and `<StackTrace>` elements for error details
105: 
106: #### Test Projects (Run Individually)
107: 
108: ```bash
109: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release
110: dotnet test --project Event.Domain.UnitTests/Event.Domain.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release
111: dotnet test --project Event.Architecture.Tests/Event.Architecture.Tests.csproj --configuration Release
112: dotnet test --project Explore.Secrets.UnitTests/Explore.Secrets.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release
113: dotnet test --project Event.Persistence.IntegrationTests/Event.Persistence.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release
114: dotnet test --project Event.API.IntegrationTests/Event.API.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release
115: dotnet test --project Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests/Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests.csproj --configuration Release
116: ```
117: 
118: #### Known Pitfalls
119: 
120: | Pitfall | Solution |
121: |---------|----------|
122: | `dotnet test` at solution level fails | Run each test project individually |
123: | Positional project path doesn't work | Use `--project` flag: `dotnet test --project path.csproj` |
124: | `findstr /i` fails on French-locale Windows | Use exact case patterns instead of `/i` flag |
125: | `--treenode-filter` for TUnit filtering | Does not work reliably — use TRX reports instead |
126: | Running test DLL directly | Causes MSBuild errors — always test via `.csproj` |
127: | Basic `dotnet test` hides failures | Use `--verbosity normal` or TRX reports |
128: | Basic `dotnet build` hides errors | Use `--verbosity quiet` for summary or `normal` for details |
129: 
130: ### Common issues
131: 
132: #### Target framework / SDK mismatch
133: 
134: All backend projects target `net10.0`. If your SDK is older, install the .NET 10 SDK.
135: 
136: #### "The type or namespace name 'X' could not be found"
137: 
138: Typical causes:
139: 
140: - Missing `using` (do not remove existing usings)
141: - Missing project reference (check `.csproj`)
142: - Wrong layer dependency (see `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/QUICK_REFERENCE.md`)
143: 
144: ## OpenAPI / Swagger / Scalar
145: 
146: ### Swagger UI loads but endpoints are missing metadata
147: 
148: Controllers should annotate actions with:
149: 
150: - `[EndpointSummary]`
151: - `[EndpointDescription]`
152: - `[ProducesResponseType]`
153: 
154: See `docs/API.md`.
155: 
156: ### swagger.json file is stale
157: 
158: In Development, `{Project}.API` runs `OpenApiExportService` which exports a `swagger.json` file at startup.
159: 
160: If it doesn't update:
161: 
162: - Ensure `{Project}.API` starts successfully in Development.
163: - Check startup logs for the hosted service.
164: - Confirm the file is not locked by another process.
165: 
166: **Example (ISLAMU Event)**: `Explore.API` exports `swagger.json` to `Explore.API/swagger.json`
167: 
168: ## Authentication / Authorization
169: 
170: ### 401 Unauthorized on write endpoints
171: 
172: - Ensure you are sending `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
173: - Confirm Keycloak settings in configuration match your environment.
174: 
175: ### UserId missing in token
176: 
177: Controllers that require a user id MUST use the fallback claim extraction:
178: 
179: `sub` → `http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier` → `sid`
180: 
181: If all are missing, return `401`.
182: 
183: ## Database / EF Core / Migrations
184: 
185: ### Apply migrations (Development)
186: 
187: `{Project}.API` exposes a Development-only endpoint:
188: 
189: ```http
190: POST /admin/migrate
191: ```
192: 
193: It is protected with `.RequireAuthorization()`.
194: 
195: **Example (ISLAMU Event)**: `Explore.API` provides `POST /admin/migrate`
196: 
197: ### Migration worker (if applicable)
198: 
199: If your project has a dedicated migration service, it's responsible for background migration/maintenance tasks.
200: 
201: **Example (ISLAMU Event)**: `Event.MigrationService` handles background migrations (see `Event.MigrationService/Program.cs`)
202: 
203: ### Duplicate key violations
204: 
205: `GenericRepository.Create` catches PostgreSQL unique constraint violations (`SqlState == "23505"`) and rethrows with more context.
206: 
207: If you see duplicate key errors:
208: 
209: - Check unique constraints in EF configurations/migrations.
210: - Verify seed data and id generation.
211: 
212: 
213: ### Development URLs (Default)
214: 
215: | Service | URL |
216: |---------|-----|
217: | Aspire Dashboard | `https://localhost:17225` |
218: | API | `https://localhost:7001` |
219: | Blazor | `https://localhost:7002` |
220: | Scalar API Docs | `https://localhost:7001/scalar/v1` |
221: | Swagger UI | `https://localhost:7001/swagger` |
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Organization/InviteMemberDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 3: @using MudBlazor
 4: @inject IOrganizationMemberService MemberService
 5: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 6: 
 7: <MudDialog>
 8:     <DialogContent>
 9:         <MudTextField @bind-Value="model.Email" Label="Email" Required="true" RequiredError="Email is required" InputType="InputType.Email" />
10:         <MudSelect T="int?" Label="Role" @bind-Value="model.Role" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter">
11:             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="2">Co-Owner</MudSelectItem>
12:             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="3">Admin</MudSelectItem>
13:             <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="4">Member</MudSelectItem>
14:         </MudSelect>
15:     </DialogContent>
16:     <DialogActions>
17:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
18:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Invite</MudButton>
19:     </DialogActions>
20: </MudDialog>
21: 
22: @code {
23:     [CascadingParameter] MudBlazor.IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; }
24:     [Parameter] public Guid OrganizationId { get; set; }
25: 
26:     private AddOrganizationMemberDto model = new();
27: 
28:     protected override void OnInitialized()
29:     {
30:         model.OrganizationId = OrganizationId;
31:         model.Role = 4; // Member role
32:     }
33: 
34:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
35: 
36:     private async Task Submit()
37:     {
38:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Email))
39:         {
40:             Snackbar.Add("Email is required", Severity.Warning);
41:             return;
42:         }
43: 
44:         try
45:         {
46:             await MemberService.InviteMemberAsync(model);
47:             Snackbar.Add("Member invited successfully", Severity.Success);
48:             MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
49:         }
50:         catch (Exception ex)
51:         {
52:             Snackbar.Add($"Error inviting member: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
53:         }
54:     }
55: }
````

 25:     private string? _errorMessage;
 26: 
 27:     private string _searchString = "";
 28:     private int? _roleFilter;
 29: 
 30:     private IEnumerable<OrganizationMemberDto> FilteredMembers =>
 31:         Members
 32:             .Where(x => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString) ||
 33:                         (x.UserFullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
 34:                         (x.UserEmail?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))
 35:             .Where(x => _roleFilter == null || x.OrganizationRoleId == _roleFilter);
 36: 
 37:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 38:     {
 39:         var idStr = RouterState.GetParam("id");
 40:         if (Guid.TryParse(idStr, out var id))
 41:         {
 42:             Id = id;
 43:         }
 44: 
 45:         var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 46:         var user = authState.User;
 47:         currentUserId = user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
 48:             ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
 49:             ?? user.FindFirst("oid")?.Value;
 50: 
 51:         await LoadMembers();
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     private void DetermineCurrentUserRole()
 55:     {
 56:         if (currentUserId != null)
 57:         {
 58:             var me = Members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId.ToString().Equals(currentUserId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 59:             if (me != null)
 60:             {
 61:                 currentUserRole = me.OrganizationRoleId;
 62:             }
 63:         }
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     private async Task LoadMembers()
 67:     {
 68:         _loading = true;
 69:         _errorMessage = null;
 70:         try
 71:         {
 72:             Members = (await MemberService.GetMembersAsync(Id))?.ToList() ?? new List<OrganizationMemberDto>();
 73:             DetermineCurrentUserRole();
 74:         }
 75:         catch (Exception ex)
 76:         {
 77:             _errorMessage = $"Error loading members: {ex.Message}";
 78:         }
 79:         finally
 80:         {
 81:             _loading = false;
 82:         }
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     private Color GetRoleColor(int role)
 86:     {
 87:         return RoleHelper.GetRoleColor(role);
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     private string GetRoleName(int role)
 91:     {
 92:         return RoleHelper.GetRoleName(role);
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     private async Task OpenInviteDialog()
 96:     {
 97:         var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["OrganizationId"] = Id };
 98:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<InviteMemberDialog>("Invite Member", parameters);
 99:         var result = await dialog.Result;
100: 
101:         if (!result.Canceled)
102:         {
103:             await LoadMembers();
104:         }
105:     }
106: 
107:     private async Task OpenEditRoleDialog(OrganizationMemberDto member)
108:     {
109:         var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["Member"] = member, ["OrganizationId"] = Id };
110:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditMemberRoleDialog>("Edit Role", parameters);
111:         var result = await dialog.Result;
112: 
113:         if (!result.Canceled)
114:         {
115:             await LoadMembers();
116:         }
117:     }
118: 
119:     private async Task RemoveMember(OrganizationMemberDto member)
120:     {
121:         bool? result = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
122:             "Remove Member",
123:             $"Are you sure you want to remove {member.UserEmail} from the organization?",
124:             yesText: "Remove", cancelText: "Cancel");
125: 
126:         if (result == true)
127:         {
128:             try
129:             {
130:                 if (!member.Id.HasValue)
131:                 {
132:                     _errorMessage = "Member ID is missing";
133:                     return;
134:                 }
135:                 await MemberService.DeleteMemberAsync(member.Id.Value);
136:                 await LoadMembers();
137:             }
138:             catch (Exception ex)
139:             {
140:                 _errorMessage = $"Error removing member: {ex.Message}";
141:             }
142:         }
143:     }
144: }

## File: README.md
````markdown
  1: <a name="readme-top"></a>
  2: 
  3: <div align="center">
  4: 
  5: # ISLAMU Event
  6: 
  7: # Event Platform & Management System in Heavy Development
  8: 
  9: ISLAMU Event is a self-hostable, decentralized, multi-tenant event platform for any community or industry. 
 10: The ISLAMU organization hosts a public instance focused on Islamic events, but the software itself is purpose-agnostic, fully white-label, and designed to be rebranded for any use case.
 11: 
 12: ![GitHub Workflow Status][github-workflow-status-shield]
 13: [![Codecov][codecov-shield]][codecov-link]
 14: [![Quality Gate Status][sonarcloud-shield]][sonarcloud-link]
 15: [![GitHub License][github-license-shield]][github-license-link]
 16: [![GitHub Repo Stars][github-stars-shield]][github-stars-link]
 17: [![GitHub Last Commit][github-last-commit-shield]][github-last-commit-link]
 18: [![Contributors][github-contributors-shield]][github-contributors-link]
 19: [![Discussions][github-discussions-shield]][github-discussions-link]
 20: [![Discord][discord-shield]][discord-link]
 21: 
 22: [**ISLAMU's Islamic Instance**][islamu-platform] · [**Docs**](docs/index.md) · [**Roadmap**][roadmap-link]
 23: 
 24: </div>
 25: 
 26: ---
 27: 
 28: ## ℹ About ISLAMU Event
 29: 
 30: ISLAMU Event is an Event Platform & Management System built for both allowing the best Event Discovery and Event Management Experience.
 31: 
 32: > Give us a Star ⭐️
 33: 
 34: - **The software is general-purpose**: it can be used for any kind of Events, Communities, and Organizations.
 35: - **The ISLAMU-hosted instance is Islamic-focused**: ISLAMU’s public instance is curated for Islamic Events and Community needs.
 36: 
 37: ## ✨ Why ISLAMU Event
 38: 
 39: ### Key Differentiators
 40: 
 41: - **🌍 Decentralized by Design:** Federation-ready architecture with ATProto / ActivityPub planned
 42: - **🔐 Privacy-First:** Self-hostable with complete data ownership
 43: - **🎯 Cultural Intelligence:** Advanced filtering by madhab, gender, age, and prayer times
 44: - **🛡️ Verified Organizations:** Two-tier verification system for trust and quality
 45: - **Runtime Mode Switching** Single-tenant ↔ Multi-tenant without code changes
 46: - **Policy-Based Rendering** Blazor render modes controlled by policy, not hardcoded
 47: - **📖 Open Source:** AGPL-3.0 licensed for transparency and community ownership
 48: 
 49: ---
 50: 
 51: ## 🎯 Core Features
 52: 
 53: ### For Event Seekers
 54: 
 55: - **🔍 Powerful discovery** Search & filter events with location, category, language, and time filters
 56: - **👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Culturally-aware filters** (e.g., audience, gender, prayer-relative timing) for instances that need them
 57: - **🌐 Multi-language support** for global communities
 58: - **📱 Mobile-friendly experience** across devices
 59: 
 60: ### For Event Organizers
 61: 
 62: - **📅 Multi-session events** for conferences, seminars, and recurring programs
 63: - **✅ Verification system** to build trust and credibility
 64: - **📊 Analytics and engagement tracking** for organizers
 65: - **Flexible publishing policies** (open, approval-based, or invite-only)
 66: - **Event Extensibility** 
 67: 
 68: ### For Platform Owners
 69: 
 70: - **🐳 Docker-Ready** One-command deployment with docker-compose
 71: - **💼 Single or Multi-Tenancy Support**
 72: - **🛠️ Full white-label control** (branding, domain, instance identity)
 73: - **Configurable policies** Choose who can publish, verification criteria, categories, and more
 74: - **Federation-ready architecture** with ATProto / ActivityPub planned
 75: - **📚 Comprehensive Docs** for deployment, customization, and operation
 76: 
 77: ##  Deployment & Hosting Options
 78: 
 79: This platform is designed to be flexible and self-hostable for any organization.
 80: 
 81: - **Single-Instance Mode**: One organization or community per deployment
 82: - **Multi-Tenant SaaS Mode**: Multiple isolated tenants with custom domains and branding
 83: 
 84: See [Operations Guide][operations-doc] for full deployment details and examples.
 85: 
 86: ## 🎨 Branding & Customization
 87: 
 88: ISLAMU Event is built for white-label use:
 89: 
 90: - **Change instance name and domain**
 91: - **Customize logos, colors, and UI**
 92: - **Define your own categories, tags, and policies**
 93: - **Decide who can publish events and how verification works**
 94: 
 95: See [Configuration Guide][configuration-doc] for full customization options.
 96: 
 97: ## 🛡️ Enterprise Security & Compliance
 98: 
 99: We treat security as a first-class citizen, not an afterthought.
100: 
101: * **Identity & Access:** Managed via **Keycloak**, supporting MFA, Social Login, and SAML/LDAP integration.
102: * **Authorization:** Fine-grained access control (FGAC) powered by **Cerbos**: Policy Decision Point that coordinates unified policy-based authorization, allowing for complex "Who can do what" logic with human readable yaml for non technical users.
103: * **Data Integrity:** All database interactions use **Parameterized EF Core queries** to eliminate SQL injection.
104: * **Secret Management:** Zero hardcoded credentials; all secrets are injected at runtime via **Infisical**.
105: * **Observability:** Integrated **OpenTelemetry** for distributed tracing and real-time security monitoring.
106: 
107: ### Security Features
108: 
109: - **🔒 HTTPS Enforcement:** All traffic encrypted with HSTS
110: - **🔐 Modern Authentication:** OAuth 2.0/OIDC via Keycloak
111: - **🗝️ Secret Management:** Infisical vault for credentials
112: - **🛡️ Authorization:** Policy-based access control via Cerbos
113: - **🔍 Input Validation:** FluentValidation + ASP.NET Core model binding
114: - **🚫 SQL Injection Prevention:** Parameterized queries (EF Core)
115: - **🌐 CORS:** Configurable origin whitelist
116: - **⏱️ Rate Limiting:** ASP.NET Core middleware
117: 
118: ### Extensibility Model
119: 
120: Events use **composition over inheritance**:
121: 
122: ```
123: Event (Core)
124:   ├── IslamicDetails (optional aspect)
125:   ├── TechDetails (optional aspect)
126:   └── EducationalDetails (optional aspect)
127: ```
128: 
129: A "Ramadan Tech Workshop" has both Islamic and Tech aspects. No class explosion.
130: 
131: See [EXTENSIBILITY.md](docs/EXTENSIBILITY.md) and [MODULAR_EVENTS.md](docs/MODULAR_EVENTS.md).
132: 
133: ## 🚀 Quick Start
134: 
135: ### 🌐 Use Our Hosted Instance
136: 
137: Visit **[event.openislamu.org](https://event.openislamu.org)** to: 
138: - Browse events (no account needed)
139: - Create account to post events
140: - Register for events
141: - Follow organizations
142: 
143: ### 🖥️ Self-Host Your Instance (Advanced)
144: 
145: ```bash
146: # Clone the repository
147: git clone [https://github.com/islamu-ngo/Explore.git](https://github.com/islamu-ngo/Explore.git) && cd Explore
148: 
149: # Start without Object Storage (API, DB, Auth, UI...) And provide the secrets inside the Admin UI for Object Storage! 
150: docker-compose up -d
151: 
152: # Start the full stack (API, DB, Auth, UI, Object Storage...)
153: docker-compose up --profile storage -d
154: 
155: 
156: ```
157: 
158: See [Operations Guide][operations-doc] for full deployment instructions.
159:

161:

165:

171: 
172: ## 🤝 Contributing
173: 
174: There are many ways you can contribute to ISLAMU Event:
175: 
176: **Non-Technical:**

200: ## 📚 Documentation
201: 
202: Start here for deeper details and technical guides:
203: 
204: ### 📚 Core Docs
205: 
206: - **Project Overview**: [Master Reference][master-reference-doc] & [Project Context][project-doc]
207: - [Architecture][architecture-doc]
208: - [Governance][governance-doc]
209: - [Quick Reference][quick-reference-doc]
210: 
211: ### 📚 Platform Docs
212: 
213: - [Operations Guide][operations-doc]
214: - [Multi-Tenancy][multi-tenancy-doc]
215: - [Admin Hierarchy][admin-hierarchy-doc]
216: - [Deployment Modes][deployment-modes-doc]
217: - [Extensibility][extensibility-doc]
218: - [Modular Events][modular-events-doc]
219: - [Rendering Policies][render-policies-doc]
220: 
221: ### 📚 Reference Docs
222: 
223: - [API Reference][api-doc]
224: - [Domain Model][domain-doc]
225: - [Security][security-doc]
226: - [Configuration & Environment][configuration-doc]
227: - [Troubleshooting][troubleshooting-doc]
228: 
229: ## 🏗️ Technical Overview
230: 
231: ISLAMU Event is built on **Clean Architecture + CQRS** with a **BFF (Backend-for-Frontend)** pattern.
232: 
233: ### Stack
234: 
235: [- **Backend**: .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, MediatR, EF Core
236: - **Frontend**: Blazor Server + WASM, MudBlazor
237: - **Database**: PostgreSQL + PostGIS
238: - **AuthN**: Keycloak (OIDC/OAuth2)(Core: .NET 10 (LTS) & ASP.NET Core
239: - **AuthZ**: Cerbos (Policy Decision Point)
240: - **Secrets**: Infisical Vault
241: - **Observability**: Serilog, OpenTelemetry
242: 
243: ### The Request Lifecycle (CQRS)
244: We utilize **MediatR** for a decoupled command/query pipeline. This ensures that our business logic is isolated from transport layers (API/Blazor).
245: 
246: ```mermaid
247: graph TD
248:     subgraph Client_Layer [Presentation]
249:         A[Blazor WASM / Mobile] -->|HTTPS/REST| B[ASP.NET Core API]
250:     end
251: 
252:     subgraph Application_Layer [Business Logic]
253:         B -->|Command/Query| C[MediatR Pipeline]
254:         C -->|Validation| D[FluentValidation]
255:         D -->|Execution| E[Domain Handler]
256:     end
257: 
258:     subgraph Infrastructure_Layer [Data & Services]
259:         E -->|EF Core| F[(PostgreSQL + PostGIS)]
260:         E -->|OIDC| G[Keycloak]
261:         E -->|Events| H[Svix Webhooks]
262:     end
263: 
264:     E -.->|Future| I[ATProto / ActivityPub Gateway]
265: ```
266: 
267: ```mermaid
268: graph LR
269:     A[Request] --> B[Controller]
270:     B --> C[MediatR]
271:     C --> D[Handler]
272:     D --> E[Repository]
273:     E --> F[(PostgreSQL)]
274:     D --> G[Response]
275: ```

299:     private bool ValidateForm()
300:     {
301:         errorMessage = string.Empty;
302: 
303: 
304:         if (_publisherMode == "organization")
305:         {
306:             if (!_selectedOrganizationId.HasValue)
307:             {
308:                 errorMessage = "Please select an organization.";
309:                 return false;
310:             }
311:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_organizationRoleError))
312:             {
313:                 errorMessage = _organizationRoleError;
314:                 return false;
315:             }
316:         }
317: 
318: 
319: 
320:         if (sessions == null || !sessions.Any())
321:         {
322:             errorMessage = "You must add at least one session.";
323:             return false;
324:         }
325: 
326:         return true;
327:     }
328: 
329:     private async Task HandleSubmit()
330:     {
331:         if (!ValidateForm())
332:         {
333:             return;
334:         }
335: 
336: 
337:         if (_isUploadingImage)
338:         {
339:             errorMessage = "Please wait for the image upload to complete.";
340:             return;
341:         }
342: 
343:         if (isProcessing) return;
344:         isProcessing = true;
345:         errorMessage = string.Empty;
346:         StateHasChanged();
347: 
348:         try
349:         {
350: 
351:             Guid? featuredImageId = _uploadedImageStorageObjectId;
352: 
353:             if (featuredImageId.HasValue)
354:             {
355:                 Logger.LogInformation("Using pre-uploaded image. StorageObjectId: {StorageObjectId}", featuredImageId);
356:             }
357: 
358: 
359:             createDto.OrganizationId = _publisherMode == "organization" ? _selectedOrganizationId : null;
360:             createDto.FeaturedImageId = featuredImageId;
361:             createDto.MadhabId = selectedMadhabId;
362:             createDto.MetadataJson = EventAppearanceMetadataHelper.Upsert(createDto.MetadataJson, _appearance);
363: 
364: 
365:             var earliestStart = sessions.Min(s => DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(s.StartTime));
366:             var latestEnd = sessions.Max(s => DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(s.EndTime));
367: 
368:             createDto.FirstSessionDate = earliestStart;
369:             createDto.LastSessionDate = latestEnd;
370: 
371: 
372:             Logger.LogInformation("Creating event record (publisherMode={Mode}, organizationId={OrgId})", _publisherMode, createDto.OrganizationId);
373:             var response = await EventService.CreateEventAsync(createDto);
374: 
375:             if (response?.Success == true && response.Id.HasValue && response.Id != Guid.Empty)
376:             {
377:                 createdEventId = response.Id.Value;
378:                 Logger.LogInformation("Event created with ID: {EventId}", createdEventId);
379: 
380: 
381:                 var tenantId = Constants.TenantConstants.DefaultTenantId;
382:                 foreach (var categoryId in selectedCategoryIds)
383:                 {
384:                     await CategoryService.AssignCategoryToEventAsync(new { EventId = createdEventId, CategoryId = categoryId, TenantId = tenantId });
385:                 }
386: 
387: 
388:                 foreach (var tagId in selectedTagIds)
389:                 {
390:                     await TagService.AssignTagToEventAsync(new { EventId = createdEventId, TagId = tagId, TenantId = tenantId });
391:                 }
392: 
393: 
394:                 var existingSessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(createdEventId);
395:                 var defaultSession = existingSessions?.FirstOrDefault();
396: 
397: 
398:                 if (defaultSession != null && sessions.Count > 0)
399:                 {
400:                     var firstSessionModel = sessions[0];
401:                     firstSessionModel.Id = defaultSession.Id;
402: 
403:                     var updateDto = firstSessionModel.ToUpdateDto(createdEventId);
404:                     await EventService.UpdateSessionAsync(updateDto);
405: 
406:                     if (defaultSession.Id.HasValue)
407:                     {
408:                         await SaveSessionLanguages(firstSessionModel, defaultSession.Id.Value, tenantId);
409:                     }
410:                 }
411: 
412: 
413:                 for (int i = 1; i < sessions.Count; i++)
414:                 {
415:                     var sessionModel = sessions[i];
416:                     var createSessionDto = sessionModel.ToCreateDto(createdEventId, tenantId);
417:                     var createResponse = await EventService.CreateSessionAsync(createSessionDto);
418: 
419:                     if (createResponse?.Success == true && createResponse.Id.HasValue)
420:                     {
421:                         await SaveSessionLanguages(sessionModel, createResponse.Id.Value, tenantId);
422:                     }
423:                 }
424: 
425:                 Navigation.NavigateTo($"/event/detail/{createdEventId}");
426:             }
427:             else
428:             {
429:                 var errorMsg = response?.Message ?? "Failed to create event.";
430:                 if (response?.Errors != null && response.Errors.Any())
431:                 {
432:                     errorMsg += " Errors: " + string.Join(", ", response.Errors);
433:                 }
434:                 errorMessage = errorMsg;
435:             }
436:         }
437:         catch (Exception ex)
438:         {
439:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Exception during event creation");
440:             errorMessage = $"Error creating event: {ex.Message}";
441:         }
442:         finally
443:         {
444:             isProcessing = false;
445:             StateHasChanged();
446:         }
447:     }
448: 
449:     private async Task SaveSessionLanguages(SessionEditorModel session, Guid sessionId, Guid tenantId)
450:     {
451:         if (session.LanguageIds.Any())
452:         {
453:             foreach (var languageId in session.LanguageIds)
454:             {
455:                 try
456:                 {
457:                     await EventService.AssignLanguageToSessionAsync(new { EventSessionId = sessionId, LanguageId = languageId, TenantId = tenantId });
458:                 }
459:                 catch {  }
460:             }
461:         }
462:     }
463: 
464: 
465:     private void AddSession()
466:     {
467:         var defaultStart = DateTime.Today.AddDays(1).AddHours(9);
468:         var defaultEnd = DateTime.Today.AddDays(1).AddHours(17);
469: 
470:         if (sessions.Any())
471:         {
472:             var last = sessions.Last();
473:             defaultStart = last.StartTime.AddDays(1);
474:             defaultEnd = last.EndTime.AddDays(1);
475:         }
476: 
477:         sessions.Add(new SessionEditorModel
478:         {
479:             StartTime = defaultStart,
480:             EndTime = defaultEnd,
481:             RegistrationModeId = sessions.FirstOrDefault()?.RegistrationModeId ?? 1
482:         });
483:     }
484: 
485:     private async void RemoveSession(int index)
486:     {
487:         if (index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
488:         {
489:             if (sessions.Count <= 1)
490:             {
491:                 errorMessage = "You must have at least one session.";
492:                 return;
493:             }
494: 
495:             var session = sessions[index];
496: 
497:             if (session.Id.HasValue && session.Id != Guid.Empty)
498:             {
499:                 bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
500:                     "Delete Session",
501:                     "This session already exists. Deleting it here will remove it permanently. Continue?",
502:                     yesText: "Delete", cancelText: "Cancel");
503: 
504:                 if (confirm == true)
505:                 {
506:                     try
507:                     {
508:                         await EventService.DeleteSessionAsync(session.Id.Value);
509:                         sessions.RemoveAt(index);
510:                         StateHasChanged();
511:                     }
512:                     catch (Exception ex)
513:                     {
514:                         errorMessage = $"Failed to delete session: {ex.Message}";
515:                     }
516:                 }
517:             }
518:             else
519:             {
520:                 sessions.RemoveAt(index);
521:                 StateHasChanged();
522:             }
523:         }
524:     }
525: 
526:     private void OnSessionChanged(int index, SessionEditorModel session)
527:     {
528:         if (index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
529:         {
530:             sessions[index] = session;
531:         }
532:     }
533: 
534:     private string GetPublisherDescription()
535:     {
536:         if (_publisherMode == "personal")
537:             return "Publishing as yourself (User Reported)";
538: 
539:         if (_selectedOrganizationId.HasValue && _myOrganizations != null)
540:         {
541:             var org = _myOrganizations.FirstOrDefault(o => o.Id == _selectedOrganizationId.Value);
542:             if (org != null) return $"Publishing for {org.FullName}";
543:         }
544: 
545:         return "Select who is publishing this event";
546:     }
547:

549: }

## File: CLAUDE.md
````markdown
  1: # CLAUDE.md — ISLAMU Event Project Reference
  2: 
  3: > **Source of Truth for AI Agents and Team Collaboration**
  4: >
  5: > This document provides comprehensive context for working with the ISLAMU Event codebase.
  6: > This file is the entrypoint. Detailed docs are imported from `docs/`.
  7: > Last Updated: January 2026
  8: 
  9: You are an experienced, pragmatic software engineer. You don’t over-engineer a solution when a simple one works.
 10: 
 11: 
 12: ## Documentation Template System
 13: 
 14: This project uses **project-agnostic documentation** with placeholder syntax `{Placeholder}`.
 15: **Template Glossary**: [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md) - Defines all placeholders
 16: 
 17: 
 18: **Documentation Coverage**:
 19: - ✅ Core Docs: ARCHITECTURE.md, API.md, BLAZOR.md, GOVERNANCE.md, QUICK_REFERENCE.md
 20: - ✅ Operations: CONTRIBUTING.md, OPERATIONS.md, CONFIGURATION.md, TROUBLESHOOTING.md
 21: - ✅ Domain Reference: DOMAIN.md (project-specific with generic patterns)
 22: - ✅ Skills: blazor-bff-patterns (SKILL.md + 4 resources), and 7 other skills
 23: - ✅ All use "Generic Template + Concrete Example" pattern
 24: 
 25: ## ⚠️ CRITICAL RULES - Quick Reference
 26: 
 27: **MUST READ**: Never violate them.
 28: 
 29: 
 30: > ⚠️ **Rule #1:** Never assume an exception. Get explicit permission from me before breaking or bending any rule.
 31: 
 32: - Only write inside this repo project folder, never in users folder (not in C:\Users\*\.claude\ or anywhere outside this project folder)
 33: - When getting build errors, stop building! Get the errors, fix them, skip building until fixed. Limited retry attempts, then fix without building until confident.
 34: - NEVER run rm -rf commands or delete files/folders unless explicitly instructed - instead report files that should be deleted
 35: - Never write scripts or execute scripts files!
 36: 
 37: **Some Technical API Rules**:
 38: 1. **Repositories Return ENTITIES, Never DTOs** - Map to DTOs in handlers
 39: 2. **Validators Use Manual Instantiation (NOT DI)** - `var validator = new CreateEventDtoValidator(_repo1, _repo2);`
 40: 3. **Navigation Properties Are Readonly** - Use repository for writes: `_memberRepository.Create(member)`
 41: 4. **Use int Instead of long** - Except size/cursor fields or absolutely necessary
 42: 5. **No Default Values in Domain Entities** - Set in handler: `@event.TotalViews = 0;`
 43: 6. **Commands Return BaseCommandResponse<Guid>** - Not just `Guid`
 44: 7. **GET = AllowAnonymous, Write = Authorize, Admin = Roles** - Public read, protected write, role-based for admin operations
 45: 8. **Extract UserId with Fallback** - `sub` → `nameidentifier` → `sid`
 46: 9. **File-Scoped Namespaces** - `namespace Explore.Application.Features.Events;`
 47: 10. **Entities Include Auditing Fields** - CreatedAt, CreatedBy, UpdatedAt, UpdatedBy, IsDeleted (soft delete)
 48: 11. **Use Named Query Filters for Soft Delete** - EF Core 10+ `.HasQueryFilter(name: "SoftDelete", predicate: e => !e.IsDeleted)`
 49: **Full Details**: [@docs/QUICK_REFERENCE.md](docs/QUICK_REFERENCE.md)
 50: 
 51: ---
 52: 
 53: ## 🧱 Foundational Rules
 54: 
 55: - Doing it right is better than doing it fast. You are not in a rush.
 56: - Never skip steps or take shortcuts.
 57: - Tedious, systematic work is often the correct solution. Don't abandon an approach because it's repetitive—only if it's wrong.
 58: - **One question at a time** - When gathering requirements or clarifying design, ask questions individually. Wait for each answer before proceeding to the next question.
 59: - Honesty is a core value. If you're not fully truthful, our collaboration can't continue.
 60:

 62: 
 63: ## 🤝 Our Relationship
 64: 
 65: - We are colleagues — equals working toward the same goal.
 66: - Speak up immediately when you don’t know something or are over your head.
 67: - Call out bad ideas, mistakes, or unreasonable expectations. I highly depends on this.
 68: - Never agree just to be nice. Honest disagreement is better than fake consensus.
 69: - If you disagree, cite technical reasons. If it’s intuition, say so.
 70: - You have unreliable memory. Use your **journal** (`dev/_journal/journal.md`) to record important facts, insights, and preferences before you forget. 
 71: - Search your journal before repeating research or reasoning.
 72: - Discuss all **Important decisions** (refactors...) before implementation **or** before finalizing requirements that assume a particular approach.
 73: - When something is identified as "a major decision" elevate its priority immediately.
 74:
