 76: 
 77: ## 🔧 Starting Work (Critical First Steps)
 78: 
 79: **Before starting ANY task, always build and run tests:**
 80: 
 81: 1. **Build first** (catches compilation errors with clear output):
 82: ```bash
 83: dotnet build --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 84: ```
 85: 
 86: 2. **Run each test project individually** (do NOT use solution-level `dotnet test` — it fails if any project has issues):
 87: ```bash
 88: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 89: dotnet test --project Event.Domain.UnitTests/Event.Domain.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 90: dotnet test --project Event.Architecture.Tests/Event.Architecture.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 91: dotnet test --project Explore.Secrets.UnitTests/Explore.Secrets.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 92: dotnet test --project Event.Persistence.IntegrationTests/Event.Persistence.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 93: dotnet test --project Event.API.IntegrationTests/Event.API.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 94: dotnet test --project Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests/Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 95: ```
 96: 
 97: 3. **If tests are failing — get detailed failure info:**
 98: ```bash
 99: # Generate TRX report for detailed failure analysis
100: dotnet test --project <ProjectPath> --configuration Release -- --report-trx --report-trx-filename results.trx
101: 
102: # Then search TRX for failed tests (use Grep tool on the TRX file):
103: #   Pattern: outcome="Failed"  → finds failed test entries
104: #   Pattern: className=        → correlate testId to get full Class.Method names
105: #   Pattern: <Message>         → read error messages and stack traces
106: ```
107: 
108: 4. **If tests are failing:**
109:    - **STOP your planned work**
110:    - Fix the failing tests FIRST
111:    - Document what was broken and how you fixed it
112:    - Then resume your planned work
113: 5. **If tests are passing:**
114:    - Proceed with your work
115:    - Run tests frequently during development
116: 
117: **Important notes:**
118: - Always use `--project` flag (positional project arguments don't work reliably)
119: - Use `--verbosity quiet` for clean pass/fail summaries
120: - Use `--verbosity normal` when you need to see error details inline
121: - Solution-level `dotnet test` will fail if any test project has MSBuild issues (e.g., placeholder projects)
122: - On French-locale Windows, `findstr /i` may not work — use exact case patterns instead
123: 
124: **Why this matters:**
125: - Broken tests indicate the codebase is in an unknown state
126: - Your changes built on broken tests compound the problem
127: - It's unclear if YOUR changes break things or if they were already broken
128: - Fixing tests first establishes a known-good baseline
129: 
130: **Example workflow:**
131: ```bash
132: # Start of session — build first
133: dotnet build --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
134: 
135: # Run tests per project
136: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
137: 
138: # ❌ 3 tests failing? Generate TRX for details:
139: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release -- --report-trx --report-trx-filename results.trx
140: 
141: # Search TRX for failures (use Grep tool, not bash grep)
142: # Fix the failing tests FIRST, then resume your work
143: ```

146: 
147: ## 🚀 Proactiveness
148: 
149: When assigned a task, **do it completely**, including obvious follow-ups. However, distinguish between:
150: 
151: **Implementation tasks** (be proactive):
152: - "Fix this bug"
153: - "Add this feature"
154: - "Write tests for X"
155: - "Refactor this code"
156: 
157: **Design/planning tasks** (be systematic, not proactive):
158: - "Let's discuss architecture"
159: - "Help me design X"
160: - "What are the requirements for Y?"
161: - "Let's talk about..."
162: 
163: For design/planning: Pause and ask questions one at a time. Don't create implementations, templates, or code until explicitly requested or requirements are finalized.
164: 
165: Follow the prd skill at .claude/skills/prd/SKILL.md when planning
166: 
167: Pause to ask for confirmation when:
168: - Multiple valid approaches exist and the choice matters.
169: - The action deletes or restructures existing code.
170: - You genuinely don't understand the task.
171: - explicitly asked "how should I approach X?" — answer the question, don't start coding.
172: - You're in **requirements gathering mode** - always wait for explicit direction.
173: 
174: Act autonomously for clear, low-risk tasks. Stop and ask when changes affect architecture, data integrity, or long-term behavior.
175: 
176: ---
177: 
178: ## 📝 Requirements Gathering
179: 
180: When designing new features or systems:
181: 
182: - **One question at a time** - Never batch multiple questions. Wait for answer before proceeding.
183: - **Document as you go** - Capture decisions in real-time in a dedicated requirements document.
184: - **Don't get ahead of yourself** - Resist the urge to implement or create templates before requirements are complete.
185: - **Systematic over ad-hoc** - Work through structured questionnaires methodically.
186: - **I may enhance your options** - Be open to improving or adding to the options you propose.
187: - **Requirements before implementation** - Complete and review all requirements before any coding begins.
188: 
189: ---
190: 
191: ## 🧩 Designing Software
192: 
193: - **YAGNI** – "You Ain't Gonna Need It." The best code is no code.
194: - When possible, architect for **extensibility and flexibility**, but never preemptively.
195: 
196: ---
197: 
198: ## ✅ Test-Driven Development (TDD)
199: 
200: For every new feature or bugfix:
201: 
202: 1. Write a failing test validating the desired behavior.  
203: 2. Run it to confirm failure.  
204: 3. Write *only* enough code to make the test pass.  
205: 4. Run tests to confirm success.  
206: 5. Refactor if needed while keeping tests green.
207: 
208: You may skip TDD only with given explicit permission.
209: 
210: ---
211: 
212: ## 💻 Writing Code
213: 
214: - Verify you have followed **all rules** before submitting work.
215: - Make the **smallest reasonable changes** to achieve the desired result.
216: - Prefer simple, clean, maintainable code over clever or complex solutions.
217: - **Eliminate duplication aggressively:**
218:   - Never copy-paste code - extract and import instead
219:   - If the same logic appears twice, prepare to extract on third usage
220:   - Before creating a new file with similar purpose, refactor the existing file
221:   - Search codebase thoroughly before implementing functionality that might already exist
222: - Never throw away or rewrite code without permission (except trivial cleanup or bugfixes).
223: - Get approval before implementing **backward compatibility**.
224: - Match the surrounding code style. Local consistency beats external style guides.
225: - Don't manually adjust whitespace unless necessary; use a formatter instead: `dotnet format`.
226: - Fix broken things immediately when you find them.
227: 
228: **Error handling:** Code must fail fast, log clearly, and handle expected errors gracefully.
229: 
230: ---
231: 
232: ## 🗂️ File Management & Organization
233: 
234: ### Before Creating a New File
235: 
236: **STOP and ask these questions:**
237: 
238: 1. **Does a similar file already exist?**
239:    - Search the codebase thoroughly: `grep -r "class ClassName"`, `find . -name "*keyword*"`
240:    - If similar file exists, **extend it** rather than duplicate
241: 
242: 2. **Will this create duplication?**
243:    - If implementing similar functionality to an existing file, **refactor the existing file** instead
244:    - Never create `FileV2.cs`, `FileEnhanced.cs`, `FileNew.cs` - these indicate you should be editing the original
245:    - Bad: Creating both `WordPressClient.cs` and `WordPressEnhanced.cs`
246:    - Good: Enhancing the existing `WordPressClient.cs`
247: 
248: 3. **Is this a test file?**
249:    - **Ad-hoc test scripts → NO**: Put in proper test project
250:    - **Integration/manual tests → MAYBE**: Only if truly cannot be automated
251:    - **Never** create scripts for unit tests
252: 
253: 4. **Is this a backup or temporary file?**
254:    - Use git branches and history, not backup files
255:    - Add patterns to `.gitignore` immediately
256: 
257: ### Red Flags - Stop and Refactor
258: 
259: If you're writing and notice:
260: 
261: - ⚠️  "This is similar to what this part of the books is about..."
262: - ⚠️  "I'll just copy this from here..."
263: - ⚠️  "There's probably already a chapter or page for this..."
264: - ⚠️  "This feels like I've written it before..."
265: 
266: **STOP** - Search the Book first
267:

302: 
303: ## 🔬 Research and Recommendations
304: 
305: When researching tools, technologies, or approaches:
306: 
307: - **Document comprehensively** - Create dedicated markdown files with findings.
308: - **Provide context** - Executive summary tailored to Author's specific workflow and preferences.
309: - **Compare systematically** - Use tables/matrices for clear comparison.
310: - **Recommendation clarity** - Be explicit about what you recommend and why.
311: - **Ask clarifying questions** - End research with specific questions to guide next steps.
312: - **Don't assume Author's workflow** - Ask about primary tools and preferences before making assumptions.
313: 
314: ---
315: 
316: ### When Replacing/Deprecating Files
317: 
318: If creating a replacement file (e.g., `new-cli.cs` replacing `old-script.cs`):
319: 
320: 1. **Delete the old file in the same PR** - Don't leave both
321: 2. **Update all imports** that referenced the old file
322: 4. **Update documentation** to reference only the new file
323: 5. **Add migration notes** to git commit message
324: 
325: ### Duplication Detection Checklist
326: 
327: Before submitting code, check for these duplication patterns:
328: 
329: - [ ] **Complete file duplication** - Same class name in two files
330: - [ ] **Logic duplication** - Same algorithm copied between files (>20 lines)
331: - [ ] **Constant duplication** - Same constants defined in multiple files
332: 
333: **Rule of Three**: If the same code appears **3 times**, extract it to a shared utility following asp.net core conventions and clean architecture and this repo' convention. If it appears **twice** and you're adding a third, extract **before** adding.
334: 
335: ---
336: 
337: ## 📦 Shared Logic & Abstraction
338: 
339: ### Mandatory Extraction Scenarios
340: 
341: Extract shared logic when:
342: 
343: 1. **Same logic in 2+ files AND you're adding a 3rd usage**
344:    - Extract **before** adding the third copy
345:    - Example: `chunkArray` used in 3 places
346: 
347: 2. **Same class structure in 2+ files** (>100 lines shared)
348:    - Create abstract base class with shared logic
349:    - Example: LocalWhisper + MLXWhisper both traverse directories identically
350: 
351: 3. **Same algorithm repeated** (>20 lines)
352:    - Extract to shared function
353:    - Example: Retry logic, error handling patterns
354: 
355: 4. **Same constants/config in 2+ files**
356:    - Extract to shared file
357:    - Example: `FILE_STATUS` constants, supported file extensions
358: 
359: ### Abstraction Guidelines
360: 
361: - **Base classes** for shared **implementation** (template method pattern)
362: - **Interfaces** for shared **contracts** (dependency inversion)
363: - **Utility functions** for shared **algorithms** (pure functions)
364: - **Never** copy-paste similar code - refactor to share instead
365: 
366: ### Red Flags - Stop and Refactor
367: 
368: If you're writing code and notice:
369: 
370: - ⚠️  "This is similar to what `FileX.cs` does..."
371: - ⚠️  "I'll just copy this logic from here..."
372: - ⚠️  "There's probably already a function for this..."
373: - ⚠️  "This feels like I've written it before..."
374: 
375: **STOP** - Search the codebase first, then extract shared logic.
376: 
377: ---
378: 
379: ## 🧠 Naming
380: 
381: - Names must express **what** code does, not **how** it works or its history.
382: - Don’t reference implementation details unless essential to meaning.
383: - Avoid temporal or comparative names (“NewController”, “LegacyHandler”, “EnhancedService”).
384: - Avoid pattern names unless they improve clarity.
385: 
386: ---
387: 
388: ## 💬 Code Comments
389: 
390: Comments explain **what** or **why**, never **how it changed** or **what used to be**.
391: 
392: - Don’t reference prior implementations (“refactored from…”, “used x instead of…”).
393: - Don’t add meta-comments like “improved”, “better”, “new”, or “enhanced.”
394: - Don’t leave instructional comments (“use this pattern”).
395: - Remove outdated comments only when they describe behavior that no longer exists.
396: - Don’t add temporal context (“recently refactored”, “moved”, “new”).
397: - All files must start with a **two-line summary** beginning with `ABOUTME:` describing what the file does.
398: 
399: **Examples:**
400: ```csharp
401: // BAD: This uses FluentValidator for validation instead of manual checking
402: // BAD: Refactored from old validation system
403: // GOOD: Executes tools with validated arguments
404: ```
405: 
406: If you find yourself writing “new”, “old”, “legacy”, “wrapper”, “unified”, or “enhanced”, stop and find a better description.
407: 
408: ---
409: 
410: ## 🧰 Version Control
411: 
412: - Ask how to handle uncommitted or untracked files before starting work.
413: - If no branch exists for your task, create a **WIP** branch.
414: - Track all non-trivial changes in git.
415: - Commit frequently and atomically, with meaningful messages describing intent.
416: - Never skip or disable pre-commit hooks.
417: - Never use `git add -A` without first running `git status`.
418: - **Never commit backup or temporary files:**
419:   - Use `.gitignore` to prevent accidental commits
420:   - If you see these in git, delete them immediately
421: - **Clean up deprecated code in the same commit:**
422:   - When adding a replacement file, delete the old one in the same PR
423:   - Update all references to point to new implementation
424:   - Remove old exports from barrel files
425:

427: 
428: ## 🧪 Testing
429: 
430: ### Testing Standards
431: 
432: **CRITICAL RULE: Never commit or push with broken tests**
433: 
434: - **All test failures are YOUR responsibility**, even if you didn't cause them
435: - If tests are broken when you start work, fix them FIRST before proceeding
436: - If you break tests during your work, fix them IMMEDIATELY
437: - If tests break during your work for unrelated reasons, fix them before committing
438: - **Never** commit with the intention of "fixing tests in the next commit"
439: - **Never** push broken tests to any branch (including WIP branches)
440: 
441: **Test Quality Standards:**
442: 
443: - Never delete failing tests — raise the issue with me.
444: - Tests must cover all functionality comprehensively.
445: - Never test mocked behavior; test real logic.
446: - Never mock in end-to-end tests — use real APIs and data.
447: - Never ignore logs or output — they often reveal the issue.
448: - Test output must be **pristine** (no unexpected warnings or stack traces).
449: - Intermittent failures count as full failures until proven otherwise.
450: 
451: ---
452: 
453: ## 📋 Issue Tracking
454: 
455: ### GitHub Issues for Work Items
456: 
457: **Use GitHub Issues for all significant work:**
458: 
459: - Create issues for features, bugs, refactors, and technical debt
460: - **Break down to smallest complete unit of work** - each issue should be:
461:   - Completable in a single PR
462:   - Independently testable
463:   - Deployable without dependencies (when possible)
464:   - Estimated at 4 hours or less of work
465: - If a task is larger than 4 hours, break it into multiple issues
466: - Link related issues together (e.g., "Part 1 of 3: Delete duplicate files")
467: 
468: **Good issue breakdown:**
469: - ✅ "Delete duplicate client implementation"
470: - ✅ "Update imports after client deletion"
471: - ✅ "Remove client from barrel exports" (15 min)
472: 
473: **Bad issue breakdown:**
474: - ❌ "Fix all architectural issues" (too large, not specific)
475: - ❌ "Refactor transcribers and fix tests and update docs" (multiple units of work)
476: 
477: 
478: ## 🔍 Systematic Debugging Process
479: 
480: Always find the **root cause** — never patch symptoms or add workarounds.
481: 
482: ### Phase 1: Root Cause Investigation
483: - Read error messages carefully.
484: - Reproduce consistently.
485: - Check recent changes (`git diff`, commits).
486: 
487: ### Phase 2: Pattern Analysis
488: - Find similar working examples.
489: - Compare against reference code.
490: - Identify differences.
491: - Understand dependencies.
492: 
493: ### Phase 3: Hypothesis and Testing
494: 1. Form one hypothesis at a time.  
495: 2. Make the smallest possible change to test it.  
496: 3. Verify results before continuing.  
497: 4. If you don’t know, say “I don’t understand X.”
498: 
499: ### Phase 4: Implementation
500: - Always have a minimal failing test case.  
501: - Never add multiple fixes at once.  
502: - Never claim to follow a pattern without reading it fully.  
503: - Test after every change.  
504: - If the first fix fails, re-analyze instead of stacking patches.
505:

563: ## 🗄️ Code Archeology & Cleanup
564: 
565: ### When Making Changes, Look for Obsolete Code
566: 
567: While working in a file, actively search for:
568: 
569: 1. **Unused imports** - Remove immediately
570: 2. **Commented-out code** - Delete (it's in git history)
571: 3. **Dead functions** - Delete if no references found
572: 4. **Backup files** - Never commit
573: 5. **TODO comments older than 3 months** - Convert to GitHub issues or delete
574: 6. **Deprecated patterns** - Refactor to current standards
575: 
576: ### Spotting Obsolete Code Patterns
577: 
578: These patterns indicate obsolete code to delete:
579: 
580: - Files with "old", "legacy", "deprecated" in name
581: - Commented-out imports or functions
582: - Duplicate implementations of same interface
583: - Multiple files exporting the same class name
584: 
585: ### Regular Maintenance (Requested)
586: 
587: Periodically ask to run architectural reviews:
588: 
589: > "Would you like me to scan for duplicate code and obsolete files?"
590: 
591: This prevents accumulation of technical debt.
592:

594: 
595: ## 🏗️ Architectural Hygiene
596: 
597: ### Pre-Implementation Checklist
598: 
599: Before implementing a new feature or significant change:
600: 
601: - [ ] **Search for existing implementations**: `grep -r "class Name"`, `find . -name "*keyword*"`
602: - [ ] **Review similar features**: Understand patterns already in use
603: - [ ] **Identify shared logic**: Will this duplicate any existing functionality?
604: - [ ] **Plan for reuse**: How can this be designed to avoid future duplication?
605: 
606: ### Post-Implementation Checklist
607: 
608: After implementing a feature:
609: 
610: - [ ] **Delete obsolete code**: If replacing functionality, delete old implementation
611: - [ ] **Update all references**: Ensure no dangling imports to deleted code
612: - [ ] **Extract duplicates**: If logic is similar to existing code, refactor to share
613: - [ ] **Clean up test scaffolding**: Delete ad-hoc test scripts if proper tests exist
614: - [ ] **Update documentation**: Remove references to deleted/obsolete files
615: - [ ] **Verify exports**: Remove deleted files from `index.ts` barrel exports
616: 
617: ### Red Flags - Request Architectural Review
618: 
619: If you notice any of these, suggest an architectural review:
620: 
621: - Multiple files with same/similar class names
622: - Same schema/type defined in 2+ places
623: - 3+ test testing similar functionality
624: - Logic duplicated across files (>50 lines)
625: 
626: **Phrase to use:**
627: > "I noticed [pattern]. Would you like me to do an architectural review to identify duplication and suggest consolidation?"

699: # 🛠️ Specialized Tooling (MCP)
700: 
701: ALWAYS use these mcp servers for their specific purposes when applicable! NEVER bypass then when applicable. For example, if you need to work on tests, use Context7 mcp to find TUnit or BUnit documentation:
702: 
703: * **Context7**: Auto-use for documentation!, for libraries docs, setup steps, and complex library configs.
704: * **Sequential Thinking**: Multi-step architecture, debugging, and refining hypotheses.
705: * **Tavily**: Web scraping and data extraction.
706: * **Perplexity**: Broad technical research and modern programming concepts.
707: * **At-Explore**: ATProto integration and debugging.
708: * **Playwrighter**: UI testing and automated web interactions (on request only).
709: * **Chrome-DevTools**: Blazor frontend inspection and CSS/JS troubleshooting (on request only).
710: 
711: ## Context, plans, and task management
712: ALWAYS refer to this file and all the files in @dev/active/ that contain context, plan, tasks...
713: @dev/active/README.md
714: 
715: ALWAYS use the correct tools available for editing files or other actions, never bash or other manual methods when a tool is available.
716: 
717: # SHELL BEHAVIOR RULES
718: 1. **FORBIDDEN COMMANDS:** You are strictly forbidden from using:
719:    - `rm` (remove)
720:    - `rm -rf`
721:    - `mv` (move/overwrite without checking)
722:    - `> ` (overwrite redirection)
723: 
724: Instead: report to user wich files should be removed at the end of your response!

107:                             {

109:                                 regMap[reg.EventId.Value] = reg.Id.Value;
110:                             }

114:                     }
115:                 }

154: 
155:             allEvents = await eventsTask ?? new List<EventListDto>();
156:             eventTypes = await eventTypesTask ?? new List<EventTypeListDto>();
157:             eventFormats = await eventFormatsTask ?? new List<EventFormatListDto>();
158:             categories = await categoriesTask ?? new List<CategoryListDto>();
159:             tags = await tagsTask ?? new List<TagListDto>();
160:             madhabs = await madhabsTask ?? new List<MadhabListDto>();
161:             locations = await locationsTask ?? new List<LocationListDto>();
162:             registrationModes = await registrationModesTask ?? new List<RegistrationModeListDto>();
163:             languages = await languagesTask ?? new List<LanguageListDto>();
164:             allSessions = await sessionsTask ?? new List<EventSessionListDto>();
165:             sessionLanguages = (await sessionLanguagesTask)?.Cast<EventSessionLanguageListDto>().ToList() ?? new List<EventSessionLanguageListDto>();

178:         }

181:     private List<EventListDto> AllFilteredEvents
182:     {
183:         get
184:         {
185:             if (_filtersDirty)
186:             {
187:                 _cachedFilteredEvents = ComputeFilteredEvents();
188:                 _filtersDirty = false;
189:             }
190:             return _cachedFilteredEvents;
191:         }
192:     }
193: 
194:     private void InvalidateFilterCache()
195:     {
196:         _filtersDirty = true;
197:         displayedCount = loadBatchSize;
198:     }
199: 
200:     private List<EventListDto> ComputeFilteredEvents()
201:     {
202:         var filteredEvents = allEvents ?? Enumerable.Empty<EventListDto>();
203: 
204:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchText))
205:         {
206:             filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e =>
207:                 e.Title.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
208:                 (e.Description?.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
209:         }
210: 
211:         if (selectedCategoryId.HasValue)
212:         {
213:             if (eventsByCategory != null && eventsByCategory.Any())
214:             {
215:                 var categoryEventIds = eventsByCategory.Select(e => e.Id).ToHashSet();
216:                 filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => categoryEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
217:             }
218:             else if (!isLoadingCategory)
219:             {
220:                 filteredEvents = Enumerable.Empty<EventListDto>();
221:             }
222:         }
223: 
224:         if (selectedTagId.HasValue)
225:         {
226:             if (eventsByTag != null && eventsByTag.Any())
227:             {
228:                 var tagEventIds = eventsByTag.Select(e => e.Id).ToHashSet();
229:                 filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => tagEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
230:             }
231:             else if (!isLoadingTag)
232:             {
233:                 filteredEvents = Enumerable.Empty<EventListDto>();
234:             }
235:         }
236: 
237:         if (selectedFormatId.HasValue)
238:         {
239:             filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => e.EventFormatId == selectedFormatId.Value);
240:         }
241: 
242:         if (selectedMadhabId.HasValue)
243:         {
244:             filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => e.MadhabId == selectedMadhabId.Value);
245:         }
246: 
247:         if (selectedLocationId.HasValue && allSessions.Any())
248:         {
249:             var locationEventIds = allSessions
250:                 .Where(s => s.LocationId == selectedLocationId.Value)
251:                 .Select(s => s.EventId)
252:                 .ToHashSet();
253:             filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => locationEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
254:         }
255: 
256:         if (selectedRegistrationModeId.HasValue && allSessions.Any())
257:         {
258:             var registrationEventIds = allSessions
259:                 .Where(s => s.RegistrationModeId == selectedRegistrationModeId.Value)
260:                 .Select(s => s.EventId)
261:                 .ToHashSet();
262:             filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => registrationEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
263:         }
264: 
265:         if (selectedLanguageId.HasValue && allSessions.Any() && sessionLanguages.Any())
266:         {
267:             var languageSessionIds = sessionLanguages
268:                 .Where(l => l.LanguageId == selectedLanguageId.Value)
269:                 .Select(l => l.EventSessionId)
270:                 .ToHashSet();
271:             var languageEventIds = allSessions
272:                 .Where(s => languageSessionIds.Contains(s.Id))
273:                 .Select(s => s.EventId)
274:                 .ToHashSet();
275:             filteredEvents = filteredEvents.Where(e => languageEventIds.Contains(e.Id));
276:         }
277: 
278:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedDate))
279:         {
280:             var today = DateTimeOffset.Now.Date;
281:             filteredEvents = selectedDate switch
282:             {
283:                 "today" => filteredEvents.Where(e => e.FirstSessionDate.HasValue && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date == today),
284:                 "tomorrow" => filteredEvents.Where(e => e.FirstSessionDate.HasValue && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date == today.AddDays(1)),
285:                 "thisweek" => filteredEvents.Where(e => e.FirstSessionDate.HasValue && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date >= today && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date <= today.AddDays(7)),
286:                 "thismonth" => filteredEvents.Where(e => e.FirstSessionDate.HasValue && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date >= today && e.FirstSessionDate.Value.Date <= today.AddDays(30)),
287:                 _ => filteredEvents
288:             };
289:         }
290: 
291:         return filteredEvents.ToList();
292:     }

406:     {
407:         if (!evt.Id.HasValue) return;
408:         var sessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(evt.Id.Value);
409:         if (sessions == null || !sessions.Any())
410:         {
411:             _errorMessage = "No sessions available for this event yet.";
412:             return;
413:         }
414:         var primarySession = sessions.First();
415:         var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["EventSessionId"] = primarySession.Id, ["Title"] = $"Register for {evt.Title}" };
416:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseOnEscapeKey = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true };
417:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.EventRegistration>("Register", parameters, options);
418:         var result = await dialog.Result;
419:         if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
420:         {
421:             _successMessage = "Successfully registered for event!";
422:             await LoadUserRegistrationsAsync();
423:             StateHasChanged();
424:         }
425:     }
426: 
427:     private async Task CancelRegistrationAsync(EventListDto evt)
428:     {
429:         if (!evt.Id.HasValue) return;
430:         var eventId = evt.Id.Value;
431: 
432:         if (!_registrationIdByEventId.TryGetValue(eventId, out var registrationId))
433:         {
434:             _errorMessage = "Registration not found.";
435:             return;
436:         }
437: 
438:         var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
439:             "Cancel Registration",
440:             $"Are you sure you want to cancel your registration for \"{evt.Title}\"?",
441:             yesText: "Cancel Registration",
442:             cancelText: "Keep Registration");
443: 
444:         if (confirm != true) return;
445: 
446:         _isCancellingRegistration = true;
447:         StateHasChanged();
448: 
449:         try
450:         {
451:             var success = await EventService.CancelEventRegistrationAsync(registrationId);
452:             if (success)
453:             {
454:                 _registeredEventIds.Remove(eventId);
455:                 _registrationIdByEventId.Remove(eventId);
456:                 _successMessage = "Registration cancelled.";
457:             }
458:             else
459:             {
460:                 _errorMessage = "Failed to cancel registration. Please try again.";
461:             }
462:         }
463:         catch (Exception ex)
464:         {
465:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error cancelling registration for event {EventId}", eventId);
466:             _errorMessage = "An error occurred while cancelling registration.";
467:         }
468:         finally
469:         {
470:             _isCancellingRegistration = false;
471:             StateHasChanged();
472:         }
473:     }
474: 
475:     private string GetEventTypeName(EventListDto eventItem)
476:     {
477:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventItem.EventTypeFullName)) return eventItem.EventTypeFullName;
478:         if (eventItem.EventTypeId.HasValue && eventTypeMap.TryGetValue(eventItem.EventTypeId.Value, out var eventTypeName))
479:             return eventTypeName;
480:         return "Event";
481:     }
482: 
483:     private string GetLocationText(EventListDto eventItem)
484:     {
485:         if (eventItem.EventFormatId == 2) return "Online";
486:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventItem.EventFormatFullName)) return eventItem.EventFormatFullName;
487:         if (eventItem.EventFormatId.HasValue && eventFormatMap.TryGetValue(eventItem.EventFormatId.Value, out var formatName))
488:             return formatName;
489:         return "Location TBD";
490:     }
491: 
492:     private string GetEventImage(EventListDto eventItem)
493:     {
494:         return ImageHelper.GetEventImageUrl(eventItem.FeaturedImageUri, eventItem.Title, GetEventColorForEvent(eventItem));
495:     }
496: 
497:     private string GetEventColorForEvent(EventListDto eventItem)
498:     {
499:         var color = EventColorHelper.GetColorByTypeId(eventItem.EventTypeId);
500:         return color != EventColorHelper.DefaultColor ? color : EventColorHelper.GetColorByHash(eventItem.Title);
501:     }
502: 
503:     private string GetTruncatedDescription(string? description)
504:     {
505:         return StringHelper.TruncateDescription(description);
506:     }
507: 
508:     private string GetActorInitials(string? displayName)
509:     {
510:         return DisplayHelper.GetInitials(displayName);
511:     }
512: }

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/EventDetail.razor.cs
````csharp
  1: using Blazouter.Services;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
  3: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Event;
  4: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers;
  5: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  6: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts;
  7: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  8: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  9: using MudBlazor;
 10: 
 11: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Event;
 12: 
 13: 
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17: public partial class EventDetail : ComponentBase
 18: {
 19:     [Inject] private NavigationManager Navigation { get; set; } = default!;
 20:     [Inject] private IEventService EventService { get; set; } = default!;
 21:     [Inject] private IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = default!;
 22:     [Inject] private IMapsService MapsService { get; set; } = default!;
 23:     [Inject] private RouterStateService RouterState { get; set; } = default!;
 24:     [Inject] private IUserService UserService { get; set; } = default!;
 25:     [Inject] private Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization.AuthenticationStateProvider AuthStateProvider { get; set; } = default!;
 26:     [Inject] private IEventAspectService EventAspectService { get; set; } = default!;
 27: 
 28: 
 29:     [Inject] protected ILogger<EventDetail> Logger { get; set; } = default!;
 30: 
 31:     private Guid EventId { get; set; }
 32: 
 33:     private EventDto? _eventDetails;
 34:     private ICollection<EventSessionListDto>? _eventSessions;
 35:     private EventSessionListDto? _primarySession;
 36:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 37:     private bool _isUserRegistered;
 38:     private bool _isCheckingRegistration = true;
 39:     private bool _isCancellingRegistration = false;
 40:     private List<Guid> _userRegistrationIds = new();
 41:     private bool _canDelete = false;
 42:     private bool _canEdit = false;
 43:     private bool _isCheckingAuth = true;
 44:     private string? _errorMessage;
 45: 
 46: 
 47:     private EventIslamicAspectDto? _islamicAspect;
 48:     private EventTechAspectDto? _techAspect;
 49:     private EventAppearanceSettings _appearance = new();
 50: 
 51: 
 52: 
 53: 
 54:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 55:     {
 56:         var eventIdStr = RouterState.GetParam("eventId");
 57:         if (Guid.TryParse(eventIdStr, out var id))
 58:         {
 59:             EventId = id;
 60:         }
 61:         await LoadEventDataAsync();
 62:     }
 63: 
 64: 
 65: 
 66: 
 67:     private async Task LoadEventDataAsync()
 68:     {
 69:         _isLoading = true;
 70:         _isCheckingRegistration = true;
 71:         _isCheckingAuth = true;
 72:         _errorMessage = null;
 73: 
 74:         try
 75:         {
 76:             Logger.LogInformation("Loading event {EventId}", EventId);
 77:             _eventDetails = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(EventId);
 78: 
 79:             if (_eventDetails != null)
 80:             {
 81:                 Logger.LogInformation("Loaded event: {Title}", _eventDetails.Title);
 82:                 _appearance = EventAppearanceMetadataHelper.Parse(_eventDetails.MetadataJson);
 83: 
 84: 
 85:                 _eventSessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
 86:                 _primarySession = _eventSessions?.FirstOrDefault();
 87:                 Logger.LogInformation("Loaded {SessionCount} sessions", _eventSessions?.Count ?? 0);
 88: 
 89: 
 90:                 var registrationTask = CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
 91:                 var authTask = CheckDeleteAuthorizationAsync();
 92:                 var aspectsTask = LoadEventAspectsAsync();
 93:                 await Task.WhenAll(registrationTask, authTask, aspectsTask);
 94:             }
 95:         }
 96:         catch (Exception ex)
 97:         {
 98:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load event details: {ex.Message}";
 99:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load event {EventId}", EventId);
100:         }
101:         finally
102:         {
103:             _isLoading = false;
104:             _isCheckingRegistration = false;
105:             _isCheckingAuth = false;
106:         }
107:     }
108: 
109: 
110: 
111: 
112:     private async Task LoadEventAspectsAsync()
113:     {
114:         try
115:         {
116:             var islamicTask = EventAspectService.GetIslamicAspectAsync(EventId);
117:             var techTask = EventAspectService.GetTechAspectAsync(EventId);
118: 
119:             await Task.WhenAll(islamicTask, techTask);
120: 
121:             _islamicAspect = await islamicTask;
122:             _techAspect = await techTask;
123: 
124:             Logger.LogDebug("Loaded aspects for event {EventId}: Islamic={HasIslamic}, Tech={HasTech}",
125:                 EventId, _islamicAspect != null, _techAspect != null);
126:         }
127:         catch (Exception ex)
128:         {
129:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading event aspects for event {EventId}", EventId);
130:         }
131:     }
132: 
133:     private async Task CheckRegistrationStatusAsync()
134:     {
135:         try
136:         {
137:             var authState = await AuthStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
138:             if (authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
139:             {
140:                 var user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
141:                 if (user?.Id != null)
142:                 {
143:                     var registrations = await EventService.GetRegistrationsByUserAsync(user.Id.Value);
144:                     if (_eventSessions != null && registrations != null)
145:                     {
146:                         var sessionIds = _eventSessions.Select(s => s.Id).ToHashSet();
147:                         var matchingRegistrations = registrations
148:                             .Where(r => sessionIds.Contains(r.EventSessionId) && r.Id.HasValue)
149:                             .ToList();
150:                         _isUserRegistered = matchingRegistrations.Any();
151:                         _userRegistrationIds = matchingRegistrations.Select(r => r.Id!.Value).ToList();
152:                     }
153:                 }
154:             }
155:         }
156:         catch (Exception ex)
157:         {
158:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error checking registration status");
159:         }
160:     }
161: 
162: 
163: 
164: 
165:     private async Task CancelRegistrationAsync()
166:     {
167:         if (!_userRegistrationIds.Any()) return;
168: 
169:         var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
170:             "Cancel Registration",
171:             $"Are you sure you want to cancel your registration for \"{_eventDetails?.Title}\"?",
172:             yesText: "Cancel Registration",
173:             cancelText: "Keep Registration");
174: 
175:         if (confirm != true) return;
176: 
177:         _isCancellingRegistration = true;
178:         StateHasChanged();
179: 
180:         try
181:         {
182:             var allCancelled = true;
183:             foreach (var registrationId in _userRegistrationIds)
184:             {
185:                 var success = await EventService.CancelEventRegistrationAsync(registrationId);
186:                 if (!success) allCancelled = false;
187:             }
188: 
189:             if (allCancelled)
190:             {
191:                 _isUserRegistered = false;
192:                 _userRegistrationIds.Clear();
193:                 Logger.LogInformation("Registration cancelled for event {EventId}", EventId);
194:             }
195:             else
196:             {
197:                 _errorMessage = "Some registrations could not be cancelled. Please try again.";
198: 
199:                 await CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
200:             }
201:         }
202:         catch (Exception ex)
203:         {
204:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error cancelling registration for event {EventId}", EventId);
205:             _errorMessage = "An error occurred while cancelling registration.";
206:         }
207:         finally
208:         {
209:             _isCancellingRegistration = false;
210:             StateHasChanged();
211:         }

367:     private async Task OpenRegistrationDialog()
368:     {
369:         if (_eventDetails == null) return;
370: 
371: 
372:         if (_eventSessions == null || !_eventSessions.Any())
373:         {
374:             await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
375:                 "Registration unavailable",
376:                 "No sessions are available for this event yet.",
377:                 yesText: "OK");
378:             return;
379:         }
380: 
381: 
382:         if (_eventSessions.Count == 1)
383:         {
384:             await RegisterForSession(_eventSessions.First());
385:         }
386: 
387:         else
388:         {
389:             var parameters = new DialogParameters
390:             {
391:                 { "Sessions", _eventSessions.ToList() }
392:             };
393: 
394:             var options = new DialogOptions
395:             {
396:                 CloseOnEscapeKey = true,
397:                 MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
398:                 FullWidth = true,
399:                 Position = DialogPosition.Center
400:             };
401: 
402:             var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Event.SessionSelectionDialog>(
403:                 "Select Session",
404:                 parameters,
405:                 options
406:             );
407: 
408:             var result = await dialog.Result;
409: 
410:             if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is List<Guid> selectedSessionIds)
411:             {
412: 
413:                 int successCount = 0;
414:                 foreach (var sessionId in selectedSessionIds)
415:                 {
416:                     var session = _eventSessions.First(s => s.Id == sessionId);
417:                     if (await RegisterForSession(session))
418:                     {
419:                         successCount++;
420:                     }
421:                 }
422: 
423:                 if (successCount > 0)
424:                 {
425: 
426:                     await CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
427:                     StateHasChanged();
428:                 }
429:             }
430:         }
431:     }

436:     private async Task<bool> RegisterForSession(EventSessionListDto session)
437:     {
438:         var parameters = new DialogParameters
439:         {
440:             { "EventSessionId", session.Id },
441:             { "Title", $"Register for {_eventDetails!.Title} - {session.Title}" }
442:         };
443: 
444:         var options = new DialogOptions
445:         {
446:             CloseOnEscapeKey = true,
447:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium,
448:             FullWidth = true,
449:             Position = DialogPosition.Center
450:         };
451: 
452:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<Components.EventRegistration>(
453:             "Register",
454:             parameters,
455:             options
456:         );
457: 
458:         var result = await dialog.Result;
459: 
460:         if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
461:         {
462:             Logger.LogInformation("Registration completed for session {SessionId}", session.Id);
463: 
464: 
465:             if (_eventSessions != null && _eventSessions.Count == 1)
466:             {
467:                 await CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
468:                 StateHasChanged();
469:             }
470:             return true;
471:         }
472:         return false;
473:     }

132:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mb-4 flex-grow-1">@TruncateText(evt.Description, 100)</MudText>
133:                                         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Primary" EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward" Class="align-self-start px-0">View Details</MudButton>
134:                                     </MudCardContent>
135:                                 </MudCard>
136:                             }
137:                         </div>
138:                     </MudCarouselItem>
139:                 }
140:             </MudCarousel>
141:         }
142:         else
143:         {
144:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="justify-center">No upcoming events found.</MudAlert>
145:         }
146:     </MudContainer>
147: 
148:     <!-- FAQ -->
149:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Medium" Class="mb-16">
150:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Align="Align.Center" Style="font-weight: 700;" Class="mb-8">Frequently Asked Questions</MudText>
151:         <MudExpansionPanels Elevation="0" Class="rounded-xl border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default overflow-hidden">
152:             <MudExpansionPanel Text="Is registration free?">
153:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Yes, signing up is completely free. Some events might have a fee, but most are open to everyone.</MudText>
154:             </MudExpansionPanel>
155:             <MudExpansionPanel Text="How are events selected?">
156:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">We carefully verify organizers and feature only trustworthy, relevant, and community-oriented events.</MudText>
157:             </MudExpansionPanel>
158:             <MudExpansionPanel Text="Can I cancel my participation?">
159:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Absolutely. You can cancel any event with one click from your dashboard.</MudText>
160:             </MudExpansionPanel>
161:         </MudExpansionPanels>
162:     </MudContainer>
163: 
164:     <!-- FINAL CTA -->
165:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="mb-12" id="register">
166:         <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="rounded-xl pa-12 text-center" Style="background: var(--mud-palette-primary-darken); color: white;">
167:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;" Class="mb-4">Ready to Join?</MudText>
168:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="opacity: 0.9; font-weight: 400;" Class="mb-8">Create your account now and get full access to all upcoming events.</MudText>
169:             <div class="d-flex justify-center gap-4">
170:                 <MudButton Href="/login" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Surface" Size="Size.Large" Style="color: var(--mud-palette-primary-darken); font-weight: 700;" Class="rounded-pill px-8">Sign Up Now</MudButton>
171:             </div>
172:         </MudPaper>
173:     </MudContainer>
174: </div>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Organization/MyOrganizations.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/organizations/my"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  6: @attribute [Authorize]
  7: 
  8: <PageTitle>My Organizations</PageTitle>
  9: 
 10: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge" Class="py-4 py-sm-8 py-md-12">
 11:     <!-- Header -->
 12:     <div class="d-flex flex-wrap align-end justify-space-between gap-4 mb-8">
 13:         <div>
 14:             <MudText Typo="Typo.overline" Class="mud-text-secondary" Style="letter-spacing: 0.18em;">MANAGEMENT</MudText>
 15:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4">My Organizations</MudText>
 16:         </div>
 17:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 18:                    Color="Color.Primary"
 19:                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
 20:                    Href="/organization/create">
 21:             Create Organization
 22:         </MudButton>
 23:     </div>
 24: 
 25:     @if (_isLoading)
 26:     {
 27:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
 28:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
 29:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">
 30:                 Loading your organizations...
 31:             </MudText>
 32:         </div>
 33:     }
 34:     else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 35:     {
 36:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="my-4">
 37:             @_errorMessage
 38:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Inherit" OnClick="RetryLoadAsync" Class="ml-4">
 39:                 Retry
 40:             </MudButton>
 41:         </MudAlert>
 42:     }
 43:     else if (_organizations == null || !_organizations.Any())
 44:     {
 45:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
 46:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.Business" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Default" Style="width: 80px; height: 80px; opacity: 0.2;" />
 47:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mt-4">No organizations yet</MudText>
 48:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mb-6">
 49:                 Create an organization to start hosting events
 50:             </MudText>
 51:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 52:                        Color="Color.Primary"
 53:                        Href="/organization/create"
 54:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add">
 55:                 Create your first organization
 56:             </MudButton>
 57:         </div>
 58:     }
 59:     else
 60:     {
 61:         <!-- Search -->
 62:         <MudGrid Class="mb-8">
 63:             <MudItem xs="12">
 64:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
 65:                               Placeholder="Search by name or email..."
 66:                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 67:                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 68:                               Immediate="true"
 69:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 70:                               Margin="Margin.Dense" />
 71:             </MudItem>
 72:         </MudGrid>
 73: 
 74:         @if (!FilteredOrganizations.Any())
 75:         {
 76:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-8">
 77:                 No organizations match your search.
 78:             </MudText>
 79:         }
 80:         else
 81:         {
 82:             <MudGrid>
 83:                 @foreach (var org in FilteredOrganizations)
 84:                 {
 85:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
 86:                         <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column">
 87:                             <div class="d-flex align-center justify-center py-8" style="background-color: @GetOrganizationColor(org.FullName); min-height: 120px;">
 88:                                 <MudAvatar Size="Size.Large"
 89:                                            Color="Color.Surface"
 90:                                            Variant="Variant.Filled">
 91:                                     <MudText Color="Color.Primary" Typo="Typo.h5">@GetInitials(org.FullName)</MudText>
 92:                                 </MudAvatar>
 93:                             </div>
 94: 
 95:                             <MudCardContent Class="flex-grow-1">
 96:                                 <div class="mb-2">
 97:                                     @if (org.CurrentUserRole.HasValue)
 98:                                     {
 99:                                         <MudChip T="string"
100:                                                  Size="Size.Small"
101:                                                  Color="@GetRoleColor(org.CurrentUserRole.Value)"
102:                                                  Variant="Variant.Outlined">
103:                                             @GetRoleName(org.CurrentUserRole.Value)
104:                                         </MudChip>
105:                                     }
106:                                 </div>
107: 
108:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4">@org.FullName</MudText>
109: 
110:                                 <div class="mt-auto">
111:                                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1 mb-1">
112:                                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
113:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary" Style="white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">
114:                                             @org.City, @org.Country
115:                                         </MudText>
116:                                     </div>
117:                                     
118:                                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1">
119:                                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
120:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary" Style="white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">@org.Email</MudText>
121:                                     </div>
122:                                 </div>
123:                             </MudCardContent>
124: 
125:                             <MudCardActions>
126:                                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
127:                                            Color="Color.Primary"
128:                                            Href="@($"/organization/{org.Id}")"
129:                                            EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward">
130:                                     Details
131:                                 </MudButton>
132:                                 <MudSpacer />
133:                                 @if (CanCreateEvents(org))
134:                                 {
135:                                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
136:                                                Color="Color.Primary"
137:                                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
138:                                                Href="@($"/organization/{org.Id}/create-event")">
139:                                         Event
140:                                     </MudButton>
141:                                 }
142:                             </MudCardActions>
143:                         </MudCard>
144:                     </MudItem>
145:                 }
146:             </MudGrid>
147: 
148:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-8 mb-8">
149:                 Showing @FilteredOrganizations.Count() of @_organizations.Count organization(s)
150:             </MudText>
151:         }
152:     }
153: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Organization/OrganizationProfile.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: @using Blazouter.Services
  5: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  6: 
  7: <PageTitle>Organization Profile</PageTitle>
  8: <MudContainer Class="organization-profile">
  9:     @if (_isLoading)
 10:     {
 11:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" />
 12:     }
 13:     else if (_organization == null)
 14:     {
 15:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">Organization not found.</MudAlert>
 16:     }
 17:     else
 18:     {
 19:         <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="organization-profile">
 20:             <!-- Header Section -->
 21:             <div class="organization-profile__header-section mb-6">
 22:                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="organization-profile__header-card">
 23:                     <div class="organization-profile__banner" style="@_bannerStyle"></div>
 24:                     <div class="organization-profile__header-content">
 25:                         <div class="organization-profile__avatar-wrapper">
 26:                             @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_organization.ActorProfilePictureUri))
 27:                             {
 28:                                 <MudImage Src="@_organization.ActorProfilePictureUri"
 29:                                           Alt="@($"{_organization.FullName} Logo")"
 30:                                           Class="organization-profile__avatar-image"
 31:                                           ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" />
 32:                             }
 33:                             else
 34:                             {
 35:                                 <MudImage Src="@GetOrganizationPlaceholder()"
 36:                                           Alt="Organization Logo"
 37:                                           Class="organization-profile__avatar-image"
 38:                                           ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" />
 39:                             }
 40:                         </div>
 41: 
 42:                         <div class="organization-profile__info">
 43:                             <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2 mb-1">
 44:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 700;">@_organization.FullName</MudText>
 45:                                 @if (_organization.ApprovalStatusId == 2)
 46:                                 {
 47:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Verified" Color="Color.Primary" Title="Verified" Size="Size.Small" />
 48:                                 }
 49:                             </div>
 50: 
 51:                             <div class="d-flex align-center gap-4 mb-4 flex-wrap">
 52:                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1">
 53:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 54:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">@_organization.City, @_organization.Country</MudText>
 55:                                 </div>
 56:                                 @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_organization.WebsiteUrl))
 57:                                 {
 58:                                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1">
 59:                                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Language" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 60:                                         <MudLink Href="@_organization.WebsiteUrl" Target="_blank" Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Primary">Website</MudLink>
 61:                                     </div>
 62:                                 }
 63:                             </div>
 64: 
 65:                             <div class="organization-profile__stats d-flex gap-6">
 66:                                 <div class="text-center">
 67:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@_reviews.Count</MudText>
 68:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Reviews</MudText>
 69:                                 </div>
 70:                                 <div class="text-center">
 71:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@(_reviews.Any() && _reviews.Any(r => r.Rating.HasValue) ? _reviews.Where(r => r.Rating.HasValue).Average(r => r.Rating!.Value).ToString("0.0") : "-")</MudText>
 72:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Rating</MudText>
 73:                                 </div>
 74:                             </div>
 75:                         </div>
 76:                     </div>
 77:                 </MudCard>
 78:             </div>
 79: 
 80:             <MudGrid>
 81:                 <!-- Reviews Column -->
 82:                 <MudItem xs="12" md="8">
 83:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mb-4">Reviews</MudText>
 84:                     @if (_reviews.Any())
 85:                     {
 86:                         <MudStack Spacing="3">
 87:                             @foreach (var review in _reviews.Take(3))
 88:                             {
 89:                                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
 90:                                     <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-start mb-2">
 91:                                         <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2">
 92:                                             <MudAvatar Size="Size.Medium" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 93:                                                 @(string.IsNullOrEmpty(review.UserFullName) ? "?" : review.UserFullName.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper())
 94:                                             </MudAvatar>
 95:                                             <div>
 96:                                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2">@review.UserFullName</MudText>
 97:                                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@(review.CreatedAt?.DateTime.ToShortDateString() ?? "Unknown")</MudText>
 98:                                             </div>
 99:                                         </div>
100:                                         <MudRating ReadOnly="true" SelectedValue="@(review.Rating ?? 0)" Size="Size.Small" />
101:                                     </div>
102:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@review.Comment</MudText>
103:                                 </MudCard>
104:                             }
105:                         </MudStack>
106: 
107:                         <div class="d-flex justify-center mt-4">
108:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="ShowAllReviews">View All Reviews</MudButton>
109:                         </div>
110:                     }
111:                     else
112:                     {
113:                         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined">No reviews yet.</MudAlert>
114:                     }
115:                 </MudItem>
116: 
117:                 <!-- Sidebar Info -->
118:                 <MudItem xs="12" md="4">
119:                     <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
120:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-3">About</MudText>
121:                         <MudList T="string" Dense="true" DisablePadding="true">
122:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" IconColor="Color.Primary">
123:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@_organization.Email</MudText>
124:                             </MudListItem>
125:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Work" IconColor="Color.Primary">
126:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Religious Organization</MudText>
127:                             </MudListItem>
128:                         </MudList>
129:                     </MudCard>
130:                 </MudItem>
131:             </MudGrid>
132:         </MudContainer>
133:     }
134: </MudContainer>

324:             isLoading = true;

326:             var eventTypesTask = AdminService.GetEventTypesAsync();
327:             var eventFormatsTask = AdminService.GetEventFormatsAsync();
328:             var eventStatusesTask = AdminService.GetEventStatusesAsync();
329:             var visibilityTypesTask = AdminService.GetVisibilityTypesAsync();
330:             var madhabsTask = AdminService.GetMadhabsAsync();
331: 
332:             await Task.WhenAll(eventTypesTask, eventFormatsTask, eventStatusesTask, visibilityTypesTask, madhabsTask);
333: 
334:             eventTypes = await eventTypesTask;
335:             eventFormats = await eventFormatsTask;
336:             eventStatuses = await eventStatusesTask;
337:             visibilityTypes = await visibilityTypesTask;

352:                     ActorId = currentEvent.ActorId,
353:                     Price = currentEvent.Price,
354:                     CurrencyCode = currentEvent.CurrencyCode,

358:                     EventTypeId = currentEvent.EventTypeId,
359:                     EventFormatId = currentEvent.EventFormatId,
360:                     EventStatusId = currentEvent.EventStatusId,
361:                     VisibilityTypeId = currentEvent.VisibilityTypeId,
362:                     FirstSessionDate = currentEvent.FirstSessionDate,
363:                     LastSessionDate = currentEvent.LastSessionDate,
364:                     MetadataJson = currentEvent.MetadataJson
365:                 };
366:                 _appearance = EventAppearanceMetadataHelper.Parse(currentEvent.MetadataJson);
367: 
368:                 if (currentEvent.FirstSessionDate.HasValue)
369:                 {
370:                     var localStart = currentEvent.FirstSessionDate.Value.LocalDateTime;
371:                     _startDate = localStart.Date;
372:                     _startTime = localStart.TimeOfDay;
373:                 }
374: 
375:                 if (currentEvent.LastSessionDate.HasValue)
376:                 {
377:                     var localEnd = currentEvent.LastSessionDate.Value.LocalDateTime;
378:                     _endDate = localEnd.Date;
379:                     _endTime = localEnd.TimeOfDay;
380:                 }
381: 
382:                 _isOnline = currentEvent.EventFormatId == 2;
383:                 _previewImageUrl = currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri ?? GeneratePlaceholderImage();
384:                 selectedMadhabId = currentEvent.MadhabId;
385:                 selectedTimezone = currentEvent.Timezone;
386: 
387:                 var allCategoriesTask = CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
388:                 var allTagsTask = TagService.GetAllTagsAsync();
389:                 var eventCategoriesTask = CategoryService.GetCategoriesByEventAsync(EventId);
390:                 var eventTagsTask = TagService.GetTagsByEventAsync(EventId);
391:                 var sessionsTask = EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
392: 
393:                 await Task.WhenAll(allCategoriesTask, allTagsTask, eventCategoriesTask, eventTagsTask, sessionsTask);
394: 
395:                 allCategories = await allCategoriesTask;
396:                 allTags = await allTagsTask;
397:                 existingCategoriesRaw = await eventCategoriesTask;
398:                 existingTagsRaw = await eventTagsTask;
399:                 var eventSessions = await sessionsTask;
400: 
401:                 selectedCategoryIds = new HashSet<Guid?>();
402:                 selectedTagIds = new HashSet<Guid?>();
403: 
404:                 sessions = eventSessions?.Select(s => SessionEditorModel.FromDto(s)).ToList() ?? new List<SessionEditorModel>();
405:             }
406:             else
407:             {
408:                 _errorMessage = "Event not found";
409:             }
410:         }
411:         catch (Exception ex)
412:         {
413:             _errorMessage = $"Error loading event: {ex.Message}";
414:         }
415:         finally
416:         {
417:             isLoading = false;
418:         }
419:     }
420: 
421:     private string GeneratePlaceholderImage()
422:     {
423:         if (currentEvent == null) return string.Empty;
424:         var eventTitle = Uri.EscapeDataString(currentEvent.Title ?? "Event");
425:         return $"https://via.placeholder.com/400x250/607D8B/ffffff?text={eventTitle}";
426:     }
427: 
428:     private async Task HandleValidSubmit()
429:     {
430:         if (updateDto == null) return;
431: 
432:         if (_isUploadingImage)
433:         {
434:             _errorMessage = "Please wait for the image upload to complete.";
435:             return;
436:         }
437: 
438:         try
439:         {
440:             updateDto.FirstSessionDate = DateTimeHelper.CombineDateTimeToUtc(_startDate, _startTime);
441:             updateDto.LastSessionDate = DateTimeHelper.CombineDateTimeToUtc(_endDate, _endTime);
442: 
443:             if (_uploadedStorageObjectId.HasValue)
444:             {
445:                 updateDto.FeaturedImageId = _uploadedStorageObjectId.Value;
446:             }
447: 
448:             updateDto.MetadataJson = EventAppearanceMetadataHelper.Upsert(updateDto.MetadataJson, _appearance);
449: 
450:             if (!updateDto.Id.HasValue)
451:             {
452:                 _errorMessage = "Event ID is missing";
453:                 return;
454:             }
455:             var response = await EventService.UpdateEventAsync(updateDto.Id.Value, updateDto);
456: 
457:             if (response?.Success == true)
458:             {
459:                 Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
460:             }
461:             else
462:             {
463:                 _errorMessage = response?.Message ?? "Failed to update event";
464:             }
465:         }
466:         catch (Exception ex)
467:         {
468:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error updating event");
469:             _errorMessage = $"Error updating event: {ex.Message}";
470:         }
471:     }
472: 
473:     private void NavigateBack()
474:     {
475:         Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
476:     }
477: 
478:     private async Task OnImageFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
479:     {
480:         _selectedFileData = fileData;
481:         _uploadError = null;
482: 
483:         if (fileData == null)
484:         {
485:             return;
486:         }
487: 
488:         _isUploadingImage = true;
489:         await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
490: 
491:         try
492:         {
493:             var uploadResult = await ImageStorageService.UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync(fileData);
494: 
495:             if (uploadResult?.Success == true)
496:             {
497:                 _uploadedStorageObjectId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
498:                 _uploadError = null;
499:             }
500:             else
501:             {
502:                 _uploadError = uploadResult?.ErrorMessage ?? "Failed to upload image.";
503:                 await ClearUploadState();
504:             }
505:         }
506:         catch (Exception ex)
507:         {
508:             _uploadError = $"Upload error: {ex.Message}";
509:             await ClearUploadState();
510:         }
511:         finally
512:         {
513:             _isUploadingImage = false;
514:             await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
515:         }
516:     }
517: 
518:     private async Task ClearUploadState()
519:     {
520:         try
521:         {
522:             if (_imageUploadComponent != null)
523:             {
524:                 await _imageUploadComponent.RemoveImage();
525:             }
526:         }
527:         catch { }
528: 
529:         _selectedFileData = null;
530:         if (currentEvent != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri))
531:         {
532:             _previewImageUrl = currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri;
533:         }
534:         else
535:         {
536:             _previewImageUrl = GeneratePlaceholderImage();
537:         }
538:     }
539: 
540:     private void AddSession()
541:     {
542:         sessions.Add(new SessionEditorModel
543:         {
544:             StartTime = _startDate?.Date.Add(_startTime ?? TimeSpan.Zero) ?? DateTime.Today.AddHours(9),
545:             EndTime = _endDate?.Date.Add(_endTime ?? TimeSpan.Zero) ?? DateTime.Today.AddHours(17)
546:         });
547:     }
548: 
549:     private void RemoveSession(int index)
550:     {
551:         if (sessions.Count > 0 && index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
552:         {
553:             sessions.RemoveAt(index);
554:         }
555:     }
556: 
557:     private void OnSessionChanged(int index, SessionEditorModel session)
558:     {
559:         if (index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
560:         {
561:             sessions[index] = session;
562:         }
563:     }
564: 
565:     private string GetCategorySelectionText(List<string> selectedValues)
566:     {
567:         if (selectedValues == null || !selectedValues.Any()) return "Select categories";
568:         return $"{selectedValues.Count} categor{(selectedValues.Count == 1 ? "y" : "ies")} selected";
569:     }
570: 
571:     private string GetTagSelectionText(List<string> selectedValues)
572:     {
573:         if (selectedValues == null || !selectedValues.Any()) return "Select tags";
574:         return $"{selectedValues.Count} tag{(selectedValues.Count == 1 ? "" : "s")} selected";
575:     }
576: }
````

105:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary">Registered Organization</MudText>
106:                     </div>
107:                 </div>
108:             </div>
109: 
110:             <MudCardContent Class="pa-6">
