````razor
114:                         <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
115:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4" Style="font-weight: 700;">General Information</MudText>
116:                             <MudStack Spacing="3">
117:                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
118:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" />
119:                                     <div>
120:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Contact Email</MudText>
121:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">@organization.Email</MudText>
122:                                     </div>
123:                                 </div>
124:                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
125:                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Language" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" />
126:                                     <div>
127:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Website</MudText>
128:                                         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(organization.WebsiteUrl))
129:                                         {
130:                                             <MudLink Href="@organization.WebsiteUrl" Target="_blank" Typo="Typo.body1">@organization.WebsiteUrl</MudLink>
131:                                         }
132:                                         else
133:                                         {
134:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary">Not provided</MudText>
135:                                         }
136:                                     </div>
137:                                 </div>
138:                             </MudStack>
139:                         </MudItem>
140: 
141:                         <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
142:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4" Style="font-weight: 700;">Address</MudText>
143:                             <div class="d-flex gap-3">
144:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" />
145:                                 <div>
146:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">@organization.Address</MudText>
147:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">@organization.Postcode @organization.City</MudText>
148:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Style="font-weight: 600;">@organization.Country</MudText>
149:                                 </div>
150:                             </div>
151:                         </MudItem>
152:                     </MudGrid>
153:                 }
154:                 else
155:                 {
156:                     <MudForm @ref="form" @bind-IsValid="@formValid">
157:                         <MudGrid Spacing="3">
158:                             <MudItem xs="12">
159:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="editModel.FullName"
160:                                               Label="Organization Name"
161:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
162:                                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
163:                                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business"
164:                                               Required="true"
165:                                               RequiredError="Organization name is required" />
166:                             </MudItem>
167: 
168:                             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
169:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="editModel.Email"
170:                                               Label="Email"
171:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
172:                                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
173:                                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email"
174:                                               Required="true"
175:                                               RequiredError="Email is required"
176:                                               Validation="@(new Func<string, string?>(ValidateEmail))" />
177:                             </MudItem>
178: 
179:                             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
180:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="editModel.WebsiteUrl"
181:                                               Label="Website (Optional)"
182:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
183:                                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
184:                                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Language" />
185:                             </MudItem>
186: 
187:                             <MudItem xs="12">
188:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Class="mt-4 mb-2" Color="Color.Primary" Style="font-weight: 700;">Location Details</MudText>
189:                                 <MudDivider Class="mb-4"/>
190:                             </MudItem>
191: 
192:                             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
193:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="editModel.Address"
194:                                               Label="Address"
195:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
196:                                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
197:                                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Home"
198:                                               Required="true"
199:                                               RequiredError="Address is required" />
200:                             </MudItem>
201: 
202:                             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
203:                                 <MudNumericField @bind-Value="editModel.Postcode"
204:                                                  Label="Postcode"
205:                                                  Variant="Variant.Outlined"
206:                                                  Adornment="Adornment.Start"
207:                                                  AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Pin"
208:                                                  Required="true"
209:                                                  RequiredError="Postcode is required"
210:                                                  HideSpinButtons="true"
211:                                                  Min="1000" />
212:                             </MudItem>
213: 
214:                             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
215:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="editModel.City"
216:                                               Label="City"
217:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
218:                                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
219:                                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationCity"
220:                                               Required="true"
221:                                               RequiredError="City is required" />
222:                             </MudItem>
223: 
224:                             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
225:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="editModel.Country"
226:                                               Label="Country"
227:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
228:                                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
229:                                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Public"
230:                                               Required="true"
231:                                               RequiredError="Country is required" />
232:                             </MudItem>
233: 
234:                             <MudItem xs="12">
235:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Class="mt-4 mb-2" Color="Color.Primary" Style="font-weight: 700;">Organization Page Appearance</MudText>
236:                                 <MudDivider Class="mb-4" />
237:                             </MudItem>
238: 
239:                             <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
240:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundColor"
241:                                               Label="Background Color"
242:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
243:                                               InputType="InputType.Color"
244:                                               HelperText="Used when no media URL is provided." />
245:                             </MudItem>
246: 
247:                             <MudItem xs="12" sm="8">
248:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl"
249:                                               Label="Background Media URL"
250:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
251:                                               Placeholder="https://... (image or GIF)" />
252:                             </MudItem>
253: 
254:                             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
255:                                 <MudSelect T="string"
256:                                            Label="Background Effect"
257:                                            Variant="Variant.Outlined"
258:                                            @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundEffect">
259:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("None")">None</MudSelectItem>
260:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("SoftOverlay")">Soft Overlay</MudSelectItem>
261:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("StrongOverlay")">Strong Overlay</MudSelectItem>
262:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("Blur")">Blur</MudSelectItem>
263:                                 </MudSelect>
264:                             </MudItem>
265: 
266:                             <MudItem xs="12" Class="d-flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
267:                                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
268:                                            Color="Color.Primary"
269:                                            OnClick="SaveChanges"
270:                                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Save"
271:                                            Disabled="!formValid || isSaving"
272:                                            Class="rounded-pill px-8">
273:                                     @if (isSaving)
274:                                     {
275:                                         <MudProgressCircular Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" />
276:                                         <span>Saving...</span>
277:                                     }
278:                                     else
279:                                     {
280:                                         <span>Save Changes</span>
281:                                     }
282:                                 </MudButton>
283:                             </MudItem>
284:                         </MudGrid>
285:                     </MudForm>
286:                 }
287:             </MudCardContent>
288:         </MudCard>
289:     }
290: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Organization/OrganizationMembers.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  6: @using Blazouter.Services
  7: 
  8: <PageTitle>Organization Members</PageTitle>
  9: 
 10: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge" Class="py-8">
 11:     <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center flex-wrap gap-4 mb-6">
 12:         <MudStack Row AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="3">
 13:             <MudAvatar Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Rounded="true">
 14:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.People" />
 15:             </MudAvatar>
 16:             <div>
 17:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">Organization Members</MudText>
 18:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Manage access and roles for your organization</MudText>
 19:             </div>
 20:         </MudStack>
 21: 
 22:         @if (currentUserRole.HasValue && currentUserRole.Value != 4) @* 4 = Member *@
 23:         {
 24:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="OpenInviteDialog" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.PersonAdd" Class="rounded-pill">
 25:                 Invite Member
 26:             </MudButton>
 27:         }
 28:     </div>
 29: 
 30:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 31:     {
 32:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _errorMessage = null)">
 33:             @_errorMessage
 34:         </MudAlert>
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
 38:         <div class="d-flex gap-4 mb-6 flex-wrap">
 39:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
 40:                           Placeholder="Search members..."
 41:                           Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 42:                           AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 43:                           Immediate="true"
 44:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 45:                           Margin="Margin.Dense"
 46:                           Class="rounded-pill"
 47:                           Style="max-width: 400px;"/>
 48: 
 49:             <MudSelect T="int?" Label="Role" @bind-Value="_roleFilter" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Style="min-width: 150px;" Clearable="true" Class="rounded-pill">
 50:                 <MudSelectItem Value="(int?)1">Creator</MudSelectItem>
 51:                 <MudSelectItem Value="(int?)2">Co-Owner</MudSelectItem>
 52:                 <MudSelectItem Value="(int?)3">Admin</MudSelectItem>
 53:                 <MudSelectItem Value="(int?)4">Member</MudSelectItem>
 54:             </MudSelect>
 55:         </div>
 56: 
 57:         <MudTable Items="@FilteredMembers" Hover="true" Loading="@_loading" Striped="true" Elevation="0" Class="border-none" Breakpoint="Breakpoint.Sm">
 58:             <HeaderContent>
 59:                 <MudTh>User</MudTh>
 60:                 <MudTh>Email</MudTh>
 61:                 <MudTh>Role</MudTh>
 62:                 @if (currentUserRole.HasValue && currentUserRole.Value != 4) @* 4 = Member *@
 63:                 {
 64:                     <MudTh Style="text-align:right">Actions</MudTh>
 65:                 }
 66:             </HeaderContent>
 67:             <RowTemplate>
 68:                 <MudTd DataLabel="User">
 69:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
 70:                         <MudAvatar Color="Color.Secondary" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled">@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.UserEmail) ? "?" : context.UserEmail.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper())</MudAvatar>
 71:                         @if (context.UserId == Guid.Empty)
 72:                         {
 73:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-style: italic;" Color="Color.Secondary">Pending Invite</MudText>
 74:                         }
 75:                         else
 76:                         {
 77:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">@(context.UserFullName ?? context.UserEmail)</MudText>
 78:                         }
 79:                     </div>
 80:                 </MudTd>
 81:                 <MudTd DataLabel="Email">
 82:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@context.UserEmail</MudText>
 83:                 </MudTd>
 84:                 <MudTd DataLabel="Role">
 85:                     <MudChip T="string" Color="@GetRoleColor(context.OrganizationRoleId ?? 0)" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled">@GetRoleName(context.OrganizationRoleId ?? 0)</MudChip>
 86:                 </MudTd>
 87:                 @if (currentUserRole.HasValue && currentUserRole.Value != 4) @* 4 = Member *@
 88:                 {
 89:                     <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Style="text-align:right">
 90:                         @if (context.OrganizationRoleId != 1) @* 1 = Creator *@
 91:                         {
 92:                             <MudMenu Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MoreVert" Size="Size.Small" Dense="true" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomRight" TransformOrigin="Origin.TopRight">
 93:                                 <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => OpenEditRoleDialog(context))" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit">Change Role</MudMenuItem>
 94:                                 <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => RemoveMember(context))" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" IconColor="Color.Error">Remove</MudMenuItem>
 95:                             </MudMenu>
 96:                         }
 97:                     </MudTd>
 98:                 }
 99:             </RowTemplate>
100:             <NoRecordsContent>
101:                 <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center pa-8">
102:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.PersonSearch" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Default" />
103:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-2" Style="font-weight: 700;">No members found</MudText>
104:                 </div>
105:             </NoRecordsContent>
106:         </MudTable>
107:     </MudPaper>
108: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/User/UserProfile.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/user/profile"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  6: @attribute [Authorize]
  7: 
  8: <PageTitle>User Profile</PageTitle>
  9: 
 10: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="py-8">
 11:     @if (IsLoading)
 12:     {
 13:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
 14:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 15:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mt-4" Color="Color.Secondary">Loading profile...</MudText>
 16:         </div>
 17:     }
 18:     else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ErrorMessage))
 19:     {
 20:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6">@ErrorMessage</MudAlert>
 21:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="@LoadUserDataAsync">Retry</MudButton>
 22:     }
 23:     else if (UserData == null)
 24:     {
 25:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Variant="Variant.Filled">
 26:             Unable to load user profile. Please try logging in again.
 27:         </MudAlert>
 28:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" Href="/login" Class="mt-4">Log In</MudButton>
 29:     }
 30:     else
 31:     {
 32:         <!-- Modern Hero Profile Header -->
 33:         <MudCard Elevation="0" Outlined="true" Class="rounded-xl overflow-hidden mb-6 position-relative">
 34:             <!-- Hero Banner -->
 35:             <div style="height: 200px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--mud-palette-primary) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mud-palette-primary) 60%, black) 100%);"></div>
 36:             
 37:             <div class="px-6 pb-6" style="margin-top: -50px;">
 38:                 <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center">
 39:                     <!-- Avatar -->
 40:                     <MudAvatar Style="width: 120px; height: 120px; font-size: 3rem; border: 4px solid var(--mud-palette-surface);" Class="mb-4 elevation-4">
 41:                         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserData?.ProfileImageUri))
 42:                         {
 43:                             <MudImage Src="@UserData.ProfileImageUri" Alt="Profile picture" ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" />
 44:                         }
 45:                         else
 46:                         {
 47:                             @GetInitials()
 48:                         }
 49:                     </MudAvatar>
 50: 
 51:                     <!-- User Info -->
 52:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;" Align="Align.Center">@GetFullName()</MudText>
 53:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Align="Align.Center" Class="mb-4">@@@GetUsername()</MudText>
 54: 
 55:                     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetDisplayLocation()) && GetDisplayLocation() != "Location not set")
 56:                     {
 57:                         <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1 mb-6">
 58:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 59:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">@GetDisplayLocation()</MudText>
 60:                         </div>
 61:                     }
 62: 
 63:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Primary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" Href="/settings" Class="rounded-pill px-6">Edit Profile</MudButton>
 64:                 </div>
 65:             </div>
 66: 
 67:             <!-- Stats Bar -->
 68:             <MudDivider />
 69:             <div class="d-flex justify-center gap-16 py-6">
 70:                 <div class="text-center">
 71:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 800; color: var(--mud-palette-primary);">@EventsAttended</MudText>
 72:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Style="text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 600;" Color="Color.Secondary">Events</MudText>
 73:                 </div>
 74:                 <div class="text-center">
 75:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 800; color: var(--mud-palette-primary);">@ReviewsGiven</MudText>
 76:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Style="text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 600;" Color="Color.Secondary">Reviews</MudText>
 77:                 </div>
 78:             </div>
 79:         </MudCard>
 80: 
 81:         <MudGrid Spacing="6">
 82:             <!-- Left Column: About -->
 83:             <MudItem xs="12" md="4">
 84:                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Outlined="true" Class="rounded-xl h-100">
 85:                     <MudCardHeader>
 86:                         <CardHeaderContent>
 87:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700;">About</MudText>
 88:                         </CardHeaderContent>
 89:                     </MudCardHeader>
 90:                     <MudCardContent>
 91:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-6">
 92:                             Member of the community
 93:                         </MudText>
 94: 
 95:                         <MudList T="string" Dense="true" DisablePadding="true">
 96:                             @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserData.Email))
 97:                             {
 98:                                 <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" IconColor="Color.Primary">
 99:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@UserData.Email</MudText>
100:                                 </MudListItem>
101:                             }
102: 
103:                             @if (UserData.EmailVerified == true)
104:                             {
105:                                 <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Verified" IconColor="Color.Success">
106:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Email Verified</MudText>
107:                                 </MudListItem>
108:                             }
109:                         </MudList>
110:                     </MudCardContent>
111:                 </MudCard>
112:             </MudItem>
113: 
114:             <!-- Right Column: Reviews -->
115:             <MudItem xs="12" md="8">
116:                 <MudCard Elevation="0" Outlined="true" Class="rounded-xl h-100">
117:                     <MudCardHeader>
118:                         <CardHeaderContent>
119:                             <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center w-100">
120:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700;">Recent Reviews</MudText>
121:                                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Primary" EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward" Href="/user/reviews" Class="rounded-pill">View All</MudButton>
122:                             </div>
123:                         </CardHeaderContent>
124:                     </MudCardHeader>
125:                     <MudCardContent>
126:                         @if (MyReviews != null && MyReviews.Any())
127:                         {
128:                             <MudStack Spacing="3">
129:                                 @foreach (var review in MyReviews.Take(3))
130:                                 {
131:                                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 bg-surface border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
132:                                         <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-start mb-2">
133:                                             <div>
134:                                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 700;">@(review.OrganizationFullName ?? "Organization")</MudText>
135:                                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@(review.CreatedAt?.ToString("MMM dd, yyyy") ?? "")</MudText>
136:                                             </div>
137:                                             <MudRating ReadOnly="true" SelectedValue="@(review.Rating ?? 0)" Size="Size.Small" />
138:                                         </div>
139:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@review.Comment</MudText>
140:                                     </MudPaper>
141:                                 }
142:                             </MudStack>
143:                         }
144:                         else
145:                         {
146:                             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined">No reviews given yet.</MudAlert>
147:                         }
148:                     </MudCardContent>
149:                 </MudCard>
150:             </MudItem>
151:         </MudGrid>
152:     }
153: </MudContainer>
````

````csharp
106:     public async Task<bool> CanDeleteEventAsync(Guid eventId)
107:     {
108:         try
109:         {
110:             var eventResource = await _apiClient.GetEventByIdAsync(eventId);
111:             if (eventResource?.ActorId is null) return false;
112: 
113:             var actorResource = await _apiClient.GetActorByIdAsync(eventResource.ActorId.Value);
114:             if (actorResource?.OrganizationId is null) return true;
115: 
116:             var myOrgs = await _organizationService.GetMyOrganizationsAsync();
117:             return myOrgs?.Any(o => o.Id == actorResource.OrganizationId.Value) ?? false;
118:         }
119:         catch (Exception ex)
120:         {
121:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error checking CanDeleteEvent for {EventId}", eventId);
122:             return false;
123:         }

190: 
191:     public Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> RegisterForEventSessionAsync(CreateEventRegistrationDto registration) => _apiClient.EventregistrationPOSTAsync(registration);
192: 
193:     public Task<ICollection<EventRegistrationListDto>> GetRegistrationsForSessionAsync(Guid sessionId) => _apiClient.BySessionAsync(sessionId);
194: 
195:     public Task<ICollection<EventRegistrationListDto>> GetRegistrationsByUserAsync(Guid userId) => _apiClient.ByUserAsync(userId);
196: 
197:     public Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> UpdateRegistrationAsync(UpdateEventRegistrationDto registration) => _apiClient.EventregistrationPUTAsync(registration.Id ?? Guid.Empty, registration);
198: 
199:     public async Task<bool> CancelEventRegistrationAsync(Guid registrationId)
200:     {
201:         try { await _apiClient.EventregistrationDELETEAsync(registrationId); return true; } catch { return false; }
202:     }
203: 
204:     public async Task<EventSessionDto?> GetSessionByIdAsync(Guid sessionId)
205:     {
206:         try
207:         {
208:             var result = await _apiClient.GetEventSessionByIdAsync(sessionId);
209:             return result?.ToDto();
210:         }
211:         catch (Exception ex)
212:         {
213:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error fetching session {SessionId}", sessionId);
214:             return null;
215:         }
216:     }
217: }
````

````razor
  1: @*
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/CreateEvent.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/create-event"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components

 53:                 <EditForm Model="createDto" OnValidSubmit="@HandleSubmit">

237:                                 </div>

241:                                     {

244:                                             <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center mb-4">

249:                                                 }

252:                                             <EventSessionEditor Session="sessions[index]"

258:                                                                 RegistrationModes="registrationModes"
259:                                                                 ShowLanguageSelector="true"

274:                             </div>

306:                                         <MudStack Spacing="3">

317:                                                 @if (allTags != null)
318:                                                 {

320:                                                     {

322:                                                     }
323:                                                 }
324:                                             </MudSelect>
325:                                         </MudStack>
326:                                     </MudItem>
327: 
328:                                     <MudItem xs="12">
329:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Class="mb-3" Style="font-weight: 700;">Event Appearance</MudText>
330:                                         <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 bg-surface border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
331:                                             <MudGrid Spacing="3">
332:                                                 <MudItem xs="12" md="4">
333:                                                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundColor"
334:                                                                   Label="Background Color"
335:                                                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
336:                                                                   Placeholder="#0f172a" />
337:                                                 </MudItem>
338:                                                 <MudItem xs="12" md="5">
339:                                                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl"
340:                                                                   Label="Background Media URL (Image/GIF)"
341:                                                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
342:                                                                   Placeholder="https://..." />
343:                                                 </MudItem>
344:                                                 <MudItem xs="12" md="3">
345:                                                     <MudSelect @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundEffect"
346:                                                                Label="Effect"
347:                                                                Variant="Variant.Outlined"
348:                                                                AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter">
349:                                                         <MudSelectItem Value="@("None")">None</MudSelectItem>
350:                                                         <MudSelectItem Value="@("SoftOverlay")">Soft Overlay</MudSelectItem>
351:                                                         <MudSelectItem Value="@("StrongOverlay")">Strong Overlay</MudSelectItem>
352:                                                         <MudSelectItem Value="@("Blur")">Blur Overlay</MudSelectItem>
353:                                                     </MudSelect>
354:                                                 </MudItem>
355:                                             </MudGrid>
356:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-2">
357:                                                 This style is applied per event and can differ between events from the same organization.
358:                                             </MudText>
359:                                         </MudPaper>
360:                                     </MudItem>
361:                                 </MudGrid>
362:                             </div>
363:                         </MudTabPanel>
364:                     </MudTabs>
365: 
366:                     <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
367: 
368:                     <div class="d-flex justify-end gap-3">
369:                         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" OnClick="@(() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/events"))" Class="rounded-pill">Cancel</MudButton>
370:                         <MudButton ButtonType="ButtonType.Submit"
371:                                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
372:                                    Color="Color.Primary"

374:                                    StartIcon="@(isProcessing || _isUploadingImage ? null : Icons.Material.Filled.Save)"
375:                                    Class="rounded-pill px-6">
376:                             @if (isProcessing)
377:                             {

379:                                 <span>Creating...</span>
380:                             }
381:                             else if (_isUploadingImage)
382:                             {
383:                                 <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Class="mr-2" />
384:                                 <span>Uploading image...</span>
385:                             }
386:                             else
387:                             {
388:                                 <span>Create Event</span>
389:                             }
390:                         </MudButton>
391:                     </div>
392:                 </EditForm>
393:             </div>
394:         </MudPaper>
395:     }
396: </MudContainer>
````

````razor
 34:     @if (_isLoading)
 35:     {
 36:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
 37:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
 38:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">
 39:                 Loading your events...
 40:             </MudText>
 41:         </div>
 42:     }
 43:     else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 44:     {
 45:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="my-4">
 46:             @_errorMessage
 47:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Inherit" OnClick="RetryLoadAsync" Class="ml-4">
 48:                 Retry
 49:             </MudButton>
 50:         </MudAlert>
 51:     }
 52:     else
 53:     {
 54:         <!-- Filters -->
 55:         <MudGrid Class="mb-8">
 56:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="3">
 57:                 <MudSelect T="Guid?" Value="@_selectedOrganizationId" ValueChanged="@((Guid? v) => OnOrganizationChanged(v))"
 58:                            Label="Organization" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true">
 59:                     <MudSelectItem T="Guid?" Value="@Guid.Empty">All Organizations</MudSelectItem>
 60:                     @foreach (var org in _myOrganizations)
 61:                     {
 62:                         <MudSelectItem T="Guid?" Value="@org.Id">@org.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 63:                     }
 64:                 </MudSelect>
 65:             </MudItem>
 66:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="3">
 67:                 <MudSelect T="string" Value="@_selectedCategory" ValueChanged="@((string? v) => OnCategoryChanged(v))"
 68:                            Label="Event Type" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true">
 69:                     <MudSelectItem T="string" Value="@("")">All Types</MudSelectItem>
 70:                     @foreach (var eventType in UniqueEventTypes)
 71:                     {
 72:                         <MudSelectItem T="string" Value="@eventType">@eventType</MudSelectItem>
 73:                     }
 74:                 </MudSelect>
 75:             </MudItem>
 76:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="6">
 77:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
 78:                               Placeholder="Search events..."
 79:                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 80:                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 81:                               Immediate="true"
 82:                               DebounceInterval="300"
 83:                               TextChanged="OnSearch"
 84:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 85:                               Margin="Margin.Dense" />
 86:             </MudItem>
 87:         </MudGrid>
 88: 
 89:         @if (!FilteredEvents.Any())
 90:         {
 91:             <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
 92:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.Event" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Default" Style="width: 80px; height: 80px; opacity: 0.2;" />
 93:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-4">No events found</MudText>
 94:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
 95:                     @if (_events.Any())
 96:                     {
 97:                         <span>Try adjusting your filters</span>
 98:                     }
 99:                     else
100:                     {
101:                         <span>Create an event to get started</span>
102:                     }
103:                 </MudText>
104:             </div>
105:         }
106:         else
107:         {
108:             <!-- Event Cards -->
109:             <MudGrid>
110:                 @foreach (var evt in FilteredEvents)
111:                 {
112:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
113:                         <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column position-relative">
114:                             <div style="position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; z-index: 10;">
115:                                 <MudMenu Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MoreVert" AriaLabel="Event options" Dense="true" Color="Color.Default" Variant="Variant.Filled" Size="Size.Small" Style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border-radius: 8px;">
116:                                     @if (CanEditEvent(evt))
117:                                     {
118:                                         <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => EditEvent(evt))">
119:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> Edit
120:                                         </MudMenuItem>
121:                                     }
122:                                     <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => ViewEventDetails(evt))">
123:                                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Visibility" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> View Details
124:                                     </MudMenuItem>
125:                                     @if (CanEditEvent(evt))
126:                                     {
127:                                         <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => ViewRegistrations(evt))">
128:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.People" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> Registrations
129:                                         </MudMenuItem>
130:                                         <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => DeleteEvent(evt))" Class="text-error">
131:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> Delete
132:                                         </MudMenuItem>
133:                                     }
134:                                 </MudMenu>
135:                             </div>
136: 
137:                             <MudCardMedia Image="@GetEventImageUrl(evt)" Height="200" />
138:                             
139:                             <MudCardContent Class="flex-grow-1">
140:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.button" Class="mud-text-disabled mb-1">@(evt.EventTypeFullName ?? "Event")</MudText>
141:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4">@evt.Title</MudText>
142:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;">
143:                                     @evt.Description
144:                                 </MudText>
145:                                 
146:                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2 mt-4">
147:                                     <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business">
148:                                         @(evt.ActorDisplayName ?? "Unknown")
149:                                     </MudChip>
150:                                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1 ml-auto">
151:                                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
152:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@(evt.EventFormatFullName ?? "Online")</MudText>
153:                                     </div>
154:                                 </div>
155:                             </MudCardContent>
156: 
157:                             <MudCardActions>
158:                                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
159:                                            Color="Color.Primary"
160:                                            Href="@($"/event/detail/{evt.Id}")"
161:                                            EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward">
162:                                     Details
163:                                 </MudButton>
164:                                 <MudSpacer />
165:                                 @if (CanEditEvent(evt))
166:                                 {
167:                                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Secondary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" OnClick="@(() => EditEvent(evt))">Edit</MudButton>
168:                                 }
169:                             </MudCardActions>
170:                         </MudCard>
171:                     </MudItem>
172:                 }
173:             </MudGrid>
174: 
175:             <!-- Pagination -->
176:             <div class="d-flex justify-center mt-8 mb-4">
177:                 <MudPagination Count="@TotalPages"
178:                                Selected="@_currentPage"
179:                                SelectedChanged="OnPageChanged"
180:                                Color="Color.Primary"
181:                                ShowFirstButton="true"
182:                                ShowLastButton="true" />
183:             </div>
184:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mb-8">
185:                 Showing @((_currentPage - 1) * ItemsPerPage + 1) - @Math.Min(_currentPage * ItemsPerPage, AllFilteredEvents.Count)
186:                 of @AllFilteredEvents.Count events
187:             </MudText>
188:         }
189:     }
190: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/EventDetail.razor

````razor
 53:             @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
````

````csharp
558: static string GetSafeReturnUrl(HttpContext ctx, ILogger logger)
559: {
560:     var returnUrl = ctx.Request.Query["returnUrl"].ToString();
561: 
562:     if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(returnUrl))
563:     {
564:         return "/";
565:     }
566: 
567:     if (returnUrl.StartsWith('/') &&
568:         !returnUrl.StartsWith("//", StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
569:         !returnUrl.StartsWith("/\\", StringComparison.Ordinal))
570:     {
571:         return returnUrl;
572:     }
573: 
574:     logger.LogWarning("[AuthEndpoints] Invalid returnUrl '{ReturnUrl}' - defaulting to /", returnUrl);
575:     return "/";
576: }

578: // Authentication endpoints - using /auth/* paths to avoid conflict with Blazor routes.
579: // The Blazor shim components at /login and /logout force-load these server endpoints.
580: app.MapGet("/auth/challenge", async ctx =>
581: {
582:     var returnUrl = GetSafeReturnUrl(ctx, app.Logger);
583: 
584:     var config = ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IConfiguration>();
585:     app.Logger.LogDebug(
586:         "[AuthEndpoints] /auth/challenge - Config check: Authority={Authority}, HasClientId={HasClientId}, HasSecret={HasSecret}",
587:         config["Keycloak:Authority"],
588:         !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config["Keycloak:ClientId"]),
589:         !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config["Keycloak:ClientSecret"]));
590: 
591:     app.Logger.LogInformation(
592:         "[AuthEndpoints] /auth/challenge hit - Url: {Url} ReturnUrl: {ReturnUrl}",
593:         ctx.Request.GetDisplayUrl(),
594:         returnUrl);
595: 
596:     try
597:     {
598:         await ctx.ChallengeAsync(
599:             OpenIdConnectDefaults.AuthenticationScheme,
600:             new AuthenticationProperties
601:             {
602:                 RedirectUri = returnUrl
603:             });
604:     }
605:     catch (Exception ex)
606:     {
607:         app.Logger.LogError(ex, "[AuthEndpoints] Error during login challenge. Authority: {Authority}, ClientId: {ClientId}, HasSecret: {HasSecret}, InnerException: {Inner}",
608:             config["Keycloak:Authority"],
609:             config["Keycloak:ClientId"],
610:             !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config["Keycloak:ClientSecret"]),
611:             ex.InnerException?.Message);
612:         ctx.Response.StatusCode = 500;
613:         await ctx.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new
614:         {
615:             error = "Login failed. Please try again later."
616:         });
617:     }
618: });

666:     {
667:         var authority = config["Keycloak:Authority"];
668:         var metadataAddress = config["Keycloak:MetadataAddress"] ?? $"{authority}/.well-known/openid-configuration";
669: 
670:         var result = new Dictionary<string, object?>
671:         {
672:             ["authority"] = authority,
673:             ["metadataAddress"] = metadataAddress,
674:             ["hasClientId"] = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config["Keycloak:ClientId"]),
675:             ["hasClientSecret"] = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config["Keycloak:ClientSecret"])
676:         };
677: 
678: 
679:         try
680:         {
681:             using var httpClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient();
682:             httpClient.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
683:             var response = await httpClient.GetAsync(metadataAddress);
684:             result["discoveryStatus"] = (int)response.StatusCode;
685:             result["discoverySuccess"] = response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
686: 
687:             if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
688:             {
689:                 var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
690:                 result["discoveryDocument"] = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<object>(content);
691:             }
692:             else
693:             {
694:                 result["discoveryError"] = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
695:             }
696:         }
697:         catch (Exception ex)
698:         {
699:             result["discoveryError"] = ex.Message;
700:         }
701: 
702:         return Results.Ok(result);
703:     }).RequireAuthorization();
704: }
````
